/* ================= language (i18n.js holds the dictionary) =================
   localStorage "eg-lang" = "ar" (default) | "en"; ?lang=en|ar overrides for one load. The language is read once, before anything is built:
   switching sets the key and reloads, because much of the text is baked into canvases and DOM lists at start-up.
   T(ar) returns the English for an Arabic source string in English mode (exact match, then a match ignoring surrounding spaces), else the string itself. */
const LANG = (() => { let l = "ar"; try { l = localStorage.getItem("eg-lang") || "ar"; } catch (e) {} try { const q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("lang"); if (q === "en" || q === "ar") l = q; } catch (e) {} return l === "en" ? "en" : "ar"; })();
const EN = LANG === "en";

/* ================= ground grid: only the frame (origin, step, size) is kept, to lay out the ground textures. It carries NO heights: the map is flat. ================= */
const DEM = (() => {
  const dec = b => { const s = atob(b), n = s.length >> 1, a = new Int16Array(n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const v = s.charCodeAt(2 * i) | (s.charCodeAt(2 * i + 1) << 8); a[i] = v > 32767 ? v - 65536 : v; } return a; };
  const mk = o => ({lon0: o.lon0, lat0: o.lat0, dl: o.dl, nx: o.nx, ny: o.ny, a: new Int16Array(o.nx * o.ny), e: o.b ? dec(o.b) : null});      /* a: heights used for geometry (none: the map is flat) · e: real elevations, used only to draw contour lines and tint on the flat ground */
  return {fine: mk(D.dem.fine), coarse: mk(D.dem.coarse)};
})();
function demAt(G, lon, lat){
  let fx = (lon - G.lon0) / G.dl, fy = (G.lat0 - lat) / G.dl;
  fx = Math.max(0, Math.min(G.nx - 1.001, fx)); fy = Math.max(0, Math.min(G.ny - 1.001, fy));
  const x0 = fx | 0, y0 = fy | 0, ax = fx - x0, ay = fy - y0, a = G.a, nx = G.nx, i = y0 * nx + x0;
  return (a[i] * (1 - ax) + a[i + 1] * ax) * (1 - ay) + (a[i + nx] * (1 - ax) + a[i + nx + 1] * ax) * ay;
}
const lonOf = x => D.proj.lon0 + x / (SC * CXK), latOf = z => D.proj.lat0 - z / (SC * K);
const inFine = (lo, la) => lo >= DEM.fine.lon0 && lo <= DEM.fine.lon0 + (DEM.fine.nx - 1) * DEM.fine.dl && la <= DEM.fine.lat0 && la >= DEM.fine.lat0 - (DEM.fine.ny - 1) * DEM.fine.dl;
const elevM = (x, z) => { const lo = lonOf(x), la = latOf(z); return inFine(lo, la) ? demAt(DEM.fine, lo, la) : demAt(DEM.coarse, lo, la); };
const RELR = 1.55;                                       // relief height (scene units) of a 2600 m summit: about 15x vertical exaggeration
const relOf = e => e >= 0 ? RELR * Math.pow(e / 2600, 0.9) : -RELR * Math.pow(Math.min(-e, 140) / 2600, 0.9);
const egRings = pathRings(D.egypt);
const TU = {uRel: {value: 1}, uBaseY: {value: H}, uMD: {value: 0}, uBoot: {value: reduce ? 99 : 0}, uCont: {value: 1}, uY0: {value: 0}, uYs: {value: 1}, uTwin: {value: 0}, uNear: {value: 0}, uTLift: {value: 0.003}};
TU.uY0.value = Math.min(...D.govs.map(g => g.bb[1])); TU.uYs.value = Math.max(1, Math.max(...D.govs.map(g => g.bb[1])) - TU.uY0.value);
const RISE_GLSL = `float ie = clamp((uBoot - (0.1 + 1.6 * clamp((position.z / 0.05 - uY0) / uYs, 0.0, 1.0))) / 1.1, 0.0, 1.0); ie = 1.0 - pow(1.0 - ie, 3.0);`;
const TG = DEM.fine, TNX = TG.nx, TNY = TG.ny;
const gxOf = i => (TG.lon0 + i * TG.dl - D.proj.lon0) * CXK * SC;
const gzOf = j => (D.proj.lat0 - (TG.lat0 - j * TG.dl)) * K * SC;
const X0d = (TG.lon0 - D.proj.lon0) * CXK, Y0d = (D.proj.lat0 - TG.lat0) * K;     // data coordinates of grid column 0 / row 0 (north edge)
const XSd = (TNX - 1) * TG.dl * CXK, YSd = (TNY - 1) * TG.dl * K;
const GOVI = {}; D.govs.forEach((g, i) => { GOVI[g.id] = i + 1; });

/* exact (non anti-aliased) scan-line polygon fill into a top-down byte grid; rings = [[outer, hole...], ...] in data coordinates */
function fillPolys(arr, W, Hh, ppu, polys, val){
  const ex = [];
  polys.forEach(poly => poly.forEach(r => { for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i += 2) { const j = (i + 2) % r.length; const x0 = (r[i] - X0d) * ppu, y0 = (r[i + 1] - Y0d) * ppu, x1 = (r[j] - X0d) * ppu, y1 = (r[j + 1] - Y0d) * ppu; if (y0 !== y1) ex.push(y0 < y1 ? [x0, y0, x1, y1] : [x1, y1, x0, y0]); } }));
  ex.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
  for (let y = 0; y < Hh; y++) {
    const yc = y + 0.5, xs = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < ex.length; k++) { const e = ex[k]; if (e[1] > yc) break; if (e[3] > yc) xs.push(e[0] + (yc - e[1]) / (e[3] - e[1]) * (e[2] - e[0])); }
    xs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    for (let k = 0; k + 1 < xs.length; k += 2) { const a = Math.max(0, Math.round(xs[k])), b = Math.min(W, Math.round(xs[k + 1])); for (let x = a; x < b; x++) arr[y * W + x] = val; }
  }
}
function boxBlur(src, W, Hh, r){
  const tmp = new Float32Array(W * Hh), out = new Float32Array(W * Hh), n = 2 * r + 1;
  for (let y = 0; y < Hh; y++) { let s = 0; const o = y * W; for (let x = -r; x <= r; x++) s += src[o + Math.min(W - 1, Math.max(0, x))]; for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) { tmp[o + x] = s / n; s += src[o + Math.min(W - 1, x + r + 1)] - src[o + Math.max(0, x - r)]; } }
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) { let s = 0; for (let y = -r; y <= r; y++) s += tmp[Math.min(Hh - 1, Math.max(0, y)) * W + x]; for (let y = 0; y < Hh; y++) { out[y * W + x] = s / n; s += tmp[Math.min(Hh - 1, y + r + 1) * W + x] - tmp[Math.max(0, y - r) * W + x]; } }
  return out;
}

/* ---- land mask, height field with land extrapolated over the coast ---- */
const MPPU = 1, MW = Math.round(XSd * MPPU), MH = Math.round(YSd * MPPU);
const maskArr = new Uint8Array(MW * MH);
fillPolys(maskArr, MW, MH, MPPU, [egRings.map(r => r)], 1);
const inLand = (i, j) => { const x = Math.min(MW - 1, Math.round(i / (TNX - 1) * (MW - 1))), y = Math.min(MH - 1, Math.round(j / (TNY - 1) * (MH - 1))); return maskArr[y * MW + x] === 1; };
const EM = new Float32Array(TNX * TNY), KN = new Uint8Array(TNX * TNY);
for (let j = 0; j < TNY; j++) for (let i = 0; i < TNX; i++) { const q = j * TNX + i; EM[q] = TG.a[q]; if (inLand(i, j)) KN[q] = 1; }
const NEAR = new Uint8Array(TNX * TNY);
for (let j = 0; j < TNY; j++) for (let i = 0; i < TNX; i++) { if (!KN[j * TNX + i]) continue; for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) { const ii = i + a, jj = j + b; if (ii >= 0 && jj >= 0 && ii < TNX && jj < TNY) NEAR[jj * TNX + ii] = 1; } }
for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) {
  const nk = KN.slice(), ne = EM.slice();
  for (let j = 0; j < TNY; j++) for (let i = 0; i < TNX; i++) { const q = j * TNX + i; if (KN[q]) continue; let s = 0, c = 0;
    for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) { const ii = i + a, jj = j + b; if (ii < 0 || jj < 0 || ii >= TNX || jj >= TNY) continue; const p = jj * TNX + ii; if (KN[p]) { s += EM[p]; c++; } }
    if (c) { ne[q] = s / c; nk[q] = 1; } }
  EM.set(ne); KN.set(nk);
}
const HV = new Float32Array(TNX * TNY);                 // relief height (scene units above the slab top)
for (let q = 0; q < HV.length; q++) HV[q] = KN[q] ? relOf(EM[q]) : 0;

/* relief height at a scene position, read from the same triangles the terrain mesh is drawn with, so anything placed on it sits exactly on the surface */
function relH(x, z){ return 0; }   /* the map is flat: no elevation data is used at all */
function relH0(x, z){
  let fi = (x / (SC * CXK) + D.proj.lon0 - TG.lon0) / TG.dl, fj = (z / (K * SC) - (D.proj.lat0 - TG.lat0)) / TG.dl;
  fi = Math.max(0, Math.min(TNX - 1.0001, fi)); fj = Math.max(0, Math.min(TNY - 1.0001, fj));
  const i = fi | 0, j = fj | 0, fx = fi - i, fy = fj - j, q = j * TNX + i, ha = HV[q], hb = HV[q + 1], hc = HV[q + TNX], hd = HV[q + TNX + 1];
  return fx + fy <= 1 ? ha + fx * (hb - ha) + fy * (hc - ha) : hd + (1 - fx) * (hc - hd) + (1 - fy) * (hb - hd);
}
const onT = off => (x, z) => H + relH(x, z) + off;       // height function for ribbons that hug the ground

function makeSandTex(){
  const s = 256, cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s; const x = cv.getContext("2d");
  const im = x.createImageData(s, s);
  for (let i = 0; i < s * s; i++) { const v = 222 + Math.random() * 33; im.data[i * 4] = v; im.data[i * 4 + 1] = v * 0.97; im.data[i * 4 + 2] = v * 0.93; im.data[i * 4 + 3] = 255; }
  x.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
  for (let j = 0; j < 26; j++) { const cx = Math.random() * s, cy = Math.random() * s, r = 24 + Math.random() * 46, dark = Math.random() < 0.6;
    for (const ox of [-s, 0, s]) for (const oy of [-s, 0, s]) { const g = x.createRadialGradient(cx + ox, cy + oy, 0, cx + ox, cy + oy, r); g.addColorStop(0, dark ? "rgba(110,70,36,.09)" : "rgba(255,236,200,.10)"); g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)"); x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(cx + ox - r, cy + oy - r, r * 2, r * 2); } }
  x.lineWidth = 2.5;
  for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) { x.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,80,40," + (0.035 + Math.random() * 0.04).toFixed(3) + ")"; x.beginPath(); const y0 = Math.random() * s, ph = Math.random() * 6; x.moveTo(0, y0); for (let xx = 0; xx <= s; xx += 16) x.lineTo(xx, y0 + Math.sin(xx / 34 + ph) * 7); x.stroke(); }
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv); t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping; t.repeat.set(0.1, 0.1); t.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
  t.anisotropy = Math.min(8, renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy());
  return t;
}

/* every line on the map is drawn by code as a centre line that the shader widens on the spot: its designed width from afar, but never more than pxMax (nor less than pxMin) pixels on screen, so borders, rivers and canals stay hair-crisp at any zoom */
const ribbonMat = (color, alpha, pulse, edge, speed, pxMax, pxMin) => new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime, uColor: {value: new THREE.Color(color)}, uAlpha: {value: alpha}, uPulse: {value: pulse}, uEdge: {value: edge}, uSpeed: {value: speed || 2.4}, uHot: {value: 0}, uScale: U.uScale, uPR: U.uPR, uPxMax: {value: pxMax || 1e5}, uPxMin: {value: pxMin || 0}},
  transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  vertexShader: `attribute float along; attribute float side; attribute vec2 aN; attribute float aW; uniform float uScale; uniform float uPR; uniform float uPxMax; uniform float uPxMin; varying float vA; varying float vS;
    void main(){ vA = along; vS = side; vec4 wc = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); float k = distance(cameraPosition, wc.xyz) / uScale * 0.5 * uPR;
      float hw = clamp(aW, uPxMin * k, uPxMax * k); vec3 lp = position; lp.xz += aN * side * hw; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(lp, 1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uColor; uniform float uAlpha; uniform float uPulse; uniform float uEdge; uniform float uSpeed; uniform float uHot; varying float vA; varying float vS;
    void main(){ float e = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(vS)), uEdge);
      float p = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(vA * 1.6 - uTime * uSpeed), 8.0);
      float a = uAlpha * e * (0.55 + uPulse * p) * (1.0 + uHot * 1.5);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor * a, a); }`
});

const nileCoreMat = ribbonMat(0x6ff2e4, 0.85, 1.6, 0.7, -3.0, 4, 1.4);
const canalMat = ribbonMat(0x7ff0e6, 0.8, 0.4, 0.7, -2.0, 2.6, 1.0);

function makeLightsMat(){ return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime, uScale: U.uScale, uKP: U.uKP, uFade: {value: 1}}, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
  vertexShader: `attribute float aSize; attribute vec3 aColor; attribute float aRnd; uniform float uTime; uniform float uScale; uniform float uKP;
    varying vec3 vC; varying float vA;
    void main(){ vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0);
      float tw = 0.78 + 0.22 * sin(uTime * (1.2 + aRnd * 2.6) + aRnd * 40.0);
      gl_PointSize = clamp(aSize * uScale / -mv.z, 1.5, 13.0) * (0.75 + 0.25 * uKP);
      vC = aColor; vA = tw; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uFade; varying vec3 vC; varying float vA;
    void main(){ vec2 p = gl_PointCoord - 0.5; float d = length(p) * 2.0; if (d > 1.0) discard;
      float core = exp(-d * d * 9.0) + 0.35 * exp(-d * d * 2.2);
      float a = core * vA * uFade; gl_FragColor = vec4(vC * a, a); }`
}); }
const lightsMat = makeLightsMat();
const dustMat = makeLightsMat(); dustMat.uniforms.uFade.value = 0.5;

/* ================= geometry helpers ================= */
const flatToV2 = f => { const a = []; for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i += 2) a.push(new THREE.Vector2(f[i] * SC, -f[i + 1] * SC)); return a; };
function ribbon(lines, width, y, cum){
  const pos = [], along = [], side = [], idx = [], nrm = [], hwA = [];
  const yf = typeof y === "function" ? y : null;
  lines.forEach(f0 => {
    let f = f0;
    if (yf) { const o = []; for (let i = 0; i < f0.length; i += 2) { if (i > 0) { const dx = (f0[i] - f0[i - 2]) * SC, dz = (f0[i + 1] - f0[i - 1]) * SC, m = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(dx, dz) / 0.2); for (let k = 1; k < m; k++) o.push(f0[i - 2] + (f0[i] - f0[i - 2]) * k / m, f0[i - 1] + (f0[i + 1] - f0[i - 1]) * k / m); } o.push(f0[i], f0[i + 1]); } f = o; }
    const n = f.length / 2; if (n < 2) return;
    const base = pos.length / 3; let acc = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const x = f[i * 2] * SC, z = f[i * 2 + 1] * SC;
      const ia = Math.max(0, i - 1), ib = Math.min(n - 1, i + 1);
      let tx = f[ib * 2] * SC - f[ia * 2] * SC, tz = f[ib * 2 + 1] * SC - f[ia * 2 + 1] * SC;
      const l = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1; tx /= l; tz /= l;
      const nx = -tz, nz = tx, w = width / 2;
      const yy = yf ? yf(x, z) : y; pos.push(x, yy, z, x, yy, z); nrm.push(nx, nz, nx, nz); hwA.push(w, w);
      if (i > 0) acc += Math.hypot(x - f[(i - 1) * 2] * SC, z - f[(i - 1) * 2 + 1] * SC);
      const a = cum ? acc : -z; along.push(a, a); side.push(1, -1);
      if (i < n - 1) { const v = base + i * 2; idx.push(v, v + 1, v + 2, v + 1, v + 3, v + 2); }
    }
  });
  if (!pos.length) return null;
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setAttribute("along", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(along, 1));
  g.setAttribute("side", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(side, 1));
  g.setAttribute("aN", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nrm, 2)); g.setAttribute("aW", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(hwA, 1));
  g.setIndex(idx); return g;
}
function closedLines(rings){ const out = []; rings.forEach(poly => poly.forEach(r => { const a = r.slice(); a.push(r[0], r[1]); out.push(a); })); return out; }
function shapesOf(rings){ return rings.map(r => { const s = new THREE.Shape(flatToV2(r[0])); r.slice(1).forEach(h => s.holes.push(new THREE.Path(flatToV2(h)))); return s; }); }
/* SVG path ("M x,y x,y ... Z") to flat rings */
function pathRings(d){ const out = []; d.split("M").forEach(part => { if (!part) return; const nums = part.replace(/Z/g, "").trim().split(/[ ,]+/).map(Number).filter(v => !isNaN(v)); if (nums.length >= 6) out.push(nums); }); return out; }
/* point in governorate polygon (projected units) */
function govOf(x, z){
  for (const g of D.govs) { const b = g.bb; if (x < b[0] || x > b[2] || z < b[1] || z > b[3]) continue;
    for (const r of g.rings) { const ring = r[0]; let ins = false;
      for (let i = 0, j = ring.length - 2; i < ring.length; j = i, i += 2) { const xi = ring[i], yi = ring[i + 1], xj = ring[j], yj = ring[j + 1];
        if ((yi > z) !== (yj > z) && x < (xj - xi) * (z - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) ins = !ins; }
      if (ins) return g.id; } }
  return null;
}

/* ================= governorate slabs ================= */
const govs = {}, pickMeshes = [], allShapes = [], allRings = [];
const LCLS = [[0.2, [1.0, 0.5, 0.22]], [0.26, [1.0, 0.6, 0.28]], [0.34, [1.0, 0.72, 0.4]], [0.52, [1.0, 0.84, 0.56]]];
const yMin = Math.min(...D.govs.map(g => g.bb[1])), yMax = Math.max(...D.govs.map(g => g.bb[1]));
D.govs.forEach(g => {
  const group = new THREE.Group(); scene.add(group);
  const shapes = shapesOf(g.rings); allShapes.push(...shapes); g.rings.forEach(r => allRings.push(r));
  /* selection, hover and dimming are painted by the governorate's own polygon lying on the ground: a real edge that stays razor-sharp at any zoom (it used to be a texture mask that went soft and blocky close up) */
  const flatGeo = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(shapes); flatGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const flatMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0x000000, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -2, toneMapped: false});
  const flat = new THREE.Mesh(flatGeo, flatMat); flat.position.y = H; flat.renderOrder = 1; flat.visible = false; flat.frustumCulled = false; scene.add(flat);
  const geo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shapes, {depth: H - 0.14, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 1}); geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const base = col(TOPC[REGION[g.id]]);
  const topMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: base.clone(), roughness: 0.9, metalness: 0, emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000)});
  const sideMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: SIDE.clone(), roughness: 0.8, metalness: 0.05, emissive: new THREE.Color(0x0b0502)});
  /* the extruded polygon is only a column for the density mode; the relief itself is the terrain mesh */
  topMat.transparent = sideMat.transparent = true; topMat.depthWrite = sideMat.depthWrite = false;      /* density columns are tinted glass: the map underneath always reads through */
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, [topMat, sideMat]); mesh.userData.id = g.id; mesh.visible = false; mesh.frustumCulled = false; mesh.renderOrder = 2; scene.add(mesh); pickMeshes.push(mesh);
  const oMat = ribbonMat(0xffc98a, 0.5, 0.3, 1.2, 1.4, 2.4, 1.1);
  const outline = new THREE.Mesh(ribbon(closedLines(g.rings), 0.075, onT(0.03), true), oMat); outline.renderOrder = 4; group.add(outline);
  const lp = [], ls = [], lc = [], lr = [];
  g.lights.forEach((arr, c) => { for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 2) { lp.push(arr[i] * SC, H + relH(arr[i] * SC, arr[i + 1] * SC) + 0.035, arr[i + 1] * SC); ls.push(LCLS[c][0] * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4)); lc.push(...LCLS[c][1]); lr.push(Math.random()); } });
  if (lp.length) {
    const pg = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    pg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(lp, 3)); pg.setAttribute("aSize", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(ls, 1));
    pg.setAttribute("aColor", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(lc, 3)); pg.setAttribute("aRnd", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(lr, 1));
    const pts = new THREE.Points(pg, lightsMat); pts.renderOrder = 3; group.add(pts);
  }
  /* water: the Nile between its real banks and the lakes, one mesh per governorate */
  if (g.lakes.length) { const lg = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(shapesOf(g.lakes)); lg.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); lg.translate(0, H + 0.004, 0); const lm = new THREE.Mesh(lg, lakeMat); lm.renderOrder = 1; group.add(lm); natWater.push(lm); }
  [[g.nile, 0.95, nileGlowMat], [g.nile, 0.16, nileCoreMat], [g.canal, 0.14, canalMat], [g.minor, 0.1, minorMat]].forEach(([lines, w, m]) => {
    const rg = ribbon(lines, w, onT(0.035 + w * 0.002), false); if (rg) { const rm = new THREE.Mesh(rg, m); rm.renderOrder = 2; group.add(rm); }
  });
  const cx = (g.bb[0] + g.bb[2]) / 2 * SC, cz = (g.bb[1] + g.bb[3]) / 2 * SC;
  govs[g.id] = {id: g.id, g, group, col: mesh, topMat, sideMat, oMat, flat, flatMat, base, cx, cz, lx: g.lx * SC, lz: g.ly * SC, ty: relH(g.lx * SC, g.ly * SC), s: 1, k: 1,
    heat: 0, tHeat: 0, sel: 0, hov: 0, dim: 1, tDim: 1, intro: reduce ? 1 : 0, delay: 0.1 + 1.6 * (g.bb[1] - yMin) / (yMax - yMin)};
});

/* ================= the country silhouette, shared by the layer plates and the scan sweep ================= */
const egShapes = egRings.map(r => new THREE.Shape(flatToV2(r)));
const plateFillGeo = (() => { const g = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(egShapes); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); return g; })();
const plateEdgeGeo = ribbon(egRings.map(r => r.concat([r[0], r[1]])), 0.14, 0, true);
const plateGovGeo = ribbon(closedLines(allRings.map(r => r)), 0.05, 0, true);
const PT = 1.0;                                 // layer plate thickness
const plateSolidGeo = (() => { const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(egShapes, {depth: PT, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 1}); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, -PT, 0); return g; })();
/* each layer owns a pattern that fits its content: honeycomb for housing, lanes for transport, live grid for energy, flowing waves for water, hatch for industry, dot matrix for people, triangles for heritage, bit cells for the digital state */
const gridMat = (c, type) => new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime, uC: {value: new THREE.Color(c)}, uA: {value: 0}, uType: {value: type}}, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, extensions: {derivatives: true},
  vertexShader: `varying vec3 vW; void main(){ vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); vW = w.xyz; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * w; }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uA; uniform float uType; varying vec3 vW;
    float hash(vec2 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453); }
    float aa(float d, float w, float px){ return 1.0 - smoothstep(w, w + px * 1.5, d); }
    void main(){
      vec2 q = vW.xz / 1.1; vec2 fw = fwidth(q); float px = max(fw.x, fw.y);
      float line = 0.0, fill = 0.0, pulse = 0.0;
      if (uType < 0.5) {                                   // honeycomb
        vec2 r = vec2(1.0, 1.7320508); vec2 h = r * 0.5; vec2 a = mod(q * 0.9, r) - h; vec2 b = mod(q * 0.9 - h, r) - h;
        vec2 gv = dot(a, a) < dot(b, b) ? a : b; float hd = max(dot(abs(gv), normalize(vec2(1.0, 1.7320508))), abs(gv.x));
        line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.5 - 0.03 - px, 0.5 - 0.03, abs(0.5 - hd) + 0.0) * 0.0; line = smoothstep(0.5 - 0.05 - px, 0.5 - 0.02, hd);
        vec2 id = floor(q * 0.9 / r * 2.0); fill = step(0.92, hash(id + floor(uTime * 0.35))) * 0.5;
      } else if (uType < 1.5) {                            // lanes
        float l = aa(abs(fract(q.x * 0.7) - 0.5) * 2.0 - 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        float d = abs(fract(q.x * 0.7) - 0.5); line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.04 + px * 0.6, d);
        float dash = step(0.55, fract(q.y * 0.9 - uTime * 0.7 * (mod(floor(q.x * 0.7), 2.0) < 0.5 ? 1.0 : -1.0)));
        line *= mix(0.25, 1.0, dash); pulse = 0.0;
      } else if (uType < 2.5) {                            // energy grid with travelling pulses
        vec2 g = abs(fract(q - 0.5) - 0.5); float d = min(g.x, g.y); line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.03 + px, d);
        float tx = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(q.x * 2.4 - uTime * 2.6 + floor(q.y) * 1.7), 10.0), ty = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(q.y * 2.4 - uTime * 2.2 + floor(q.x) * 2.3), 10.0);
        pulse = line * (tx + ty);
      } else if (uType < 3.5) {                            // flowing water
        float wv = abs(fract(q.y * 0.95 + sin(q.x * 0.8 + uTime * 0.55) * 0.22 - uTime * 0.05) - 0.5) * 2.0; line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.1 + px, wv);
        line *= 0.8 + 0.2 * sin(q.x * 1.3 - uTime);
      } else if (uType < 4.5) {                            // industrial hatch
        float d = abs(fract((q.x + q.y) * 0.85) - 0.5); line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.05 + px, d);
        vec2 c = floor(q * 1.7); fill = step(0.93, hash(c + floor(uTime * 0.4))) * 0.45;
      } else if (uType < 5.5) {                            // people: dot matrix
        vec2 g = fract(q * 1.05) - 0.5; float d = length(g); float beat = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(uTime * 1.6 + (floor(q.x) + floor(q.y)) * 0.6);
        line = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.07 + px, 0.11 + px * 2.0, d)) * (0.45 + 0.55 * beat);
      } else if (uType < 6.5) {                            // heritage: triangular lattice
        vec2 p = q * 0.9; float a1 = abs(fract(p.x) - 0.5), a2 = abs(fract(p.x * 0.5 + p.y * 0.8660254) - 0.5), a3 = abs(fract(-p.x * 0.5 + p.y * 0.8660254) - 0.5);
        line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.035 + px, min(a1, min(a2, a3)));
      } else {                                              // digital: bit cells
        vec2 cc = floor(q * 1.6); vec2 g = abs(fract(q * 1.6 - 0.5) - 0.5); line = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.02 + px * 1.3, min(g.x, g.y))) * 0.55;
        float rr = hash(cc + floor(uTime * 0.7 * (0.3 + hash(cc.yx)))); fill = step(0.86, rr) * 0.55 * step(hash(cc), 0.6);
      }
      float scan = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(vW.z * 1.7 - uTime * 0.9), 12.0);
      float a = (0.045 + line * 0.26 + fill + pulse * 0.5 + scan * 0.08) * uA; gl_FragColor = vec4(uC * (0.8 + scan + pulse), a); }`
});
const plates = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
  const grp = new THREE.Group(); grp.visible = false; scene.add(grp);
  const c = col(SECC[i]);
  const capMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: c.clone().multiplyScalar(0.4), emissive: c.clone().multiplyScalar(0.2), roughness: 0.9, metalness: 0.0, transparent: true, opacity: 0.0, depthWrite: false});
  const sideMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: c.clone().multiplyScalar(0.6), emissive: c.clone().multiplyScalar(0.5), roughness: 0.8, metalness: 0.0, transparent: true, opacity: 0.0, depthWrite: false});
  const solid = new THREE.Mesh(plateSolidGeo, [capMat, sideMat]); solid.renderOrder = 1; solid.scale.y = 0.16; grp.add(solid);   /* thin glass sheets, not slabs */
  const gm = gridMat(SECC[i], i); const grid = new THREE.Mesh(plateFillGeo, gm); grid.position.y = 0.02; grid.renderOrder = 3; grp.add(grid);
  const gvm = ribbonMat(SECC[i], 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0); const gv = new THREE.Mesh(plateGovGeo, gvm); gv.position.y = 0.03; gv.renderOrder = 3; grp.add(gv);
  const em = ribbonMat(SECC[i], 0.9, 0.5, 1.2, 1.4);
  const edge = new THREE.Mesh(plateEdgeGeo, em); edge.position.y = 0.04; edge.renderOrder = 4; grp.add(edge);
  const em2 = ribbonMat(SECC[i], 0.5, 0.3, 1.2, -1.4);
  const edge2 = new THREE.Mesh(plateEdgeGeo, em2); edge2.position.y = -PT - 0.02; edge2.renderOrder = 4; grp.add(edge2);
  plates.push({grp, capMat, sideMat, gm, gvm, em, em2, y: 0, a: 0, sel: 0});
}

/* dust motes */
const dust = (() => {
  const N = coarse ? 240 : 480, p = new Float32Array(N * 3), s = [], c = [], r = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { p[i * 3] = EC.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100; p[i * 3 + 1] = 0.8 + Math.random() * 30; p[i * 3 + 2] = EC.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 92;
    s.push(0.12 + Math.random() * 0.2); c.push(...(Math.random() < 0.35 ? [1, 0.62, 0.3] : [0.3, 0.9, 0.85])); r.push(Math.random()); }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(p, 3));
  g.setAttribute("aSize", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(s, 1)); g.setAttribute("aColor", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(c, 3)); g.setAttribute("aRnd", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(r, 1));
  const o = new THREE.Points(g, dustMat); o.frustumCulled = false; scene.add(o); return o;
})();


/* ================= ground: a flat map drawn only from OpenFreeMap layers (land, land cover, water). No elevation data, no contours. ================= */
/* ---- mesh ---- */
const tPos = new Float32Array(TNX * TNY * 3), tNor = new Float32Array(TNX * TNY * 3), tUv = new Float32Array(TNX * TNY * 2), tK = new Float32Array(TNX * TNY).fill(1);
const dxs = gxOf(1) - gxOf(0), dzs = gzOf(1) - gzOf(0);
for (let j = 0; j < TNY; j++) for (let i = 0; i < TNX; i++) {
  const q = j * TNX + i, h = HV[q];
  tPos[q * 3] = gxOf(i); tPos[q * 3 + 1] = H + h; tPos[q * 3 + 2] = gzOf(j);
  tUv[q * 2] = i / (TNX - 1); tUv[q * 2 + 1] = 1 - j / (TNY - 1);
  const hE = HV[j * TNX + Math.min(TNX - 1, i + 1)], hW = HV[j * TNX + Math.max(0, i - 1)], hS = HV[Math.min(TNY - 1, j + 1) * TNX + i], hN = HV[Math.max(0, j - 1) * TNX + i];
  let nx = -(hE - hW) / (2 * dxs), nz = -(hS - hN) / (2 * dzs); const l = Math.hypot(nx, 1, nz);
  tNor[q * 3] = nx / l; tNor[q * 3 + 1] = 1 / l; tNor[q * 3 + 2] = nz / l;
}
const tIdx = [];
for (let j = 0; j < TNY - 1; j++) for (let i = 0; i < TNX - 1; i++) {
  const a = j * TNX + i, b = a + 1, c = a + TNX, d = c + 1;
  if (!(NEAR[a] || NEAR[b] || NEAR[c] || NEAR[d])) continue;
  tIdx.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
}
const terrainGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
terrainGeo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(tPos, 3)); terrainGeo.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(tNor, 3));
terrainGeo.setAttribute("aE", new THREE.BufferAttribute(Float32Array.from(EM), 1));
terrainGeo.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.BufferAttribute(tUv, 2)); terrainGeo.setAttribute("aK", new THREE.BufferAttribute(tK, 1));
terrainGeo.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Uint32Array(tIdx), 1));
terrainGeo.computeBoundingSphere(); terrainGeo.boundingSphere.radius += 4;

/* flat land: the national outline as vector triangles, so the coast is a crisp, anti-aliased edge instead of a texture-alpha staircase */
const landGeo = (() => { const pos = [], uv = [], idx = [], x0 = gxOf(0), x1 = gxOf(TNX - 1), z0 = gzOf(0), z1 = gzOf(TNY - 1);
  egRings.forEach(r => { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i += 2) pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(r[i] * SC, r[i + 1] * SC));
    if (pts.length > 3 && pts[0].distanceTo(pts[pts.length - 1]) < 1e-6) pts.pop(); if (pts.length < 3) return;
    const base = pos.length / 3, tris = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(pts, []);
    pts.forEach(p => { pos.push(p.x, H, p.y); uv.push((p.x - x0) / (x1 - x0), 1 - (p.y - z0) / (z1 - z0)); });
    tris.forEach(t => { const a = pts[t[0]], b = pts[t[1]], c = pts[t[2]], ny = (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x) - (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y); if (ny >= 0) idx.push(base + t[0], base + t[1], base + t[2]); else idx.push(base + t[0], base + t[2], base + t[1]); }); });
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(), n = pos.length / 3, nor = new Float32Array(n * 3); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) nor[i * 3 + 1] = 1;
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); g.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
  g.setAttribute("aK", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n), 1)); g.setAttribute("aE", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n), 1));
  g.setIndex(n > 65535 ? new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Uint32Array(idx), 1) : new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Uint16Array(idx), 1)); g.computeBoundingSphere(); g.boundingSphere.radius += 4; return g; })();
/* elevation in metres as a texture (16 bits in two channels), read with a hand-made bilinear filter: contour lines and relief tint on a flat ground, no relief mesh */
const elevTex = (() => { const E = TG.e, b = new Uint8Array(TNX * TNY * 4); for (let j = 0; j < TNY; j++) for (let i = 0; i < TNX; i++) { const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(65535, Math.round(((E ? E[j * TNX + i] : 0) + 500) / 4000 * 65535))), o = ((TNY - 1 - j) * TNX + i) * 4; b[o] = v >> 8; b[o + 1] = v & 255; b[o + 3] = 255; }
  const t = new THREE.DataTexture(b, TNX, TNY, THREE.RGBAFormat); t.minFilter = t.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter; t.generateMipmaps = false; t.needsUpdate = true; return t; })();
TU.uContOn = {value: TG.e ? 1 : 0};
/* ---- colour map: one flat ground tone and the OpenFreeMap water. Nothing else is painted on the land:
   OpenFreeMap's farmland / built-up polygons cover Egypt only in patches (the delta is mostly untagged), so drawing them would mislead. ---- */
const PPU = (coarse || innerWidth < 900) ? 0.9 : 1.75;
const CW = Math.round(XSd * PPU), CH = Math.round(YSd * PPU);
const colorCanvas = document.createElement("canvas"); colorCanvas.width = CW; colorCanvas.height = CH;
const GROUND = {sand: {base: "#b4824c", water: "#12808c"}, twin: {base: "#0f2149", water: "#1b6fb0"}};
function paintTerrain(cv, twin){
  cv = cv || colorCanvas;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d"), G = twin ? GROUND.twin : GROUND.sand;
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0); ctx.fillStyle = G.base; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CW, CH);
  ctx.setTransform(PPU, 0, 0, PPU, -X0d * PPU, -Y0d * PPU);
  ctx.fillStyle = G.water; D.lakes.forEach(l => ctx.fill(new Path2D(l.d)));
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);   /* no cut-out here: the land's outline is the geometry itself */
}
paintTerrain();
const colorTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(colorCanvas); colorTex.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding; colorTex.anisotropy = Math.min(8, renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy());
colorTex.wrapS = colorTex.wrapT = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
let twinTex = null;
function getTwinTex(){
  if (twinTex) return twinTex;
  const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = CW; cv.height = CH; paintTerrain(cv, true);

}

/* ---- governorate id map (exact, no anti-aliasing) and a tiny state texture that drives selection, hover, dimming and density tint ---- */
const IPPU = PPU * 0.5, IW = Math.round(XSd * IPPU), IH = Math.round(YSd * IPPU);
const idArr = new Uint8Array(IW * IH);
D.govs.forEach(g => fillPolys(idArr, IW, IH, IPPU, g.rings, GOVI[g.id] * 9));
const idBuf = new Uint8Array(IW * IH * 4);
for (let y = 0; y < IH; y++) for (let x = 0; x < IW; x++) { const v = idArr[y * IW + x], o = ((IH - 1 - y) * IW + x) * 4; idBuf[o] = v; idBuf[o + 3] = 255; }
const idTex = new THREE.DataTexture(idBuf, IW, IH, THREE.RGBAFormat); idTex.minFilter = idTex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter; idTex.generateMipmaps = false; idTex.needsUpdate = true;
const govBuf = new Uint8Array(32 * 4); for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) govBuf[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
const govTex = new THREE.DataTexture(govBuf, 32, 1, THREE.RGBAFormat); govTex.minFilter = govTex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter; govTex.generateMipmaps = false; govTex.needsUpdate = true;
/* anti-aliased mask of the selected (red) and hovered (green) governorate, redrawn only when either changes */
const SMW = Math.min(2048, Math.round(XSd * PPU * 1.6)), SMH = Math.round(SMW * YSd / XSd), SMK = SMW / XSd;
const selMaskCv = document.createElement("canvas"); selMaskCv.width = SMW; selMaskCv.height = SMH; const selMaskCx = selMaskCv.getContext("2d");
const selMaskTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(selMaskCv); selMaskTex.generateMipmaps = false; selMaskTex.minFilter = selMaskTex.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
const SELU = {k: {value: 0}, h: {value: 0}, d: {value: 1}}; let maskSel = null, maskHov = null, maskSig = "";
function drawGovMask(id, col){
  const g = D.govs.find(q => q.id === id); if (!g) return;
  selMaskCx.fillStyle = col; selMaskCx.beginPath();
  g.rings.forEach(poly => poly.forEach(r => { for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i += 2) { const x = (r[i] - X0d) * SMK, y = (r[i + 1] - Y0d) * SMK; if (i) selMaskCx.lineTo(x, y); else selMaskCx.moveTo(x, y); } selMaskCx.closePath(); }));
  selMaskCx.fill("evenodd");
}
function terrainGovUpdate(){
  const hi = S.theme === "twin" ? [0.25, 0.62, 1.0] : [1.0, 0.72, 0.42], near = ZS.close, y = H + TU.uTLift.value + 0.00002, show = (1 - mL) * (1 - mD);
  for (const id in govs) { const o = govs[id], m = o.flatMat, lit = o.sel * 0.17 + o.hov * 0.09;
    if (lit > 0.004) { if (m.blending !== THREE.AdditiveBlending) m.blending = THREE.AdditiveBlending; m.color.setRGB(hi[0], hi[1], hi[2]); m.opacity = lit * (1 - near) * show; }
    else { if (m.blending !== THREE.NormalBlending) m.blending = THREE.NormalBlending; m.color.setRGB(0.008, 0.02, 0.07); m.opacity = (1 - o.dim) * (1 - 0.7 * near) * show; }
    o.flat.visible = m.opacity > 0.004; o.flat.position.y = y; }
}
/* which governorate lies under a screen ray: march the ray down onto the relief, then test the polygons */
function groundHit(ray){
  /* the map is flat: the ground is the plane y = H, so the hit is exact at any distance (the old relief march gave up beyond ~60 units) */
  const o = ray.ray.origin, d = ray.ray.direction; if (d.y > -1e-4) return null;
  const t = (H - o.y) / d.y; if (!(t > 0)) return null;
  const tx = o.x + d.x * t, tz = o.z + d.z * t; return {x: tx, z: tz, id: govOf(tx / SC, tz / SC)};
}

/* ---- materials ---- */
function reliefHook(mat, key, frag, withE){
  mat.customProgramCacheKey = () => key;
  mat.onBeforeCompile = sh => {
    sh.uniforms.uRel = TU.uRel; sh.uniforms.uBaseY = TU.uBaseY; sh.uniforms.uBoot = TU.uBoot; sh.uniforms.uY0 = TU.uY0; sh.uniforms.uYs = TU.uYs; sh.uniforms.uTLift = TU.uTLift;
    sh.vertexShader = sh.vertexShader.replace("#include <common>", "#include <common>\nattribute float aK;\nuniform float uTLift;\nuniform float uRel;\nuniform float uBaseY;\nuniform float uBoot;\nuniform float uY0;\nuniform float uYs;" + (withE ? "\nattribute float aE;\nvarying float vE;" : ""))
      .replace("#include <beginnormal_vertex>", "float kk = mix(1.0, uRel, aK); vec3 objectNormal = normalize(vec3(normal.x * kk, normal.y, normal.z * kk));")
      .replace("#include <begin_vertex>", "vec3 transformed = vec3(position); transformed.y += aK * (uRel - 1.0) * (position.y - uBaseY);\n" + RISE_GLSL + "\ntransformed.y = transformed.y * ie + uTLift;" + (withE ? "\nvE = aE;" : ""));
    if (frag) frag(sh);
  };
}
const terrainMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map: colorTex, roughness: 0.96, metalness: 0});
reliefHook(terrainMat, "terrainTop", sh => {
  sh.uniforms.uIdMap = {value: idTex}; sh.uniforms.uElev = {value: elevTex}; sh.uniforms.uESz = {value: new THREE.Vector2(TNX, TNY)}; sh.uniforms.uContOn = TU.uContOn; sh.uniforms.uGovTex = {value: govTex}; sh.uniforms.uSelMask = {value: selMaskTex}; sh.uniforms.uSelK = SELU.k; sh.uniforms.uHovK = SELU.h; sh.uniforms.uDimO = SELU.d; sh.uniforms.uMD = TU.uMD; sh.uniforms.uCont = TU.uCont; sh.uniforms.uTwin = TU.uTwin; sh.uniforms.uNear = TU.uNear;
  sh.fragmentShader = sh.fragmentShader.replace("#include <common>", "#include <common>\nuniform sampler2D uIdMap;\nuniform sampler2D uElev;\nuniform vec2 uESz;\nuniform float uContOn;\nuniform float uCont;\nfloat eTap(vec2 i){ vec4 t = texture2D(uElev, (i + 0.5) / uESz); return (t.r * 65280.0 + t.g * 255.0) / 65535.0 * 4000.0 - 500.0; }\nfloat elevAt(vec2 uv){ vec2 p = clamp(uv, 0.0, 1.0) * (uESz - 1.0); vec2 i = min(floor(p), uESz - 2.0), f = p - i; return mix(mix(eTap(i), eTap(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), f.x), mix(eTap(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), eTap(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), f.x), f.y); }\nuniform sampler2D uGovTex;\nuniform sampler2D uSelMask;\nuniform float uSelK;\nuniform float uHovK;\nuniform float uDimO;\nvec4 govAt(vec2 q){ float id = floor(texture2D(uIdMap, q).r * 255.0 / 9.0 + 0.5); return texture2D(uGovTex, vec2((id + 0.5) / 32.0, 0.5)); }\nuniform float uMD;\nuniform float uTwin;\nuniform float uNear;\nvarying float vE;")
    .replace("#include <map_fragment>", `#include <map_fragment>
      vec4 gs = govAt(vUv);
      /* selection, hover and dimming come from a vector-drawn, anti-aliased mask of the chosen governorate, so its edge is smooth, not the id grid's staircase */
      gs = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);    /* nothing per-governorate is read from textures any more: the vector overlays and the density columns carry it */
      /* relief read from the elevation texture, drawn on the flat ground: a tint that follows the height and a soft hill shade (both fade out near the ground, where the street tiles take over) */
      float eLv = elevAt(vUv), far = (1.0 - uNear) * uContOn;
      { vec2 d = 1.2 / uESz; float gx = elevAt(vUv + vec2(d.x, 0.0)) - elevAt(vUv - vec2(d.x, 0.0)), gy = elevAt(vUv + vec2(0.0, d.y)) - elevAt(vUv - vec2(0.0, d.y));
        float hs = clamp(1.0 + (gx * 0.55 + gy * 0.8) / 520.0, 0.62, 1.5), hk = smoothstep(0.0, 1500.0, eLv);
        vec3 tw = diffuseColor.rgb * (1.0 + 1.5 * hk) + vec3(0.0, 0.03, 0.09) * hk, sd = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, vec3(0.30, 0.19, 0.11), hk * 0.7);
        diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, mix(sd, tw, uTwin) * hs, far); }
      diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, mix(vec3(0.46, 0.30, 0.155), vec3(0.008, 0.019, 0.05), uTwin), uNear * 0.8);
      diffuseColor.rgb *= gs.a * (1.0 - mix(0.28, 0.36, uTwin) * uMD) * (1.0 + (gs.r * 0.4 + gs.g * 0.12) * (1.0 - uNear));
      diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, mix(vec3(1.0, 0.4, 0.06), vec3(0.16, 0.62, 1.0), uTwin) * 0.6, gs.b * gs.b * uMD * mix(0.5, 0.62, uTwin));`)
    .replace("#include <emissivemap_fragment>", `#include <emissivemap_fragment>
      totalEmissiveRadiance += mix(vec3(1.0, 0.79, 0.54), vec3(0.3, 0.75, 1.0), uTwin) * (gs.r * 0.15 + gs.g * 0.1) + mix(vec3(0.34, 0.16, 0.03), vec3(0.03, 0.16, 0.36), uTwin) * gs.b * gs.b * uMD;
      /* contour lines every 100 m, bolder every 500 m */
      float ce = eLv / 100.0, cw = max(fwidth(ce), 1e-4), c1 = 1.0 - clamp(abs(fract(ce + 0.5) - 0.5) / (cw * 1.15), 0.0, 1.0);
      float c5 = 1.0 - clamp(abs(fract(ce / 5.0 + 0.5) - 0.5) / (cw * 0.23 * 1.25), 0.0, 1.0);
      float cf = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.22, 0.5, cw)) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.6, eLv / 100.0) * uCont * far;

}, true);

/* ---- side walls of the land mass, following the relief along the national outline ---- */
const wallPos = [], wallNor = [], wallK = [], wallCol = [], wallIdx = [];
egRings.forEach(r0 => {
  const pts = []; const n0 = r0.length / 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < n0; i++) { const a = [r0[i * 2] * SC, r0[i * 2 + 1] * SC], b = [r0[((i + 1) % n0) * 2] * SC, r0[((i + 1) % n0) * 2 + 1] * SC];
    const m = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) / 0.25)); for (let k = 0; k < m; k++) pts.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / m, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / m]); }
  if (pts.length < 9) return;          /* an islet too small to carry a wall */
  let cx = 0, cz = 0; pts.forEach(p => { cx += p[0]; cz += p[1]; }); cx /= pts.length; cz /= pts.length;
  let s = 0; pts.forEach((p, i) => { const q = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length]; s += (p[0] - cx) * (q[1] - cz) - (q[0] - cx) * (p[1] - cz); });
  const flip = s > 0 ? 1 : -1, base = wallPos.length / 3, n = pts.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const p = pts[i], pn = pts[(i + 4) % n], pp = pts[(i + n - 4) % n]; let tx = pn[0] - pp[0], tz = pn[1] - pp[1]; const l = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1; tx /= l; tz /= l;
    const nx = flip * tz, nz2 = -flip * tx, ht = H + relH(p[0], p[1]);
    wallPos.push(p[0], ht, p[1], p[0], 0, p[1]); wallNor.push(nx, 0, nz2, nx, 0, nz2); wallK.push(1, 0);
    wallCol.push(0.085, 0.042, 0.018, 0.006, 0.013, 0.015);
    const j = (i + 1) % n, v0 = base + i * 2, v1 = base + j * 2;
    const tri = (a, b, c) => { const pa = [wallPos[a * 3], wallPos[a * 3 + 1], wallPos[a * 3 + 2]] ; wallIdx.push(a, b, c); };
    wallIdx.push(v0, v0 + 1, v1, v1, v0 + 1, v1 + 1);
  }
});
/* fix triangle winding so the outward face is the front face */
for (let t = 0; t < wallIdx.length; t += 3) {
  const a = wallIdx[t], b = wallIdx[t + 1], c = wallIdx[t + 2];
  const ax = wallPos[a * 3], ay = wallPos[a * 3 + 1], az = wallPos[a * 3 + 2], bx = wallPos[b * 3] - ax, by = wallPos[b * 3 + 1] - ay, bz = wallPos[b * 3 + 2] - az, cx2 = wallPos[c * 3] - ax, cy2 = wallPos[c * 3 + 1] - ay, cz2 = wallPos[c * 3 + 2] - az;
  const fx = by * cz2 - bz * cy2, fz = bx * cy2 - by * cx2; const dot = fx * wallNor[a * 3] + fz * wallNor[a * 3 + 2];
  if (dot < 0) { wallIdx[t + 1] = c; wallIdx[t + 2] = b; }
}
const wallGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
wallGeo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(wallPos, 3)); wallGeo.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(wallNor, 3));
wallGeo.setAttribute("aK", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(wallK, 1)); wallGeo.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(wallCol, 3));
wallGeo.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Uint32Array(wallIdx), 1)); wallGeo.computeBoundingSphere(); wallGeo.boundingSphere.radius += 4;
const wallMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0.05, emissive: new THREE.Color(0x140905), side: THREE.DoubleSide, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: 1, polygonOffsetUnits: 1});

const scanMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime, uA: {value: 1}, uZ0: {value: EC.z - 30}, uMap: {value: colorTex}, uRel: TU.uRel, uBaseY: TU.uBaseY, uBoot: TU.uBoot, uY0: TU.uY0, uYs: TU.uYs},

  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform float uA; uniform float uZ0; uniform sampler2D uMap; varying vec3 vW; varying vec2 vU;
    void main(){ float z = uZ0 + mod(uTime * 4.2, 62.0); float d = vW.z - z; float band = exp(-d * d / 1.3); float tail = smoothstep(9.0, 0.0, -d) * step(d, 0.0);
      vec2 q = vW.xz / 0.9; vec2 g = abs(fract(q - 0.5) - 0.5) / fwidth(q); float line = 1.0 - min(min(g.x, g.y), 1.0);
      float a = (band * 0.22 + tail * 0.035 + band * line * 0.22) * uA; gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(0.55, 1.0, 0.95) * a, a); }`
});

function makeInst(geo){ const g = new THREE.InstancedBufferGeometry(); g.setIndex(geo.index); g.setAttribute("position", geo.attributes.position); g.instanceCount = NI;
  const mk = (arr, n) => new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(arr, n).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  g.setAttribute("iPos", mk(aPos, 3)); g.setAttribute("iH", mk(aH, 1)); g.setAttribute("iW", mk(aW, 1)); g.setAttribute("iA", mk(aA, 4)); g.setAttribute("iCol", mk(aCol, 3)); g.setAttribute("iKind", mk(aKind, 1)); g.setAttribute("iOff", mk(aOff, 2)); return g; }
const quadV = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); quadV.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute([-0.5, 0, 0, 0.5, 0, 0, 0.5, 1, 0, -0.5, 1, 0], 3)); quadV.setIndex([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]);
const quadF = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); quadF.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute([-0.5, 0, -0.5, 0.5, 0, -0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5, -0.5, 0, 0.5], 3)); quadF.setIndex([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]);

const beamMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime, uScale: U.uScale, uPx: {value: 2.4}, uGlow: {value: 1}, uTwin: {value: 0}, uRes: U.uRes, uPR: U.uPR}, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, depthTest: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  vertexShader: INSTDECL + `uniform float uScale; uniform float uPx; varying vec2 vUv; varying vec3 vC; varying float vAl; varying float vK; varying float vHh; varying float vHv; varying float vFl;
    void main(){ float h = iH * iA.x; vec3 base = iPos;
      vec3 tc = cameraPosition - base; tc.y = 0.0; float l = length(tc); tc = l > 1e-4 ? tc / l : vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
      vec3 right = vec3(-tc.z, 0.0, tc.x);
      float dist = distance(cameraPosition, base + vec3(0.0, position.y * h, 0.0));   /* same pixel width all the way up, so a near base never balloons */
      float w = uPx * iW * dist / uScale * (1.0 + iA.z * 0.5 + iA.w * 0.35);
      vec3 p = base + right * position.x * w + vec3(0.0, position.y * h, 0.0);
      vUv = vec2(position.x + 0.5, position.y); vC = iCol; vAl = iA.y; vK = iKind; vHh = h; vHv = iA.z; vFl = iA.w;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0); gl_Position.xy += iOff * vec2(1.0, -1.0) * uPR * 2.0 / uRes * gl_Position.w * position.y; }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform float uGlow; uniform float uTwin; varying vec2 vUv; varying vec3 vC; varying float vAl; varying float vK; varying float vHh; varying float vHv; varying float vFl;
    void main(){ float x = abs(vUv.x - 0.5) * 2.0; float prof = mix(exp(-x * x * 4.0), exp(-x * x * 9.0) * 0.8 + smoothstep(0.35, 0.0, x) * 0.35, uTwin);
      float grad = mix(0.12, 1.0, pow(vUv.y, 1.5));
      float a = prof * grad * vAl * 0.56 * mix(uGlow, 1.0, max(vHv, vFl));
      if (vK > 1.5) { float d = step(fract(vUv.y * vHh * 1.6 - uTime * 0.5), 0.55); a *= mix(0.2, 1.0, d); }
      else if (vK > 0.5) { a *= 0.78 + 0.22 * sin(uTime * 2.2 + vHh * 3.0); }
      vec3 c = vC * (1.0 + vHv * 0.35 + vFl * 0.6) + vec3(vFl * 0.12 + vHv * 0.05);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(c, a); }`});
const ringMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime, uScale: U.uScale, uPx: {value: 9}, uRes: U.uRes, uPR: U.uPR}, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, depthTest: false, blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendEquation: THREE.MaxEquation, blendSrc: THREE.OneFactor, blendDst: THREE.OneFactor, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  vertexShader: INSTDECL + `uniform float uScale; uniform float uPx; varying vec2 vUv; varying vec3 vC; varying float vAl; varying float vFl; varying float vK;

      float r = uPx * (0.8 + iW * 0.35) * dist / uScale * (1.0 + iA.w * 1.3 + iA.z * 0.35);
      vec3 p = iPos + vec3(position.x * 2.0 * r, 0.03, position.z * 2.0 * r);

      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0); }`,

    void main(){ float d = length(vUv); float ring = smoothstep(0.66, 0.78, d) * smoothstep(1.0, 0.86, d);
      float inner = exp(-d * d * 7.0) * 0.3;

const headMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: {uPR: U.uPR, uKP: U.uKP, uTime: U.uTime, uGlow: {value: 1}, uRes: U.uRes, uNear: {value: 1}}, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, depthTest: false, blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendEquation: THREE.MaxEquation, blendSrc: THREE.OneFactor, blendDst: THREE.OneFactor,
  vertexShader: `attribute float aSize; attribute vec4 aA; attribute vec3 aCol; attribute vec2 aOff; uniform float uPR; uniform float uKP; uniform vec2 uRes; uniform float uNear; varying vec3 vC; varying float vAl; varying float vFl; varying float vHv;

      vec3 col = mix(vC, vec3(1.0), core * 0.28 + vFl * 0.5 + vHv * 0.35);

      float a = pow(1.0 - vUv.y, 2.2) * (0.26 + 0.08 * sin(uTime * 2.4 - vUv.y * 10.0)) * core; gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.12), a); }`});
  const b1 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.03, 0.09, 14, 24, 1, true), bm); b1.position.y = 7; selFX.add(b1);
  const rm = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, side: THREE.DoubleSide});

}
function setSelColor(sc){ const c = sc >= 0 ? SECF[sc] : [1, 0.97, 0.88]; selU.uC.value.setRGB(c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) selFX.children[i].material.color.setRGB(lerp(c[0], 1, 0.12), lerp(c[1], 1, 0.12), lerp(c[2], 1, 0.12)); }
const arcFX = new THREE.Group(); scene.add(arcFX);
const arcDotMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, uniforms: {uC: {value: new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1)}, uK: {value: 330}},
  vertexShader: "uniform float uK; void main(){ vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); gl_PointSize = clamp(uK / -mv.z, 3.0, 11.0); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }",
  fragmentShader: "uniform vec3 uC; void main(){ float r = length(gl_PointCoord - 0.5) * 2.0; float a = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - r), 1.6); gl_FragColor = vec4(uC, a); }"});
let arcRun = [];
function buildArcs(pi){
  while (arcFX.children.length) { const c = arcFX.children.pop(); c.geometry.dispose(); }
  arcRun = [];
  if (pi < 0) return;
  const p = P[pi]; if (p.nat || p.ins.length < 2) return;
  const a0 = INST[p.ins[0]]; let n = 0;
  p.ins.slice(1, 15).forEach(k => { const b = INST[k]; const N = 36, pts = [], dx = b.x - a0.x, dz = b.z - a0.z, len = Math.hypot(dx, dz), hgt = Math.min(9, 1.5 + len * 0.22);
    for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) { const t = i / N; pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(a0.x + dx * t, H + 0.9 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * hgt, a0.z + dz * t)); }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
    const ln = new THREE.Line(g, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color: new THREE.Color(SECC[p.sc]), transparent: true, opacity: 0.7, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending})); arcFX.add(ln);
    const pg = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([pts[0]]);
    const pm = new THREE.Points(pg, arcDotMat.clone()); pm.material.uniforms.uC.value.set(SECC[p.sc]).lerp(new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1), 0.55); pm.frustumCulled = false; arcFX.add(pm);
    arcRun.push({pts, pm, t: n * 0.17}); n++; });
}

const LAYER = {ships: [], oil: [], rail: []};
const LAYER_ON = {ships: true, oil: true, rail: true};
const ll = (lat, lon) => { const p = proj(lat, lon); return [p[0] * SC, p[1] * SC]; };
const govAtScene = (x, z) => govOf(x / SC, z / SC) || nearestGov(x / SC, z / SC);
function nearestGov(x, z){ let best = null, bd = 1e18; for (const g of D.govs) { const d = (g.lx - x) ** 2 + (g.ly - z) ** 2; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = g.id; } } return best; }
const M4 = (x, y, z, rx, ry, rz, sx, sy, sz) => new THREE.Matrix4().compose(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z),
  new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(rx || 0, ry || 0, rz || 0)), new THREE.Vector3(sx || 1, sy || 1, sz || 1));
function merge(parts){
  const pos = [], nor = [], cl = [];
  parts.forEach(p => {
    let g = p.g.index ? p.g.toNonIndexed() : p.g.clone();
    if (p.m) g.applyMatrix4(p.m);
    const c = new THREE.Color(p.c).convertSRGBToLinear();
    const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array;
    for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { pos.push(P[i]); nor.push(N[i]); }
    for (let i = 0; i < P.length / 3; i++) cl.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
  });
  const o = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  o.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  o.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
  o.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(cl, 3));
  return o;
}
const box = (w, h, d) => new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d);

/* route helpers (scene coords) */
function makeRoute(latlon, step){
  const raw = latlon.map(p => ll(p[0], p[1]));
  const pts = [raw[0]];
  for (let i = 1; i < raw.length; i++) {
    const [ax, az] = raw[i - 1], [bx, bz] = raw[i]; const d = Math.hypot(bx - ax, bz - az); const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(d / (step || .25)));
    for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) pts.push([ax + (bx - ax) * k / n, az + (bz - az) * k / n]);
  }
  const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1]));
  return {pts, cum, L: cum[cum.length - 1], gid: null};
}
function withGid(r){ r.gid = r.pts.map((p, i) => { const q = r.pts[Math.min(i + 1, r.pts.length - 1)]; return govAtScene((p[0] + q[0]) / 2, (p[1] + q[1]) / 2); }); return r; }
const smp = {x: 0, z: 0, a: 0, i: 0};
function sampleRoute(r, s){
  s = Math.max(0, Math.min(r.L, s));
  let lo = 0, hi = r.cum.length - 1;
  while (hi - lo > 1) { const m = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (r.cum[m] <= s) lo = m; else hi = m; }
  const t = (s - r.cum[lo]) / ((r.cum[hi] - r.cum[lo]) || 1);
  const a = r.pts[lo], b = r.pts[hi];
  smp.x = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t; smp.z = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t; smp.a = Math.atan2(-(b[1] - a[1]), b[0] - a[0]); smp.i = lo;
  return smp;
}
/* ribbons split per governorate so they ride with lifted / exploded pieces */
function ribbonRuns(r, width, y, mat, layer, alongScale){
  const runs = {};
  let cur = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < r.pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const g = r.gid[i];
    if (!cur || cur.g !== g) { cur = {g, pts: [r.pts[i]], a0: r.cum[i]}; (runs[g] = runs[g] || []).push(cur); }
    cur.pts.push(r.pts[i + 1]);
  }
  for (const g in runs) {
    const pos = [], along = [], side = [], idx = [];
    runs[g].forEach(run => {
      const n = run.pts.length, base = pos.length / 3; let acc = run.a0;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const [x, z] = run.pts[i]; const ia = Math.max(0, i - 1), ib = Math.min(n - 1, i + 1);
        let tx = run.pts[ib][0] - run.pts[ia][0], tz = run.pts[ib][1] - run.pts[ia][1]; const l = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1; tx /= l; tz /= l;
        if (i) acc += Math.hypot(x - run.pts[i - 1][0], z - run.pts[i - 1][1]);
        const nx = -tz * width / 2, nz = tx * width / 2;
        const yy = typeof y === "function" ? y(x, z) : y; pos.push(x + nx, yy, z + nz, x - nx, yy, z - nz); along.push(acc * (alongScale || 1), acc * (alongScale || 1)); side.push(1, -1);
        if (i < n - 1) { const v = base + i * 2; idx.push(v, v + 1, v + 2, v + 1, v + 3, v + 2); }
      }
    });
    const gg = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    gg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    gg.setAttribute("along", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(along, 1));
    gg.setAttribute("side", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(side, 1));
    gg.setIndex(idx);
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(gg, mat); m.renderOrder = 2;
    govs[g].group.add(m); LAYER[layer].push(m);
  }
}

const railMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime}, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  vertexShader: `attribute float along; attribute float side; varying float vA; varying float vS; void main(){ vA = along; vS = side; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `varying float vA; varying float vS;
    void main(){ float s = abs(vS);
      float rail = smoothstep(.40,.48,s) * (1.0 - smoothstep(.56,.64,s));
      float tie = step(.5, fract(vA * 26.0)) * (1.0 - smoothstep(.80,.92,s));
      vec3 c = vec3(.10,.08,.07);
      c = mix(c, vec3(.36,.25,.16), tie * .9);
      c = mix(c, vec3(.86,.9,.95), rail);
      float a = (1.0 - smoothstep(.9,1.0,s)) * .92;
      gl_FragColor = vec4(c, a); }`
});

});

const flameMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime, uScale: U.uScale}, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
  vertexShader: `attribute float aSize; attribute float aRnd; uniform float uTime; uniform float uScale; varying float vF;
    void main(){ vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); float f = .75 + .25 * sin(uTime * 11.0 + aRnd * 30.0) * sin(uTime * 7.3 + aRnd * 11.0);
      vF = f; gl_PointSize = clamp(aSize * f * uScale / -mv.z, 2.0, 22.0); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  fragmentShader: `varying float vF; void main(){ vec2 p = gl_PointCoord - .5; p.y *= .8; float d = length(p) * 2.0; if (d > 1.0) discard;
      float core = exp(-d * d * 7.0); vec3 c = mix(vec3(1.0,.35,.08), vec3(1.0,.9,.55), core); float a = (core + .3 * exp(-d * d * 2.0)) * vF; gl_FragColor = vec4(c * a, a); }`
});
function flamePoints(list, parent){
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(list.flatMap(p => [p[0], p[1], p[2]]), 3));
  g.setAttribute("aSize", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(list.map(p => p[3] || .6), 1));
  g.setAttribute("aRnd", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(list.map(() => Math.random()), 1));
  const pts = new THREE.Points(g, flameMat); pts.renderOrder = 4; parent.add(pts); LAYER.oil.push(pts); return pts;
}

const pumpBeams = [];
const perGov = {};
const addTo = (lat, lon, fn) => { const [x, z] = ll(lat, lon); const g = govAtScene(x, z); const o = fn(x, z); o.y = relH(x, z); (perGov[g] = perGov[g] || []).push(o); return g; };

  addTo(f[1] + Math.sin(a) * rr * .8, f[2] + Math.cos(a) * rr, (x, z) => ({kind: "pj", x, z, rot: Math.random() * 6.28, ph: Math.random() * 6.28})); } });

  if (refs.length) { const im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(refGeo, vcMat, refs.length); refs.forEach((o, i) => { dmy.position.set(o.x, H + o.y, o.z); dmy.rotation.set(0, i, 0); dmy.scale.setScalar(1.5); dmy.updateMatrix(); im.setMatrixAt(i, dmy.matrix);

function animatePumps(t){
  for (const pb of pumpBeams) { pb.items.forEach((o, i) => {
    dmy.position.set(o.x, H + o.y + .16 * 1.6, o.z); dmy.rotation.set(0, o.rot, 0); dmy.rotateZ(Math.sin(t * 1.9 + o.ph) * .28); dmy.scale.setScalar(1.6); dmy.updateMatrix(); pb.mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dmy.matrix); });
    pb.mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; }
}

/* ---------- per-frame update ---------- */
const tmpV = new THREE.Vector3();
let lastK = -1;
function updateInfra(dt, t, onSurf){
  const camD = camera.position.distanceTo(controls.target), kD = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (camD - 22) / 45));
  const shipK = 1 + kD * 1.5, trainK = 1 + kD * 1.1;
  if (Math.abs(kD - lastK) > .02) { lastK = kD; PLATFORMS.forEach((p, i) => { const [x, z] = ll(p[0], p[1]); const r = i * 1.7, sc = 1.4 * (1 + kD * .9); dmy.position.set(x, 0, z); dmy.rotation.set(0, r, 0); dmy.scale.setScalar(sc); dmy.updateMatrix(); plats.setMatrixAt(i, dmy.matrix);
      const pa = platFlamePts.geometry.attributes.position.array; pa[i * 3] = x + Math.cos(r) * .31 * sc; pa[i * 3 + 1] = .43 * sc; pa[i * 3 + 2] = z - Math.sin(r) * .31 * sc; }); plats.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; platFlamePts.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true; }
  // trains
  if (LAYER_ON.rail) {
    let k = 0; const hp = trHeads.geometry.attributes.position.array;
    TRAINS.forEach((tr, ti) => {
      const r = railRoutes[tr.r];
      tr.s += tr.v * dt * tr.dir;
      const span = (tr.n - 1) * .34 + .3;
      if (tr.dir > 0 && tr.s > r.L + .2) tr.s = -span; if (tr.dir < 0 && tr.s < -.2) tr.s = r.L + span;
      for (let i = 0; i < tr.n; i++) {
        const s = tr.s - tr.dir * i * .34 * trainK;
        const q = sampleRoute(r, s); const o = liftAt(r.gid[q.i]);
        const fade = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, Math.min(s + .1, r.L + .1 - s) / .5)) * onSurf * (govs[r.gid[q.i]].intro > .98 ? 1 : 0);
        const yw = q.a + (tr.dir < 0 ? Math.PI : 0), fx = Math.cos(yw) * .15, fz = -Math.sin(yw) * .15, ty0 = relH(q.x, q.z) * TU.uRel.value; dmy.position.set(q.x + o.x, H + ty0 + .035 + o.y, q.z + o.z); dmy.rotation.set(0, yw, Math.atan2(relH(q.x + fx, q.z + fz) - relH(q.x - fx, q.z - fz), .3)); dmy.scale.set(fade * trainK, fade * trainK, fade * trainK); dmy.updateMatrix(); cars.setMatrixAt(k++, dmy.matrix);
        if (i === 0) { const f = tr.dir * .17; hp[ti * 3] = q.x + o.x + Math.cos(q.a) * f; hp[ti * 3 + 1] = H + relH(q.x, q.z) * TU.uRel.value + .09 + o.y; hp[ti * 3 + 2] = q.z + o.z - Math.sin(q.a) * f; if (fade < .3) hp[ti * 3 + 1] = -50; }
      }
    });
    cars.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; trHeads.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  }
  // ships
  if (LAYER_ON.ships) {
    const lp = shipLights.geometry.attributes.position.array;
    SHIPS.forEach((sh, n) => {
      let x, z, a, y = -.005, sc = 1, wk = 1;
      if (sh.anchor) { x = sh.anchor[0]; z = sh.anchor[1]; a = sh.rot + Math.sin(t * .1 + sh.ph) * .15; wk = 0; }
      else {
        const r = sh.r; sh.s += sh.v * dt * sh.dir;
        if (sh.dir > 0 && sh.s > r.L) sh.s = 0; if (sh.dir < 0 && sh.s < 0) sh.s = r.L;
        const q = sampleRoute(r, sh.s); a = q.a + (sh.dir < 0 ? Math.PI : 0);
        const la = sh.lat; x = q.x + Math.sin(q.a) * la; z = q.z + Math.cos(q.a) * la;
        const edge = sh.canal ? .6 : 1.6; sc = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.min(sh.s, r.L - sh.s) / edge));
        if (sh.canal) { const o = liftAt(r.gid[q.i]); x += o.x; z += o.z; y = H + relH(x, z) * TU.uRel.value + .005 + o.y - SEA_Y; sc *= .62 * onSurf * (govs[r.gid[q.i]].intro > .98 ? 1 : 0); }
      }
      sc *= shipK; y += Math.sin(t * 1.3 + sh.ph) * .006;
      dmy.position.set(x, y, z); dmy.rotation.set(Math.sin(t * .9 + sh.ph) * .02, a, 0); dmy.scale.setScalar(Math.max(.0001, sc)); dmy.updateMatrix();
      (sh.type === 0 ? shipsC : shipsT).setMatrixAt(sh.idx, dmy.matrix);
      dmy.scale.set(Math.max(.0001, sc), 1, Math.max(.0001, sc) * (.85 + .15 * Math.sin(t * 2 + sh.ph))); dmy.scale.multiplyScalar(wk || .0001); dmy.updateMatrix(); wakes.setMatrixAt(n, dmy.matrix);
      const c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a), vis = sc > .15 ? 0 : -60;
      lp[n * 6] = x + c * .3 * sc; lp[n * 6 + 1] = y + .2 * sc + vis; lp[n * 6 + 2] = z - s * .3 * sc;
      lp[n * 6 + 3] = x - c * .45 * sc; lp[n * 6 + 4] = y + .24 * sc + vis; lp[n * 6 + 5] = z + s * .45 * sc;
    });
    shipsC.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; shipsT.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; wakes.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; shipLights.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  }
  if (LAYER_ON.oil) animatePumps(t);
}
function setLive(on){ for (const k in LAYER) { LAYER_ON[k] = on; LAYER[k].forEach(o => o.visible = on && !(typeof infraHidden !== "undefined" && infraHidden)); } }

const RMX0 = 1152, RMY0 = 832, RMW = 128, RMH = 64;                 // window of zoom-11 tiles that covers Egypt
const REG_SHOW_GLSL = `uniform sampler2D uRegMask; uniform vec4 uGeo; uniform float uRA; uniform vec2 uRC; uniform vec2 uRR;
  vec2 regUV(vec2 xz){ float lon = uGeo.x + xz.x * uGeo.z, lat = radians(uGeo.y - xz.y * uGeo.w);
    vec2 t = vec2((lon + 180.0) / 360.0 * 2048.0, (1.0 - log(tan(lat) + 1.0 / cos(lat)) / 3.14159265359) * 1024.0);
    return (t - vec2(${RMX0}.0, ${RMY0}.0)) / vec2(${RMW}.0, ${RMH}.0); }
  float regShow(vec2 xz){ vec2 uv = regUV(xz); if (uv.x <= 0.0 || uv.x >= 1.0 || uv.y <= 0.0 || uv.y >= 1.0) return 0.0;
    return uRA * (1.0 - smoothstep(uRR.x, uRR.y, distance(xz, uRC))) * texture2D(uRegMask, uv).r; }`;
const roadMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {uTime: U.uTime, uScale: U.uScale, uRel: TU.uRel, uH: {value: H}, uA: {value: 1}, uTwin: TU.uTwin, uPR: U.uPR,
    uRegMask: {value: null}, uGeo: {value: new THREE.Vector4()}, uRA: {value: 0}, uRC: {value: new THREE.Vector2()}, uRR: {value: new THREE.Vector2(1, 2)}},   /* filled by the region tier */
  transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  vertexShader: `attribute float aRel; attribute vec2 aDir; attribute float aSide; attribute float aAlong; attribute float aCls; attribute float aPh;
    uniform float uScale; uniform float uRel; uniform float uH; uniform float uPR; varying float vS; varying float vA; varying float vC; varying float vP; varying vec2 vXZ;
    void main(){ vec3 p = vec3(position.x, uH + aRel * uRel + 0.014, position.z);
      float dist = distance(cameraPosition, p);
      float px = (aCls < 1.5 ? 2.3 : aCls < 2.5 ? 1.7 : 1.1) * uPR;                 /* constant on-screen width per class */
      p.xz += vec2(-aDir.y, aDir.x) * aSide * px * dist / uScale * 0.5; vXZ = p.xz;
      vS = aSide; vA = aAlong; vC = aCls; vP = aPh; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform float uA; uniform float uTwin; varying float vS; varying float vA; varying float vC; varying float vP; varying vec2 vXZ;
    ` + REG_SHOW_GLSL + `
    void main(){ float e = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.35, 1.0, abs(vS))) * (1.0 - regShow(vXZ));   /* where the region tier shows, it replaces these lines */
      float sp = vC < 1.5 ? 1.0 : vC < 2.5 ? 0.8 : 0.6;
      float pulse = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(vA * 1.15 - uTime * 2.4 * sp + vP), 18.0) * 0.55;          /* light packets running along every road */
      float pulse2 = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(vA * 0.37 + uTime * 1.3 * sp + vP * 1.7), 30.0) * 0.4;    /* and slower ones the other way */
      vec3 base = vC < 1.5 ? mix(vec3(1.0, 0.55, 0.15), vec3(1.0, 0.58, 0.16), uTwin) : vC < 2.5 ? mix(vec3(0.95, 0.72, 0.4), vec3(0.12, 0.55, 1.0), uTwin) : mix(vec3(0.7, 0.6, 0.45), vec3(0.16, 0.36, 0.8), uTwin);
      float k = vC < 1.5 ? 0.46 : vC < 2.5 ? 0.3 : 0.2;                                  /* the line itself carries the network; the packets only ride on it */
      float a = e * uA * (k + (pulse + pulse2 * 0.8) * (vC < 1.5 ? 1.0 : vC < 2.5 ? 0.8 : 0.45));
      gl_FragColor = vec4(base * a + base * pulse * e * uA * 0.5, a); }`
});
const roads = (() => {
  const P = [], R = [], Dr = [], Sd = [], A = [], C = [], Ph = [], I = [];
  for (const r of ROADS_RAW) {
    const cls = r[0]; let lo = r[1], la = r[2]; const pts = [];
    const push = () => { const q = ll(la / 10000, lo / 10000); pts.push(q); };
    push(); for (let i = 3; i < r.length; i += 2) { lo += r[i]; la += r[i + 1]; push(); }
    if (pts.length > 1) addRun(pts, cls);     /* already cut to Egypt and stitched into long strokes when the data was built */
  }
  function addRun(pts, cls){
    const ph = Math.random() * 6.28; let along = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
      const p = pts[i], a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)];
      let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
      if (i) along += Math.hypot(p[0] - pts[i - 1][0], p[1] - pts[i - 1][1]);
      const rr = relH(p[0], p[1]);
      for (const sd of [-1, 1]) { P.push(p[0], 0, p[1]); R.push(rr); Dr.push(dx, dz); Sd.push(sd); A.push(along); C.push(cls); Ph.push(ph); }
      if (i < pts.length - 1) { const b0 = P.length / 3 - 2; I.push(b0, b0 + 1, b0 + 2, b0 + 1, b0 + 3, b0 + 2); }
    }
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(P, 3)); g.setAttribute("aRel", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(R, 1));
  g.setAttribute("aDir", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(Dr, 2)); g.setAttribute("aSide", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(Sd, 1));
  g.setAttribute("aAlong", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(A, 1)); g.setAttribute("aCls", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(C, 1)); g.setAttribute("aPh", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(Ph, 1));
  g.setIndex(I);
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(g, roadMat); m.frustumCulled = false; m.renderOrder = 3; scene.add(m); return m;
})();
function updateRoads(){
  const a = (1 - mL) * (1 - 0.45 * mD) * (1 - 0.55 * ZS.close) * (typeof bootT === "number" ? clamp((bootT - 1.5) / 1.5, 0, 1) : 1);
  roadMat.uniforms.uA.value = a; roads.visible = a > 0.01;
}


/* ================= layer glyphs: every sector has its own little model, shown at project sites in the layered view and when a sector is isolated ================= */

const hexP = (r, h) => cyl(r, r, h, 6);

const cone = (r, h, s) => new THREE.ConeGeometry(r, h, s || 10);

const GLYPH_K = [0.64, 0.66, 0.6, 0.62, 0.58, 0.62, 0.62, 0.6];
/* holographic look: a faint glass body that brightens toward its silhouette, crisp edge lines in the sector colour and a slow scan band */
const GLV = `attribute vec4 iM0; attribute vec4 iM1; attribute vec4 iM2; attribute vec4 iM3; attribute float aTone; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying float vT; varying float vY;
  void main(){ mat4 im = mat4(iM0, iM1, iM2, iM3); vec4 wp = modelMatrix * im * vec4(position, 1.0);
    vN = normalize(mat3(im) * normal); vV = cameraPosition - wp.xyz; vT = aTone; vY = position.y; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp; }`;
const GLF = `uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uO; uniform float uP; uniform float uTime; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying float vT; varying float vY;
  void main(){ vec3 n = normalize(vN); if (!gl_FrontFacing) n = -n; float ndv = clamp(abs(dot(n, normalize(vV))), 0.0, 1.0); float fr = pow(1.0 - ndv, 2.2);
    float sh = 0.55 + 0.45 * max(dot(n, normalize(vec3(0.4, 0.8, 0.45))), 0.0);
    float band = smoothstep(0.05, 0.0, abs(vY - fract(uTime * 0.22) * 0.95));
    vec3 c = uC * (0.22 + 0.22 * vT) * sh * uP + uC * fr * 0.85 + uC * band * 0.35;
    gl_FragColor = vec4(c, uO * (0.12 + 0.42 * fr + 0.22 * band)); }`;
const GLEV = `attribute vec4 iM0; attribute vec4 iM1; attribute vec4 iM2; attribute vec4 iM3; varying float vY;
  void main(){ mat4 im = mat4(iM0, iM1, iM2, iM3); vY = position.y; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * modelMatrix * im * vec4(position, 1.0); }`;
const GLEF = `uniform vec3 uC; uniform float uO; uniform float uTime; varying float vY;
  void main(){ float band = smoothstep(0.06, 0.0, abs(vY - fract(uTime * 0.22) * 0.95)); gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uC, vec3(1.0), 0.18 + 0.4 * band), uO * (0.62 + 0.38 * band)); }`;
function glyphGeos(parts, n){
  const pos = [], nor = [], tone = [], ep = [];
  parts.forEach(p => {
    let g = p.g.index ? p.g.toNonIndexed() : p.g.clone(); if (p.m) g.applyMatrix4(p.m);
    const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, c = new THREE.Color(p.c), tn = (c.r + c.g + c.b) / 3;
    for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { pos.push(P[i]); nor.push(N[i]); } for (let i = 0; i < P.length / 3; i++) tone.push(tn);
    if (p.ring) { const m = 40; for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) { const a0 = i / m * 6.2832, a1 = (i + 1) / m * 6.2832; ep.push(Math.cos(a0) * p.ring, p.y, Math.sin(a0) * p.ring, Math.cos(a1) * p.ring, p.y, Math.sin(a1) * p.ring); } }
    else { const e = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(g, 46).attributes.position.array; for (let i = 0; i < e.length; i++) ep.push(e[i]); }
  });
  const buf = new THREE.InstancedInterleavedBuffer(new Float32Array(Math.max(1, n) * 16), 16, 1).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  const inst = g => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) g.setAttribute("iM" + i, new THREE.InterleavedBufferAttribute(buf, 4, i * 4)); g.instanceCount = n; return g; };
  const fill = new THREE.InstancedBufferGeometry(); fill.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); fill.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); fill.setAttribute("aTone", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(tone, 1));
  const edge = new THREE.InstancedBufferGeometry(); edge.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(ep, 3));
  return {fill: inst(fill), edge: inst(edge), buf};
}
const glyphs = SECS.map((sec, s) => {
  const idx = []; INST.forEach((q, k) => { if (q.show && P[q.pi].sc === s) idx.push(k); });
  const gg = glyphGeos(GPARTS[s], idx.length), c = col(SECC[s]);
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: {uC: {value: c.clone()}, uO: {value: 0}, uP: {value: 1}, uTime: U.uTime}, vertexShader: GLV, fragmentShader: GLF, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide});
  const emat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms: {uC: {value: c.clone()}, uO: {value: 0}, uTime: U.uTime}, vertexShader: GLEV, fragmentShader: GLEF, transparent: true, depthWrite: false});
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(gg.fill, mat); mesh.frustumCulled = false; mesh.visible = false; mesh.renderOrder = 4; scene.add(mesh);
  const lines = new THREE.LineSegments(gg.edge, emat); lines.frustumCulled = false; lines.renderOrder = 5; mesh.add(lines);
  return {s, idx, mesh, mat, emat, buf: gg.buf, vis: 0, ph: idx.map((k, i) => fr(Math.sin((k + 3) * 91.7) * 4375.5) * 6.28)};
});
const gDum = new THREE.Object3D();
function updateGlyphs(dt, t, distK){
  glyphs.forEach(G => {
    const tgt = (S.sec === G.s && S.mode !== "density" ? 1 : 0) * (mD > 0.05 ? 0 : 1);   /* models only for the chosen sector: the overview of the stack stays clean dots */
    G.vis += (tgt - G.vis) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
    const on = G.vis > 0.01 && mL < 2; G.mesh.visible = on; if (!on) return;
    const pl = plates[G.s], f = S.sec < 0 ? 0.8 : (S.sec === G.s ? 1 : 0.35);
    const op = Math.min(1, G.vis * (mL > 0.5 ? lerp(0.25, 1, pl.f) : 1)) * lerp(0.6, 1, f) * Math.max(mL, sstep(14, 24, ZS.d));   /* icons only from afar or on the plates: close in, the map is real scale */
    G.mat.uniforms.uO.value = op; G.emat.uniforms.uO.value = op;
    G.mat.uniforms.uP.value = 0.9 + (S.sec === G.s ? 0.35 : 0) + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 1.5 + G.s);
    const kk = GLYPH_K[G.s] * (1 + distK * 0.8) * (0.4 + 0.6 * G.vis), arr = G.buf.array;
    for (let n = 0; n < G.idx.length; n++) {
      const k = G.idx[n], q = INST[k], p = P[q.pi], a = ap[k];
      const sc = kk * a * lerp(0.55, 1, clamp(dimK[k] * 1.4, 0, 1)) * (1 + hv[k] * 0.25) * (0.86 + 0.06 * p.tr) * (q.prim ? 1 : 0.85);
      gDum.position.set(aPos[k * 3], aPos[k * 3 + 1] + Math.sin(t * 1.2 + G.ph[n]) * 0.02 * sc, aPos[k * 3 + 2]);
      const spin = (G.s === 1 || G.s === 3 || G.s === 7) ? t * 0.25 : 0;
      gDum.rotation.set(0, G.ph[n] + spin, 0); gDum.scale.setScalar(Math.max(0.0001, sc)); gDum.updateMatrix(); gDum.matrix.toArray(arr, n * 16);
    }
    G.buf.needsUpdate = true;
  });
}


/* ================= world scale: from the whole country down to street level ================= */
const sstep = (a, b, x) => { const t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
const ZS = {d: 100, rel: 1, beam: 1, close: 0, street: 0, tk: 1};   /* tk: 1 = relief displaced (sand), 0 = flat digital map */
let SEA_Y = 0, seaObjs = null;
controls.minDistance = 0.0045;   /* 100 m: a model on the map is shown from as near as 110 m */
function updateZoomScale(){
  const d = camera.position.distanceTo(controls.target); ZS.d = d;
  ZS.rel = lerp(1 / 15, 1, sstep(0.45, 12, d));          // relief exaggeration fades to true height near the ground
  ZS.beam = clamp(d / 16, 0.0032, 1);                     // beams shrink to a marker as the camera comes down
  ZS.close = 1 - sstep(0.35, 3.2, d);                      // 1 at city scale
  headMat.uniforms.uNear.value = 1 + 0.6 * ZS.close; beamMat.uniforms.uPx.value = 2.3 * PR * KP * (1 + 0.45 * ZS.close);
  ZS.street = 1 - sstep(0.03, 0.22, d);                    // 1 at street scale
  TU.uNear.value = ZS.close; infraByZoom(); railGlowMat.visible = pipeMat.visible = d > 9; pipeCore.visible = d > 9; TU.uTLift.value = 0.003 * sstep(1.6, 4, d);   /* no terrain lift while street tiles are on: it made roads and land cover fight the ground in stripes */
  /* the sea is painted on a plinth below the land slab: near the ground it rises to the coast so the shore is not a cliff */
  /* digital map: the land stands only a thin step above the sea, thinnest as the camera comes down, so ships never sit in a trench */
  const ext = lerp(0.03, 0.4, sstep(6, 45, d));
  SEA_Y = lerp(H - ext, H - 0.0005, ZS.close);
  plinth.position.y = SEA_Y - 1.5; plEdges.position.y = plinth.position.y; plEdges.visible = ZS.close < 0.5;
  if (!seaObjs) seaObjs = [shipsC, shipsT, wakes, shipLights, plats, platFlamePts];
  for (const o of seaObjs) o.position.y = SEA_Y;
  const nr = clamp(d * 0.024, 0.00012, 0.4);   /* a deeper near plane keeps depth precise enough that flat ground layers never stripe */
  if (Math.abs(nr - camera.near) / camera.near > 0.004) { camera.near = nr; camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); }
  scene.fog.density = (S.theme === "twin" ? 0.0068 : 0.0062) * (d > 20 ? Math.min(1, 96 / d) : 20 / Math.max(d, 0.035));
}
let infraHidden = false;
function infraByZoom(){ const h = ZS.d < 16;   /* ships, trains and plants are icons for the country view; closer in, only the real-scale map stays */ if (h === infraHidden) return; infraHidden = h; for (const k in LAYER) LAYER[k].forEach(o => o.visible = LAYER_ON[k] && !h); }
function groundClear(){ return clamp(ZS.d * 0.05, 0.0011, 1.0); }   /* 0.05: a tall tower is framed from 50 m up and nearly 900 m away, and must not be lifted above that */

/* ================= map themes: the current sand relief, or a night-blue "digital twin" ================= */

  document.documentElement.dataset.map = T;
