  plinthTop.map = getBaseTwinTex(); plinthTop.needsUpdate = true;          /* both looks share the night-blue digital sea */
  scanMat.uniforms.uMap.value = terrainMat.map;
  scene.background.setHex(t.bg); renderer.setClearColor(t.bg, 1); scene.fog.color.setHex(t.bg);
  hemi.color.setHex(t.hemiS); hemi.groundColor.setHex(t.hemiG); hemi.intensity = t.hemiI;
  sun.color.setHex(t.sun); sun.intensity = t.sunI; rimL.color.setHex(t.rim); rimL.intensity = t.rimI;
  wallMat.color.setHex(t.wall); wallMat.emissive.setHex(t.wallE);
  cityGlow.forEach((L, i) => { L.color.setHex(t.city); L.intensity = CITY_I[i] * t.cityK; });
  plEdges.material.color.setHex(t.edge);
  vcMat.color.setHex(tw ? 0x16253d : 0x6e6458); carMat.color.setHex(tw ? 0x16253d : 0x6e6458);   /* infrastructure models sit in the palette instead of glaring white */
  renderer.toneMappingExposure = t.exp;
  if (bloom && !QS.has("bs")) bloom.strength = t.bloom;
  beamMat.uniforms.uGlow.value = t.glow; headMat.uniforms.uGlow.value = t.glow; beamMat.uniforms.uTwin.value = tw ? 1 : 0;
  if (typeof cityApplyTheme === "function") cityApplyTheme(T); scopeText();
  document.querySelectorAll("#themeSeg button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.dataset.theme === T));
  try { localStorage.setItem("masirat.theme", T); } catch (e) {}
}
document.querySelectorAll("#themeSeg button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => applyTheme(b.dataset.theme)));
function savedTheme(){ if (QS.has("theme")) return QS.get("theme"); try { return localStorage.getItem("masirat.theme") || "twin"; } catch (e) { return "twin"; } }

/* crowded beams: each head is dimmed by how many neighbours share its few pixels, with a soft (gaussian) count
   so the dimming glides instead of jumping when heads cross a grid line during a zoom */
const crowd = new Float32Array(NI).fill(1), crowdMap = new Map(), cX = new Float32Array(NI), cY = new Float32Array(NI);
function updateCrowd(){
  crowdMap.clear(); const cell = 32 * clamp(KP, 0.8, 1.6), sig2 = 2 * Math.pow(13 * clamp(KP, 0.8, 1.6), 2);
  for (let k = 0; k < NI; k++) { if (ap[k] < 0.3) { sxy[k * 3 + 2] = -1; continue; }
    v3.set(aHeadPos[k * 3], aHeadPos[k * 3 + 1], aHeadPos[k * 3 + 2]).project(camera); if (v3.z > 1 || behindCam(aHeadPos[k * 3], aHeadPos[k * 3 + 1], aHeadPos[k * 3 + 2])) { sxy[k * 3 + 2] = -1; continue; }
    const x = (v3.x + 1) / 2 * W, y = (1 - v3.y) / 2 * Hh; cX[k] = x; cY[k] = y;
    const key = Math.floor(x / cell) * 4096 + Math.floor(y / cell); sxy[k * 3 + 2] = key; let a = crowdMap.get(key); if (!a) crowdMap.set(key, a = []); a.push(k); }
  for (let k = 0; k < NI; k++) { const key = sxy[k * 3 + 2]; let n = 1;
    if (key >= 0) { n = 0; const gx = Math.floor(key / 4096), gy = key - gx * 4096;
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) { const a = crowdMap.get((gx + dx) * 4096 + gy + dy); if (!a) continue;
        for (const j of a) { const ex = cX[j] - cX[k], ey = cY[j] - cY[k]; n += Math.exp(-(ex * ex + ey * ey) / sig2); } } }
    const tgt = n <= 1.15 ? 1 : Math.max(0.3, 1 / Math.sqrt(n * 0.85)); crowd[k] += (tgt - crowd[k]) * 0.07; }
  fanOut();
}
/* beacons standing on (almost) the same spot: their heads part on a small circle round the spot so each one can be seen and picked;
   the beam leans to its head and its foot ring stays on the true place. Big city clusters seen from far keep the soft dimming instead. */
const fanPar = new Int32Array(NI), FAN_MAX = 9;
function fanFind(a){ while (fanPar[a] !== a) { fanPar[a] = fanPar[fanPar[a]]; a = fanPar[a]; } return a; }
function fanOut(){
  const R = 15 * clamp(KP, 0.8, 1.6), cell = R * 2;
  offT.fill(0);
  if (mL < 0.5 && mD < 0.5) {
    const grid = new Map();
    for (let k = 0; k < NI; k++) { fanPar[k] = k; if (sxy[k * 3 + 2] < 0 || ap[k] < 0.5 || dimK[k] < 0.25) continue;
      const key = Math.floor(cX[k] / cell) * 4096 + Math.floor(cY[k] / cell); let a = grid.get(key); if (!a) grid.set(key, a = []); a.push(k); }
    grid.forEach((a, key) => { const gx = Math.floor(key / 4096), gy = key - gx * 4096;
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) { const b = grid.get((gx + dx) * 4096 + gy + dy); if (!b) continue;
        for (const i of a) for (const j of b) if (i < j && Math.hypot(cX[i] - cX[j], cY[i] - cY[j]) < R) { const ri = fanFind(i), rj = fanFind(j); if (ri !== rj) fanPar[ri] = rj; } } });
    const cl = new Map(); grid.forEach(a => a.forEach(k => { const r = fanFind(k); let c = cl.get(r); if (!c) cl.set(r, c = []); c.push(k); }));
    cl.forEach(c => { if (c.length < 2 || c.length > FAN_MAX) return;
      c.sort((a, b) => INST[a].pi - INST[b].pi || a - b);
      let mx = 0, my = 0; c.forEach(k => { mx += cX[k]; my += cY[k]; }); mx /= c.length; my /= c.length;
      const rr = Math.max(R * 1.25, c.length * 7.5 * clamp(KP, 0.8, 1.6));
      c.forEach((k, i) => { const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i / c.length) * Math.PI * 2 + (c.length === 2 ? Math.PI / 2 : 0);
        offT[k * 2] = mx + Math.cos(a) * rr - cX[k]; offT[k * 2 + 1] = my + Math.sin(a) * rr - cY[k]; }); });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < NI * 2; i++) { aOff[i] += (offT[i] - aOff[i]) * 0.18; if (Math.abs(aOff[i]) < 0.05) aOff[i] = offT[i]; }
}

/* geographic readout: compass, altitude, coordinates and a true scale bar, the way a globe viewer shows them */
const gNd = document.getElementById("gNd"), gAlt = document.getElementById("gAlt"), gLL = document.getElementById("gLL"), gBar = document.getElementById("gBar"), gScl = document.getElementById("gScl");
const NICE = [5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 20000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 500000];
const fmtM = m => m >= 1000 ? (m / 1000).toLocaleString(NUM_LOC, {maximumFractionDigits: m >= 10000 ? 0 : 1}) + T(" كم") : Math.round(m).toLocaleString(NUM_LOC) + T(" م");
let geoAcc = 0, geoSig = "";
function updateGeoHud(dt){
  geoAcc += dt; if (geoAcc < 0.12 || !gAlt) return; geoAcc = 0;
  const t = controls.target, c = camera.position, mperU = 1 / M2U;
  const th = Math.atan2(c.x - t.x, c.z - t.z) * 180 / Math.PI;
  const gy = H + relH(c.x, c.z) * TU.uRel.value, altM = Math.max(0, (c.y - gy) * mperU / (ZS.rel < 0.999 ? 1 : 1));
  const mpp = 2 * ZS.d * Math.tan(camera.fov * Math.PI / 360) / Hh * mperU;
  let L = NICE[0]; for (const n of NICE) { if (n / mpp <= 120) L = n; }
  const lat = xLon ? zLat(t.z) : 0, lon = xLon ? xLon(t.x) : 0;
  const sig = Math.round(th) + "|" + Math.round(altM / 10) + "|" + lat.toFixed(4) + lon.toFixed(4) + "|" + L;
  if (sig === geoSig) return; geoSig = sig;
  gNd.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${th.toFixed(1)} 12 12)`);
  gAlt.textContent = T("الارتفاع ") + fmtM(altM);
  gLL.textContent = Math.abs(lat).toFixed(4) + "°N  " + Math.abs(lon).toFixed(4) + "°E";
  gBar.style.width = (L / mpp).toFixed(1) + "px"; gScl.textContent = fmtM(L);
}

const M2U = K * SC / 110574;                         // scene units per metre (north-south); tiles are mapped with their own exact corners
const osmAttr = document.getElementById("osmattr");
const cityGroup = new THREE.Group(); cityGroup.visible = false; scene.add(cityGroup);
const CU = {uH: {value: H}, uRel: TU.uRel, uM2U: {value: M2U}, uTwin: TU.uTwin, uTime: U.uTime, uFade: {value: 0}, uFogC: {value: new THREE.Color()}, uFogD: {value: 0},
  uSea: {value: plinthTop.map}, uSeaR: {value: new THREE.Vector4(plCx, plCz, plW, plD)}, uHiC: {value: new THREE.Vector2(0, 0)}, uHiR: {value: 0}, uHiCol: {value: new THREE.Color(1, 0.6, 0.2)}, uHiK: {value: 0}, uStreet: {value: 0}, uGrow: {value: 1}, uMdl: {value: [new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0)]}};
const tile2lon = (x, z) => x / Math.pow(2, z) * 360 - 180;
const tile2lat = (y, z) => { const n = Math.PI - 2 * Math.PI * y / Math.pow(2, z); return 180 / Math.PI * Math.atan(0.5 * (Math.exp(n) - Math.exp(-n))); };
const lonX = lon => (lon - D.proj.lon0) * CXK * SC, latZ = lat => (D.proj.lat0 - lat) * K * SC;
const xLon = x => D.proj.lon0 + x / (CXK * SC), zLat = z => D.proj.lat0 - z / (K * SC);

const SEA_GLSL = `uniform sampler2D uSea; uniform vec4 uSeaR;
  /* open water in the tiles is painted with the very texel of the sea plane beneath it (same texture, same fog), so a loaded tile can never show as a square on the sea */
  vec3 seaCol(vec2 xz){ vec3 t = texture2D(uSea, vec2((xz.x - uSeaR.x) / uSeaR.z + 0.5, 0.5 - (xz.y - uSeaR.y) / uSeaR.w)).rgb;
    return t; }`;      /* these tile shaders write display-space colour (no output encoding), so the sea texel is used as it is */
const CITY_FOG = `uniform vec3 uFogC; uniform float uFogD; varying float vFogZ;`;
const CITY_VS_HEAD = `uniform float uH; uniform float uRel; uniform float uM2U; attribute float aRel; varying float vFogZ;`;
function cityMat(vs, fs, opts){
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial(Object.assign({uniforms: CU, vertexShader: vs, fragmentShader: fs, transparent: true, depthWrite: true,
    polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -1, polygonOffsetUnits: -2}, opts || {}));
}
/* buildings: night-blue towers with lit floors and a glowing roof line, or pale stone in daylight */
const bldMat = cityMat(CITY_VS_HEAD + `attribute float aBH; attribute vec3 aN; attribute vec2 aC; varying float vH; varying float vBH; varying vec3 vN; varying vec2 vXZ; varying vec3 vW; varying vec2 vC;
  void main(){ vC = aC; vec3 p = position; float y = uH + aRel * uRel + p.y * uM2U; vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(p.x, y, p.z, 1.0);
    vH = p.y; vBH = aBH; vN = aN; vXZ = w.xz; vW = w.xyz; vec4 mv = viewMatrix * w; vFogZ = -mv.z; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  `uniform float uTwin; uniform float uTime; uniform float uFade; uniform vec2 uHiC; uniform float uHiR; uniform vec3 uHiCol; uniform float uHiK; uniform vec3 uMdl[4]; ` + CITY_FOG + `
  varying float vH; varying float vBH; varying vec3 vN; varying vec2 vXZ; varying vec3 vW; varying vec2 vC;
  void main(){
    /* a true-shape model stands here: the map's own massing around it (by building centroid, so a building is never cut in half) is not drawn, so it never hides the model */
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { if (uMdl[i].z > 0.0 && distance(vC, uMdl[i].xy) < uMdl[i].z) discard; }
    float roof = step(0.5, vN.y), k = clamp(vH / max(vBH, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 L = normalize(vec3(0.45, 0.8, 0.35)); float lam = 0.55 + 0.45 * abs(dot(vN, L));
    vec3 cT = mix(vec3(0.035, 0.075, 0.15), vec3(0.10, 0.22, 0.42), k) * lam;
    cT = mix(cT, vec3(0.08, 0.17, 0.30), roof);
    float fl = (1.0 - roof) * smoothstep(0.86, 1.0, fract(vH / 3.4)) * step(4.0, vBH) * 0.22;
    float edge = (1.0 - roof) * smoothstep(vBH - 1.6, vBH, vH) * 0.85;
    cT += vec3(0.25, 0.6, 1.0) * (fl + edge);
    float ao = mix(0.62, 1.0, clamp(vH / 9.0, 0.0, 1.0));
    vec3 cS = mix(vec3(0.80, 0.77, 0.72) * lam * ao, vec3(0.93, 0.91, 0.87), roof);
    vec3 c = mix(cS, cT, uTwin);
    float hd = length(vXZ - uHiC); float hi = uHiK * (1.0 - smoothstep(uHiR * 0.82, uHiR, hd));
    c = mix(c, uHiCol * (0.55 + 0.6 * k) + vec3(0.25) * edge, hi * (0.75 + 0.25 * sin(uTime * 2.4)));
    float f = 1.0 - exp(-pow(uFogD * vFogZ, 2.0)); c = mix(c, uFogC, clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0));
    gl_FragColor = vec4(c, uFade); }`, {transparent: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide});
/* flat ground features: water, green, aprons (aKind selects the colour) */
const flatMat = cityMat(CITY_VS_HEAD + `attribute float aKind; attribute float aLift; varying float vK; varying vec2 vXZ;
  void main(){ float y = uH + aRel * uRel + (aLift + 1.0) * uM2U; vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position.x, y, position.z, 1.0); vK = aKind; vXZ = w.xz;
    vec4 mv = viewMatrix * w; vFogZ = -mv.z; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  `uniform float uTwin; uniform float uFade; uniform float uTime; ` + CITY_FOG + SEA_GLSL + ` varying float vK; varying vec2 vXZ;
  void main(){ vec3 cS, cT; float a = 1.0;
    if (vK < 1.5) { cS = cT = seaCol(vXZ); }   /* water: deep blue, never a black hole */
    else if (vK < 2.5) { cS = vec3(0.56, 0.66, 0.44); cT = vec3(0.04, 0.17, 0.19); a = 0.85; }
    else { cS = vec3(0.70, 0.70, 0.68); cT = vec3(0.10, 0.16, 0.27); a = 0.9; }
    vec3 c = mix(cS, cT, uTwin); float f = 1.0 - exp(-pow(uFogD * vFogZ, 2.0)); c = mix(c, uFogC, clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0));
    gl_FragColor = vec4(c, a * uFade); }`, {depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide});
/* roads and other lines as ribbons: highways glow amber with moving light, streets in cool blue */
const lineMat = cityMat(CITY_VS_HEAD + `attribute float aCls; attribute float aSide; attribute float aAlong; varying float vC; varying float vS; varying float vA;
  void main(){ float y = uH + aRel * uRel + (aCls > 99.0 ? 1.2 : 2.2) * uM2U; vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position.x, y, position.z, 1.0); vC = aCls; vS = aSide; vA = aAlong;
    vec4 mv = viewMatrix * w; vFogZ = -mv.z; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  `uniform float uTwin; uniform float uFade; uniform float uTime; uniform float uStreet; ` + CITY_FOG + ` varying float vC; varying float vS; varying float vA;
  void main(){ float e = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, abs(vS)); vec3 cS, cT; float a = 1.0;
    if (vC < 2.5) { cS = vec3(1.0, 0.86, 0.62); float rim = smoothstep(0.55, 0.9, abs(vS)); float fl = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(vA * 0.05 - uTime * 3.0), 12.0); cT = vec3(0.42, 0.2, 0.05) + vec3(1.0, 0.58, 0.18) * rim * 0.75 + vec3(1.0, 0.8, 0.5) * fl * 0.7; }
    else if (vC < 3.5) { cS = vec3(1.0, 0.93, 0.78); cT = vec3(0.62, 0.38, 0.12) + vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.25) * smoothstep(0.55, 0.9, abs(vS)) * 0.5; }
    else if (vC < 5.5) { cS = vec3(0.98, 0.98, 0.96); cT = vec3(0.25, 0.55, 0.95); a = 0.85; }
    else if (vC < 7.5) { cS = vec3(0.95, 0.94, 0.92); cT = vec3(0.16, 0.34, 0.62); a = 0.7 * mix(0.35, 1.0, uStreet); }
    else if (vC < 9.5) { cS = vec3(0.45, 0.42, 0.4); cT = vec3(0.55, 0.45, 0.85); a = 0.85; }
    else if (vC < 99.0) { cS = vec3(0.35, 0.6, 0.8); cT = vec3(0.08, 0.3, 0.55); a = 0.8; }
    else { cS = vec3(0.55, 0.55, 0.55); cT = vec3(0.3, 0.45, 0.6); a = 0.9; }
    vec3 c = mix(cS, cT, uTwin); a *= mix(0.55 + 0.45 * e, e, uTwin);
    float f = 1.0 - exp(-pow(uFogD * vFogZ, 2.0)); c = mix(c, uFogC, clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0));
    gl_FragColor = vec4(c, a * uFade); }`, {depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide});
const RW = [0, 26, 20, 15, 12, 10, 7, 5, 4, 4, 5];       // ribbon width in metres by road class
const WW = [0, 26, 14, 6, 4];
const AW = [0, 45, 22, 0, 0, 0];

/* ---- decoding ---- */
function cityTileGeo(buf, off){
  const dv = new DataView(buf, off);
  const z = dv.getUint8(0), x = dv.getUint16(2, true), y = dv.getUint16(4, true);
  let o = off + 8; const sec = [];
  for (let s = 0; s < 6; s++) {
    const nm = new DataView(buf, o).getUint32(0, true), nc = new DataView(buf, o).getUint32(4, true); o += 8;
    const meta = new Uint16Array(buf.slice(o, o + nm * 2)); o += nm * 2;
    const co = new Int16Array(buf.slice(o, o + nc * 2)); o += nc * 2;
    sec.push([meta, co]);
  }
  /* tile pixel -> scene, linear inside the tile (a 2 km square) */
  const lon0 = tile2lon(x, z), lon1 = tile2lon(x + 1, z), lat0 = tile2lat(y, z), lat1 = tile2lat(y + 1, z);
  const X0 = lonX(lon0), X1 = lonX(lon1), Z0 = latZ(lat0), Z1 = latZ(lat1);
  const sx = px => X0 + (X1 - X0) * px / 4096, sz = py => Z0 + (Z1 - Z0) * py / 4096;
  return {x, y, z, sec, sx, sz, cx: (X0 + X1) / 2, cz: (Z0 + Z1) / 2, size: Math.abs(X1 - X0), lat: (lat0 + lat1) / 2, mpp: Math.abs(Z1 - Z0) / 4096 / M2U};
}
/* landmarks drawn with their true shape (tiles only know flat-roofed footprints, so a pyramid would come out as a box) */
const LANDMARKS = [
  {k: "pyr", lat: 29.97917, lon: 31.13417, base: 230, h: 138.5, name: "هرم خوفو"},
  {k: "pyr", lat: 29.97611, lon: 31.13083, base: 215, h: 136.4, name: "هرم خفرع"},
  {k: "pyr", lat: 29.97250, lon: 31.12833, base: 103, h: 65, name: "هرم منكاورع"},
  {k: "step", lat: 29.87130, lon: 31.21650, base: 121, base2: 109, h: 62, steps: 6, name: "هرم زوسر المدرج"}
];
LANDMARKS.forEach(L => { L.x = lonX(L.lon); L.z = latZ(L.lat); L.r = L.base * 0.75 * M2U; });
const nearLandmark = (x, z) => LANDMARKS.some(L => Math.hypot(x - L.x, z - L.z) < L.r);
function buildBuildings(T, keep){
  const [meta, co] = T.sec[0]; if (!meta.length) return null;
  const P = [], N = [], BH = [], R = [], I = [], CC = []; let m = 0, c = 0, bcx = 0, bcz = 0;
  while (m < meta.length) {
    const h = meta[m] / 10, mh = meta[m + 1] / 10, nr = meta[m + 2]; m += 3;
    const rings = []; for (let r = 0; r < nr; r++) { const n = meta[m + r]; const ring = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { ring.push(new THREE.Vector2(T.sx(co[c]), T.sz(co[c + 1]))); c += 2; } rings.push(ring); }
    m += nr; if (h <= mh) continue;
    const v0 = P.length / 3;
    { let cx = 0, cz = 0; const o = rings[0]; o.forEach(v => { cx += v.x; cz += v.y; }); cx /= o.length; cz /= o.length; bcx = cx; bcz = cz;
      if (model3dCovers(cx, cz)) continue;                      /* a true-shape model stands here (models3d.js): never two masses on one footprint */
      if (keep ? !keep(cx, cz) : nearLandmark(cx, cz)) continue; }
    const top = Math.max(h, mh + 2.5);
    /* walls */
    rings.forEach(ring => { const n = ring.length; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % n]; const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.y - a.y, l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1, nx = dz / l, nz = -dx / l;
      const ra = relH(a.x, a.y), rb = relH(b.x, b.y), base = P.length / 3;
      P.push(a.x, mh, a.y, b.x, mh, b.y, b.x, top, b.y, a.x, top, a.y); for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) { N.push(nx, 0, nz); BH.push(top); } R.push(ra, rb, rb, ra);
      I.push(base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3); } });
    /* roof */
    const outer = rings[0], holes = rings.slice(1);
    let tris; try { tris = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(outer, holes); } catch (e) { tris = []; }
    const all = outer.concat(...holes), base = P.length / 3;
    all.forEach(v => { P.push(v.x, top, v.y); N.push(0, 1, 0); BH.push(top); R.push(relH(v.x, v.y)); });
    tris.forEach(t => I.push(base + t[0], base + t[1], base + t[2]));
    for (let q = P.length / 3 - v0; q > 0; q--) CC.push(bcx, bcz);
  }
  if (!I.length) return null;
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(P, 3)); g.setAttribute("aN", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(N, 3)); g.setAttribute("aC", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(CC, 2));
  g.setAttribute("aBH", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(BH, 1)); g.setAttribute("aRel", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(R, 1));
  g.setIndex(P.length / 3 > 65535 ? new THREE.Uint32BufferAttribute(I, 1) : new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(I, 1));
  return g;
}
function buildFlat(T){
  const P = [], R = [], Kd = [], L = [], I = [];
  const add = (s, kind, lift) => { const [meta, co] = T.sec[s]; let m = 0, c = 0;
    while (m < meta.length) { const cls = meta[m], nr = meta[m + 1]; m += 2; const rings = [];
      for (let r = 0; r < nr; r++) { const n = meta[m + r]; const ring = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { ring.push(new THREE.Vector2(T.sx(co[c]), T.sz(co[c + 1]))); c += 2; } rings.push(ring); }
      m += nr; if (s === 5 && cls >= 100) continue;
      let tris; try { tris = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(rings[0], rings.slice(1)); } catch (e) { tris = []; }
      const all = rings[0].concat(...rings.slice(1)), base = P.length / 3; const k = kind(cls);
      all.forEach(v => { P.push(v.x, 0, v.y); R.push(relH(v.x, v.y)); Kd.push(k); L.push(lift); });
      tris.forEach(t => I.push(base + t[0], base + t[1], base + t[2])); } };
  add(3, () => 2, 0.8); add(2, () => 1, 1.4);
  /* aprons and airfields are polygons in the aeroway section */
  { const [meta, co] = T.sec[5]; let m = 0, c = 0;
    while (m < meta.length) { const cls = meta[m];
      if (cls >= 100) { const n = meta[m + 1]; m += 2; c += n * 2; continue; }
      const nr = meta[m + 1]; m += 2; const rings = [];
      for (let r = 0; r < nr; r++) { const n = meta[m + r]; const ring = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { ring.push(new THREE.Vector2(T.sx(co[c]), T.sz(co[c + 1]))); c += 2; } rings.push(ring); }
      m += nr; if (cls === 3) continue;
      let tris; try { tris = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(rings[0], rings.slice(1)); } catch (e) { tris = []; }
      const all = rings[0].concat(...rings.slice(1)), base = P.length / 3;
      all.forEach(v => { P.push(v.x, 0, v.y); R.push(relH(v.x, v.y)); Kd.push(3); L.push(1.0); });
      tris.forEach(t => I.push(base + t[0], base + t[1], base + t[2])); } }
  if (!I.length) return null;
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(P, 3)); g.setAttribute("aRel", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(R, 1));
  g.setAttribute("aKind", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(Kd, 1)); g.setAttribute("aLift", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(L, 1));
  g.setIndex(P.length / 3 > 65535 ? new THREE.Uint32BufferAttribute(I, 1) : new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(I, 1));
  return g;
}
function buildLines(T){
  const P = [], R = [], C = [], S = [], A = [], I = [];
  const add = (s, clsOf, wOf) => { const [meta, co] = T.sec[s]; let m = 0, c = 0;
    while (m < meta.length) {
      if (s === 5 && meta[m] < 100) { const nr = meta[m + 1]; let tot = 0; for (let r = 0; r < nr; r++) tot += meta[m + 2 + r]; m += 2 + nr; c += tot * 2; continue; }
      const cls = meta[m], n = meta[m + 1]; m += 2;
      const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { pts.push([T.sx(co[c]), T.sz(co[c + 1])]); c += 2; }
      const w = wOf(cls) * M2U * 0.5; if (!w) continue; const cc = clsOf(cls); let along = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = pts[i], a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)]; let tx = b[0] - a[0], tz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1; tx /= l; tz /= l;
        if (i > 0) along += Math.hypot(p[0] - pts[i - 1][0], p[1] - pts[i - 1][1]) / M2U;
        const rr = relH(p[0], p[1]); P.push(p[0] - tz * w, 0, p[1] + tx * w, p[0] + tz * w, 0, p[1] - tx * w); R.push(rr, rr); C.push(cc, cc); S.push(-1, 1); A.push(along, along);
        if (i < n - 1) { const b0 = P.length / 3 - 2; I.push(b0, b0 + 1, b0 + 2, b0 + 1, b0 + 3, b0 + 2); } } } };
  add(1, c => c, c => RW[c] || 4);
  add(4, c => 10, c => WW[c] || 4);
  add(5, c => c, c => AW[c - 100] || 0);
  if (!I.length) return null;
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(P, 3)); g.setAttribute("aRel", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(R, 1));
  g.setAttribute("aCls", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(C, 1)); g.setAttribute("aSide", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(S, 1)); g.setAttribute("aAlong", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(A, 1));
  g.setIndex(P.length / 3 > 65535 ? new THREE.Uint32BufferAttribute(I, 1) : new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(I, 1));
  return g;
}

function buildLandmarks(keep){
  const P = [], N = [], BH = [], R = [], I = [];
  const quad = (a, b, c, d, n, top) => { const base = P.length / 3; [a, b, c, d].forEach(v => { P.push(v[0], v[1], v[2]); N.push(n[0], n[1], n[2]); BH.push(top); R.push(relH(v[0], v[2])); }); I.push(base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3); };
  const tri = (a, b, c, n, top) => { const base = P.length / 3; [a, b, c].forEach(v => { P.push(v[0], v[1], v[2]); N.push(n[0], n[1], n[2]); BH.push(top); R.push(relH(v[0], v[2])); }); I.push(base, base + 1, base + 2); };
  LANDMARKS.forEach(L => { if (keep && !keep(L.x, L.z)) return;
    if (L.k === "pyr") { const hw = L.base / 2 * M2U, ap = [L.x, L.h, L.z], c = [[-hw, -hw], [hw, -hw], [hw, hw], [-hw, hw]].map(([dx, dz]) => [L.x + dx, 0, L.z + dz]);
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = c[i], b = c[(i + 1) % 4], mx = (a[0] + b[0]) / 2 - L.x, mz = (a[2] + b[2]) / 2 - L.z, l = Math.hypot(mx, mz); tri(a, b, ap, [mx / l * 0.78, 0.62, mz / l * 0.78], L.h); } }
    else { for (let s = 0; s < L.steps; s++) { const f = 1 - s / L.steps * 0.62, hx = L.base / 2 * f * M2U, hz = L.base2 / 2 * f * M2U, y0 = L.h * s / L.steps, y1 = L.h * (s + 1) / L.steps - 1.2;
        const c = [[-hx, -hz], [hx, -hz], [hx, hz], [-hx, hz]].map(([dx, dz]) => [L.x + dx, L.z + dz]);
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = c[i], b = c[(i + 1) % 4], nx = (a[1] === b[1]) ? 0 : (a[0] > L.x ? 1 : -1), nz = (a[1] === b[1]) ? (a[1] > L.z ? 1 : -1) : 0;
          quad([a[0], y0, a[1]], [b[0], y0, b[1]], [b[0], y1, b[1]], [a[0], y1, a[1]], [nx, 0, nz], y1); }
        quad([c[0][0], y1, c[0][1]], [c[1][0], y1, c[1][1]], [c[2][0], y1, c[2][1]], [c[3][0], y1, c[3][1]], [0, 1, 0], y1); } }
  });
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(P, 3)); g.setAttribute("aN", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(N, 3));
  g.setAttribute("aBH", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(BH, 1)); g.setAttribute("aRel", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(R, 1)); g.setIndex(I);
  g.setAttribute("aC", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(P.length / 3 * 2).fill(1e6), 2));      /* landmarks are never cleared by a model */
  if (keep) return I.length ? g : null;
  if (globalThis.__landM) { cityGroup.remove(globalThis.__landM); globalThis.__landM.geometry.dispose(); }      /* rebuilt once the workshop models have taken their landmarks over */
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(g, bldMat); m.renderOrder = 3; m.frustumCulled = false; cityGroup.add(m); globalThis.__landM = m;
}
buildLandmarks();

/* the buildings that belong to an exactly located project, lifted out in the sector colour with a rising scan */
/* the simulation: each real building of the site rises in the sector colour, one after another, with a bright construction front at its top */
const hiMat = cityMat(CITY_VS_HEAD + `attribute float aBH; attribute vec3 aN; uniform float uGrow; varying float vH; varying float vBH; varying float vR; varying vec3 vN; varying float vG;
  void main(){ vec3 p = position; p.xz += aN.xz * 0.9 * uM2U; float top = step(0.5, aN.y);
    float st = fract(aBH * 0.6180339 + 0.37) * 0.4, g = clamp((uGrow - st) / 0.6, 0.0, 1.0); g = g * g * (3.0 - 2.0 * g); vG = g;
    float y = uH + aRel * uRel + (p.y + top * 0.9) * uM2U; vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(p.x, y, p.z, 1.0);
    vH = p.y; vBH = aBH; vR = top; vN = aN; vec4 mv = viewMatrix * w; vFogZ = -mv.z; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  `uniform vec3 uHiCol; uniform float uHiK; uniform float uTime; ` + CITY_FOG + ` varying float vH; varying float vBH; varying float vR; varying vec3 vN; varying float vG;
  void main(){ if (vG < 0.004) discard; float k = clamp(vH / max(vBH, 0.5), 0.0, 1.0);
    /* the sector colour climbs the real walls like a rising scan, then the roof lights up: the building keeps its true size the whole time */
    if (vR < 0.5 && k > vG + 0.001) discard; float roofA = smoothstep(0.9, 1.0, vG); if (vR > 0.5 && roofA < 0.01) discard;
    float scan = smoothstep(0.08, 0.0, abs(fract(uTime * 0.35) - k)) * (1.0 - vR) * step(0.999, vG);
    float edge = smoothstep(vBH - 1.8, vBH, vH) * (1.0 - vR);
    float front = (1.0 - step(0.999, vG)) * smoothstep(0.12, 0.0, vG - k) * (1.0 - vR);          /* the bright rim of the wipe */
    vec3 L = normalize(vec3(0.45, 0.8, 0.35)); float lam = 0.62 + 0.38 * abs(dot(normalize(vN), L));
    vec3 c = uHiCol * (0.3 + 0.5 * k + vR * 0.3) * lam + vec3(1.0) * (scan * 0.55 + edge * 0.6) + mix(uHiCol, vec3(1.0), 0.5) * front * 0.9;
    gl_FragColor = vec4(c, uHiK * (0.62 + 0.25 * vR + scan * 0.3 + front * 0.2) * mix(1.0, roofA, vR)); }`, {depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, blending: THREE.NormalBlending});
let hiMesh = null, hiSig = "";
function cityHighlight(g, site){
  if (!g || !site) { if (hiMesh) { cityGroup.remove(hiMesh); hiMesh.geometry.dispose(); hiMesh = null; } hiSig = null; return; }
  const ring = g.pl ? g.pl.map(([lo, la]) => [lonX(lo), latZ(la)]) : null, R2 = Math.pow((g.m || 600) * 0.55 * M2U, 2);
  const inside = (x, z) => { if (!ring) return (x - site.x) * (x - site.x) + (z - site.z) * (z - site.z) < R2;
    let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = ring.length - 1; i < ring.length; j = i++) { const [xi, zi] = ring[i], [xj, zj] = ring[j]; if ((zi > z) !== (zj > z) && x < (xj - xi) * (z - zi) / (zj - zi) + xi) c = !c; } return c; };
  const span = ring ? Math.max(...ring.map(([x, z]) => Math.hypot(x - site.x, z - site.z))) : Math.sqrt(R2);
  const near = []; cityTiles.forEach((e, key) => { if (Math.hypot(e.T.cx - site.x, e.T.cz - site.z) < span + e.T.size) near.push(key); });
  const sig = near.sort().join(","); if (sig === hiSig) return; hiSig = sig;
  const parts = near.map(k => buildBuildings(cityTiles.get(k).T, inside)).concat([buildLandmarks(inside)]).filter(Boolean);
  if (hiMesh) { cityGroup.remove(hiMesh); hiMesh.geometry.dispose(); hiMesh = null; }
  if (!parts.length) return;
  const geo = parts.length === 1 ? parts[0] : mergeGeos(parts);
  hiMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, hiMat); hiMesh.renderOrder = 8; hiMesh.frustumCulled = false; cityGroup.add(hiMesh);
}
function mergeGeos(list){
  /* preallocated arrays (spreading big typed arrays into push() overflows the argument limit in Safari) */
  const names = ["position", "aN", "aBH", "aRel"], out = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  const tot = names.map(n => list.reduce((a, g) => a + g.attributes[n].array.length, 0)), ni = list.reduce((a, g) => a + g.index.array.length, 0);
  const arrs = tot.map(t => new Float32Array(t)), off = names.map(() => 0); const vtot = list.reduce((a, g) => a + g.attributes.position.count, 0);
  const idx = vtot > 65535 ? new Uint32Array(ni) : new Uint16Array(ni); let io = 0, vn = 0;
  list.forEach(g => { names.forEach((n, i) => { arrs[i].set(g.attributes[n].array, off[i]); off[i] += g.attributes[n].array.length; });
    const ix = g.index.array; for (let i = 0; i < ix.length; i++) idx[io++] = ix[i] + vn; vn += g.attributes.position.count; g.dispose(); });
  names.forEach((n, i) => out.setAttribute(n, new THREE.BufferAttribute(arrs[i], n === "position" || n === "aN" ? 3 : 1)));
  out.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(idx, 1)); return out;
}

/* ---- loading: bundles of z14 tiles, fetched next to the page ---- */
const cityBundles = CITYMAN.map(b => Object.assign({}, b, {st: 0, tiles: null}));   // st: 0 idle, 1 loading, 2 ready, -1 failed
const cityTiles = new Map();                                                       // key -> {T, meshes:[], built}
let cityInflight = 0, cityAcc = 0, cityBuilt = 0;
/* over http the bundles are fetched as text; opened from a local folder (offline package) each bundle is a small script that hands its data over */
const CITY_WAIT = {};
window.__egTile = (name, txt) => { const w = CITY_WAIT[name]; delete CITY_WAIT[name]; if (w) w(txt); };
function cityLoad(b){
  b.st = 1; cityInflight++;
  const done = txt => {
    try {
      const bin = atob(txt.trim()), u8 = new Uint8Array(bin.length); for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) u8[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i); const buf = u8.buffer;
      const dv = new DataView(buf); const n = dv.getUint32(4, true); let o = 8 + n * 4; const tl = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const len = dv.getUint32(8 + i * 4, true); tl.push(cityTileGeo(buf, o)); o += len; }
      b.tiles = tl; b.st = 2; cityInflight--;
      tl.forEach(T => cityTiles.set(T.x + "_" + T.y, {T, meshes: null, a: 0}));
    } catch (e) { fail(); }
  };
  const fail = () => { cityInflight--; b.tries = (b.tries || 0) + 1; b.st = -1; if (b.tries < 4) setTimeout(() => { b.st = 0; }, 3000 * b.tries); };
  if (window.EG_OFFLINE) {
    const name = b.f.replace(/\.txt$/, ""); CITY_WAIT[name] = done;
    const s = document.createElement("script"); s.src = EGB + "c/" + name + ".js"; s.async = true;
    s.onload = () => { s.remove(); if (CITY_WAIT[name]) { delete CITY_WAIT[name]; fail(); } }; s.onerror = () => { s.remove(); delete CITY_WAIT[name]; fail(); };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  } else fetch(EGB + "c/" + b.f).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.text(); }).then(done).catch(fail);
}
function cityBuild(e){
  const T = e.T; e.meshes = [];
  const gB = buildBuildings(T), gF = buildFlat(T), gL = buildLines(T);
  if (gF) { const m = new THREE.Mesh(gF, flatMat); m.renderOrder = 1; m.frustumCulled = false; e.meshes.push(m); }
  if (gL) { const m = new THREE.Mesh(gL, lineMat); m.renderOrder = 2; m.frustumCulled = false; e.meshes.push(m); }
  if (gB) { const m = new THREE.Mesh(gB, bldMat); m.renderOrder = 3; m.frustumCulled = false; e.meshes.push(m); }
  /* the shaders place vertices, so give each tile a hand-made bounding sphere and let the camera skip tiles it cannot see */
  const bs = new THREE.Sphere(new THREE.Vector3(T.cx, H + 0.1, T.cz), T.size * 0.75 + 0.3);
  e.meshes.forEach(m => { m.geometry.boundingSphere = bs; m.frustumCulled = true; cityGroup.add(m); }); cityBuilt++;
}
function cityDrop(e){ e.meshes.forEach(m => { cityGroup.remove(m); m.geometry.dispose(); }); e.meshes = null; cityBuilt--; }
function updateCity(dt){
  updateRegion(dt);
  const vis = (1 - sstep(0.55, 1.4, ZS.d)) * (1 - mD) * (1 - Math.min(1, mL * 3));
  CU.uFade.value += ((vis > 0.02 ? 1 : 0) - CU.uFade.value) * Math.min(1, dt * 3);
  CU.uFade.value = Math.min(CU.uFade.value, vis * 1.6);
  cityGroup.visible = CU.uFade.value > 0.01; if (osmAttr) { const sh = cityGroup.visible || RU.uRA.value > 0.02; if (osmAttr.hidden === sh) osmAttr.hidden = !sh; }
  CU.uFogC.value.copy(scene.fog.color); CU.uFogD.value = scene.fog.density; CU.uSea.value = plinthTop.map; CU.uStreet.value = ZS.street;

  cityAcc += dt; if (cityAcc < 0.25) return; cityAcc = 0;
  if (vis <= 0.01 || !CITYMAN.length) return;
  const tx = controls.target.x, tz = controls.target.z, lon = xLon(tx), lat = zLat(tz);
  const R = Math.max(0.05, ZS.d * 1.5);                                  // scene units around the target to keep built
  const Rdeg = R / (K * SC) + 0.02;
  cityBundles.forEach(b => { if (b.st !== 0 || cityInflight >= 3) return;
    if (lon > b.bb[0] - Rdeg && lon < b.bb[2] + Rdeg && lat > b.bb[1] - Rdeg && lat < b.bb[3] + Rdeg) cityLoad(b); });
  /* build the nearest few tiles per tick, drop far ones */
  const cand = [];
  cityTiles.forEach(e => { const d = Math.hypot(e.T.cx - tx, e.T.cz - tz); e.d = d;
    if (!e.meshes && d < R + e.T.size) cand.push(e);
    else if (e.meshes && d > R * 2.2 + e.T.size * 2 && cityBuilt > 24) cityDrop(e); });
  /* dense cities: a cap on live tiles; a new tile only replaces a farther one, so nothing is built just to be thrown away */
  const CAP = innerWidth <= 900 ? 70 : 120;
  for (const e of cand.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d).slice(0, 3)) {
    if (cityBuilt >= CAP) { let far = null; cityTiles.forEach(q => { if (q.meshes && (!far || q.d > far.d)) far = q; }); if (!far || far.d <= e.d + 1e-4) break; cityDrop(far); }
    cityBuild(e);
  }
}
function cityApplyTheme(){}
/* start fetching the street tiles around a point before the camera gets there (the drone tour calls this one hop ahead) */
function cityPrefetch(x, z){ const lon = xLon(x), lat = zLat(z); cityBundles.forEach(b => { if (b.st === 0 && lon > b.bb[0] - 0.03 && lon < b.bb[2] + 0.03 && lat > b.bb[1] - 0.03 && lat < b.bb[3] + 0.03) cityLoad(b); }); }

   Bundles load lazily around the camera target below a regional altitude. Two coverage masks (one texel per zoom-11 / zoom-14 tile)
   drive every cross-fade in the shaders, so nothing is drawn twice:
     national roads (roads.js)  x (1 - region)      region  x (1 - street tiles)                                                    */

  varying float vC; varying float vS; varying vec2 vXZ; varying float vFogZ;
  void main(){ float c = abs(aSC); vC = c; vS = sign(aSC);
    vec3 p = vec3(position.x, uH + uLift * (c > 20.0 ? 1.25 : 1.5), position.z); float dist = distance(cameraPosition, p);
    float px = c < 1.5 ? 3.6 : c < 2.5 ? 3.2 : c < 3.5 ? 2.6 : c < 4.5 ? 2.1 : c < 5.5 ? 1.7 : c < 7.5 ? 1.3 : c < 9.5 ? 1.5 : c < 21.5 ? 2.4 : c < 22.5 ? 1.9 : 1.4;
    float wm = c < 1.5 ? 26.0 : c < 2.5 ? 20.0 : c < 3.5 ? 15.0 : c < 4.5 ? 12.0 : c < 5.5 ? 10.0 : c < 7.5 ? 7.0 : c < 9.5 ? 4.0 : c < 21.5 ? 26.0 : c < 22.5 ? 14.0 : 6.0;
    float hw = max(px * uPR * dist / uScale * 0.5, wm * uM2U * 0.5);
    p.xz += vec2(-aDir.y, aDir.x) * vS * hw; vXZ = p.xz; vec4 mv = viewMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0); vFogZ = -mv.z; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  `uniform float uTwin; uniform float uD; uniform vec3 uFogC; uniform float uFogD; varying float vC; varying float vS; varying vec2 vXZ; varying float vFogZ;
  ` + REG_GLSL + `
  void main(){ float e = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.45, 1.0, abs(vS)), rim = smoothstep(0.5, 0.9, abs(vS)); vec3 cS, cT; float a = 1.0, lod = 1.0;
    if (vC < 2.5) { cS = vec3(0.93, 0.52, 0.16); cT = vec3(0.62, 0.32, 0.08) + vec3(1.0, 0.58, 0.18) * rim * 0.6; }
    else if (vC < 3.5) { cS = vec3(0.90, 0.66, 0.34); cT = vec3(0.62, 0.38, 0.12) + vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.25) * rim * 0.4; }
    else if (vC < 4.5) { cS = vec3(0.99, 0.98, 0.95); cT = vec3(0.25, 0.55, 0.95); a = 0.9; }
    else if (vC < 5.5) { cS = vec3(0.98, 0.97, 0.94); cT = vec3(0.20, 0.44, 0.80); a = 0.8; lod = 1.0 - smoothstep(2.4, 3.6, uD); }
    else if (vC < 7.5) { cS = vec3(0.95, 0.94, 0.92); cT = vec3(0.16, 0.34, 0.62); a = 0.65; lod = 1.0 - smoothstep(1.2, 1.9, uD); }
    else if (vC < 9.5) { cS = vec3(0.45, 0.42, 0.40); cT = vec3(0.55, 0.45, 0.85); a = 0.8; lod = 1.0 - smoothstep(3.0, 4.4, uD); }
    else if (vC < 21.5) { cS = vec3(0.10, 0.36, 0.44); cT = vec3(0.05, 0.20, 0.42); }
    else if (vC < 22.5) { cS = vec3(0.16, 0.44, 0.54); cT = vec3(0.08, 0.30, 0.55); a = 0.9; lod = 1.0 - smoothstep(3.2, 4.6, uD); }
    else { cS = vec3(0.22, 0.50, 0.58); cT = vec3(0.07, 0.26, 0.48); a = 0.75; lod = 1.0 - smoothstep(1.4, 2.2, uD); }
    a *= lod * mix(0.6 + 0.4 * e, e, uTwin) * regAlpha(vXZ); if (a < 0.004) discard;
    vec3 c = mix(cS, cT, uTwin); float f = 1.0 - exp(-pow(uFogD * vFogZ, 2.0)); c = mix(c, uFogC, clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0));
    gl_FragColor = vec4(c, a); }`);
/* flat land: water, green, built-up, industrial */
const regFlatMat = regMat(`attribute float aKind; uniform float uH; uniform float uLift; varying float vK; varying vec2 vXZ; varying float vFogZ;
  void main(){ vK = aKind; vec3 p = vec3(position.x, uH + uLift * (aKind < 1.5 ? 1.0 : aKind < 5.0 ? 0.8 : 0.6), position.z); vXZ = p.xz;
    vec4 mv = viewMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0); vFogZ = -mv.z; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  `uniform float uTwin; uniform vec3 uFogC; uniform float uFogD; varying float vK; varying vec2 vXZ; varying float vFogZ;
  ` + REG_GLSL + SEA_GLSL + `
  void main(){ vec3 cS, cT; float a = 1.0;
    if (vK < 1.5) { cS = cT = seaCol(vXZ); }
    else if (vK < 5.0) { cS = vec3(0.56, 0.66, 0.44); cT = vec3(0.04, 0.17, 0.19); a = 0.8; }
    else if (vK < 10.5) { cS = vec3(0.74, 0.68, 0.60); cT = vec3(0.10, 0.19, 0.33); a = 0.62; }
    else { cS = vec3(0.70, 0.67, 0.71); cT = vec3(0.14, 0.15, 0.33); a = 0.62; }
    a *= regAlpha(vXZ); if (a < 0.004) discard;
    vec3 c = mix(cS, cT, uTwin); float f = 1.0 - exp(-pow(uFogD * vFogZ, 2.0)); c = mix(c, uFogC, clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0));
    gl_FragColor = vec4(c, a); }`);
const regGroup = new THREE.Group(); regGroup.visible = false; scene.add(regGroup);
const regBundles = REGMAN.b.map(b => Object.assign({}, b, {st: 0, buf: null, keys: null}));     // st: 0 idle, 1 loading, 2 ready, -1 failed
const regTiles = new Map(), regLive = new Set();
let regInflight = 0, regAcc = 0, regQueue = [];
/* text bundles come over http, or as small scripts in the offline package (same hand-over as the street tiles) */
function egFetchTxt(dir, f, done, fail){
  if (window.EG_OFFLINE) { const name = f.replace(/\.txt$/, ""); CITY_WAIT[name] = done; const s = document.createElement("script"); s.src = EGB + dir + name + ".js"; s.async = true;
    s.onload = () => { s.remove(); if (CITY_WAIT[name]) { delete CITY_WAIT[name]; fail(); } }; s.onerror = () => { s.remove(); delete CITY_WAIT[name]; fail(); }; document.head.appendChild(s); }
  else fetch(EGB + dir + f).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.text(); }).then(done).catch(fail);
}
/* base64 -> bytes in slices, so a 1 MB bundle never blocks a frame */
function b64Async(txt, cb, fail){
  try { txt = txt.trim(); const n = txt.length, pad = txt.endsWith("==") ? 2 : txt.endsWith("=") ? 1 : 0, u8 = new Uint8Array(n / 4 * 3 - pad); let i = 0, o = 0; const CH = 1 << 18;
    const step = () => { try { const s = atob(txt.slice(i, i + CH)); for (let k = 0; k < s.length; k++) u8[o++] = s.charCodeAt(k); i += CH; if (i < n) setTimeout(step, 0); else cb(u8); } catch (e) { fail(); } }; step();
  } catch (e) { fail(); }
}
function regLoad(b){
  b.st = 1; regInflight++;
  const fail = () => { regInflight--; b.tries = (b.tries || 0) + 1; b.st = -1; if (b.tries < 4) setTimeout(() => { b.st = 0; }, 3000 * b.tries); };
  egFetchTxt("c2/", b.f, txt => b64Async(txt, u8 => {
    try { const buf = u8.buffer, dv = new DataView(buf), n = dv.getUint32(4, true), jl = dv.getUint32(8, true); let o = 12 + n * 4; const keys = [], ents = {};
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const len = dv.getUint32(12 + i * 4, true), x = dv.getUint16(o, true), y = dv.getUint16(o + 2, true), key = x + "_" + y;
        const X0 = lonX(tile2lon(x, 11)), X1 = lonX(tile2lon(x + 1, 11)), Z0 = latZ(tile2lat(y, 11)), Z1 = latZ(tile2lat(y + 1, 11));
        const e = {x, y, b, o, X0, X1, Z0, Z1, cx: (X0 + X1) / 2, cz: (Z0 + Z1) / 2, size: Math.abs(X1 - X0), meshes: null, a: 0, dying: false, d: 1e9, pl: null, mi: (y - RMY0) * RMW + (x - RMX0)};
        regTiles.set(key, e); keys.push(key); ents[key] = e; o += len; }
      const tail = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(u8.subarray(o, o + jl)));
      for (const k in tail.p) { const e = ents[k]; if (e) e.pl = tail.p[k].map(q => ({x: e.X0 + (e.X1 - e.X0) * q[0] / 4096, z: e.Z0 + (e.Z1 - e.Z0) * q[1] / 4096, c: q[2], r: q[3], n: q[4], k: q[2] + "|" + q[4] + "|" + k})); }
      b.buf = buf; b.keys = keys; b.st = 2; regInflight--;
    } catch (e) { fail(); } }, fail), fail);
}
function regBuild(e){
  const buf = e.b.buf, dv = new DataView(buf, e.o), nL = dv.getUint32(4, true), nLP = dv.getUint32(8, true), nP = dv.getUint32(12, true), nPV = dv.getUint32(16, true), nPI = dv.getUint32(20, true);
  let o = e.o + 24; const lm = new Uint16Array(buf, o, nL * 2); o += nL * 4; const lc = new Int16Array(buf, o, nLP * 2); o += nLP * 4;
  const pm = new Uint16Array(buf, o, nP * 4); o += nP * 8; const pc = new Int16Array(buf, o, nPV * 2); o += nPV * 4; const pi = new Uint16Array(buf, o, nPI);
  const kx = (e.X1 - e.X0) / 4096, kz = (e.Z1 - e.Z0) / 4096; e.meshes = [];
  const bs = new THREE.Sphere(new THREE.Vector3(e.cx, H, e.cz), e.size * 0.8 + 0.05);
  if (nPI) {
    const P = new Float32Array(nPV * 3), Kd = new Float32Array(nPV), I = nPV > 65535 ? new Uint32Array(nPI) : new Uint16Array(nPI), vo = new Uint32Array(nP), io = new Uint32Array(nP);
    let a = 0, b = 0, ii = 0; for (let p = 0; p < nP; p++) { vo[p] = a; io[p] = b; a += pm[p * 4 + 1]; b += pm[p * 4 + 2] + pm[p * 4 + 3] * 65536; }
    for (let v = 0; v < nPV; v++) { P[v * 3] = e.X0 + pc[v * 2] * kx; P[v * 3 + 2] = e.Z0 + pc[v * 2 + 1] * kz; }
    for (const kind of [10, 11, 2, 1]) for (let p = 0; p < nP; p++) { if (pm[p * 4] !== kind) continue;       /* painted bottom to top: built-up, industry, green, water */
      const nv = pm[p * 4 + 1], ni = pm[p * 4 + 2] + pm[p * 4 + 3] * 65536, v0 = vo[p], i0 = io[p];
      for (let v = 0; v < nv; v++) Kd[v0 + v] = kind; for (let i = 0; i < ni; i++) I[ii++] = v0 + pi[i0 + i]; }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(P, 3)); g.setAttribute("aKind", new THREE.BufferAttribute(Kd, 1)); g.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(I, 1)); g.setDrawRange(0, ii);
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(g, regFlatMat); m.renderOrder = 0.6; e.meshes.push(m);
  }
  if (nLP) {
    const nv = nLP * 2, P = new Float32Array(nv * 3), Dr = new Float32Array(nv * 2), Sc = new Float32Array(nv), I = nv > 65535 ? new Uint32Array((nLP - nL) * 6) : new Uint16Array((nLP - nL) * 6);
    let c = 0, v = 0, ii = 0;
    /* water lines first, then roads from the smallest class up, so a motorway is never painted over by a canal or a side road */
    const ord = []; for (let l = 0, cc = 0; l < nL; l++) { ord.push([lm[l * 2] > 20 ? 0 : 30 - lm[l * 2], cc, lm[l * 2], lm[l * 2 + 1]]); cc += lm[l * 2 + 1] * 2; } ord.sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]);
    for (const [, c0, cls, n] of ord) { c = c0;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = c + Math.max(0, i - 1) * 2, b = c + Math.min(n - 1, i + 1) * 2, q = c + i * 2;
        let dx = (lc[b] - lc[a]) * kx, dz = (lc[b + 1] - lc[a + 1]) * kz; const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= len; dz /= len;
        const x = e.X0 + lc[q] * kx, z = e.Z0 + lc[q + 1] * kz;
        P[v * 3] = x; P[v * 3 + 2] = z; P[v * 3 + 3] = x; P[v * 3 + 5] = z; Dr[v * 2] = dx; Dr[v * 2 + 1] = dz; Dr[v * 2 + 2] = dx; Dr[v * 2 + 3] = dz; Sc[v] = -cls; Sc[v + 1] = cls;
        if (i < n - 1) { I[ii++] = v; I[ii++] = v + 1; I[ii++] = v + 2; I[ii++] = v + 1; I[ii++] = v + 3; I[ii++] = v + 2; }
        v += 2; } }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(P, 3)); g.setAttribute("aDir", new THREE.BufferAttribute(Dr, 2)); g.setAttribute("aSC", new THREE.BufferAttribute(Sc, 1)); g.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(I, 1));
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(g, regLineMat); m.renderOrder = 0.8; e.meshes.push(m);
  }
  e.meshes.forEach(m => { m.geometry.boundingSphere = bs; m.frustumCulled = true; m.matrixAutoUpdate = false; regGroup.add(m); });
  e.dying = false; regLive.add(e);
}
function regDrop(e){ if (!e.meshes) return; e.meshes.forEach(m => { regGroup.remove(m); m.geometry.dispose(); }); e.meshes = null; e.a = 0; e.dying = false; regLive.delete(e); if (e.mi >= 0 && e.mi < regMaskData.length) regMaskData[e.mi] = 0; regMaskTex.needsUpdate = true; }
const cityMaskIdx = T => { const mx = T.x - RMX0 * 8, my = T.y - RMY0 * 8; return mx >= 0 && my >= 0 && mx < RMW * 8 && my < RMH * 8 ? my * RMW * 8 + mx : -1; };
function updateRegion(dt){
  const d = ZS.d, tx = controls.target.x, tz = controls.target.z, modeK = (1 - mD) * (1 - Math.min(1, mL * 3));
  const vis = (1 - sstep(4.6, 7.2, d)) * modeK;
  const R1 = clamp(d * 1.7, 1.4, 5.4);
  RU.uRA.value = vis; RU.uRC.value.set(tx, tz); RU.uRR.value.set(R1 * 0.68, R1); RU.uD.value = d; RU.uLift.value = clamp(d * 0.0016, 0.00012, 0.006) + TU.uTLift.value * 1.2;
  regGroup.visible = vis > 0.004 && regLive.size > 0;
  /* the masks: a region tile fades in once built and fades out before it is dropped; a street tile takes over from the region as soon as it is built */
  let ch = false;
  regLive.forEach(e => { const tgt = e.dying ? 0 : 1; if (e.a === tgt) return;
    e.a = tgt > e.a ? Math.min(1, e.a + dt * 2.2) : Math.max(0, e.a - dt * 3); regMaskData[e.mi] = Math.round(e.a * 255); ch = true; if (e.a === 0 && e.dying) regDrop(e); });
  if (ch) regMaskTex.needsUpdate = true;
  ch = false;
  cityTiles.forEach(e => { const tgt = e.meshes ? 1 : 0; if ((e.ma || 0) === tgt) return; const i = cityMaskIdx(e.T); e.ma = tgt ? Math.min(1, (e.ma || 0) + dt * 3) : 0; if (i >= 0) { cityMaskData[i] = Math.round(e.ma * 255); ch = true; } });
  if (ch) cityMaskTex.needsUpdate = true;
  regAcc += dt;
  if (regAcc >= 0.2) { regAcc = 0;
    if (d < 8.5 && modeK > 0.3 && REGMAN.b.length) {
      const lon = xLon(tx), lat = zLat(tz), Ry = (R1 + 0.5) / (K * SC), Rx = (R1 + 0.5) / (CXK * SC);
      const near = b => lon > b.bb[0] - Rx && lon < b.bb[2] + Rx && lat > b.bb[1] - Ry && lat < b.bb[3] + Ry;
      regBundles.forEach(b => { if (b.st === 0 && regInflight < 2 && near(b)) regLoad(b); });
      regQueue = [];
      regTiles.forEach(e => { const dd = Math.hypot(e.cx - tx, e.cz - tz); e.d = dd;
        if (!e.meshes) { if (dd < R1 + e.size * 0.75 && vis > 0.004) regQueue.push(e); }
        else e.dying = dd > R1 * 1.6 + e.size * 2; });
      regQueue.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
      /* keep at most a handful of decoded bundles: a far one with nothing on screen gives its memory back */
      const ready = regBundles.filter(b => b.st === 2);
      if (ready.length > 9) { const far = ready.filter(b => !near(b) && !b.keys.some(k => regTiles.get(k).meshes))
          .sort((p, q) => Math.hypot((q.bb[0] + q.bb[2]) / 2 - lon, (q.bb[1] + q.bb[3]) / 2 - lat) - Math.hypot((p.bb[0] + p.bb[2]) / 2 - lon, (p.bb[1] + p.bb[3]) / 2 - lat))[0];
        if (far) { far.keys.forEach(k => regTiles.delete(k)); far.keys = null; far.buf = null; far.st = 0; } }
    } else if (vis <= 0.004 && regLive.size) regLive.forEach(e => regDrop(e));
  }
  /* geometry is built off the critical path: a few milliseconds per frame, nearest tile first */
  if (regQueue.length) { const t0 = performance.now(), budget = clamp(dt * 250, 3, 40), CAP = innerWidth <= 900 ? 90 : 170;
    while (regQueue.length && performance.now() - t0 < budget) { const e = regQueue.shift(); if (e.meshes || !e.b.buf) continue;
      if (regLive.size >= CAP) { let far = null; regLive.forEach(q => { if (!far || q.d > far.d) far = q; }); if (!far || far.d <= e.d + 1e-4) { regQueue.length = 0; break; } regDrop(far); }
      regBuild(e); } }
  updatePlaceNames(dt);
}

/* ================= PLACE AND STREET NAMES, exactly as recorded in OpenFreeMap (name:ar, else name) =================
   DOM labels projected every frame like the governorate labels; level of detail by class, collision culling, never under the fixed panels */
{ const st = document.createElement("style"); st.textContent = `
.lb.pn{font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.15;color:#2b2218;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .4s;text-shadow:0 0 2px #fff,0 0 4px #fff,0 0 7px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.lb.pn.c1{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700}.lb.pn.c2{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600}.lb.pn.c4,.lb.pn.c5,.lb.pn.c6{font-size:.7rem;color:#54473a}
.lb.pn.c7{font-size:.7rem;font-style:italic;color:#0d5266}.lb.pn.st{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:500;color:#4a4036}
[data-map="twin"] .lb.pn{color:#eef3fb;text-shadow:0 0 3px #000,0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 1px 2px #000}
[data-map="twin"] .lb.pn.c4,[data-map="twin"] .lb.pn.c5,[data-map="twin"] .lb.pn.c6{color:#b9c6da}[data-map="twin"] .lb.pn.c7{color:#8fd0ff}[data-map="twin"] .lb.pn.st{color:#dfe8f6}`; document.head.appendChild(st); }
const PN_CITY = REGMAN.c.map(c => ({x: lonX(c[0]), z: latZ(c[1]), c: 1, r: c[2], n: c[3], k: "1|" + c[3] + "|" + c[0]}));
const PN_MAX = 40, ST_MAX = 25, pnPool = [], pnShown = new Map();
let pnAcc = 1, pnRem = 16;
/* street-name side files (one per zoom-8 square that has street tiles) */
const stFiles = (REGMAN.s || []).map(b => Object.assign({}, b, {st: 0})), stTiles = new Map(); let stInflight = 0;
function stLoad(b){ b.st = 1; stInflight++; const fail = () => { stInflight--; b.st = -1; b.tries = (b.tries || 0) + 1; if (b.tries < 4) setTimeout(() => { b.st = 0; }, 3000 * b.tries); };
  egFetchTxt("c2/", b.f, txt => b64Async(txt, u8 => { try { const j = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(u8));
      const ent = k => { let e = stTiles.get(k); if (!e) { const [x, y] = k.split("_").map(Number), X0 = lonX(tile2lon(x, 14)), X1 = lonX(tile2lon(x + 1, 14)), Z0 = latZ(tile2lat(y, 14)), Z1 = latZ(tile2lat(y + 1, 14)); e = {X0, Z0, kx: (X1 - X0) / 256, kz: (Z1 - Z0) / 256, s: [], p: []}; stTiles.set(k, e); } return e; };
      for (const k in j.t) { const e = ent(k); e.s = j.t[k].map(q => { const an = q[2] * 2 * Math.PI / 180; return {x: e.X0 + (q[0] + 0.5) * e.kx, z: e.Z0 + (q[1] + 0.5) * e.kz, dx: Math.cos(an), dz: Math.sin(an), c: q[3], n: j.n[q[4]], k: "s|" + j.n[q[4]] + "|" + k, st: 1}; }); }
      for (const k in j.p) { const e = ent(k); e.p = j.p[k].map(q => ({x: e.X0 + (q[0] + 0.5) * e.kx, z: e.Z0 + (q[1] + 0.5) * e.kz, c: q[2], r: q[3], n: q[4], k: q[2] + "|" + q[4] + "|" + k})); }
      b.st = 2; stInflight--; } catch (e) { fail(); } }, fail), fail); }
const PN_ORD = [0, 0, 1, 3, 4, 6, 5, 2];                          // class -> importance: city, town, water, village, suburb, hamlet, neighbourhood
function updatePlaceNames(dt){
  const d = ZS.d, on = d < 13 && (1 - mD) * (1 - mL) > 0.6 && typeof W === "number" && W > 1;
  pnAcc += dt;
  if (pnAcc >= 0.22 || (!on && pnShown.size)) { pnAcc = 0;
    const tx = controls.target.x, tz = controls.target.z, y = H + RU.uLift.value, cand = [];
    if (on) {
      pnRem = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize) || 16;
      const vis = 1.15 / scene.fog.density, cpx = camera.position.x, cpz = camera.position.z;          /* a name beyond what the haze lets through is not written on the horizon */
      const push = (q, pri) => { if (Math.hypot(q.x - cpx, q.z - cpz) > vis) return; const s = screenOf(q.x, y, q.z); if (s[2] > 1 || s[0] < 8 || s[0] > W - 8 || s[1] < 8 || s[1] > Hh - 8) return;
        cand.push({q, s, pri: pri + Math.hypot(s[0] - W / 2, s[1] - Hh / 2) * 0.012 - (pnShown.has(q.k) ? 60 : 0)}); };
      for (const q of PN_CITY) { if (q.r > (d > 7 ? 6 : d > 4.5 ? 9 : 99)) continue; push(q, q.r * 2); }
      const maxC = c => c === 2 ? d < 5 : c === 7 ? d < 2.6 : c === 3 ? d < 2.0 : c === 4 ? d < 1.3 : c === 6 ? d < 0.6 : c === 5 ? d < 0.5 : false;
      const R = clamp(d * 1.7, 1.4, 5.4);
      if (d < 5) regTiles.forEach(e => { if (!e.pl || Math.hypot(e.cx - tx, e.cz - tz) > R + e.size) return; for (const q of e.pl) if (maxC(q.c)) push(q, PN_ORD[q.c] * 100 + q.r * 2); });
      if (d < 1.1 && stFiles.length) {
        const lon = xLon(tx), lat = zLat(tz); stFiles.forEach(b => { if (b.st === 0 && stInflight < 1 && lon > b.bb[0] - 0.05 && lon < b.bb[2] + 0.05 && lat > b.bb[1] - 0.05 && lat < b.bb[3] + 0.05) stLoad(b); });
        const n = 16384, cx = Math.floor((lon + 180) / 360 * n), la = lat * Math.PI / 180, cy = Math.floor((1 - Math.log(Math.tan(la) + 1 / Math.cos(la)) / Math.PI) / 2 * n), rr = d < 0.25 ? 2 : d < 0.6 ? 4 : 7;
        for (let i = -rr; i <= rr; i++) for (let j = -rr; j <= rr; j++) { const e = stTiles.get((cx + i) + "_" + (cy + j)); if (!e) continue;
          for (const q of e.p) if (maxC(q.c)) push(q, PN_ORD[q.c] * 100 + q.r * 2 + 1);
          if (d < 0.5 && Math.abs(i) <= 3 && Math.abs(j) <= 3) for (const q of e.s) { if (q.c > (d < 0.1 ? 7 : d < 0.22 ? 6 : 4)) continue; push(q, 1000 + q.c * 40); } }
      }
      cand.sort((a, b) => a.pri - b.pri);
    }
    /* collision culling against the fixed panels, the governorate labels and each other */
    const placed = RESERVED.slice();
    if (on) for (const L of LBL) if (L.kind === "g" && L.vis) { const s = screenOf(L.x, H + 0.3, L.z), tw = (GN[L.id].length + 3) * 13 * 0.55 + 10; placed.push([s[0] - tw / 2, s[1] - 13, s[0] + tw / 2, s[1] + 8]); }
    const free = r => !placed.some(p => r[0] < p[2] && r[2] > p[0] && r[1] < p[3] && r[3] > p[1]);
    const keep = new Map(), names = new Map(); let np = 0, ns = 0;
    for (const c of cand) { const q = c.q, isSt = !!q.st; if (isSt ? ns >= ST_MAX : np >= PN_MAX) continue; if (keep.has(q.k)) continue;
      const fs = (isSt ? 0.7 : q.c === 1 ? 0.95 : q.c === 2 ? 0.82 : q.c === 3 ? 0.75 : 0.7) * pnRem, tw = q.n.length * fs * (q.c === 1 || q.c === 2 ? 0.62 : 0.54) + 12; let rect, ang = 0;
      if (isSt) { const s2 = screenOf(q.x + q.dx * 0.003, y, q.z + q.dz * 0.003); ang = Math.atan2(s2[1] - c.s[1], s2[0] - c.s[0]); if (ang > Math.PI / 2) ang -= Math.PI; else if (ang < -Math.PI / 2) ang += Math.PI;
        const hw = (Math.abs(Math.cos(ang)) * tw + Math.abs(Math.sin(ang)) * fs * 1.3) / 2, hh = (Math.abs(Math.sin(ang)) * tw + Math.abs(Math.cos(ang)) * fs * 1.3) / 2; rect = [c.s[0] - hw, c.s[1] - hh, c.s[0] + hw, c.s[1] + hh]; }
      else rect = [c.s[0] - tw / 2 - 3, c.s[1] - fs * 0.75 - 2, c.s[0] + tw / 2 + 3, c.s[1] + fs * 0.75 + 2];
      const prev = names.get(q.n); if (prev && Math.hypot(prev[0] - c.s[0], prev[1] - c.s[1]) < (isSt ? 260 : 120)) continue;       /* the same name is not repeated side by side */
      if (!free(rect)) continue; placed.push(rect); names.set(q.n, c.s); keep.set(q.k, q); if (isSt) ns++; else np++; }
    const now = performance.now();
    pnShown.forEach((o, k) => { if (!keep.has(k)) { o.el.classList.add("off"); o.tOff = now; o.key = null; pnShown.delete(k); } });
    keep.forEach((q, k) => { if (pnShown.has(k)) return;
      let o = pnPool.find(p => !p.key && now - p.tOff > 450);
      if (!o) { if (pnPool.length >= PN_MAX + ST_MAX + 12) return; const el = document.createElement("div"); el.className = "lb pn off"; labelsEl.appendChild(el); o = {el, key: null, tOff: 0}; pnPool.push(o); }
      o.key = k; o.q = q; o.el.textContent = q.n; o.el.className = "lb pn off " + (q.st ? "st" : "c" + q.c); o.fresh = 2; pnShown.set(k, o); });
  }
  if (!pnShown.size) return;
  const y = H + RU.uLift.value;
  pnShown.forEach(o => { const q = o.q, s = screenOf(q.x, y, q.z); let tr = `translate(${s[0].toFixed(1)}px,${s[1].toFixed(1)}px) translate(-50%,-50%)`;
    if (q.st) { const s2 = screenOf(q.x + q.dx * 0.003, y, q.z + q.dz * 0.003); let a = Math.atan2(s2[1] - s[1], s2[0] - s[0]); if (a > Math.PI / 2) a -= Math.PI; else if (a < -Math.PI / 2) a += Math.PI; tr += ` rotate(${(a * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1)}deg)`; }
    if (o.tr !== tr) { o.tr = tr; o.el.style.transform = tr; }
    if (o.fresh && --o.fresh === 0) o.el.classList.remove("off");                 /* placed first, shown a frame later, so it fades in where it belongs */
    if (s[2] > 1) o.el.classList.add("off"); });
}
if (QS.has("test")) window.__reg = {REGMAN, regBundles, regTiles, regLive, RU, pnShown, stTiles, stFiles, regMaskData, cityMaskData, get queue(){ return regQueue.length; }};

/* Iconic Tower, Central Business District, New Administrative Capital — procedural architectural study.
 * Unit = metre. X east, Y up, Z south. Origin WGS84 31.693848 E, 30.012736 N (centre of the circle fitted to the OSM outline).
 * Footprint outline: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (way 819256088).
 * Heights and floor count: CTBUH Skyscraper Center. Everything marked "estimated" in DIMENSIONS is a photo-derived approximation,
 * not surveyed as-built geometry: shell profile, slot, crown, facade subdivision, entrance.
 * No scanned geometry, raster textures, external model files or image assets.
 */
(function(global){
'use strict';
const ANCHOR = {longitude: 31.693848, latitude: 30.012736};
/* OSM way 819256088, metres east / north of the anchor (19 points; they fit a circle of radius 38.04 m within 0.3 m) */
const FOOTPRINT = [[-3.88, 37.59], [8.52, 37.09], [20.42, 31.89], [29.72, 23.69], [35.92, 12.89], [38.02, 0.59], [36.52, -11.71], [30.82, -22.51], [21.52, -31.21], [10.12, -36.41],
  [-2.28, -37.91], [-14.18, -35.31], [-25.08, -28.71], [-32.78, -18.91], [-37.48, -7.11], [-37.98, 5.19], [-33.88, 16.99], [-26.58, 27.29], [-16.28, 34.49], [-3.88, 37.59]];
/* every number the geometry is built from, with where it comes from.
   status: "published" (stated by a named source) · "map" (computed from the OpenStreetMap outline) · "estimated" (read off photographs, or assumed) */
const DIMENSIONS = [
  {id: 'height', label: 'Architectural height (to tip)', value: 393.8, unit: 'm', status: 'published', source: 'CTBUH Skyscraper Center'},
  {id: 'occupied', label: 'Highest occupied floor', value: 360.2, unit: 'm', status: 'published', source: 'CTBUH Skyscraper Center'},
  {id: 'floors', label: 'Floors above ground', value: 77, unit: '', status: 'published', source: 'CTBUH Skyscraper Center'},
  {id: 'radius', label: 'Radius at the ground (outline is a circle, diameter 76.1 m)', value: 38.04, unit: 'm', status: 'map', source: 'OpenStreetMap way 819256088, least-squares circle'},
  {id: 'anchor', label: 'Centre of the tower', value: '31.693848 E, 30.012736 N', unit: '', status: 'map', source: 'OpenStreetMap way 819256088, centre of the fitted circle'},
  {id: 'floorHeight', label: 'Floor to floor (360.2 m / 77)', value: 4.678, unit: 'm', status: 'estimated', source: 'derived from the two published figures; real floors are not all equal'},
  {id: 'profile', label: 'Width of the body relative to the ground: 0.957 at 118 m, 0.807 at 333 m', value: '0.957 / 0.807', unit: '', status: 'estimated', source: 'measured on the photograph of 18 June 2023 (Wikimedia Commons, Mohamed Ouda, CC BY-SA 4.0)'},
  {id: 'slotAzimuth', label: 'Direction of the glazed slot between the two shells', value: 286, unit: '° from north', status: 'estimated', source: 'axis of the forecourt and the ring building in OpenStreetMap; shell side seen in the 2023 photograph'},
  {id: 'slotWidth', label: 'Width of the slot', value: 13, unit: 'm', status: 'estimated', source: 'about 19% of the diameter on the showroom model photograph (Wikimedia Commons, 4 March 2020)'},
  {id: 'slotBase', label: 'Slot opening at the ground (shell edges peel apart below about 52 m)', value: 28, unit: 'm', status: 'estimated', source: 'showroom model photograph'},
  {id: 'crown', label: 'Shell tips at 393.8 m, falling about 10.5 m toward the slot; core roof at the occupied height', value: 10.5, unit: 'm', status: 'estimated', source: 'showroom model photograph (design model: the 2023 photograph predates the finished crown)'},
  {id: 'bands', label: 'White sunshade band per floor: 1.9 m high, 0.9 m proud of the glass', value: '1.9 / 0.9', unit: 'm', status: 'estimated', source: '2023 photograph'},
  {id: 'mechanical', label: 'Louvred floors seen at about 26, 63, 129 and 352 m; assumed at 195, 261 and 327 m', value: 7, unit: 'floors', status: 'estimated', source: '2023 photograph; the three middle ones are assumed by the same spacing'},
  {id: 'entrance', label: 'Entrance canopy and plinth', value: '', unit: '', status: 'estimated', source: 'generic; not measured'}
];
const SOURCES = [
  'CTBUH Skyscraper Center — Iconic Tower (heights, floors, completion 2024, design Dar al-Handasah Shair & Partners with Perkins&Will, contractor CSCEC)',
  'Perkins&Will project page — crown inspired by the lotus bud; facade of low-e glass with horizontal sunshades',
  'OpenStreetMap way 819256088 (outline and position), ODbL',
  'Wikimedia Commons: "Iconic Tower Egypt (18-6-2023)" by Mohamed Ouda, CC BY-SA 4.0 (as built, before the crown was finished)',
  'Wikimedia Commons: "Iconic Tower Maquette" (showroom design model, 4 March 2020)'
];
const HEIGHT = 393.8, OCCUPIED = 360.2, FLOORS = 77, R0 = 38.04, FLOOR = OCCUPIED / FLOORS;
const PROUD = 0.9, BAND_LOW = 1.4, BAND_HIGH = 0.5;             /* sunshade band: 0.9 m proud, from 1.4 m below each slab to 0.5 m above it */
const SLOT = 6.5, SLOT_BASE = 14, PEEL = 52, RIM_DROP = 10.5, CORE_RECESS = 4.2;
const MECHANICAL = [5, 13, 27, 41, 55, 69, 75];                 /* storeys (counted from 0 at the ground) with louvres instead of glass */
/* radius of the outer face (sunshade tips) against height, as a share of the ground radius */
const PROFILE = [[0, 1], [8, 0.985], [30, 0.972], [118, 0.957], [220, 0.9], [333, 0.807], [360.2, 0.775], [375, 0.725], [386, 0.64], [393.8, 0.52]];
function radiusAt(h){
  const T = PROFILE, n = T.length; if (h <= T[0][0]) return T[0][1] * R0; if (h >= T[n - 1][0]) return T[n - 1][1] * R0;
  let i = 0; while (h > T[i + 1][0]) i++;
  /* smooth curve through the measured points (Catmull-Rom on uneven spacing) */
  const p0 = T[Math.max(0, i - 1)], p1 = T[i], p2 = T[i + 1], p3 = T[Math.min(n - 1, i + 2)], d = p2[0] - p1[0], t = (h - p1[0]) / d;
  const m1 = (p2[1] - p0[1]) / (p2[0] - p0[0]) * d, m2 = (p3[1] - p1[1]) / (p3[0] - p1[0]) * d, t2 = t * t, t3 = t2 * t;
  return ((2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * p1[1] + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * m1 + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * p2[1] + (t3 - t2) * m2) * R0;
}
const slotHalfAt = h => SLOT + (SLOT_BASE - SLOT) * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - h / PEEL), 2);
const rimAt = phi => HEIGHT - RIM_DROP * Math.pow(Math.sin(phi), 2);     /* top edge of a shell: highest at its middle, lower at the slot */

function createIconicTower(THREE, options = {}) {
  const root = new THREE.Group(); root.name = 'Iconic Tower / metre-based study';
  root.userData = {anchor: ANCHOR, units: 'metres', axes: 'X east, Y up, Z south', footprintSource: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/819256088',
    accuracy: 'published heights and floor count; OSM footprint; photo-derived profile, slot, crown and facade, not surveyed as-built geometry', dimensions: DIMENSIONS, sources: SOURCES};
  const architecture = new THREE.Group(), landscape = new THREE.Group(), crown = new THREE.Group();
  root.add(architecture, landscape); architecture.add(crown);
  architecture.name = 'Tower'; landscape.name = 'Plinth'; crown.name = 'Crown';
  const NA = Math.max(12, options.segments || 36);            /* facets along each shell */
  const azimuth = options.slotAzimuth == null ? 286 : options.slotAzimuth;
  /* the tower is built with the slot along X, then turned so the slot points along the given azimuth (clockwise from north) */
  architecture.rotation.y = -(azimuth - 90) * Math.PI / 180;
  landscape.rotation.y = architecture.rotation.y;
  const materials = {}, buckets = new Map();
  function mat(name, color, roughness = .8, metalness = 0){
    const m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color, roughness, metalness, side: THREE.DoubleSide});
    m.color.convertSRGBToLinear(); m.name = name; materials[name] = m; return m;
  }
  const band = mat('sunshade bands', 0xe9e7e1, .55), edge = mat('shell edges', 0xf1efe9, .6), roofM = mat('roof', 0xcfcbc0, .85);
  const glass = mat('shell glazing', 0x4b6a7b, .2, .3), louvre = mat('louvred floors', 0x66757d, .6, .25);
  const slotGlass = mat('slot glazing', 0x25405a, .16, .35), slotFrame = mat('slot frames', 0xa9b8bf, .5, .2);
  const canopy = mat('entrance canopy', 0xe4e2dc, .6), plaza = mat('plinth stone', 0xb9b2a2, .9);
  const V = (e, h, n) => new THREE.Vector3(e, h, -n);
  function tri(a, b, c, m, parent = architecture){ let by = buckets.get(parent); if (!by) { by = new Map(); buckets.set(parent, by); } let p = by.get(m); if (!p) { p = []; by.set(m, p); } p.push(a.x, a.y, a.z, b.x, b.y, b.z, c.x, c.y, c.z); }
  function quad(a, b, c, d, m, parent = architecture){ tri(a, b, c, m, parent); tri(a, c, d, m, parent); }
  /* a point on a shell: side = +1 north shell / -1 south shell (before the turn), t = 0..1 along the arc from one slot edge to the other,
     h = height (cut off by the shell's own top edge), out = metres inside (-) or outside the profile */
  function arc(h, out){ const r = radiusAt(h) + out, a0 = Math.asin(Math.min(.98, slotHalfAt(h) / r)); return {r, a0}; }
  function shell(side, t, h, out){
    let g = arc(h, out), a = g.a0 + (Math.PI - 2 * g.a0) * t;
    const top = rimAt(a - Math.PI / 2);
    if (h > top) { h = top; g = arc(h, out); a = g.a0 + (Math.PI - 2 * g.a0) * t; }
    return V(g.r * Math.cos(a), h, side * g.r * Math.sin(a));
  }
  const flat = (a, d) => d.y - a.y < 1e-3;                       /* a strip that the top edge has cut away completely */
  const NF = Math.ceil(HEIGHT / FLOOR);
  for (const side of [1, -1]) {
    const part = h => h > OCCUPIED ? crown : architecture;
    for (let k = 0; k < NF; k++) {
      const h0 = k * FLOOR, h1 = h0 + FLOOR, g0 = k ? h0 + BAND_HIGH : 0, g1 = h1 - BAND_LOW, b0 = g1, b1 = h1 + BAND_HIGH;
      const wall = MECHANICAL.includes(k) ? louvre : glass, P = part(h0 + 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) {
        const t0 = i / NA, t1 = (i + 1) / NA;
        /* glazing of this floor */
        { const a = shell(side, t0, g0, -PROUD), b = shell(side, t1, g0, -PROUD), c = shell(side, t1, g1, -PROUD), d = shell(side, t0, g1, -PROUD);
          if (!(flat(a, d) && flat(b, c))) quad(a, b, c, d, wall, P); }
        /* sunshade band at the slab: outer face, top and underside are real faces, so the ribbed silhouette is true geometry */
        { const a = shell(side, t0, b0, 0), b = shell(side, t1, b0, 0), c = shell(side, t1, b1, 0), d = shell(side, t0, b1, 0);
          if (flat(a, d) && flat(b, c)) continue;
          const ai = shell(side, t0, b0, -PROUD), bi = shell(side, t1, b0, -PROUD), ci = shell(side, t1, b1, -PROUD), di = shell(side, t0, b1, -PROUD);
          quad(a, b, c, d, band, P); quad(d, c, ci, di, band, P); quad(ai, bi, b, a, band, P); }
      }
      /* the two ends of the band, and the flat face of the shell that looks into the slot */
      for (const t of [0, 1]) { const a = shell(side, t, b0, -PROUD), b = shell(side, t, b0, 0), c = shell(side, t, b1, 0), d = shell(side, t, b1, -PROUD); if (!flat(a, d)) quad(a, b, c, d, band, P); }
      { const a = shell(side, 0, h0, 0), b = shell(side, 1, h0, 0), c = shell(side, 1, h1, 0), d = shell(side, 0, h1, 0); if (!flat(a, d)) quad(a, b, c, d, edge, P); }
    }
    /* coping along the feather-shaped top edge, and the roof inside it */
    const rim = []; for (let i = 0; i <= NA; i++) rim.push(shell(side, i / NA, 1e4, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) { const a = rim[i], b = rim[i + 1], lo = v => new THREE.Vector3(v.x * 1.006, v.y - 1.5, v.z * 1.006);
      quad(lo(a), lo(b), b.clone().multiply(new THREE.Vector3(1.006, 1, 1.006)), a.clone().multiply(new THREE.Vector3(1.006, 1, 1.006)), edge, crown); }
    const mid = rim[0].clone().add(rim[NA]).multiplyScalar(.5); mid.y -= 1.2;
    for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) { const a = rim[i].clone(), b = rim[i + 1].clone(); a.y -= 1.2; b.y -= 1.2; tri(mid, a, b, roofM, crown); }
  }
  /* the glazed core that fills the slot: only its two curved ends are ever seen, set back from the shells */
  const coreTop = OCCUPIED + 1.2, NC = 4;
  function core(end, s, h, out){ const r = radiusAt(h) - PROUD - CORE_RECESS + out, b0 = Math.asin(Math.min(.98, (slotHalfAt(h) - .2) / r)), b = -b0 + 2 * b0 * s; return V(end * r * Math.cos(b), h, r * Math.sin(b)); }
  for (const end of [1, -1]) {
    for (let k = 0; k < FLOORS; k++) {
      const h0 = k * FLOOR, h1 = k === FLOORS - 1 ? coreTop : h0 + FLOOR;
      for (let i = 0; i < NC; i++) { const s0 = i / NC, s1 = (i + 1) / NC;
        quad(core(end, s0, h0 + .4, 0), core(end, s1, h0 + .4, 0), core(end, s1, h1, 0), core(end, s0, h1, 0), slotGlass);
        quad(core(end, s0, h0, .15), core(end, s1, h0, .15), core(end, s1, h0 + .4, .15), core(end, s0, h0 + .4, .15), slotFrame); }
    }
    /* slim vertical frames on the slot glazing */
    for (let i = 0; i <= NC; i++) for (let k = 0; k < FLOORS; k++) { const h0 = k * FLOOR, h1 = k === FLOORS - 1 ? coreTop : h0 + FLOOR, s = i / NC, w = .012;
      quad(core(end, s - w, h0, .22), core(end, s + w, h0, .22), core(end, s + w, h1, .22), core(end, s - w, h1, .22), slotFrame); }
    /* entrance canopy under the opening of the slot (generic, see DIMENSIONS) */
    { const y0 = 7.4, y1 = 8.2, uIn = radiusAt(8) - PROUD - CORE_RECESS - .5, uOut = R0 + 4, wIn = slotHalfAt(8) - .6, wOut = slotHalfAt(8) + 1;
      const p = (u, w, y) => V(end * u, y, w);
      quad(p(uIn, -wIn, y1), p(uOut, -wOut, y1), p(uOut, wOut, y1), p(uIn, wIn, y1), canopy); quad(p(uIn, -wIn, y0), p(uOut, -wOut, y0), p(uOut, wOut, y0), p(uIn, wIn, y0), canopy);
      quad(p(uOut, -wOut, y0), p(uOut, wOut, y0), p(uOut, wOut, y1), p(uOut, -wOut, y1), canopy);
      quad(p(uIn, -wIn, y0), p(uOut, -wOut, y0), p(uOut, -wOut, y1), p(uIn, -wIn, y1), canopy); quad(p(uIn, wIn, y0), p(uOut, wOut, y0), p(uOut, wOut, y1), p(uIn, wIn, y1), canopy); }
  }
  { const ring = []; for (const end of [1, -1]) for (let i = 0; i <= NC; i++) ring.push(core(end, end > 0 ? i / NC : 1 - i / NC, coreTop, 0));
    const c = V(0, coreTop, 0); for (let i = 0; i < ring.length; i++) tri(c, ring[i], ring[(i + 1) % ring.length], roofM); }
  /* low circular plinth the tower stands on */
  { const n = 48, r = R0 + 3.5, y = .45, c = V(0, y, 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = i / n * 2 * Math.PI, b = (i + 1) / n * 2 * Math.PI, p = V(r * Math.cos(a), y, r * Math.sin(a)), q = V(r * Math.cos(b), y, r * Math.sin(b));
      tri(c, p, q, plaza, landscape); quad(V(p.x, 0, -p.z), V(q.x, 0, -q.z), q, p, plaza, landscape); } }
  /* Batch faces into one draw call per material. */
  buckets.forEach((by, parent) => by.forEach((p, m) => { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p, 3)); g.computeVertexNormals();
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(g, m); mesh.castShadow = true; mesh.receiveShadow = true; parent.add(mesh); }));
  landscape.visible = options.landscape !== false;
  root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  const bounds = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(architecture), size = bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  root.userData.measuredPlan = {eastWestMetres: +size.x.toFixed(1), northSouthMetres: +size.z.toFixed(1), heightMetres: +bounds.max.y.toFixed(1)};
  let triangles = 0; root.traverse(o => { if (o.geometry) triangles += o.geometry.attributes.position.count / 3; }); root.userData.triangles = triangles;
  /* looks: daylight, or lit from inside on a dark map. Colours are given in sRGB and stored linear, like the materials above. */
  const LOOK = {
    day: {'sunshade bands': [0xe9e7e1, 0, 0], 'shell edges': [0xf1efe9, 0, 0], 'roof': [0xcfcbc0, 0, 0], 'shell glazing': [0x4b6a7b, 0, 0], 'louvred floors': [0x66757d, 0, 0],
      'slot glazing': [0x25405a, 0, 0], 'slot frames': [0xa9b8bf, 0, 0], 'entrance canopy': [0xe4e2dc, 0, 0], 'plinth stone': [0xb9b2a2, 0, 0]},
    night: {'sunshade bands': [0x86a9d6, 0x1f4f9c, .22], 'shell edges': [0xa8c8f5, 0x3d8bff, .4], 'roof': [0x2c4672, 0x10254a, .4], 'shell glazing': [0x16386e, 0x1d55a8, .6], 'louvred floors': [0x2a4a78, 0x12305c, .4],
      'slot glazing': [0x0a1f44, 0x143a78, .5], 'slot frames': [0x4f79b3, 0x2a6fd0, .35], 'entrance canopy': [0x7ea0cf, 0xffc17a, .22], 'plinth stone': [0x1d3663, 0x0c1c3c, .5]}
  };
  let night = false, accentK = 0; const accentC = new THREE.Color(), tmpC = new THREE.Color();
  function paint(){
    const L = LOOK[night ? 'night' : 'day'];
    for (const name in materials) { const m = materials[name], l = L[name]; m.color.setHex(l[0]).convertSRGBToLinear(); m.emissive.setHex(l[1]).convertSRGBToLinear(); m.emissiveIntensity = l[2];
      if (accentK > 0 && (m === glass || m === slotGlass || m === edge)) { tmpC.copy(accentC).convertSRGBToLinear(); m.emissive.lerp(tmpC, accentK); m.emissiveIntensity = l[2] + (m === edge ? .5 : .75) * accentK; } }
  }
  return {group: root, architecture, landscape, crown, materials, bounds, dimensions: DIMENSIONS, sources: SOURCES,
    setWireframe(value){ Object.values(materials).forEach(m => m.wireframe = value); },
    setNight(value){ night = !!value; paint(); },
    /* tint the glazing with a colour (the map uses its sector colour when the project of this site is selected); k = 0 removes it */
    setAccent(color, k){ accentC.set(color); accentK = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, k || 0)); paint(); },
    dispose(){ const geos = new Set(); root.traverse(o => { if (o.geometry) geos.add(o.geometry); }); geos.forEach(g => g.dispose()); Object.values(materials).forEach(m => m.dispose()); }
  };
