function createGrandEgyptianMuseum(THREE, options = {}) {
  const root = new THREE.Group(); root.name = 'Grand Egyptian Museum / metre-based study';
  root.userData = {anchor:{longitude:31.11965,latitude:29.99315},units:'metres',axes:'X east, Y up, Z south',footprintSource:'https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/652382736',accuracy:'OSM footprint; photo-derived elevations, not surveyed as-built geometry'};
  const architecture = new THREE.Group(), landscape = new THREE.Group(), roof = new THREE.Group();
  root.add(architecture,landscape); architecture.add(roof);
  architecture.name='Museum';landscape.name='Landscape';roof.name='Folded roof';
  let seed=1917;const rand=()=>{seed=(seed*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296;};
  const materials = {}, buckets = new Map();
  function mat(name,color,roughness=.8,metalness=0){
    const m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness,metalness,side:THREE.DoubleSide});
    m.color.convertSRGBToLinear();m.name=name;materials[name]=m;return m;
  }
  const stone=mat('limestone',0xbeb7a8),white=mat('roof limestone',0xe5dfd2),edge=mat('cut stone edges',0xf2eee5),dark=mat('shadow joints',0x3a4243);
  const glass=mat('blue-green glass',0x355b65,.27,.42),bronze=mat('bronze frames',0x8a806e,.35,.5);
  const pavement=mat('courtyard limestone',0xc8bfac),grass=mat('garden',0x657556),soil=mat('planter',0x7b725e);
  const glow=mat('warm interior',0xb69763,.6);glow.emissive.setHex(0xffc17a);glow.emissiveIntensity=.06;
  const panelStone=[0xc3bdaf,0xc7c0b0,0xc8c1b3,0xb9b3a6,0xd1c9b9].map((c,i)=>mat('stone panel '+i,c));
  const panelGlass=[0x466168,0x294550,0x5b7378,0x82918b,0x3b5760].map((c,i)=>mat('glass panel '+i,c,.27,.42));
  const V=(e,h,n)=>new THREE.Vector3(e,h,-n);
  function tri(a,b,c,m,parent=architecture){let by=buckets.get(parent);if(!by){by=new Map();buckets.set(parent,by);}let p=by.get(m);if(!p){p=[];by.set(m,p);}p.push(...a.toArray(),...b.toArray(),...c.toArray());}
  function quad(a,b,c,d,m,parent=architecture){tri(a,b,c,m,parent);tri(a,c,d,m,parent);}
  function flat(points,h,m,parent=landscape){const p=points.map(v=>new THREE.Vector2(v[0],v[1]));const ids=THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(p,[]);for(const t of ids)tri(V(...[points[t[0]][0],h,points[t[0]][1]]),V(points[t[1]][0],h,points[t[1]][1]),V(points[t[2]][0],h,points[t[2]][1]),m,parent);}
  function box(x,n,w,d,h,y,m,parent=architecture){const g=new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d);g.translate(x,y+h/2,-n);const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(g,m);mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(mesh);return mesh;}
  function beam(a,b,r,m,parent=architecture){const d=b.clone().sub(a),g=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,d.length(),5);g.applyMatrix4(new THREE.Matrix4().makeRotationFromQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),d.normalize())));g.translate(...a.clone().add(b).multiplyScalar(.5).toArray());const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(g,m);mesh.castShadow=true;parent.add(mesh);return mesh;}
  function polyFace(a,b,ha,hb,m,parent=architecture){quad(V(a[0],0,a[1]),V(b[0],0,b[1]),V(b[0],hb,b[1]),V(a[0],ha,a[1]),m,parent);}
  function northHeight(n){return 33+(240-n)/360*10;}
  // Exact OpenStreetMap outline at ground level, without a guessed rectangle.
  flat(FOOTPRINT,.15,stone,architecture);
  for(let i=0;i<FOOTPRINT.length-1;i++){
    const a=FOOTPRINT[i],b=FOOTPRINT[i+1];
    if(i===0 || i>=39) continue;
    const wing=i>=15&&i<=32;
    const ha=wing?20:northHeight(a[1]),hb=wing?20:northHeight(b[1]);
    polyFace(a,b,ha,hb,stone);
  }
  // Faceted glazed entrance (north). The visible triangles are real mesh faces.
  const F0=[-170.4,240.5],F1=[-42.9,240.5];
  function facade(a,b,ha,hb,kind,cols,rows,parent=architecture){
    const front=(u,v)=>V(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,(ha+(hb-ha)*u)*v,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u);
    for(let j=0;j<rows;j++)for(let i=0;i<cols;i++){
      const u=i/cols,v=j/rows,du=1/cols,dv=1/rows;
      const p00=front(u,v),p10=front(u+du,v),p11=front(u+du,v+dv),p01=front(u,v+dv);
      let m1,m2;
      if(kind==='glass'){m1=panelGlass[(i+2*j)%5];m2=panelGlass[(i*3+j+2)%5];}
      else {
        const phase=((u*5.25)%1),height=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(phase-.5)*2)*.78;
        const window=false;
        m1=window?panelGlass[(i+j)%5]:panelStone[(i+2*j)%5];
        m2=window?panelGlass[(i+j+1)%5]:panelStone[(i+j)%5];
        if(!window&&(i*7+j*13)%17===0)m2=glass;
      }
      const inset=(verts)=>{const c=verts.reduce((s,p)=>s.add(p),new THREE.Vector3()).multiplyScalar(1/3);return verts.map(p=>p.clone().lerp(c,.016));};
      let t1=inset([p00,p10,p11]),t2=inset([p00,p11,p01]);tri(...t1,m1,parent);tri(...t2,m2,parent);
    }
    beam(front(0,1),front(1,1),.38,edge,parent);
    beam(front(0,0),front(0,1),.65,edge,parent);beam(front(1,0),front(1,1),.65,edge,parent);
  }
  facade([-170.4,240.85],[-42.9,240.85],33,33,'glass',16,4);
  // Long eastern facade: large triangular windows + a finer triangular stone screen.
  facade([-42.2,240.5],[183.2,-56.7],33,41.24,'stone',65,7);
  // Clean large triangular glazing inset into the eastern limestone screen.
  function glassTriangle(a,b,c,depth){
    if(!depth){const mid=a.clone().add(b).add(c).multiplyScalar(1/3);tri(a.clone().lerp(mid,.014),b.clone().lerp(mid,.014),c.clone().lerp(mid,.014),panelGlass[Math.floor(rand()*5)]);return;}
    const ab=a.clone().lerp(b,.5),bc=b.clone().lerp(c,.5),ca=c.clone().lerp(a,.5);
    glassTriangle(a,ab,ca,depth-1);glassTriangle(ab,b,bc,depth-1);glassTriangle(ca,bc,c,depth-1);glassTriangle(ab,bc,ca,depth-1);
  }
  const sideAt=(u,y)=>V(-41.8+225.4*u,y,241.0-297.2*u);
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const u=.055+i*.187;
    const a=sideAt(u,1.2),b=sideAt(u+.156,1.2),c=sideAt(u+.078,27+i*1.9);
    glassTriangle(a,b,c,3);
    beam(a,c,.4,edge);beam(b,c,.4,edge);beam(a,b,.3,edge);
  }
  // A glass triangular entrance canopy, not a generic pyramid-shaped museum.
  const apex=V(-103,27,243),left=V(-121,0.6,261),right=V(-85,0.6,261),rearL=V(-121,0.6,241),rearR=V(-85,0.6,241);
  tri(left,right,apex,glass);tri(rearL,left,apex,glass);tri(right,rearR,apex,glass);
  [[left,right],[left,apex],[right,apex],[rearL,left],[rearR,right]].forEach(p=>beam(...p,.27,edge));
  for(let k=1;k<9;k++){const t=k/9;beam(left.clone().lerp(apex,t),right.clone().lerp(apex,t),.12,edge);}
  for(let k=1;k<10;k++)beam(left.clone().lerp(right,k/10),apex,.11,edge);
  box(-103,245,28,3,4,.2,dark);for(let i=0;i<6;i++)box(-116+i*5,246.7,.14,.2,4,.2,bronze);
  // Fan-shaped folded roofs. Bay positions/heights reconstructed from the photographs.
  const rear=[[-23.3,-120.3],[5.4,-121.5],[31.7,-96.2],[62.9,-85.5],[89.8,-74],[121,-67],[151,-61],[182.5,-56.7]];
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
    const u0=i/7,u1=(i+1)/7;
    const frontL=[F0[0]+(F1[0]-F0[0])*u0,240.5],frontR=[F0[0]+(F1[0]-F0[0])*u1,240.5];
    const backL=rear[i],backR=rear[i+1];
    const p=(u,t,lift=0)=>{
      const f=[frontL[0]+(frontR[0]-frontL[0])*u,frontL[1]];
      const b=[backL[0]+(backR[0]-backL[0])*u,backL[1]+(backR[1]-backL[1])*u];

/* EGM model kit — three.js r128 (global THREE).
   Conventions: units = metres, Y up, +X = east, -Z = north, origin = site centre at ground level.
   Every helper returns the created Object3D and (when a parent group `g` is active) adds it to that group.
   A model file calls:  EGM.add({ id, name, en, status, span, dims:[...], sources:[...], build(K){ ...; return K.root; } })
*/
(function () {
  const EGM = (window.EGM = window.EGM || { models: {}, add(m) { this.models[m.id] = m; } });

  const PAL = {
    stone: 0xd8c7a3, sand: 0xc8b287, limestone: 0xe6dcc2, concrete: 0xb7bbb6, white: 0xf2efe7,
    glass: 0x5ab6c6, glassDark: 0x2f6f82, dark: 0x2b4853, metal: 0xa3b3b8, steel: 0x7d8f96,
    roof: 0x8b6f56, brick: 0xb0694a, red: 0xb5533c, green: 0x5d9861, palm: 0x4f8a4e, trunk: 0x7a5b3c,
    water: 0x2f90b2, road: 0x4d5c66, paving: 0xbfb49c, gold: 0xd9b45c, accent: 0xffae57,
    crane: 0xf2b53a, blue: 0x3d6fb5, teal: 0x46d7cf, soil: 0xa58f6a, black: 0x1c2a30,
    solar: 0x1f3f6e, container1: 0xc2553d, container2: 0x3d79b5, container3: 0xe0a53c
  };
  const cache = {};
  function mat(c, o) {
    if (c && c.isMaterial) return c;
    o = o || {};
    const key = c + "|" + JSON.stringify(o);
    if (cache[key]) return cache[key];
    const hex = typeof c === "string" ? (PAL[c] !== undefined ? PAL[c] : 0xff00ff) : c;
    const p = { color: hex, roughness: 0.82, metalness: 0.04 };
    if (c === "glass" || c === "glassDark") { p.roughness = 0.12; p.metalness = 0.55; p.transparent = true; p.opacity = 0.86; }
    if (c === "metal" || c === "steel" || c === "gold") { p.roughness = 0.38; p.metalness = 0.7; }
    if (c === "water") { p.roughness = 0.1; p.metalness = 0.3; p.transparent = true; p.opacity = 0.9; }
    if (c === "solar") { p.roughness = 0.2; p.metalness = 0.6; }
    Object.assign(p, o);
    if (p.doubleSide) { p.side = THREE.DoubleSide; delete p.doubleSide; }
    const mm = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(p); mm.color.convertSRGBToLinear(); return (cache[key] = mm);
  }

  function makeKit() {
    const K = { PAL, mat };
    K.root = new THREE.Group();
    let cur = K.root;
    /* run fn with a new sub-group as the active parent; returns the group (position/rotate it afterwards) */
    K.group = function (fn, x, y, z, ry) {
      const g = new THREE.Group(); cur.add(g); const prev = cur; cur = g;
      try { fn(g); } finally { cur = prev; }
      g.position.set(x || 0, y || 0, z || 0); if (ry) g.rotation.y = ry; return g;
    };
    function put(m, x, y, z, ry) {
      m.position.set(x || 0, y || 0, z || 0); if (ry) m.rotation.y = ry;
      m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true; cur.add(m); return m;
    }
    K.mesh = (geo, m, x, y, z, ry) => put(new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat(m)), x, y, z, ry);
    /* box: w (x) × h (y) × d (z); base sits at y */
    K.box = (w, h, d, m, x, y, z, ry) => K.mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d).translate(0, h / 2, 0), m, x, y, z, ry);
    /* cylinder / frustum: base at y */
    K.cyl = (rTop, rBot, h, m, x, y, z, seg) => K.mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rTop, rBot, h, seg || 32).translate(0, h / 2, 0), m, x, y, z);
    K.cone = (r, h, m, x, y, z, seg) => K.mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(r, h, seg || 32).translate(0, h / 2, 0), m, x, y, z);
    /* 4-sided pyramid with square (or w×d) base aligned to axes */
    K.pyramid = (w, h, m, x, y, z, d, ry) => {
      const g = new THREE.ConeGeometry(Math.SQRT1_2, 1, 4, 1).rotateY(Math.PI / 4).translate(0, 0.5, 0); g.scale(w, h, d || w);
      return K.mesh(g, m, x, y, z, ry);
    };
    /* dome: hemisphere radius r, optionally stretched vertically by sy (onion/pointed domes: sy > 1) */
    K.dome = (r, m, x, y, z, sy, seg) => { const g = new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, seg || 32, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2); if (sy) g.scale(1, sy, 1); return K.mesh(g, m, x, y, z); };
    K.sphere = (r, m, x, y, z) => K.mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 24, 16), m, x, y, z);
    /* extrude a footprint polygon [[x,z],...] (metres, +x east, +z south) upward by h from y. holes: array of polygons */
    K.extrude = (pts, h, m, y, holes) => {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      (holes || []).forEach(hp => { const hh = new THREE.Path(); hp.forEach((p, i) => (i ? hh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : hh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); s.holes.push(hh); });
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 12 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      return K.mesh(g, m, 0, y || 0, 0);
    };
    /* extrude a vertical profile [[u,v],...] (u horizontal, v up) along `len`; centred on its length; ry rotates. Good for gable roofs, vaults, hangars, canopies, bridge decks */
    K.profile = (pts, len, m, x, y, z, ry) => {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], p[1])));
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: len, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 16 }); g.translate(0, 0, -len / 2);
      return K.mesh(g, m, x, y, z, ry);
    };
    /* gable roof: ridge along z, width w, rise h, length len */
    K.gable = (w, h, len, m, x, y, z, ry) => K.profile([[-w / 2, 0], [w / 2, 0], [0, h]], len, m, x, y, z, ry);
    /* barrel vault / arched roof: half-ellipse of width w and rise h along len */
    K.vault = (w, h, len, m, x, y, z, ry) => { const p = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) { const a = Math.PI * i / 20; p.push([Math.cos(a) * w / 2, Math.sin(a) * h]); } return K.profile(p, len, m, x, y, z, ry); };
    /* lathe: profile [[r,y],...] revolved round Y */
    K.lathe = (pts, m, x, y, z, seg) => K.mesh(new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])), seg || 40), mat(m, { doubleSide: true }), x, y, z);
    /* tube through 3D points [[x,y,z],...] */
    K.tube = (pts, r, m, closed) => K.mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(p[0], p[1], p[2])), !!closed, "catmullrom", 0.3), Math.max(8, pts.length * 8), r, 8, !!closed), m);
    /* straight beam between two 3D points with square section t */
    K.beam = (a, b, t, m) => {
      const A = new THREE.Vector3(a[0], a[1], a[2]), B = new THREE.Vector3(b[0], b[1], b[2]); const L = A.distanceTo(B);
      const me = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(t, L, t), mat(m)); me.position.copy(A).add(B).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      me.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), B.clone().sub(A).normalize()); me.castShadow = true; me.receiveShadow = true; cur.add(me); return me;
    };
    K.torus = (R, t, m, x, y, z, arc) => K.mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(R, t, 10, 64, arc || Math.PI * 2).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), m, x, y, z);
    /* flat plate on the ground (thin box): roads, plazas, lawns, water. top surface at y + t */
    K.plate = (w, d, m, x, z, y, ry, t) => K.box(w, t || 0.4, d, m, x, y || 0, z, ry);
    /* flat polygon plate from footprint points */
    K.pad = (pts, m, y, t) => K.extrude(pts, t || 0.4, m, y || 0);
    /* many copies of one geometry: list = [[x,y,z,ry,sx,sy,sz], ...] */
    K.inst = (geo, m, list) => {
      const im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat(m), list.length); const o = new THREE.Object3D();
      list.forEach((t, i) => { o.position.set(t[0], t[1] || 0, t[2]); o.rotation.set(0, t[3] || 0, 0); o.scale.set(t[4] || 1, t[5] || t[4] || 1, t[6] || t[4] || 1); o.updateMatrix(); im.setMatrixAt(i, o.matrix); });
      im.castShadow = true; im.receiveShadow = true; cur.add(im); return im;
    };
    K.boxGeo = (w, h, d) => new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d).translate(0, h / 2, 0);
    K.cylGeo = (rt, rb, h, seg) => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, h, seg || 16).translate(0, h / 2, 0);
    /* row/grid of windows as dark glass strips on a box face is expensive: use K.bands for facade floors instead */
    /* horizontal floor bands round a box-shaped block (w×d), from y0 every `step` up to height h */
    K.bands = (w, d, h, x, y0, z, ry, step, m) => {
      const list = []; for (let yy = (step || 4) * 0.6; yy < h - 1; yy += (step || 4)) list.push([0, yy, 0]);
      return K.group(() => K.inst(K.boxGeo(w + 0.3, (step || 4) * 0.45, d + 0.3), m || "glassDark", list), x, y0, z, ry);
    };
    /* colonnade: n columns between two ground points */
    K.columns = (a, b, n, r, h, m, y) => { const list = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const t = n === 1 ? 0.5 : i / (n - 1); list.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, y || 0, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]); } return K.inst(K.cylGeo(r, r, h, 12), m || "limestone", list); };
    /* vegetation */
    K.trees = (list, h) => { h = h || 7; const tr = [], cr = []; list.forEach(p => { const s = (p[2] || 1); tr.push([p[0], 0, p[1], 0, s]); cr.push([p[0], h * 0.35 * s, p[1], 0, s]); });
      K.inst(K.cylGeo(0.25, 0.35, h * 0.4, 6), "trunk", tr); return K.inst(new THREE.SphereGeometry(h * 0.33, 8, 6).translate(0, h * 0.33, 0), "green", cr); };
    K.palms = (list, h) => { h = h || 10; const tr = [], cr = []; list.forEach(p => { tr.push([p[0], 0, p[1]]); cr.push([p[0], h, p[1], (p[0] * 7 + p[1]) % 3]); });
      K.inst(K.cylGeo(0.22, 0.32, h, 6), "trunk", tr); return K.inst(new THREE.ConeGeometry(h * 0.32, h * 0.16, 7).rotateX(Math.PI).translate(0, h * 0.05, 0), "palm", cr); };
    /* tower crane (for sites still under construction): mast height h, jib length ~0.75h */
    K.crane = (x, z, h, ry) => K.group(() => {
      h = h || 60; const j = h * 0.75;
      K.box(2.2, h, 2.2, "crane", 0, 0, 0); K.box(3.4, 3, 3.4, "white", 0, h, 0);
      K.box(j, 1.6, 1.6, "crane", j / 2 - 2, h + 3, 0); K.box(j * 0.32, 1.6, 1.6, "crane", -j * 0.16 - 2, h + 3, 0);
      K.box(4, 3.5, 2.6, "concrete", -j * 0.3, h + 0.2, 0); K.box(1.2, h * 0.14, 1.2, "crane", 0, h + 3, 0);
      K.beam([0, h + 3 + h * 0.14, 0], [j * 0.8, h + 4.6, 0], 0.35, "steel"); K.beam([0, h + 3 + h * 0.14, 0], [-j * 0.3, h + 4.6, 0], 0.35, "steel");
      K.box(0.3, h * 0.45, 0.3, "steel", j * 0.55, h + 3 - h * 0.45, 0); K.box(4, 4, 4, "concrete", 0, 0, 0);
    }, x, 0, z, ry);
    /* scaffold/unfinished frame block: open column grid w×d×h for buildings still under construction */
    K.frame = (w, h, d, x, y, z, ry, bay, floor) => K.group(() => {
      bay = bay || 8; floor = floor || 4; const cols = [], nx = Math.max(1, Math.round(w / bay)), nz = Math.max(1, Math.round(d / bay));
      for (let i = 0; i <= nx; i++) for (let k = 0; k <= nz; k++) cols.push([-w / 2 + w * i / nx, 0, -d / 2 + d * k / nz]);
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(0.7, h, 0.7), "concrete", cols); const sl = []; for (let yy = floor; yy <= h + 0.01; yy += floor) sl.push([0, yy - 0.35, 0]);
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(w + 0.8, 0.35, d + 0.8), "concrete", sl);
    }, x, y, z, ry);
    /* shipping container stack: nx × nz × ny containers (12.2 × 2.6 × 2.4 m each) */
    K.containers = (nx, ny, nz, x, z, ry, seedv) => K.group(() => {
      const lists = [[], [], []]; let s = seedv || 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) for (let k = 0; k < nz; k++) { s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647; const hgt = 1 + (s % ny);
        for (let j = 0; j < hgt; j++) { s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647; lists[s % 3].push([(i - (nx - 1) / 2) * 12.8, j * 2.6, (k - (nz - 1) / 2) * 2.9]); } }
      ["container1", "container2", "container3"].forEach((c, i) => lists[i].length && K.inst(K.boxGeo(12.2, 2.6, 2.44), c, lists[i]));
    }, x, 0, z, ry);
    /* ship-to-shore gantry crane (quay crane), ~70 m tall, boom over the water toward -z in local space */
    K.quayCrane = (x, z, ry, s) => K.group(g => {
      [[-13, -10], [13, -10], [-13, 10], [13, 10]].forEach(p => K.box(1.8, 48, 1.8, "red", p[0], 0, p[1]));
      K.box(28, 2.5, 2, "red", 0, 46, -10); K.box(28, 2.5, 2, "red", 0, 46, 10); K.box(2, 2.5, 22, "red", -13, 20, 0); K.box(2, 2.5, 22, "red", 13, 20, 0);
      K.box(5, 3, 110, "red", 0, 48, -25); K.box(6, 5, 8, "white", 0, 51, 12); K.box(1.6, 22, 1.6, "red", 0, 51, -8);
      K.beam([0, 73, -8], [0, 51, -75], 0.5, "steel"); K.beam([0, 73, -8], [0, 51, 28], 0.5, "steel"); K.box(4, 3, 4, "white", 0, 43, -40);
      if (s) g.scale.setScalar(s);
    }, x, 0, z, ry);
    /* minaret: square/octagonal shaft with balconies and a finial; total height h */
    K.minaret = (x, z, h, r, m) => K.group(() => {
      r = r || 2.2; m = m || "stone";
      K.box(r * 2.2, h * 0.3, r * 2.2, m, 0, 0, 0); K.cyl(r * 0.95, r, h * 0.3, m, 0, h * 0.3, 0, 8); K.cyl(r * 1.45, r * 1.1, h * 0.03, m, 0, h * 0.6, 0, 16);
      K.cyl(r * 0.7, r * 0.75, h * 0.2, m, 0, h * 0.63, 0, 16); K.cyl(r * 1.1, r * 0.8, h * 0.025, m, 0, h * 0.83, 0, 16);
      K.cyl(r * 0.45, r * 0.5, h * 0.06, m, 0, h * 0.855, 0, 12); K.dome(r * 0.6, m, 0, h * 0.915, 0, 1.6); K.cyl(0.12, 0.12, h * 0.05, "gold", 0, h * 0.95, 0, 6);
    }, x, 0, z);
    return K;
  }
  EGM.makeKit = makeKit; EGM.PAL = PAL;
  /* build a model into a fresh group; returns {group, box} */
  EGM.build = function (id) {
    const m = EGM.models[id]; if (!m) return null; const K = makeKit(); const r = m.build(K) || K.root;
    r.updateMatrixWorld(true); const box = new THREE.Box3(), tb = new THREE.Box3(), im = new THREE.Matrix4();
    r.traverse(o => { if (!o.geometry) return; if (!o.geometry.boundingBox) o.geometry.computeBoundingBox();
      if (o.isInstancedMesh) { for (let i = 0; i < o.count; i++) { o.getMatrixAt(i, im); im.premultiply(o.matrixWorld); tb.copy(o.geometry.boundingBox).applyMatrix4(im); box.union(tb); } }
      else { tb.copy(o.geometry.boundingBox).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld); box.union(tb); } });
    return { group: r, box };
  };
  /* integration API (same shape as the ChatGPT library): EGM.create(id) -> {group, box, meta, dispose} */
  EGM.create = function (id) { const b = EGM.build(id); if (!b) return null; return { group: b.group, box: b.box, meta: EGM.models[id],
    dispose() { b.group.traverse(o => { if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); }); } }; };
  /* standard presentation scene: lights + base, used by both the workshop page and the render harness */
  EGM.stage = function (scene, box) {
    const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()), c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()); const R = Math.max(size.x, size.z) * 0.5;
    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xd6eef2, 0x4a5f52, 0.55));
    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe9c4, 1.25); sun.position.set(c.x + R * 1.1, Math.max(R * 1.3, size.y * 1.6), c.z + R * 0.75); sun.target.position.copy(c); scene.add(sun.target);
    sun.castShadow = true; sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048); const sc = sun.shadow.camera; const E = R * 1.5 + size.y; sc.left = -E; sc.right = E; sc.top = E; sc.bottom = -E; sc.near = 1; sc.far = R * 6 + size.y * 4; sun.shadow.bias = -0.0006; sun.shadow.normalBias = R * 0.004; scene.add(sun);
    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8fd8e0, 0.2); fill.position.set(c.x - R, R * 0.6, c.z - R * 0.8); scene.add(fill);
    const base = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(R * 1.5, R * 1.54, R * 0.04, 96), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0c3f4a, roughness: 0.95 }));
    base.material.color.convertSRGBToLinear(); base.position.set(c.x, -R * 0.02 - 0.05, c.z); base.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(base);
    const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(R * 1.5, R * 0.005, 8, 128).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x46d7cf })); ring.position.set(c.x, 0.02, c.z); scene.add(ring);
    return { R, c, size };
  };
  EGM.setupRenderer = function (r) { r.shadowMap.enabled = true; r.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap; r.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding; r.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping; r.toneMappingExposure = 1.0; r.setClearColor(0x0e3540); };
  EGM.frameCam = function (cam, st, az, el, k) {
    const d = (Math.max(st.R * 0.86, st.size.y * 1.1)) / Math.tan((cam.fov * Math.PI / 180) / 2) * (k || 1.0);
    const t = new THREE.Vector3(st.c.x, Math.min(st.size.y * 0.35, st.R * 0.3), st.c.z);
    cam.position.set(t.x + d * Math.cos(el) * Math.sin(az), t.y + d * Math.sin(el), t.z + d * Math.cos(el) * Math.cos(az));
    cam.near = d / 200; cam.far = d * 20; cam.lookAt(t); cam.updateProjectionMatrix(); return t;
  };
})();

    const off = (P, d) => { const n = P.length; let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const q = P[(i + 1) % n]; a += P[i][0] * q[1] - q[0] * P[i][1]; } const s = a > 0 ? 1 : -1;
      return P.map((p, i) => { const p0 = P[(i - 1 + n) % n], p1 = P[(i + 1) % n];
        let ax = p[0] - p0[0], az = p[1] - p0[1], bx = p1[0] - p[0], bz = p1[1] - p[1]; const la = Math.hypot(ax, az) || 1, lb = Math.hypot(bx, bz) || 1; ax /= la; az /= la; bx /= lb; bz /= lb;
        const n0 = [az * s, -ax * s], n1 = [bz * s, -bx * s]; const k = Math.max(0.35, 1 + n0[0] * n1[0] + n0[1] * n1[1]);

    const shape = pts => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); return s; };
    const polyGeo = (pts, h) => new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape(pts), { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false }).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
    const cen = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };
    const grow = (p, d) => { let A = 0; const n = p.length; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n; A += p[i][0] * p[j][1] - p[j][0] * p[i][1]; } const s = A > 0 ? 1 : -1;
      return p.map((b, i) => { const a = p[(i + n - 1) % n], c = p[(i + 1) % n]; let e1 = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]], e2 = [c[0] - b[0], c[1] - b[1]]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1[0], e1[1]) || 1, l2 = Math.hypot(e2[0], e2[1]) || 1;

    const ex = (key, mat, p, h, y) => { if (p.length >= 3) add(key, mat, polyGeo(p, h), y); };
    const bands = (key, p, h, step, th, mat, d, y0) => { const q = grow(p, d || 0.5); for (let y = (y0 || step); y < h - 2; y += step) ex(key, mat, q, th, y); };
    const inBand = (x, z, m) => { const zs = z - KS * x; return x > R[0] + m && x < R[2] - m && zs > R[1] + m && zs < R[3] - m; };

    K.group(() => {
    /* ---------- ground: slanted band plate, sea + lagoon, beach, lawns ---------- */
    const par = [[R[0], R[1] + KS * R[0]], [R[2], R[1] + KS * R[2]], [R[2], R[3] + KS * R[2]], [R[0], R[3] + KS * R[0]]];
    K.pad(par, land, -4, 4);
    D.sand.forEach(p => ex("beach", beach, p, 0.14, 0));
    D.water.forEach(p => ex("sea", sea, p, 0.25, 0));
    D.grass.forEach(p => ex("grass", M("green"), p, 0.34, 0));

    /* ---------- real roads + promenades ---------- */
    const seg = (a, w, y, t) => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 4) { const dx = a[i + 2] - a[i], dz = a[i + 3] - a[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); out.push([(a[i] + a[i + 2]) / 2, y, (a[i + 1] + a[i + 3]) / 2, Math.atan2(-dz, dx), L + w * 0.5, t, w]); } return out; };
    const unit = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0), rd = D.roads;
    if (rd.path) K.inst(unit, "paving", seg(rd.path, 4, 0.2, 0.22));
    const car = [].concat(rd.svc ? seg(rd.svc, 6, 0.2, 0.3) : [], rd.minor ? seg(rd.minor, 8, 0.2, 0.34) : [], rd.sec ? seg(rd.sec, 16, 0.2, 0.42) : [], rd.trunk ? seg(rd.trunk, 18, 0.2, 0.46) : []);
    if (car.length) K.inst(unit, "road", car);
    /* corniche dual carriageway + lagoon bridge axis east of the mapped stretch: not in the map data, traced from imagery (estimated) */
    const cor = [[-705, -398], [-640, -405], [-560, -412], [-480, -408], [-400, -392], [-330, -368], [-250, -332], [-150, -296], [0, -255], [200, -195], [400, -160], [700, 80], [760, 125], [850, 180], [950, 202], [1050, 212], [1150, 218], [1300, 240], [1450, 258], [1568, 290]];
    const axis = [[978, 212], [985, 330], [990, 430], [990, 560]], tr = [];
    [cor, axis].forEach(l => { for (let i = 1; i < l.length; i++) tr.push(l[i - 1][0], l[i - 1][1], l[i][0], l[i][1]); });
    K.inst(unit, "road", seg(tr, 34, 0.2, 0.5).map((s, i) => { if (i >= cor.length - 1) { s[6] = 26; s[4] -= 12; } else s[4] -= 10; return s; }));
    K.inst(unit, "paving", seg(tr, 2.5, 0.2, 0.62));

    /* ---------- towers ---------- */
    const tower = (p, H, o) => {                     // finished tower: glass shaft, white floor bands, recessed crown
      o = o || {}; const g = o.glass || "gA", gm = { gA: glassA, gB: glassB, gC: glassC }[g];
      ex(g, gm, p, H, 0); bands("bW", p, H - 3, o.step || 10, 1.3, bandW, 0.45);
      ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, 0.9), 1.4, H - 1); ex("bD", bandD, grow(p, -2.5), 6, H); ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, -1.5), 0.8, H + 6);
      if (o.lattice) { const q = grow(p, -5.5); ex("bW", bandW, q, 0.8, H + 10); ex("metal", metal, grow(p, -8), 3.2, H + 6.8); }
    };
    const podium = (p, h) => { ex("cream", cream, p, h, 0); ex("bD", bandD, grow(p, 0.4), h * 0.3, h * 0.35); ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, 0.9), 0.8, h); };
    const cyl = [], west4 = [], low = [];
    D.B.forEach(b => {
      const p = b.p, c = cen(p), a = b.a;
      if (b.h > 90 && b.h < 135 && a > 1000) { tower(p, b.h, { glass: "gB" }); return; }                                   // Beachfront Towers (mapped heights)
      if (b.h > 90 && b.h < 135) return;                                                                                // duplicate sliver
      if (a > 20000) { podium(p, 11); return; }                                                                          // tower podiums (west)
      if (c[0] > -350 && c[0] < -90 && c[1] > -300 && c[1] < -150 && a > 1200 && a < 2100) { tower(p, 150, { glass: "gA", lattice: 1 }); return; }   // four lagoon towers (height estimated)
      if (c[0] > 570 && c[0] < 740 && c[1] > 30 && c[1] < 190 && a > 2000 && a < 2600) { cyl.push(p); return; }           // cylindrical towers
      if ((a === 2443 || a === 1285) && c[0] > 870 && c[0] < 970) { tower(p, 170, { glass: "gC", step: 8 }); return; }      // The Gate — west tower
      if (a === 3484) { tower(p, 170, { glass: "gC", step: 8 }); return; }                                               // The Gate — east tower
      if (c[0] > 1370 && c[0] < 1500 && c[1] > 300 && c[1] < 390 && a > 1400 && a < 1600) { tower(p, 160, { glass: "gB", lattice: 1 }); return; }    // North Edge (2 of 5)
      if (a > 3000 && c[0] > 700 && c[0] < 1000 && c[1] > 150) { podium(p, 14); return; }                                // The Gate podium
      if (a > 9000) { podium(p, 13); return; }                                                                           // North Edge podium
      low.push(b);
    });
    if (cyl.length) { const q = cyl[0], c0 = cen(q), c1 = cen(cyl[1] || q); const dx = c0[0] < c1[0] ? c0[0] - c1[0] : c1[0] - c0[0], dz = c0[0] < c1[0] ? c0[1] - c1[1] : c1[1] - c0[1];
      const w = c0[0] < c1[0] ? cyl[0] : cyl[1]; cyl.push(w.map(v => [v[0] + dx, v[1] + dz])); }                         // third tower (seen in imagery, not mapped): same spacing
    cyl.forEach(p => tower(p, 150, { glass: "gA", lattice: 1 }));
    low.forEach(b => { const h = b.a > 2500 ? 16 : b.a > 500 ? 13 : 8; ex("cream", cream, b.p, h, 0); if (b.a > 400) { ex("bD", bandD, grow(b.p, 0.35), 2.2, h * 0.45); ex("bW", bandW, grow(b.p, 0.7), 0.6, h); } });

    /* ---------- Downtown Towers (CSCEC) — under construction; bases traced from imagery (estimated) ---------- */
    const sector = (cx, cz, r0, r1, a0, a1, n) => { const o = []; for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const a = (a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n) * Math.PI / 180; o.push([cx + r1 * Math.cos(a), cz + r1 * Math.sin(a)]); }
      for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const a = (a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n) * Math.PI / 180; o.push([cx + r0 * Math.cos(a), cz + r0 * Math.sin(a)]); } return o; };
    const colPts = [];
    const openTop = (p, y0, y1) => { for (let y = y0 + 4; y <= y1 + 0.01; y += 4) ex("conc", conc, p, 0.4, y - 0.4); const q = grow(p, -0.8); q.forEach(v => colPts.push([v[0], y0, v[1], 0, 1, (y1 - y0), 1])); };
    [[-1115, -375], [-1000, -405], [-906, -428]].forEach((c, i) => {                                                     // three crescent towers, ≈ 200 m
      const p = sector(c[0], c[1], 75, 105, 195, 255, 10), H = 200, hc = 176;
      ex("gA", glassA, p, hc, 0); bands("bW", p, hc, 8, 1.2, bandW, 0.45); openTop(p, hc, H);
      const m = [c[0] + 90 * Math.cos(225 * Math.PI / 180), c[1] + 90 * Math.sin(225 * Math.PI / 180)];
      ex("conc", conc, sector(c[0], c[1], 84, 96, 218, 232, 3), H - hc + 6, hc);                                         // core
      const cr = K.crane(m[0], m[1], 42, 0.7 + i * 1.3); cr.position.y = H + 6;
      ex("cream", cream, grow(p, 9), 8, 0);
    });
    const sq = (cx, cz, w, ch) => { const h = w / 2; return [[cx - h + ch, cz - h], [cx + h - ch, cz - h], [cx + h, cz - h + ch], [cx + h, cz + h - ch], [cx + h - ch, cz + h], [cx - h + ch, cz + h], [cx - h, cz + h - ch], [cx - h, cz - h + ch]]; };
    { const cx = -1308, cz = -392, H = 300, hc = 228;                                                                    // Iconic Tower ≈ 300 m: gently stepped shaft
      [[0, 96, 58], [96, 168, 54], [168, hc, 50]].forEach(s => { const p = sq(cx, cz, s[2], 9); ex("gC", glassC, p, s[1] - s[0], s[0]); for (let y = s[0] + 8; y < s[1] - 2; y += 8) ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, 0.45), 1.2, y); ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, 1.2), 1.6, s[1] - 1.6); });
      openTop(sq(cx, cz, 48, 9), hc, H); ex("conc", conc, sq(cx, cz, 20, 3), H - hc + 8, hc);
      const c1 = K.crane(cx - 6, cz - 4, 46, 2.2); c1.position.y = H + 8; const c2 = K.crane(cx + 30, cz + 30, 40, 5.2); c2.position.y = hc;
      const L = [[-1470, -455], [-1405, -535], [-1380, -515], [-1425, -455], [-1365, -405], [-1385, -380], [-1450, -430]];  // annex/podium wing still rising
      for (let y = 4; y <= 24; y += 4) ex("conc", conc, L, 0.4, y - 0.4); grow(L, -1).forEach(v => colPts.push([v[0], 0, v[1], 0, 1, 24, 1]));
      [[-1440, -500], [-1395, -430], [-1435, -445]].forEach(v => colPts.push([v[0], 0, v[1], 0, 1, 24, 1]));
      K.crane(-1420, -415, 70, 1.1); K.crane(-1215, -455, 80, 3.6);
      ex("cream", cream, sq(cx, cz, 84, 10), 9, 0);
    }
    flush();
    K.inst(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.9, 1, 0.9).translate(0, 0.5, 0), "concrete", colPts);

    /* ---------- planting ---------- */
    const palms = []; const allB = D.B.map(b => grow(b.p, 6));
    const clear = (x, z) => inBand(x, z, 8) && !allB.some(p => inPoly(x, z, p)) && !D.water.some(p => inPoly(x, z, p));
    if (rd.sec) for (let i = 0; i < rd.sec.length; i += 4) { const a = rd.sec, dx = a[i + 2] - a[i], dz = a[i + 3] - a[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (L < 30) continue; const nx = -dz / L, nz = dx / L;
      for (let s = 15; s < L; s += 36) [-1, 1].forEach(sg => { const x = a[i] + dx * s / L + nx * 12 * sg, z = a[i + 1] + dz * s / L + nz * 12 * sg; if (clear(x, z)) palms.push([x, z]); }); }
    K.palms(palms, 12);
    }, 0, 3, 0);
    return K.root;
  }
});

    const scl = (p, f, c) => { c = c || cen(p); return p.map(q => [c[0] + (q[0] - c[0]) * f, c[1] + (q[1] - c[1]) * f]); };

      return p.map((b, i) => { const a = p[(i + n - 1) % n], c = p[(i + 1) % n]; let e1 = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]], e2 = [c[0] - b[0], c[1] - b[1]]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1[0], e1[1]) || 1, l2 = Math.hypot(e2[0], e2[1]) || 1;
        const n1 = [s * e1[1] / l1, -s * e1[0] / l1], n2 = [s * e2[1] / l2, -s * e2[0] / l2], k = d / Math.max(0.35, 1 + n1[0] * n2[0] + n1[1] * n2[1]); return [b[0] + (n1[0] + n2[0]) * k, b[1] + (n1[1] + n2[1]) * k]; }); };
    const inPoly = (x, z, p) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = p.length - 1; i < p.length; j = i++) if ((p[i][1] > z) !== (p[j][1] > z) && x < (p[j][0] - p[i][0]) * (z - p[i][1]) / (p[j][1] - p[i][1]) + p[i][0]) c = !c; return c; };
    const bag = {};
    const add = (key, mat, geo, y) => { if (geo.index) geo = geo.toNonIndexed(); if (y) geo.translate(0, y, 0); (bag[key] = bag[key] || { mat, g: [] }).g.push(geo); };
    const flush = () => Object.keys(bag).forEach(k => { const b = bag[k]; let n = 0; b.g.forEach(g => (n += g.attributes.position.count)); const P = new Float32Array(n * 3), Nn = new Float32Array(n * 3); let o = 0;
      b.g.forEach(g => { P.set(g.attributes.position.array, o); Nn.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o); o += g.attributes.position.count * 3; });
      const m = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); m.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(P, 3)); m.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(Nn, 3)); K.mesh(m, b.mat); delete bag[k]; });
    const ex = (key, mat, p, h, y) => add(key, mat, polyGeo(p, h), y);
    let seed = 7; const rnd = () => ((seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647);

    /* ---------- ground: desert plate, real CBD plots, the park (Green River edge) ---------- */
    K.group(() => {
    K.plate(R[2] - R[0], R[3] - R[1], "sand", (R[0] + R[2]) / 2, (R[1] + R[3]) / 2, -1.8, 0, 1.8);
    D.plots.forEach(p => K.pad(p, "paving", 0, 0.25));
    D.grass.forEach(p => K.pad(p, "green", 0, 0.34));

    /* ---------- real road network (instanced strips) ---------- */
    const seg = (a, w, y, t, ext) => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 4) { const dx = a[i + 2] - a[i], dz = a[i + 3] - a[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); out.push([(a[i] + a[i + 2]) / 2, y, (a[i + 1] + a[i + 3]) / 2, Math.atan2(-dz, dx), L + (ext === undefined ? w * 0.5 : ext), t, w]); } return out; };
    const unit = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0);
    const rd = D.roads;
    if (rd.minor) K.inst(unit, "road", seg(rd.minor, 7, 0.26, 0.12));
    if (rd.secondary) K.inst(unit, "road", seg(rd.secondary, 12, 0.26, 0.15));
    if (rd.primary) K.inst(unit, "road", seg(rd.primary, 14, 0.26, 0.18));
    if (rd.trunk) K.inst(unit, "road", seg(rd.trunk, 17, 0.26, 0.21));

    /* ---------- monorail: elevated guideway on piers along the real alignment + CBD station ---------- */
    if (rd.transit) {
      K.inst(unit, "concrete", seg(rd.transit, 2.6, 13, 1.8, 1));
      const piers = []; for (let i = 0; i < rd.transit.length; i += 4) { const a = rd.transit, L = Math.hypot(a[i + 2] - a[i], a[i + 3] - a[i + 1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / 32)); for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const t = (k + 0.5) / n; piers.push([a[i] + (a[i + 2] - a[i]) * t, 0, a[i + 1] + (a[i + 3] - a[i + 1]) * t]); } }
      K.inst(K.cylGeo(1.1, 1.3, 13, 10), "concrete", piers);
    }

    /* ---------- towers ---------- */
    const bandsFor = (key, p, h, step, th, mat, d, y0) => { const q = grow(p, d || 0.5); for (let y = (y0 || step); y < h - 2; y += step) ex(key, mat, q, th, y); };
    /* heights re-measured from building lean on Google imagery, calibrated on the Iconic Tower (393.8 m) and residential tower D01 (≈ 191 m) */
    const HM = { 6: 87, 7: 135, 14: 133, 15: 133, 20: 155, 21: 155 }; D.B.forEach((b, i) => { if (HM[i]) b.h = HM[i]; });
    const partial = [], low = [];
    D.B.forEach(b => {
      const p = b.p, c = cen(p);
      if (b.h === 394) return;                                         // Iconic Tower: bespoke below
      if (b.h === 55) {                                                // crescent buildings (two arcs = 4 linked hotel/retail blocks)
        ex("cream", cream, p, 30, 0); ex("gB", glassB, grow(p, -3.2), 3.4, 30);                     // ≈ 28–36 m measured on imagery (roof lean)
        bandsFor("bD", p, 30, 3.9, 1.5, bandD, 0.35, 4.6); ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, 1.6), 1.1, 30); ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, -2), 0.7, 33.4);
        return;
      }
      if (b.h > 140 && p.length === 6) {                               // residential L-shaped towers
        ex("cream", cream, p, b.h, 0); bandsFor("bD", p, b.h - 4, 7.6, 3.4, bandD, 0.3, 9);
        ex("metal", M("metal"), grow(p, -5), 7, b.h); ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, 1.2), 1.2, b.h - 1.2);
        return;
      }
      if (b.h >= 59) {                                                 // office / mixed-use towers
        const oval = p.length > 8;
        ex(oval ? "gB" : "gA", oval ? glassB : glassA, p, b.h, 0); bandsFor("bW", p, b.h - 3, oval ? 8 : 12, oval ? 1.1 : 1.4, bandW, 0.45);
        ex("metal", M("metal"), grow(p, -7), 6, b.h); ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, 1), 1.2, b.h - 1);
        ex("cream", cream, grow(p, 5), 9, 0); ex("bD", bandD, grow(p, 5.6), 2.2, 4);       // podium (estimated)
        return;
      }
      if (p.length === 4 && b.a > 2400 && b.a < 3700 && c[0] > 400 && c[0] < 660 && c[1] > -70 && c[1] < 230) { partial.push(b); return; }
      low.push(b);
    });
    /* three eastern towers with no mapped height: finished office slabs (checked on 2026 imagery); heights measured from lean: ≈ 76 m (north slab) and ≈ 82 m (twin slabs) */
    partial.forEach(b => {
      const p = b.p, H = b.a > 3000 ? 76 : 82;
      ex("gA", glassA, p, H, 0); bandsFor("bW", p, H - 3, 12, 1.4, bandW, 0.45);
      ex("metal", M("metal"), grow(p, -7), 6, H); ex("bW", bandW, grow(p, 1), 1.2, H - 1);
      ex("cream", cream, grow(p, 5), 9, 0); ex("bD", bandD, grow(p, 5.6), 2.2, 4);
    });
    /* low mapped buildings (services, pavilions, monorail station) */
    low.forEach(b => {
      const c = cen(b.p), station = c[0] < -300 && c[1] < -400;
      if (station) { ex("conc", M("concrete"), b.p, 9, 0); ex("gB", glassB, grow(b.p, -2), 8, 9); ex("bW", bandW, grow(b.p, 3), 1.4, 17); }
      else { ex("cream", cream, b.p, 9, 0); ex("bD", bandD, grow(b.p, 0.4), 2.4, 3.5); ex("bW", bandW, grow(b.p, 0.8), 0.7, 9); }
    });
    flush();

    /* ---------- Iconic Tower (393.8 m): two curved finned shells split by a recessed glass slot on the boulevard axis,
       slot flaring into an inverted-V entrance at grade; open "Shuti" crown = the two shells rising past the roof deck as feathers,
       with the ring-shaped oculus bridging the slot. Profile read from Perkins&Will photographs + Google imagery (estimated). ---------- */
    K.group(() => {
      const HT = 393.8, YD = 372, NA = 22, NY = 44, FL = 4.7;
      const rad = y => (35.3 - 12.8 * Math.pow(Math.min(y, HT) / 380, 1.35) - 1.3 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - y / 60), 2)) * (y > 348 ? 1 - 0.2 * Math.pow((y - 348) / (HT - 348), 2) : 1);
      const gap = y => 2.5 + 12.5 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - y / 58), 2) + 2.3 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, (y - 290) / 104), 1.5);   // half-width of the slot
      const phi = y => Math.asin(Math.min(0.9, gap(y) / rad(y)));
      const rim = u => HT - 16 * Math.pow(Math.abs(u), 2.2);                                                                   // feather rim: highest at the outer middle
      const pt = (side, u, y, off) => { const a = side * (Math.PI / 2 + u * (Math.PI / 2 - phi(y))), r = rad(y) + (off || 0); return [r * Math.cos(a), y, r * Math.sin(a)]; };
      const shellM = M(0x66b8cc, { roughness: 0.1, metalness: 0.65, doubleSide: true }), finM = M(0xf4f1ea, { doubleSide: true });
      const sv = [], si = [], fv = [];
      [1, -1].forEach(side => {
        const o = sv.length / 3;
        for (let i = 0; i <= NA; i++) { const u = i / NA * 2 - 1, top = rim(u); for (let j = 0; j <= NY; j++) { const p = pt(side, u, top * j / NY); sv.push(p[0], p[1], p[2]); } }
        for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) for (let j = 0; j < NY; j++) { const a = o + i * (NY + 1) + j, b = a + NY + 1; side > 0 ? si.push(a, a + 1, b, b, a + 1, b + 1) : si.push(a, b, a + 1, a + 1, b, b + 1); }
        // horizontal sun-shade fins, one per floor, wrapped round each shell
        const q = (A, B, C, Dd) => fv.push(...A, ...B, ...C, ...A, ...C, ...Dd);
        for (let y = 10; y < HT - 3; y += FL) for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) { const u0 = i / NA * 2 - 1, u1 = (i + 1) / NA * 2 - 1; if (y + 1.6 > Math.min(rim(u0), rim(u1))) continue;
          const a0 = pt(side, u0, y, 0.1), a1 = pt(side, u1, y, 0.1), b0 = pt(side, u0, y, 1.0), b1 = pt(side, u1, y, 1.0), c0 = b0.slice(), c1 = b1.slice(); c0[1] -= 1.5; c1[1] -= 1.5;
          q(a0, b0, b1, a1); q(b0, c0, c1, b1); }
      });
      const sg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); sg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(sv, 3)); sg.setIndex(si); sg.computeVertexNormals(); K.mesh(sg, shellM);
      const fg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); fg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(fv, 3)); fg.computeVertexNormals(); K.mesh(fg, finM);
      // recessed dark-glass slot on both boulevard faces (wide at the entrance, a narrow strip above), closed back to the shells
      const pv = [], pi = [], NS = 46, DEP = 3.2;
      [1, -1].forEach(sx => { const o = pv.length / 3;
        for (let j = 0; j <= NS; j++) { const y = YD * j / NS, r = rad(y), f = phi(y), x = r * Math.cos(f), z = r * Math.sin(f), d = DEP + (y < 58 ? 5 * (1 - y / 58) : 0);
          pv.push(sx * x, y, z, sx * (x - d), y, z, sx * (x - d), y, -z, sx * x, y, -z); }
        for (let j = 0; j < NS; j++) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { const a = o + j * 4 + k, b = a + 4; pi.push(a, b, a + 1, a + 1, b, b + 1); } });
      const pg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); pg.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pv, 3)); pg.setIndex(pi); pg.computeVertexNormals();
      K.mesh(pg, M(0x24505f, { roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.6, doubleSide: true }));
      // white edge trims that part at the base into the inverted-V entrance and run up to the feather tips
      [[1, 1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [-1, -1]].forEach(s => { const pts = []; for (let j = 0; j <= 16; j++) { const y = (HT - 17) * Math.pow(j / 16, 1.5), r = rad(y) + 0.5, f = phi(y); pts.push([s[0] * r * Math.cos(f), y, s[1] * r * Math.sin(f)]); } K.tube(pts, 0.85, bandW); });
      // roof deck inside the crown, the slot continuing across it, and the ring-shaped oculus bridging the two halves
      const ring = (r, n) => { const o = []; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const a = k / n * Math.PI * 2; o.push([r * Math.cos(a), r * Math.sin(a)]); } return o; };
      ex("conc", M("concrete"), ring(rad(YD) - 0.3, 36), 1.2, YD - 1.2);
      const gs = gap(YD); ex("bD", bandD, [[-rad(YD) + 1, -gs], [rad(YD) - 1, -gs], [rad(YD) - 1, gs], [-rad(YD) + 1, gs]], 0.5, YD);
      ex("bW", bandW, ring(6.2, 20), 2.2, YD + 0.5); ex("bD", bandD, ring(3.2, 16), 0.4, YD + 2.7);
      ex("metal", M("metal"), [[-9, 8], [1, 8], [1, 15], [-9, 15]], 3.5, YD); ex("metal", M("metal"), [[-1, -15], [9, -15], [9, -8], [-1, -8]], 3.5, YD);   // plant rooms on the two decks
      flush();
    }, -1, 0, -4, -0.324);                                                   // slot axis = the CBD boulevard axis (≈ 18.5° south of east)

    /* ---------- entrance canopies east of the tower: two L-shaped white lattice roofs flanking the boulevard axis + two small pavilions (traced from imagery) ---------- */
    [[[28.9, -54], [88.3, -86], [136.6, -70], [111.5, 12], [89.2, 6], [107.8, -53], [42.8, -28]],
     [[-8.3, 54.5], [19.6, 111], [67.9, 132], [97.6, 49.5], [74.4, 44], [57.6, 95], [16.8, 40]]].forEach(p => {
      ex("bW", bandW, p, 1.1, 10.4); ex("gB", glassB, grow(p, -5), 10.4, 0); });
    [[74.5, -13], [55, 46]].forEach(c => { const q = [[-7, -7], [7, -7], [7, 7], [-7, 7]].map(v => [c[0] + v[0] * 0.95 - v[1] * 0.32, c[1] + v[0] * 0.32 + v[1] * 0.95]);
      ex("bW", bandW, q, 0.8, 6.2); ex("gB", glassB, grow(q, -2.5), 6.2, 0); });
    flush();

    /* ---------- planting: boulevard palms + park trees ---------- */
    const palms = [], trees = [];
    const alongRoads = (a, off, step) => { for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 4) { const dx = a[i + 2] - a[i], dz = a[i + 3] - a[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (L < step) continue; const nx = -dz / L, nz = dx / L; for (let s = step / 2; s < L; s += step) [-1, 1].forEach(sg => palms.push([a[i] + dx * s / L + nx * off * sg, a[i + 1] + dz * s / L + nz * off * sg])); } };
    if (rd.primary) alongRoads(rd.primary, 11, 34); if (rd.trunk) alongRoads(rd.trunk, 13, 40);
    const clear = (x, z) => !D.B.some(b => inPoly(x, z, grow(b.p, 8)));
    K.palms(palms.filter(p => clear(p[0], p[1]) && p[0] > R[0] + 6 && p[0] < R[2] - 6 && p[1] > R[1] + 6 && p[1] < R[3] - 6), 12);
    D.grass.forEach(p => { for (let i = 0; i < 520; i++) { const x = R[0] + rnd() * (R[2] - R[0]), z = R[1] + rnd() * (R[3] - R[1]); if (inPoly(x, z, p) && clear(x, z)) trees.push([x, z, 0.8 + rnd() * 0.6]); } });
    K.trees(trees, 11);
    }, 0, 0.8, 0);                                                            // site plate −1 … 0.8; plots, lawns and roads stay within 0.5 m of it so the map cut (base + 2.3 m) removes all ground and leaves only what is built
    return K.root;
  }
});

}catch(e){console.error("model 18",e)}

    function sweep(path, prof, m, acc) {

  build(K) {
    const C = { ground: 0x6d675c, muizz: 0x8f8a80, asphalt: 0x3f454a, f0: 0xa3927a, f1: 0x8f7f68, f2: 0xb0a189, f3: 0x85765f, mapped: 0xa99a82, stone: 0xe4cc9c, stoneL: 0xefdcb2, dome: 0xd6bd88,
      white: 0xece6d6, marble: 0xf1eee6, lead: 0x8c9496, wood: 0x6f5137, grass: 0x6c9655, court: 0xd8ccb0, dark: 0x3a3229, gold: 0xd9b45c, canopy: 0xf4f1ea };
    const X0 = -390, X1 = 386, Z0 = -180, Z1 = 470;
    const GM = {}; const add = (g, m) => { (GM[m] = GM[m] || []).push(g); return g; };
    const merge = geos => { const p = [], n = []; geos.forEach(g => { const q = g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g; if (!q.attributes.normal) q.computeVertexNormals(); p.push(...q.attributes.position.array); n.push(...q.attributes.normal.array); });
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(n, 3)); return g; };
    const area = r => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % r.length; a += r[i][0] * r[j][1] - r[j][0] * r[i][1]; } return a / 2; };
    const pairs = a => { const o = []; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 2) o.push([a[i], a[i + 1]]); return o; };
    /* prism without a bottom face: walls + top (holes allowed) */
    const prism = (pts, h, y0, holes) => {
      y0 = y0 || 0; const v = []; const rings = [pts].concat(holes || []);
      rings.forEach((r, ri) => { const A = area(r) * (ri ? -1 : 1); for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { const a = r[i], b = r[(i + 1) % r.length];
        if (A > 0) v.push(a[0], y0, a[1], b[0], y0 + h, b[1], b[0], y0, b[1], a[0], y0, a[1], a[0], y0 + h, a[1], b[0], y0 + h, b[1]);
        else v.push(a[0], y0, a[1], b[0], y0, b[1], b[0], y0 + h, b[1], a[0], y0, a[1], b[0], y0 + h, b[1], a[0], y0 + h, a[1]); } });
      const V2 = r => r.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const all = [].concat(...rings);
      const cont = V2(pts), hl = (holes || []).map(V2); if (THREE.ShapeUtils.isClockWise(cont)) { /* triangulateShape handles either winding via index mapping below */ }
      const tris = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(cont, hl);
      tris.forEach(t => { const a = all[t[0]], b = all[t[1]], c = all[t[2]]; const ny = (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - a[0]) - (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - a[1]);
        if (ny > 0) v.push(a[0], y0 + h, a[1], b[0], y0 + h, b[1], c[0], y0 + h, c[1]); else v.push(a[0], y0 + h, a[1], c[0], y0 + h, c[1], b[0], y0 + h, b[1]); });
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(v, 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); return g; };
    const bx = (w, h, d, x, y, z, ry) => { const g = new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d).translate(0, h / 2, 0); if (ry) g.rotateY(ry); return g.translate(x, y, z); };
    const cy = (rt, rb, h, x, y, z, seg, ry) => { const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, h, seg || 16).translate(0, h / 2, 0); if (ry) g.rotateY(ry); return g.translate(x, y, z); };
    const dm = (r, x, y, z, sy, seg) => { const g = new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, seg || 20, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2); g.scale(1, sy || 1, 1); return g.translate(x, y, z); };
    const bulb = (r, x, y, z, sy) => { const g = new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 10, 8); g.scale(1, sy || 1.5, 1); return g.translate(x, y + r * (sy || 1.5), z); };

        const A = [q[0][0], y, q[0][1]], B = [q[0][2], y, q[0][3]], Cc = [q[1][0], y, q[1][1]], Dd = [q[1][2], y, q[1][3]]; pos.push(...A, ...Cc, ...B, ...B, ...Cc, ...Dd, ...A, ...B, ...Cc, ...B, ...Dd, ...Cc); }
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); return g; };

      if (type === "mam") {                                           // Mamluk: square base, octagonal tier, round tier, columned pavilion with bulb

      if (type === "qal") { add(cy(r * 0.62, r * 0.66, H * 0.2, x, yb + H * 0.67, z, 16), m); add(cy(r * 0.8, r * 0.64, H * 0.02, x, yb + H * 0.87, z, 16), m); add(dm(r * 0.62, x, yb + H * 0.89, z, 1.25, 12), m); add(cy(0.1, 0.1, H * 0.04, x, yb + H * 0.955, z, 5), "gold"); return; }
      const n = type === "double" ? 2 : type === "ghuri5" ? 5 : 4; add(sq(r * 0.66, H * 0.14, yb + H * 0.67), m); add(sq(r * 0.85, 0.7, yb + H * 0.81), m);
      const c = Math.cos(ry), s = Math.sin(ry), off = n === 2 ? [[-0.42, 0], [0.42, 0]] : [[-0.42, -0.42], [0.42, -0.42], [0.42, 0.42], [-0.42, 0.42]].concat(n === 5 ? [[0, 0]] : []);
      off.forEach((o, i) => { const px = x + (o[0] * c + o[1] * s) * r, pz = z + (-o[0] * s + o[1] * c) * r, e = i === 4 ? H * 0.04 : 0; add(cy(r * 0.2, r * 0.22, H * 0.06 + e, px, yb + H * 0.82, pz, 8), m); add(bulb(r * (n === 2 ? 0.34 : 0.27), px, yb + H * 0.875 + e, pz, 1.5), m); });
    };

    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;
  }
});

      for (let i = 0; i < bank.length - 1; i++) { const a = bank[i], b = bank[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); for (let s = 10; s < L; s += 22) tr.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * s / L + 20, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * s / L]); }
      [[-300, -120], [-275, -140], [-250, -150], [-262, -105], [-240, -90], [-285, -75], [-230, -125], [-270, -60]].forEach(p => tr.push(p));

        push("deck", [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, 0, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, ry, Lr, 1, w]); const nx = -(b[1] - a[1]) / Lr, nz = (b[0] - a[0]) / Lr;
        for (let d = 0; d <= Lr + 0.1; d += 18) { const x = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * d / Lr, z = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * d / Lr; push("post", [x + nx * w / 2, 0, z + nz * w / 2, ry], [x - nx * w / 2, 0, z - nz * w / 2, ry]); } });

      // ---------- tanks ----------
      D.tanks.forEach(t => { const [u, v, r, h, ty] = t;
        if (ty === 3) { pt("twA", u, v, 0, r, h, r); pt("domeA", u, v, h, r, r * 0.3, r); pt("ring", u, v, 0, r, h, r); pt("ringB", u, v, 0, r, h, r); }
        else if (ty === 2) { pt("twT", u, v, 0, r, h, r); pt("domeT", u, v, h, r, r * 0.22, r); }
        else if (ty === 1) { pt("tw", u, v, 0, r, h, r); pt("dome", u, v, h, r, r * 0.2, r); if (r > 10) pt("ring", u, v, 0, r, h, r); }
        else { pt("tw", u, v, 0, r, h, r); pt("dome", u, v, h, r, r * 0.12, r); } });
      const bund = (u0, v0, u1, v1, h) => { h = h || 1.6; rect("bund", u0, v0 - 0.5, u1, v0 + 0.5, h); rect("bund", u0, v1 - 0.5, u1, v1 + 0.5, h); rect("bund", u0 - 0.5, v0, u0 + 0.5, v1, h); rect("bund", u1 - 0.5, v0, u1 + 0.5, v1, h); };
      bund(-37, 84, 75, 174, 2.4); rect("bundPad", -37, 84, 75, 174, 0.3); bund(-780, -140, -712, -55, 2.4); rect("bundPad", -780, -140, -712, -55, 0.3);
      bund(162, -27, 197, 16); bund(385, -6, 421, 38); bund(298, 78, 342, 146); bund(522, 98, 565, 168); bund(255, -58, 302, -12);
      D.grid.forEach(g => { for (let i = 0; i < g[2]; i++) for (let j = 0; j < g[3]; j++) { pt("tw", g[0] + i * g[4], g[1] + j * g[5], 0, g[6], g[7], g[6]); pt("dome", g[0] + i * g[4], g[1] + j * g[5], g[7], g[6], g[6] * 0.2, g[6]); } });

      D.rot.forEach(r => { seg("wall", r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5]); seg("roofG", r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4] + 1, 0.8, r[5]); });

      // ---------- urea conveyors (elevated galleries) and transfer towers ----------

        const n = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.hypot(c[i + 1][0] - c[i][0], c[i + 1][1] - c[i][1]) / 24)); for (let k = 0; k <= n; k++) pt("trestle", c[i][0] + (c[i + 1][0] - c[i][0]) * k / n, c[i][1] + (c[i + 1][1] - c[i][1]) * k / n, 0); } });
      D.tower.forEach(t => { rect("convT", t[0] - t[2] / 2, t[1] - t[2] / 2, t[0] + t[2] / 2, t[1] + t[2] / 2, t[3]); });

      // ---------- generic unit fill ----------
      const col = (u, v, r, h) => { pt("col", u, v, 0, r, h, r); pt("colTop", u, v, h, r); };
      const struct = (u0, v0, u1, v1, h, step) => { step = step || 8; for (let y = step; y <= h + 0.1; y += step) rect("sslab", u0, v0, u1, v1, 0.5, y);
        const nu = Math.max(1, Math.round((u1 - u0) / 9)), nv = Math.max(1, Math.round((v1 - v0) / 9));
        for (let i = 0; i <= nu; i++) for (let j = 0; j <= nv; j++) if (i === 0 || j === 0 || i === nu || j === nv) pt("spost", u0 + (u1 - u0) * i / nu, v0 + (v1 - v0) * j / nv, 0, 1, h, 1); };
      D.unit.forEach(q => { const [u0, v0, u1, v1, tall] = q; rect("pad", u0, v0, u1, v1, 0.3);
        const Wd = u1 - u0, Dd = v1 - v0, n = Math.max(2, Math.round(Wd * Dd / 600));
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const r = 1.0 + rnd() * 1.4, h = tall * (0.3 + rnd() * 0.55); col(u0 + 3 + rnd() * (Wd - 6), v0 + 3 + rnd() * (Dd - 6), r, h); }

      // primary reformers with stacks
      D.reformer.forEach(r => { rect("furn", r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4]); rect("furnTop", r[0] + 3, r[1] + 3, r[2] - 3, r[3] - 3, 4, r[4]); pt("stack", r[5], r[6], 0, 1, r[7], 1);

      const ub = K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), I = (k, geo, m) => L[k] && K.inst(geo, m, L[k]);
      const COLM = K.mat(0xc9cfd1, { roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.25 }), FR = 0x8a8f8c, TEAL = 0x3f8f8c, cap = (n) => new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, n, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2);

      I("conv", ub, 0xd9c98f); I("trestle", K.boxGeo(0.8, 9, 3), 0x9a9482); I("convT", ub, 0xcfc3a0);
      I("col", K.cylGeo(1, 1, 1, 12), COLM); I("colTop", cap(12), COLM);
      I("vessel", new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.5, 1.5, 9, 8).rotateZ(Math.PI / 2).translate(0, 3, 0), 0xdcd8cc);
      I("sslab", ub, FR); I("spost", K.boxGeo(0.55, 1, 0.55), FR);
      I("furn", ub, 0xa9aeac); I("furnTop", ub, 0xbcc0bd); I("stack", K.cylGeo(1.6, 2.2, 1, 12), 0xd4d6d2);
      I("wall", ub, 0xd9d2bf); I("white", ub, 0xe9e6dc); I("roofF", ub, 0xcbc3ad); I("roofG", ub, 0x9aa5b8); I("roofR", ub, 0xc0694f);

      K.palms([[-470, -150], [-470, -110], [-470, 0], [-470, 60], [-470, 120], [-660, 20], [-620, 25]].map(p => W(p[0], p[1])), 9);

    return K.root;
  }

   trestle, which is cut at the plate edge (the berths lie a further 1–1.6 km out to sea). The crude farm does not fit this frame;

   Coordinates inside build() are metres from the record pin; everything emitted is shifted by (CX, CZ) to the new centre.

    const T = 21.4 * Math.PI / 180, c = Math.cos(T), s = Math.sin(T);

    /* plate (metres from the record pin) and clipping helpers */
    const X0 = 1080, X1 = 2760, Z0 = -640, Z1 = -20, CX = (X0 + X1) / 2, CZ = (Z0 + Z1) / 2;
    const inP = (x, z, m) => x - (m || 0) >= X0 && x + (m || 0) <= X1 && z - (m || 0) >= Z0 && z + (m || 0) <= Z1;
    const clipSeg = (a, b) => { let t0 = 0, t1 = 1; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const q = [[-dx, a[0] - X0], [dx, X1 - a[0]], [-dz, a[1] - Z0], [dz, Z1 - a[1]]];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { if (q[i][0] === 0) { if (q[i][1] < 0) return null; } else { const r = q[i][1] / q[i][0]; if (q[i][0] < 0) { if (r > t1) return null; if (r > t0) t0 = r; } else { if (r < t0) return null; if (r < t1) t1 = r; } } }
      return [[a[0] + dx * t0, a[1] + dz * t0], [a[0] + dx * t1, a[1] + dz * t1]]; };
    const clipPoly = pts => { let P = pts; [[0, X0, 1], [0, X1, -1], [1, Z0, 1], [1, Z1, -1]].forEach(e => { const out = [], ins = p => (p[e[0]] - e[1]) * e[2] >= 0;

    const rectU = (k, u0, v0, u1, v1, h, y) => { if (![[u0, v0], [u1, v0], [u1, v1], [u0, v1]].every(q => { const w = W(q[0], q[1]); return inP(w[0], w[1]); })) return; const p = W((u0 + u1) / 2, (v0 + v1) / 2); push(k, [p[0], y || 0, p[1], T, Math.abs(u1 - u0), h, Math.abs(v1 - v0)]); };

      [["path", 3, "paving", 0.36], ["service", 4.6, "road", 0.4], ["minor", 7, "road", 0.44], ["tertiary", 9, "road", 0.48], ["secondary", 13, "road", 0.52]].forEach(c => { const a = rd[c[0]]; if (!a) return; K.inst(unit, c[2], seg(a, c[1], 0.3, c[3])); for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 4) allSeg.push([a[i], a[i + 1], a[i + 2], a[i + 3], c[1]]); });

      /* ---------- lakes, pools, pitches, courts, athletics stadium ---------- */
      D.water.forEach(w => { if (w.c === "lake") { pad(grow(w.p, 2.5), "paving", 0, 0.35); pad(w.p, "water", 0, 0.5); } else { pad(grow(w.p, 4), white, 0, 0.5); pad(w.p, "water", 0, 0.62); } });
      const pitches = [];
      D.lu.forEach((l, i) => {
        if (l.c === "stadium") { pad(l.p, track, 0, 0.4); pitches.push(l.p); return; }
        if (l.c !== "pitch") return; const b = bb(l.p); if (b[0] > -20 && b[2] < 20 && b[1] > -40 && b[3] < 30) return;   // the playing court inside the hall
        pitches.push(l.p);
        if (l.a > 5000) { pad(grow(l.p, 4), lawn, 0, 0.42); pad(l.p, turf, 0, 0.52); pad(grow(l.p, -9), turf2, 0, 0.56); }
        else { pad(grow(l.p, 1.5), M(0x4f9a6a), 0, 0.42); pad(grow(l.p, -3), court, 0, 0.5); }
      });

      /* ---------- THE HALL ---------- */
      const C = cen(body), HW = 19, HR = 29;                                              // eave / roof apex heights (estimated)
      extrude(hallB, 7.5, cream, 0);                                                    // concourse podium incl. porches
      extrude(grow(body, -1.2), HW - 7.5, glz, 7.5);                                    // glazed drum
      pad(grow(body, 0.6), white, 7.2, 1.0);                                            // podium cornice
      pad(grow(body, 0.8), white, HW - 4.2, 4.2);                                       // white fascia under the eave
      // vertical fins all round the glazed band
      const fins = []; for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) { const a = body[i], b = body[(i + 1) % body.length], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / 4.2)); for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const t = (k + 0.5) / n; fins.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, 7.5, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, Math.atan2(-(b[1] - a[1]), b[0] - a[0])]); } }
      K.inst(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.9, HW - 11.5, 2.2).translate(0, (HW - 11.5) / 2, 0), white, fins);

        for (let r = 0; r < NR; r++) for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const a = r * n + k, b = r * n + (k + 1) % n, c = a + n, d = b + n; idx.push(a, b, c, b, d, c); }
        const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(v, 3)); g.setIndex(idx); g.computeVertexNormals(); K.mesh(g, M(0xc9d2d6, { roughness: 0.42, metalness: 0.45, doubleSide: true }));
        // radial standing ribs + central ventilation lantern

      })();
      K.cyl(9, 10, 1.6, roofD, C[0], HR - 0.6, C[1], 24); K.dome(8.6, glzL, C[0], HR + 1, C[1], 0.22, 24);
      // entrance porches (north = main, south) : glazed fronts, canopies, columns
      K.box(17.4, 6.5, 1.2, glzL, 1.7, 7.5, -65.5); K.box(26, 1.1, 12, white, 1.7, 14, -66); K.columns([-9, -71], [12.4, -71], 6, 0.55, 14, white);
      K.box(33, 6.5, 1.2, glzL, 2, 7.5, 62.6); K.box(40, 1.1, 12, white, 2, 14, 63); K.columns([-16, 68], [20, 68], 8, 0.55, 14, white);
      K.box(24, 0.5, 16, "paving", 1.7, 0.3, -78); K.box(36, 0.5, 16, "paving", 2, 0.3, 76);

      /* ---------- neighbouring halls and the swimming complex (real footprints, estimated heights) ---------- */
      D.B.slice(1).forEach(b => {
        const q = bb(b.p), w = q[2] - q[0], d = q[3] - q[1], cx = (q[0] + q[2]) / 2, cz = (q[1] + q[3]) / 2;
        if (b.a > 6000) {                                                                  // swimming complex: long hall with a barrel roof
          extrude(b.p, 9, cream, 0); pad(grow(b.p, 0.5), glz, 3, 3.2); pad(grow(b.p, 0.9), white, 9, 0.8);
          K.vault(d - 14, 6, w - 30, roofM, cx + 6, 9.8, cz, Math.PI / 2);
        } else {                                                                            // individual-games halls ≈ 60 × 60 m
          extrude(b.p, 10, cream, 0); pad(grow(b.p, 0.5), glz, 3.2, 3.6); pad(grow(b.p, 0.9), white, 10, 0.8);
          K.vault(w - 8, 5, d - 8, roofM, cx, 10.8, cz, 0);
        }
      });

      /* ---------- planting ---------- */
      const solids = D.B.map(b => grow(b.p, 7)).concat(pitches.map(p => grow(p, 6)), D.water.map(w => grow(w.p, 5)), [grow(body, 10)]);
      const nearRoad = (x, z, m) => allSeg.some(s => { const dx = s[2] - s[0], dz = s[3] - s[1], L2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1; let t = ((x - s[0]) * dx + (z - s[1]) * dz) / L2; t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t)); return Math.hypot(x - s[0] - dx * t, z - s[1] - dz * t) < s[4] / 2 + m; });
      const free = (x, z) => x > R[0] + 5 && x < R[2] - 5 && z > R[1] + 5 && z < R[3] - 5 && !solids.some(p => inPoly(x, z, p)) && !nearRoad(x, z, 2.5);
      const trees = [], palms = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 900 && trees.length < 260; i++) { const x = R[0] + rnd() * (R[2] - R[0]), z = R[1] + rnd() * (R[3] - R[1]); if (z > -150 && free(x, z)) trees.push([x, z, 0.8 + rnd() * 0.5]); }
      grow(body, 20).forEach((q, i, arr) => { const b = arr[(i + 1) % arr.length]; for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) { const x = q[0] + (b[0] - q[0]) * k / 2, z = q[1] + (b[1] - q[1]) * k / 2; if (Math.abs(x - 2) > 22 || Math.abs(z) < 50) if (!nearRoad(x, z, 1)) palms.push([x, z]); } });
      flush(); K.trees(trees, 8); K.palms(palms, 11);
    }, 0, 3, 0);                                                                           // site sits on a 4 m plate (top at y = 3)
    return K.root;
  }
});

  build(K) {
    const X0 = -250, X1 = 285, Z0 = -128, Z1 = 195;
    const RY = -Math.atan2(0.846, 0.533);            // local +x → true bearing of the station axis (toward SSE)
    /* ---------- helpers (same approach as model 83) ---------- */
    function clipLine(pts) {
      const out = []; let cur = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
        const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1]; let t0 = 0, t1 = 1; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; let ok = true;
        [[-dx, a[0] - X0], [dx, X1 - a[0]], [-dz, a[1] - Z0], [dz, Z1 - a[1]]].forEach(c => { if (c[0] === 0) { if (c[1] < 0) ok = false; } else { const r = c[1] / c[0]; if (c[0] < 0) { if (r > t1) ok = false; else if (r > t0) t0 = r; } else { if (r < t0) ok = false; else if (r < t1) t1 = r; } } });
        if (!ok || t0 >= t1) { if (cur.length > 1) out.push(cur); cur = []; continue; }
        const p = [a[0] + dx * t0, a[1] + dz * t0], q = [a[0] + dx * t1, a[1] + dz * t1];
        if (!cur.length || t0 > 0) { if (cur.length > 1) out.push(cur); cur = [p]; }
        cur.push(q); if (t1 < 1) { out.push(cur); cur = []; }
      }
      if (cur.length > 1) out.push(cur); return out;
    }
    function sweep(path, prof, m, acc) {
      const n = path.length, pos = acc || [], rings = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = path[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = path[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)];
        let tx = b[0] - a[0], tz = b[2] - a[2]; const l = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1; tx /= l; tz /= l;
        rings.push(prof.map(p => [path[i][0] - tz * p[0], path[i][1] + p[1], path[i][2] + tx * p[0]]));
      }
      const tri = (a, b, c) => pos.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], b[0], b[1], b[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]);
      for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { const r0 = rings[i], r1 = rings[i + 1], k = r0.length;
        for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) { const j2 = (j + 1) % k; tri(r0[j], r0[j2], r1[j2]); tri(r0[j], r1[j2], r1[j]); } }
      [rings[0], rings[n - 1]].forEach(r => { for (let j = 1; j < r.length - 1; j++) tri(r[0], r[j], r[j + 1]); });
      return acc ? null : flush(pos, m);
    }
    function flush(pos, m) { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); return K.mesh(g, K.mat(m, { doubleSide: true })); }

    function resample(pts, step) {
      const out = []; let s = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / step));
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) out.push({ x: a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, z: a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n, s: s + L * k / n }); s += L; }
      const e = pts[pts.length - 1]; out.push({ x: e[0], z: e[1], s }); return out;
    }

      return { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, ang: Math.atan2(b.z - a.z, b.x - a.x) }; };

        [-1, 1].forEach(sd => {

      (rnd() < 0.6 ? pm : tr).push([x, z, 0.8 + rnd() * 0.4]); })));

    const X0 = -345, X1 = 425, Z0 = -278, Z1 = 160;
    const RY = Math.atan2(195, 370.7);                 // local +x → true track bearing (ENE)
    function sweep(path, prof, acc) {
      const n = path.length, rings = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = path[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = path[Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)];
        let tx = b[0] - a[0], tz = b[2] - a[2]; const l = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1; tx /= l; tz /= l;
        rings.push(prof.map(p => [path[i][0] - tz * p[0], path[i][1] + p[1], path[i][2] + tx * p[0]]));
      }

    // flat annular sector on the ground (top face only)
    function sector(key, cx, cz, r0, r1, a0, a1, y) {
      const n = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(Math.abs(a1 - a0) / 0.14)), acc = ACC[key];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const b0 = a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n, b1 = a0 + (a1 - a0) * (i + 1) / n;
        const P = (r, a) => [cx + Math.cos(a) * r, y, cz + Math.sin(a) * r], p00 = P(r0, b0), p01 = P(r0, b1), p10 = P(r1, b0), p11 = P(r1, b1);
        acc.push(...p00, ...p11, ...p10, ...p00, ...p01, ...p11); }

    function resample(pts, step) {
      const out = []; let s = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / step));

      const e = pts[pts.length - 1]; out.push({ x: e[0], z: e[1], s }); return out;
    }

      return { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, ang: Math.atan2(b.z - a.z, b.x - a.x) }; };

      K.plate(X1 - X0, Z1 - Z0, K.mat(0xcdb07c), (X0 + X1) / 2, (Z0 + Z1) / 2, -1.6, 0, 1.6);

        for (let i = 0; i <= nx; i++) { const x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / nx;

        }

    const onLand = (x, z) => pip(LAND_W, x, z) || pip(LAND_E, x, z) || pip(ISLAND, x, z);

    function clipLine(pts) {
      const out = []; let cur = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
        let a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], t0 = 0, t1 = 1; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; let ok = true;
        [[-dx, a[0] - X0], [dx, X1 - a[0]], [-dz, a[1] - Z0], [dz, Z1 - a[1]]].forEach(c => { if (c[0] === 0) { if (c[1] < 0) ok = false; } else { const r = c[1] / c[0]; if (c[0] < 0) { if (r > t1) ok = false; else if (r > t0) t0 = r; } else { if (r < t0) ok = false; else if (r < t1) t1 = r; } } });

      const idx = []; R.forEach((p, i) => { const s = rel(i); if (s >= sFrom - 0.01 && s <= sTo + 0.01) idx.push(i); });
      if (idx.length < 2) return; const path = idx.map(i => P3[i]);
      sweep(path, k => { const h = path[k][1] - G - 0.35; return [[-W / 2 - 0.3, -0.36], [W / 2 + 0.3, -0.36], [W / 2 + 0.3 + h * 1.7, -0.35 - h], [-W / 2 - 0.3 - h * 1.7, -0.35 - h]]; }, null, ACC.fill);
    }
    embank(-9999, -2.5); embank(LB + 2.5, sE0 - 2.5); embank(sE1 + 2.5, 9999);

    /* ---------- roads from the map ---------- */
    const hT = (x, z) => { const b = R.reduce((b, r) => Math.hypot(r.x - x, r.z - z) < Math.hypot(b.x - x, b.z - z) ? r : b, R[0]); return lev(b.s - sA0) - G - 0.15; };
    function ramp(pts, w, axisAtStart) {                                 // interchange ramp between the axis (elevated) and the bank road (ground)
      const rr = resample(pts, 6), L = rr[rr.length - 1].s, e = axisAtStart ? pts[0] : pts[pts.length - 1], h0 = hT(e[0], e[1]);
      const path = rr.map(p => { let t = axisAtStart ? 1 - p.s / L : p.s / L; t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - 0.06) / 0.86)); t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t); return [p.x, G + 0.05 + h0 * t, p.z]; });
      sweep(path, [[-w / 2, 0], [w / 2, 0], [w / 2, 0.25], [-w / 2, 0.25]], null, ACC.road);
      sweep(path, k => { const h = path[k][1] - G + 0.3; return [[-w / 2 - 0.6, -0.02], [w / 2 + 0.6, -0.02], [w / 2 + 0.6 + h * 1.6, -h], [-w / 2 - 0.6 - h * 1.6, -h]]; }, null, ACC.fill);
    }

    [[-380, -5, 0xf2efe7], [-120, -5, 0xc23b3b], [90, -7.2, 0x2f6fb0], [330, -5, 0xf2efe7], [520, -5, 0xd9b45c], [700, 5, 0xf2efe7], [430, 7.2, 0x3a4a52], [200, 5, 0xc23b3b], [-40, 5, 0xf2efe7], [-250, 7.2, 0x2f6fb0], [1000, -5, 0xf2efe7], [1210, 5, 0x3a4a52]]

    // low-poly instanced vegetation (orchard trees + date palms)
    K.inst(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.4, 3.4, 4, 1, true).translate(0, 1.7, 0), "trunk", tr);
    K.inst(new THREE.SphereGeometry(3.3, 6, 4).translate(0, 5.6, 0), K.mat(0x4f8f52), tr.filter((t, i) => i % 2 === 0)); K.inst(new THREE.SphereGeometry(3.3, 6, 4).translate(0, 5.6, 0), K.mat(0x3f7a47), tr.filter((t, i) => i % 2 === 1));

    K.inst(new THREE.ConeGeometry(3.6, 1.9, 7).rotateX(Math.PI).translate(0, 11.4, 0), "palm", pm);
    // small farmhouse on the east bank next to the bridge (visible in imagery)
    K.box(14, 4, 10, K.mat(0xd9cfb8), 458, G, -8, 0.15);
    return K.root;
  }

  build(K) {
    const G = 5, WL = 0.6, BOT = -0.8;
    const X0 = -600, X1 = 640, Z0 = -400, Z1 = 400;
    const LAND_W = [[X0, Z0], [-150, Z0], [-183, -300], [-205, -200], [-235, -105], [-262, -40], [-280, 0], [-297, 100], [-343, 200], [-411, 300], [-480, Z1], [X0, Z1]];

    let sd = 11; const rnd = () => { sd = (sd * 16807) % 2147483647; return sd / 2147483647; };

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

        const pr = typeof prof === "function" ? prof(i) : prof;
        rings.push(pr.map(p => [path[i][0] - tz * p[0], path[i][1] + p[1], path[i][2] + tx * p[0]]));
      }
      const tri = (a, b, c) => acc.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], b[0], b[1], b[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]);

      [rings[0], rings[n - 1]].forEach(r => { for (let j = 1; j < r.length - 1; j++) tri(r[0], r[j], r[j + 1]); });
    }
    function flush(pos, m, noShadow) { if (!pos.length) return null; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); const me = K.mesh(g, K.mat(m, { doubleSide: true })); if (noShadow) { me.castShadow = false; me.receiveShadow = false; } return me; }
    const rect = (acc, cx, cz, w, d, ang, y, h) => { const c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang); sweep([[cx - c * w / 2, y, cz - s * w / 2], [cx + c * w / 2, y, cz + s * w / 2]], [[-d / 2, 0], [d / 2, 0], [d / 2, h], [-d / 2, h]], acc); };
    const quad = (acc, cx, cz, w, d, ang, y) => { const c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang), P = [[-w / 2, -d / 2], [-w / 2, d / 2], [w / 2, d / 2], [w / 2, -d / 2]].map(q => [cx + c * q[0] - s * q[1], y, cz + s * q[0] + c * q[1]]);

    function flushTop(pos, m) { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); const me = K.mesh(g, m); me.castShadow = false; return me; }
    function ribbon(path, u0, u1, y, acc) {                                   // flat top-only strip (normal up) along a ground polyline
