        K.inst(new THREE.SphereGeometry(dr * 0.56, 6, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2).scale(0.42, dh / (dr * 0.56) * 0.98, 1), stone, ribs);
        K.cyl(0.07, 0.07, 0.9, "gold", 0, top - 0.9, 0, 6);
      }, x, 0, z);
      salient(-52.2, -56.6, 15.6, 13.5, 21.2, 27.4, 33.7);                                        // northern minaret, built into the city wall
      salient(-50.2, 55.6, 15.6, 11.0, 16.6, 20.4, 24.7);                                         // western minaret

      /* ---------- northern city wall of Badr al-Jamali (1087) and Bab al-Futuh ---------- */
      const wz = -66, wh = 10;
      K.box(17, wh, 3.4, wallM, -69.5, 0, wz); K.box(134, wh, 3.4, wallM, 23, 0, wz);
      K.box(12, 13.5, 7, wallM, -52.2, 0, -66.5);                                                  // the salient pushes through the wall as a tower
      [[-12, 9], [34, 9], [78, 9]].forEach(t => { K.box(t[1], 12.6, 7.4, wallM, t[0], 0, wz - 2); K.inst(K.boxGeo(0.5, 1.6, 0.4), darkM, [[t[0], 8.6, wz - 5.75]]); });
      merlons([[[-78, wz - 1.7], [-58, wz - 1.7]], [[-44, wz - 1.7], [90, wz - 1.7]]], wh, 1.9, 0.9, 0.8, wallM);
      merlons([[[-58, -70], [-46.4, -70]], [[-16.5, wz - 5.7], [-7.5, wz - 5.7]], [[29.5, wz - 5.7], [38.5, wz - 5.7]], [[73.5, wz - 5.7], [82.5, wz - 5.7]]], 13.5 - 0.9, 1.9, 0.9, 0.8, wallM);
      // Bab al-Futuh: two round-fronted towers flanking the arched gateway (real position from OSM)
      K.group(() => {
        const gh = 20;
        K.box(25, gh, 19, wallM, 0, 0, 9.5);                                                       // gate block
        [-9.6, 9.6].forEach(o => { K.box(7.2, gh, 4.2, wallM, o, 0, -2.0); K.cyl(3.6, 3.6, gh, wallM, o, 0, -4.1, 24); K.cyl(3.75, 3.75, 0.5, pale, o, gh * 0.62, -4.1, 24); K.inst(archGeo(1.9, 3.6, 0.5), pale, [[o, gh * 0.66, -7.6, 0]]); });
        K.box(12, gh, 3, wallM, 0, 0, 1.5);
        K.inst(archGeo(6.6, 11.5, 0.6), pale, [[0, 0, -0.05, 0]]); K.inst(archGeo(5.2, 10.4, 1.0), darkM, [[0, 0, -0.05, 0], [0, 0, 19.0, 0]]);
        K.box(25.4, 0.5, 19.4, pale, 0, gh * 0.86, 9.5);
        merlons(loop([[-12.3, 0.2], [12.3, 0.2], [12.3, 18.8], [-12.3, 18.8]]), gh, 1.9, 0.9, 0.8, wallM);
        const arc = []; [-9.6, 9.6].forEach(o => { for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i + 0.5) * Math.PI / 7; arc.push([o + Math.sin(a) * 3.5, gh, -4.1 - Math.cos(a) * 3.5, -a]); } });
        K.inst(K.boxGeo(0.9, 0.8, 0.5), wallM, arc);
      }, -90.5, 0, -61);

      /* ---------- trees of the forecourt and surroundings ---------- */
      K.trees([[-63, -36, 1.2], [-58, -30], [-61, -22, 1.1], [-56, -17], [-60, -10, 1.2], [-57, 16], [-58, 26, 1.1], [-56, 36], [-76, -60, 1.1], [-66, -52]], 7);
      K.palms([[-55, -38], [-55, -12], [-54, 14], [-53, 40]], 9);
    }, 0, 0, 0, RY);
    merge(G);
    return K.root;
  }

   Origin = centre of the temple building (≈ 25.47648 N, 30.55539 E); +X east, -Z north; metres.

  build(K) {
    const C = { grove: 0x5f6642, sand: 0xbda477, sand2: 0xb39a6e, stone: 0xd9b472, stoneL: 0xe6c98e, stoneD: 0xa9854f, pave: 0xdfd0a8, mud: 0x9c7a55, roofN: 0x8d8777,
      dark: 0x2e2619, palm: 0x4c8246, palm2: 0x3d6e3c, dead: 0x8c6a3a, trunk: 0x6f5438, field: 0x5f9a4a, field2: 0x7aa650, white: 0xe9e2d0, asphalt: 0x6f777a, road: 0x4b555b, fence: 0x6d5a45, blue: 0x5aa6c8 };
    const PX0 = -104, PX1 = 334, PZ0 = -158, PZ1 = 100;                 // plate, world metres

      const B = [[-a, 0, -b], [a, 0, -b], [a, 0, b], [-a, 0, b]], T = [[-c, h, -d], [c, h, -d], [c, h, d], [-c, h, d]], v = [];

      K.inst(archGeo(3.2, 5.6, 0.3), doorM, L.ag); K.inst(archGeo(4.2, 6.3, 0.25), trim, L.agf);
      K.inst(unit, trim, L.box); K.inst(unit, wallD, L.boxD);
      const disc = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.62, 0.62, 0.2, 16).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), disc2 = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.4, 0.4, 0.2, 12).rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
      K.inst(disc, trim, L.rnd); K.inst(disc2, K.mat(0x8a5a36), L.rndD);                                                    // horse-head roundels (schematic)
    }, 0, 1.2, 0, RY);
    merge(G);
    return K.root;
  }
});

/* 204 — الجامع الأزهر (Al-Azhar Mosque), Cairo.
   Real orientation: the whole complex is built in a local frame whose +X axis is the qibla axis (≈ 126° from north, i.e. south-east)
   and +Z is south-west; the group is then rotated so the model sits exactly on the mapped footprint (OSM way 24749059).
   Layout read from the OSM outline + aerial imagery: Bab al-Muzayinin and the entrance court on the north-west, Aqbughawiyya (left, two domes
   + minaret) and Taybarsiyya (right), Riwaq al-Abbasi at the west corner, the Fatimid sahn with keel-arched arcades, the prayer hall with the
   raised transept between the al-Hafiz dome and the mihrab dome, Katkhuda's higher extension behind it with his two pencil minarets,
   and the Gawhariyya dome at the east corner. */
EGM.add({
  id: 204,

  build(K) {
    const RY = -Math.atan2(70.3, 97.7);            // qibla axis of the real footprint
    const stone = K.mat(0xd8c4a0), roofM = K.mat(0xc7b48e), pale = K.mat(0xe7dcc4), marble = K.mat(0xf3f0e8, { roughness: 0.45 });
    const darkM = K.mat(0x4b3b2d), rail = K.mat(0xb9a67f), blueM = K.mat(0x4f7ea6, { roughness: 0.5 }), lead = K.mat(0x4a5458, { roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.3 });
    const woodM = K.mat(0x6b4a32);

    /* ---------- small helpers ---------- */
    const rect = (x0, x1, z0, z1) => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x0, z1]];
    // solid block with a slightly darker roof plate (reads as a flat roof behind a parapet)
    const block = (x0, x1, z0, z1, h, m, y0) => {
      y0 = y0 || 0; K.box(x1 - x0, h, z1 - z0, m || stone, (x0 + x1) / 2, y0, (z0 + z1) / 2);
      if (x1 - x0 > 2 && z1 - z0 > 2) K.box(x1 - x0 - 1.2, 0.12, z1 - z0 - 1.2, roofM, (x0 + x1) / 2, y0 + h, (z0 + z1) / 2);
    };
    // extruded footprint with courts: holes are wound opposite to the outline so their walls face into the court

    const ring = (outer, holes, h, m, y0) => K.extrude(outer, h, m || stone, y0 || 0, (holes || []).map(q => (area2(q) > 0) === (area2(outer) > 0) ? q.slice().reverse() : q));
    // pointed (keel) arch panel in the XY plane, thickness d

      s.quadraticCurveTo(w / 2, h * 0.9, 0, h); s.quadraticCurveTo(-w / 2, h * 0.9, -w / 2, sp); s.lineTo(-w / 2, 0);
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: d, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 6 }); g.translate(0, 0, -d / 2); return g;

    const dome = (x, z, y, r, sy, drumH, m) => { K.cyl(r * 1.06, r * 1.1, drumH, m || stone, x, y, z, 8); K.dome(r, m || pale, x, y + drumH, z, sy || 1.15); K.cyl(0.06, 0.06, 1.2, "gold", x, y + drumH + r * (sy || 1.15) - 0.1, z, 6); };

      g.traverse(o => {

        const e = by.get(o.material); e.p.push(geo.attributes.position.array); e.n.push(geo.attributes.normal.array); rm.push(o);
      });
      rm.forEach(o => o.parent.remove(o));
      by.forEach((e, m) => {
        const len = e.p.reduce((a, b) => a + b.length, 0), P = new Float32Array(len), N = new Float32Array(len); let off = 0;
        e.p.forEach((a, i) => { P.set(a, off); N.set(e.n[i], off); off += a.length; });

        const me = new THREE.Mesh(geo, m); me.castShadow = true; me.receiveShadow = true; g.add(me);
      });

        const n = Math.max(2, Math.round((b[1] - b[0]) / 3.6)); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = b[0] + (b[1] - b[0]) * (i + 0.5) / n; for (let y = 1.6; y < b[4] - 2; y += 3.4) cwin.push([x, GL + y, b[2]], [x, GL + y, b[3]]); }
      });
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(1.1, 1.6, 0.3), darkM, cwin);

      /* ---------- the Roman water gate: curtain wall and two U-shaped bastions (limestone with brick courses) ---------- */
      K.box(38, FL, 1.6, stone, 11, 0, -1.7);
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(38.1, 0.45, 1.7), brick, [1.6, 3.4, 5.2, 7.0, 8.8].map(y => [11, y, -1.7]));
      K.inst(archGeo(3.4, 5.4, 0.5), darkM, [[9.2, 0.05, -0.92, 0]]);                                           // the gate passage under the nave
      const bastion = (cx, cz, r, h, open) => K.group(() => {
        const s = new THREE.Shape(); s.moveTo(-r, cz + 0.9); s.lineTo(-r, 0); s.absarc(0, 0, r, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2, false); s.lineTo(r, cz + 0.9);
        const ex = (sh, hh, m, y) => K.mesh(new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: hh, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 20 }).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), m, 0, y, 0);
        if (open) { const hp = new THREE.Path(); hp.absarc(0, 0, r - 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2, true); s.holes.push(hp); }
        ex(s, h, stone, 0);
        const b = new THREE.Shape(); b.moveTo(-r - 0.06, cz + 0.9); b.lineTo(-r - 0.06, 0); b.absarc(0, 0, r + 0.06, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2, false); b.lineTo(r + 0.06, cz + 0.9);
        const bh = new THREE.Path(); bh.moveTo(-r + 0.3, cz + 0.9); bh.lineTo(r - 0.3, cz + 0.9); bh.absarc(0, 0, r - 0.3, 0, -Math.PI, true); bh.lineTo(-r + 0.3, cz + 0.9); b.holes.push(bh);
        for (let y = 1.6; y < h - 0.6; y += 1.8) ex(b, 0.45, brick, y);
        const win = []; for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const a = -Math.PI * 0.4 + i * Math.PI * 0.2; win.push([Math.sin(a) * (r - 0.05), h * 0.55, Math.cos(a) * (r - 0.05), a]); }
        K.inst(archGeo(1.3, 2.4, 0.5), darkM, win);
      }, cx, 0, cz);
      // note: the bastion shapes are drawn in the XY plane and laid flat, so "cz" above is the distance back to the curtain wall
      bastion(1.3, 7.2, 6.6, 9.2, true);                                                                        // west bastion: roofless ruin
      bastion(17.6, 6.4, 7.6, FL, false);                                                                       // east bastion: carries the oldest chapel (Takla Haymanot)
      K.group(() => {                                                                                            // upper storey on the east bastion
        const s = new THREE.Shape(); s.moveTo(-7.6, 8.4); s.lineTo(-7.6, 0); s.absarc(0, 0, 7.6, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2, false); s.lineTo(7.6, 8.4);
        K.mesh(new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 5.6, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 20 }).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), plaster, 0, FL, 0);
        const s2 = new THREE.Shape(); s2.moveTo(-7.0, 8.4); s2.lineTo(-7.0, 0); s2.absarc(0, 0, 7.0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2, false); s2.lineTo(7.0, 8.4);
        K.mesh(new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s2, { depth: 0.12, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 20 }).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), roofM, 0, FL + 5.6, 0);
        const win = []; for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const a = -Math.PI * 0.4 + i * Math.PI * 0.2; win.push([Math.sin(a) * 7.56, FL + 1.6, Math.cos(a) * 7.56, a]); }
        K.inst(K.boxGeo(1.5, 2.2, 0.5), woodM, win);
      }, 17.6, 0, 6.4);

      /* ---------- the church: nave and aisles over the gate, three sanctuaries at the east end ---------- */
      const cw = C.x1 - C.x0, cd = C.z1 - C.z0, cxm = (C.x0 + C.x1) / 2, czm = (C.z0 + C.z1) / 2;
      K.box(cw, TOP - 2.2 - GL, cd, plaster, cxm, GL, czm);                                                    // aisles level
      K.box(cw - 1, 0.12, cd - 1, roofM, cxm, TOP - 2.2, czm);
      K.box(cw + 0.3, 0.4, cd + 0.3, white, cxm, TOP - 2.9, czm);
      K.box(cw - 5, 1.0, 7.2, plaster, cxm - 1.5, TOP - 2.2, czm);                                             // clerestory of the nave
      K.vault(7.2, 1.25, cw - 5, roofM, cxm - 1.5, TOP - 1.2, czm, Math.PI / 2);                               // timber barrel roof ("Noah's ark") seen from outside
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(1.1, 0.55, 0.2), darkM, [].concat(...[-7.5, -4.5, -1.5, 1.5, 4.5].map(o => [[cxm - 1.5 + o, TOP - 2.0, czm - 3.62], [cxm - 1.5 + o, TOP - 2.0, czm + 3.62]])));
      [[-5.6, 0], [0, 0], [5.6, 0]].forEach(o => {                                                             // domes of the three sanctuaries
        K.box(4.6, 1.0, 4.6, plaster, C.x1 - 3.2, TOP - 2.2, czm + o[0]); K.dome(2.0, domeM, C.x1 - 3.2, TOP - 1.2, czm + o[0], 0.8, 20); cross(C.x1 - 3.2, TOP + 0.3, czm + o[0], 0.7, Math.PI / 2);
      });
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(1.8, 0.7, 1.8), stone2, [[6, -18], [12, -18.4], [18, -18], [6, -5.4], [13, -5], [19, -5.6]].map(v => [v[0], TOP - 2.2, v[1]]));   // aisle skylights
      // windows: small round-headed lights on the north side, wooden screened windows over the fortress wall on the south side
      K.inst(archGeo(1.0, 2.2, 0.5), darkM, [4.5, 8.5, 12.5, 16.5, 20.5, 23.5].map(x => [x, FL + 3.2, C.z0, 0]).concat([-7, -1, 5].map(o => [C.x1, FL + 3.0, czm + o, Math.PI / 2])));
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(1.9, 2.3, 0.7), woodM, [4, 7.5].map(x => [x, FL + 1.6, C.z1]).concat([28, 31.5].map(x => [x - 24, FL + 5.2, C.z1])));
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(2.2, 0.25, 0.9), trim, [4, 7.5].map(x => [x, FL + 3.9, C.z1]));
      // sacristy block behind the sanctuaries (flat reddish roof seen from the air)
      K.box(8.5, 9.2, 13, plaster, 29.75, GL, -11.5); K.box(7.6, 0.14, 12, tileR, 29.75, GL + 9.2, -11.5);

      K.box(10, FL + 6 - GL, 16, plaster, -3, GL, -14); K.box(9, 0.12, 15, roofM, -3, FL + 6, -14); K.box(10.3, 0.35, 16.3, white, -3, FL + 5.2, -14);
      K.inst(archGeo(1.5, 3.2, 0.5), darkM, [[-8, FL + 0.2, AX, Math.PI / 2], [-8, FL + 0.2, AX + 3, Math.PI / 2], [-8, FL + 0.2, AX - 3, Math.PI / 2]]);     // three-arched porch front
      K.box(7.6, FL - GL, 12.6, stone2, -11.8, GL, AX); K.box(7.6, 0.1, 11.4, white, -11.8, FL, AX);                    // paved inner court at church level
      K.box(7.6, 3.4, 0.6, plaster, -11.8, FL, AX - 6); K.box(7.6, 3.4, 0.6, plaster, -11.8, FL, AX + 6);

      const FX = -17.2;                                                                                           // facade plane (towers seen on imagery at this line)
      K.box(3.2, FL - GL, 12.6, stone2, FX, GL, AX);
      K.box(1.4, 8.2, 6.2, white, FX + 0.6, FL, AX);                                                             // central bay: portico below, gallery above

      K.box(1.7, 0.3, 6.4, trim, FX + 0.55, FL + 8.2, AX);
      K.profile([[-3.2, 0], [3.2, 0], [0, 2.3]], 1.4, white, FX + 0.6, FL + 8.5, AX, Math.PI / 2); cross(FX + 0.6, FL + 10.8, AX, 1.0, Math.PI / 2);   // gable and cross

        K.box(2.6, 3.4, 2.6, white, 0, FL + 10.5, 0);                                                            // belfry with open arches
        K.inst(archGeo(1.1, 2.4, 2.8), darkM, [[0, FL + 10.9, 0, 0], [0, FL + 10.9, 0, Math.PI / 2]]);
        K.box(2.95, 0.3, 2.95, trim, 0, FL + 13.9, 0);
        K.cyl(1.0, 1.15, 0.7, white, 0, FL + 14.2, 0, 8); K.dome(1.0, domeM, 0, FL + 14.9, 0, 1.25, 16); cross(0, FL + 16.0, 0, 0.8, Math.PI / 2);
      }, FX, 0, AX + o));

      /* ---------- the 29 steps and the narrow court from the street gate ---------- */
      const SX1 = FX - 1.6, RUN = 0.32, RISE = (FL - GL) / 29, steps = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 29; i++) steps.push([SX1 - RUN * (i + 0.5), GL, AX, 0, 1, (29 - i) * RISE, 1]);
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(RUN, 1, 6.0), white, steps);
      const SX0 = SX1 - RUN * 29, CX0 = -47;
      [-3.3, 3.3].forEach(o => { K.box(SX1 - SX0 + 0.4, FL - GL + 1.0, 0.6, stone2, (SX0 + SX1) / 2, GL, AX + o); K.box(SX1 - SX0 + 0.4, 0.2, 0.8, trim, (SX0 + SX1) / 2, FL + 1.0, AX + o); });
      K.pad(rect(CX0, SX0, AX - 3, AX + 3), redPave, GL, 0.08);                                                  // reddish paving of the court
      K.box(SX0 - CX0, 5.2, 0.6, plaster, (CX0 + SX0) / 2, GL, AX - 3.3); K.box(SX0 - CX0, 5.2, 0.6, plaster, (CX0 + SX0) / 2, GL, AX + 3.3);
      K.box(SX0 - CX0, 0.25, 0.8, trim, (CX0 + SX0) / 2, GL + 5.2, AX - 3.3); K.box(SX0 - CX0, 0.25, 0.8, trim, (CX0 + SX0) / 2, GL + 5.2, AX + 3.3);
      const mo = []; for (let x = CX0 + 3; x < SX0 - 1.5; x += 3.6) mo.push([x, GL + 1.3, AX - 2.96]);
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(2.6, 2.6, 0.1), mosB, mo); K.inst(K.boxGeo(2.2, 2.2, 0.14), mosA, mo.map(p => [p[0], p[1] + 0.2, p[2]]));   // the modern mosaic panels along the wall
      const pl = [[CX0 + 4.5, AX + 0.9], [CX0 + 9.5, AX + 0.9], [CX0 + 14.5, AX + 0.9]];
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(3.4, 0.5, 1.5), stone2, pl.map(p => [p[0], GL + 0.08, p[1]]));
      K.group(() => K.palms(pl, 5), 0, GL + 0.5, 0);
      // street gate: iron gates under a pointed stone arch
      K.group(() => {
        K.box(1.4, 7.2, 8.4, stone, 0, 0, 0); K.box(1.7, 0.4, 8.8, trim, 0, 7.2, 0);
        K.inst(ptGeo(3.6, 5.6, 1.6), darkM, [[0, 0.05, 0, Math.PI / 2]]); K.inst(K.boxGeo(0.12, 3.3, 3.3), iron, [[-0.5, 0.05, 0]]);
        cross(0, 7.6, 0, 0.8, Math.PI / 2);
      }, CX0 - 0.7, GL, AX);
      K.group(() => K.trees([[-52, -6, 0.9], [-56, 12, 1.0], [36, 30, 1.1], [40, 12, 0.9], [-30, 34, 1.1], [-12, 36, 1.0]], 7), 0, GL, 0);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0, RY);
    merge(G);
    return K.root;
  }
});

   Layout read from imagery: a long rectangular hall (≈ 98 × 44 m) of 1874 in Gothic-revival style with a line of roof lanterns

  build(K) {
    const RY = -Math.atan2(0.385, 0.923);                                  // direction of the square front (real footprint)

    const rect = (x0, x1, z0, z1) => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x0, z1]];
    const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
    const grow = (p, d) => { const sg = area2(p) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = p.length; return p.map((v, i) => { const a = p[(i + n - 1) % n], b = p[(i + 1) % n];      // offset an axis-aligned outline by d
      const e1 = [v[0] - a[0], v[1] - a[1]], e2 = [b[0] - v[0], b[1] - v[1]], l1 = Math.hypot(e1[0], e1[1]), l2 = Math.hypot(e2[0], e2[1]);
      return [v[0] + (e1[1] / l1 + e2[1] / l2) * sg * d, v[1] - (e1[0] / l1 + e2[0] / l2) * sg * d]; }); };
    const archGeo = (w, h, d, sp) => {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); sp = h * (sp || 0.6); s.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, sp);
      s.quadraticCurveTo(w / 2, sp + (h - sp) * 0.7, 0, h); s.quadraticCurveTo(-w / 2, sp + (h - sp) * 0.7, -w / 2, sp); s.lineTo(-w / 2, 0);
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: d, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 6 }); g.translate(0, 0, -d / 2); return g;
    };
    const along = (a, b, n, y, skip) => {
      const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], ry = Math.atan2(-dz, dx), L = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (skip && skip(i)) continue; const t = (i + 0.5) / n; L.push([a[0] + dx * t, y, a[1] + dz * t, ry]); }
      return L;
    };
    const merge = g => {
      g.updateMatrixWorld(true); const inv = new THREE.Matrix4().copy(g.matrixWorld).invert(), by = new Map(), rm = [];
      g.traverse(o => {
        if (!o.isMesh || o.isInstancedMesh) return; const geo = o.geometry.index ? o.geometry.toNonIndexed() : o.geometry.clone();
        geo.applyMatrix4(new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(inv, o.matrixWorld)); if (!by.has(o.material)) by.set(o.material, { p: [], n: [] });
        const e = by.get(o.material); e.p.push(geo.attributes.position.array); e.n.push(geo.attributes.normal.array); rm.push(o);
      });
      rm.forEach(o => o.parent.remove(o));
      by.forEach((e, m) => {
        const len = e.p.reduce((a, b) => a + b.length, 0), P = new Float32Array(len), N = new Float32Array(len); let off = 0;
        e.p.forEach((a, i) => { P.set(a, off); N.set(e.n[i], off); off += a.length; });
        const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(P, 3)); geo.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(N, 3));
        const me = new THREE.Mesh(geo, m); me.castShadow = true; me.receiveShadow = true; g.add(me);
      });
    };
    const hip = (w, d, h) => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22 * Math.SQRT1_2 * 2, Math.SQRT1_2, 1, 4, 1).rotateY(Math.PI / 4).translate(0, 0.5, 0).scale(w, h, d);   // hipped roof with a short ridge
    const balcony = (y, r) => { K.cyl(r * 1.5, r * 1.0, 0.9, stone, 0, y - 0.9, 0, 16); K.cyl(r * 1.56, r * 1.56, 0.2, pale, 0, y, 0, 16); K.torus(r * 1.5, 0.09, rail, 0, y + 1.0, 0); K.torus(r * 1.5, 0.06, rail, 0, y + 0.55, 0); };

    const G = K.group(() => {
      /* real extents (local metres): hall X -26 … 17.5, Z -46 … 52; shrine wing to X = 22; Bab al-Akhdar block to X = 28 */
      const X0 = -26, X1 = 17.5, Z0 = -46, ZF = 52, H = 15;
      const body = [[X0, Z0], [X1, Z0], [X1, 6], [22, 6], [22, 39], [28, 39], [28, ZF], [X0, ZF]];

      /* ---------- ground ---------- */
      K.pad(rect(-40, 44, -56, 110), K.mat(0xb7ab94), -1.6, 1.6);                                  // site plate
      K.pad(rect(-40, X0, -56, ZF), paveM, 0, 0.08);                                               // lane on the Khan al-Khalili side
      K.pad(rect(X0, 44, -56, Z0), paveM, 0, 0.08);
      K.pad([[X1, Z0], [31, Z0], [31, ZF], [28, ZF], [28, 39], [22, 39], [22, 6], [X1, 6]], marble, 0, 0.14);   // paved walk along the east side
      K.pad(rect(31, 44, -56, 60), "road", 0, 0.06);                                               // street on the east side
      K.pad(rect(-40, 44, 102, 110), "road", 0, 0.06);                                             // street south of the square
      K.pad(rect(33, 44, 60, 104), "green", 0, 0.2);                                               // garden east of the square (palms)
      // the square: white marble with fine paving bands
      K.pad(rect(-22.5, 31, ZF, 97.5), marble, 0, 0.16);
      K.pad(rect(-29, -22.5, 60, 101.5), "green", 0, 0.2); K.pad(rect(-22.5, 31, 97.5, 101.5), "green", 0, 0.2);   // planted strips on the west and south edges (imagery)
      const sl = []; for (let z = ZF + 3; z < 97; z += 3.2) sl.push([4.25, 0.16, z]);
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(53.3, 0.03, 0.9), stripe, sl);
      K.box(60.6, 0.5, 0.5, pale, 1, 0.16, 101.75); K.box(0.5, 0.5, 42, pale, -29.2, 0.16, 81); K.box(0.5, 0.5, 38, pale, 31.2, 0.16, 83);   // low kerb walls
      let fp = along([-29, 101.75], [31, 101.75], 20, 0.66).concat(along([-29.2, 60], [-29.2, 101.5], 14, 0.66)).concat(along([31.2, 64], [31.2, 101.5], 13, 0.66));
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(2.6, 1.1, 0.1), rail, fp);

      /* ---------- the mosque body ---------- */
      K.extrude(body, H, stone);
      K.extrude(grow(body, -0.9), 0.16, roofM, H - 0.5);
      K.extrude(body, 0.9, stone2, 0);                                                              // plinth
      K.extrude(grow(body, 0.25), 0.45, pale, H - 1.6);   // cornice
      K.extrude(grow(body, 0.15), 0.3, pale, 7.4);         // string course

      // facades: two storeys of Gothic pointed windows between pilasters
      const faces = [
        [[X0, ZF], [22, ZF], 9, 0],            // square front (hall part)
        [[X0, Z0], [X0, ZF], 18, 1],           // west side (Khan al-Khalili)
        [[X1, 6], [X1, Z0], 10, 2],            // east side
        [[X1, Z0], [X0, Z0], 8, 3],            // north end
        [[22, 39], [22, 6], 6, 4]              // shrine wing, east
      ];
      let w1 = [], w2 = [], pil = [], doors = [], cres = [];
      faces.forEach(f => {
        const n = f[2], isDoor = i => (f[3] === 0 && (i === 1 || i === 4 || i === 7)) || (f[3] === 1 && (i === 4 || i === 9 || i === 14)) || (f[3] === 3 && i === 4);
        along(f[0], f[1], n, 0).forEach((p, i) => {
          if (isDoor(i)) doors.push([p[0], 0.2, p[2], p[3]]); else w1.push([p[0], 2.4, p[2], p[3]]);
          w2.push([p[0], 8.6, p[2], p[3]]);
        });
        const dx = (f[1][0] - f[0][0]) / n, dz = (f[1][1] - f[0][1]) / n, ry = Math.atan2(-dz, dx);
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) pil.push([f[0][0] + dx * i, 0, f[0][1] + dz * i, ry]);
        const L = Math.hypot(f[1][0] - f[0][0], f[1][1] - f[0][1]); cres = cres.concat(along(f[0], f[1], Math.round(L / 1.5), H));
      });
      cres = cres.concat(along([22, ZF], [28, ZF], 4, H)).concat(along([28, ZF], [28, 39], 8, H));
      K.inst(archGeo(2.2, 4.2, 0.5), pale, w1); K.inst(archGeo(1.6, 3.7, 0.8), darkM, w1);
      const tw = []; w2.forEach(p => { const c = Math.cos(p[3]), s = Math.sin(p[3]); [-0.85, 0.85].forEach(o => tw.push([p[0] + c * o, p[1], p[2] - s * o, p[3]])); });
      K.inst(archGeo(3.6, 5.0, 0.5), pale, w2); K.inst(archGeo(1.1, 3.6, 0.8, 0.7), darkM, tw);                         // paired lancets under one arch
      K.inst(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.42, 0.42, 0.8, 10).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), darkM, w2.map(p => [p[0], p[1] + 3.75, p[2], p[3]]));

      K.inst(archGeo(4.4, 6.6, 0.7), marble, doors); K.inst(archGeo(3.2, 5.6, 1.0), darkM, doors); K.inst(archGeo(2.4, 4.2, 1.2), woodM, doors);
      K.inst(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.42, 1.1, 4).rotateY(Math.PI / 4).translate(0, 0.55, 0), pale, cres);             // cresting along the parapet

      /* ---------- roof: lanterns, red-tiled hipped roofs, shrine dome ---------- */
      [[-5.7, -33.7, 12.5, 12], [-6.3, -19.2, 13.5, 8], [-7.5, -6.0, 13, 11.5]].forEach(l => {                               // flat clerestory lanterns (north half)
        K.box(l[2], 2.2, l[3], stone, l[0], H - 0.4, l[1]); K.box(l[2] + 0.6, 0.25, l[3] + 0.6, pale, l[0], H + 1.8, l[1]);
        K.inst(K.boxGeo(1.1, 1.0, l[3] + 0.2), darkM, [-0.33, 0, 0.33].map(o => [l[0] + o * l[2], H + 0.5, l[1]]));
        K.inst(K.boxGeo(l[2] + 0.2, 1.0, 1.1), darkM, [-0.3, 0.3].map(o => [l[0], H + 0.5, l[1] + o * l[3]]));
      });
      [[-4.8, 10.5, 8, 12.5], [-9, 26.5, 11.5, 14], [-7, 43.2, 7, 11], [14.5, 13, 10, 10.5]].forEach(r => {   // hipped tiled roofs (south half)
        K.box(r[2] - 0.8, 1.6, r[3] - 0.8, stone, r[0], H - 0.4, r[1]); K.mesh(hip(r[2], r[3], 2.6), tile, r[0], H + 1.2, r[1]);
        K.inst(K.boxGeo(r[2] - 0.6, 0.6, 0.9), darkM, [-0.25, 0.25].map(o => [r[0], H + 0.35, r[1] + o * r[3]]));
      });
      const vents = [[-17, -31], [10, -38.5], [-18.5, -3], [2, -10.5], [-14, 9.5], [1.5, 4], [-3, 17.5], [-18.5, 25.5], [-1.5, 34], [-16.5, 43]];   // gridded skylights seen on imagery
      K.inst(K.boxGeo(2.6, 1.0, 2.6), stone2, vents.map(v => [v[0], H - 0.4, v[1]]));
      // dome of the shrine (steel dome of 1996) on an octagonal drum
      K.group(() => {

        const n8 = []; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const a = Math.PI / 8 + i * Math.PI / 4; n8.push([Math.sin(a) * 5.55, H + 2.2, Math.cos(a) * 5.55, a]); }
        K.inst(archGeo(1.3, 1.8, 0.5), darkM, n8);
        K.cyl(5.75, 5.95, 0.35, pale, 0, H + 4.4, 0, 24); K.dome(5.5, domeM, 0, H + 4.75, 0, 1.02, 32);

  build(K) {

    const rail = K.mat(0x2e3a34, { roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.3 }), domeM = K.mat(0xcfa79a, { roughness: 0.55 }), domeS = K.mat(0xc3c8ca, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.15 }), drumM = K.mat(0xd3d5d3, { roughness: 0.6 }), signM = K.mat(0x1f5a3c, { roughness: 0.5 }), recM = K.mat(0x7d6648), ctx = K.mat(0xbdb3a0), ctxR = K.mat(0xa59c8a), greenM = K.mat(0x2f6b4a), road = K.mat(0x4a5258), lane = K.mat(0xb3a892);

    const archGeo = (w, h, d, sp) => {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); sp = h * (sp || 0.6); s.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, sp);
      s.quadraticCurveTo(w / 2, sp + (h - sp) * 0.7, 0, h); s.quadraticCurveTo(-w / 2, sp + (h - sp) * 0.7, -w / 2, sp); s.lineTo(-w / 2, 0);
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: d, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 6 }); g.translate(0, 0, -d / 2); return g;
    };
    // trefoil (three-lobed) portal hood, the signature of Mamluk-revival portals
    const trefoilGeo = (w, h, d) => {
      const s = new THREE.Shape(), a = w / 2, sp = h * 0.62; s.moveTo(-a, 0); s.lineTo(a, 0); s.lineTo(a, sp);
      s.absarc(a * 0.62, sp, a * 0.38, 0, Math.PI * 0.62, false); s.absarc(0, sp + a * 0.5, a * 0.42, -0.2, Math.PI + 0.2, false); s.absarc(-a * 0.62, sp, a * 0.38, Math.PI * 0.38, Math.PI, false);

    };

      return L;
    };

      });

  build(K) {
    /* ---------- shared helpers (self-contained copy) ---------- */
    const H = {};
    // flat ribbon(s) of width w following polylines [[x,z],...] at height y (one merged mesh, round joints)
    H.ribbon = (lines, w, y, m) => {
      const pos = [], hw = w / 2;
      const tri = (a, b, c) => { const n = (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - a[0]) - (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - a[1]); const q = n >= 0 ? [a, b, c] : [a, c, b]; q.forEach(p => pos.push(p[0], y, p[1])); };
      lines.forEach(l => {
        for (let i = 0; i < l.length - 1; i++) {
          const a = l[i], b = l[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (L < 0.01) continue;
          const nx = -dz / L * hw, nz = dx / L * hw;
          const p1 = [a[0] + nx, a[1] + nz], p2 = [a[0] - nx, a[1] - nz], p3 = [b[0] - nx, b[1] - nz], p4 = [b[0] + nx, b[1] + nz];
          tri(p1, p2, p3); tri(p1, p3, p4);
        }
        if (w > 4) for (let i = 1; i < l.length - 1; i++) { const c = l[i]; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const a0 = k * Math.PI / 4, a1 = (k + 1) * Math.PI / 4; tri(c, [c[0] + Math.cos(a0) * hw, c[1] + Math.sin(a0) * hw], [c[0] + Math.cos(a1) * hw, c[1] + Math.sin(a1) * hw]); } }
      });
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
      const nrm = new Float32Array(pos.length); for (let i = 1; i < nrm.length; i += 3) nrm[i] = 1; g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
      const me = K.mesh(g, m); me.castShadow = false; return me;
    };
    // outward polygon offset (miter, clamped)
    H.off = (pts, d) => {
      let A = 0; const n = pts.length; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n; A += pts[i][0] * pts[j][1] - pts[j][0] * pts[i][1]; }
      const s = A > 0 ? 1 : -1;
      return pts.map((p, i) => {
        const a = pts[(i + n - 1) % n], b = pts[(i + 1) % n];
        let e1 = [p[0] - a[0], p[1] - a[1]], e2 = [b[0] - p[0], b[1] - p[1]]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1[0], e1[1]) || 1, l2 = Math.hypot(e2[0], e2[1]) || 1;
        const n1 = [e1[1] / l1 * s, -e1[0] / l1 * s], n2 = [e2[1] / l2 * s, -e2[0] / l2 * s];
        let mx = n1[0] + n2[0], mz = n1[1] + n2[1]; const ml = Math.hypot(mx, mz) || 1; mx /= ml; mz /= ml;
        const k = Math.min(2, 1 / Math.max(0.3, mx * n1[0] + mz * n1[1]));
        return [p[0] + mx * d * k, p[1] + mz * d * k];
      });
    };
    H.merge = geos => {
      const pos = [], nor = []; geos.forEach(g0 => { const g = g0.index ? g0.toNonIndexed() : g0; g.computeVertexNormals(); pos.push(...g.attributes.position.array); nor.push(...g.attributes.normal.array); });
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); return g;
    };
    // many extruded footprints in one mesh: list of [pts, height, y0]
    H.masses = (list, m) => K.mesh(H.merge(list.map(q => { const sh = new THREE.Shape(); q[0].forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: q[1], bevelEnabled: false }).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2).translate(0, q[2] || 0, 0); })), m);
    // airliners: list of [x, z, heading(ry, nose along local +x), scale]  (scale 1 ≈ 38 m narrow-body, 1.7 ≈ 65 m wide-body)
    H.planes = (list, y) => {
      y = y || 0;
      const fus = new THREE.LatheGeometry([[0.05, -19], [0.9, -17.2], [1.6, -13], [1.95, -8], [1.95, 13], [1.65, 16.2], [0.95, 18.2], [0.05, 19]].map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])), 12).rotateZ(-Math.PI / 2).translate(0, 3.7, 0);
      const sh = a => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); a.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], p[1]))); return s; };
      const wing = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry([sh([[4.5, 0], [-5, 17], [-7.4, 17], [-3.2, 0], [-7.4, -17], [-5, -17]]), sh([[-14.6, 0], [-17.8, 6.2], [-19.2, 6.2], [-18, 0], [-19.2, -6.2], [-17.8, -6.2]])], { depth: 0.45, bevelEnabled: false }).rotateX(Math.PI / 2).translate(0, 3.3, 0);
      const eng = z => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.05, 0.95, 4.2, 10).rotateZ(Math.PI / 2).translate(0.2, 1.9, z);
      const fin = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh([[-13.8, 0], [-18.4, 7.2], [-19.9, 7.2], [-18.4, 0]]), { depth: 0.4, bevelEnabled: false }).translate(0, 5.2, -0.2);
      const L = list.map(p => [p[0], y, p[1], p[2], p[3] || 1]);
      K.inst(fus, K.mat(0xf4f4f0, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.15 }), L);
      K.inst(H.merge([wing, eng(5.9), eng(-5.9)]), "metal", L);
      K.inst(fin, K.mat(0x17407a, { roughness: 0.5 }), L);
    };
    // Cairo ATC tower (110 m, mapped height) on its real spot
    H.tower = (x, z, s) => K.group(g => {
      K.cyl(4.6, 6, 88, "concrete", 0, 0, 0, 20); K.cyl(4.9, 4.9, 2, "white", 0, 44, 0, 20);
      K.lathe([[4.6, 0], [6.5, 3], [10.5, 8], [10.5, 10]], "white", 0, 88, 0, 24); K.cyl(10.5, 10.5, 1, "white", 0, 97.5, 0, 24);
      K.cyl(10.2, 9, 5, "glassDark", 0, 98.5, 0, 16); K.cyl(10.8, 10.8, 1, "white", 0, 103.5, 0, 24); K.cyl(3, 3.6, 3, "concrete", 0, 104.5, 0, 12); K.cyl(0.35, 0.35, 6, "steel", 0, 107.5, 0, 6);
      if (s) g.scale.setScalar(s);
    }, x, 0, z);
    // runway between two ground points a,b ([x,z]); o = {y, hi (accent lighting), ta/tb (real thresholds present), k (marking exaggeration)}
    H.runway = (a, b, o) => {
      const L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), th = Math.atan2(-(b[1] - a[1]), b[0] - a[0]), y = o.y, s = o.st || 0.3, k = o.k || 1;
      return K.group(() => {
        K.plate(L, 75, K.mat(0x59636a), 0, 0, 0, 0, y);                                   // shoulders
        K.plate(L, 60, K.mat(o.hi ? 0x2a3238 : 0x3d474e), 0, 0, 0, 0, y + s);             // asphalt (resurfaced one is darker)
        const W = K.mat(0xf3f1ea, { roughness: 0.6 }), ym = y + s, t = s;
        const mk = [];                                                                    // [x, z, len, wid]
        for (let x = -L / 2 + 480; x < L / 2 - 480; x += 60) mk.push([x, 0, 36, 1.6 * k]);  // centre line
        mk.push([0, -28, L - 4, 1.2 * k], [0, 28, L - 4, 1.2 * k]);                       // side stripes
        [[-1, o.ta], [1, o.tb]].forEach(e => {
          if (!e[1]) return; const sg = e[0], x0 = sg * L / 2;
          for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) mk.push([x0 - sg * 30, -25.3 + i * 4.6, 36, 2.2]);  // threshold piano keys
          mk.push([x0 - sg * 420, -11, 55, 8], [x0 - sg * 420, 11, 55, 8]);               // aiming point
          [[150, 3], [300, 3], [600, 2], [750, 2], [900, 1]].forEach(q => { const wd = q[1] * 2.4; mk.push([x0 - sg * q[0], -9 - wd / 2, 24, wd], [x0 - sg * q[0], 9 + wd / 2, 24, wd]); });
        });
        K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, t, 1), W, mk.map(q => [q[0], ym, q[1], 0, q[2], 1, q[3]]));
        if (o.hi) {
          const A = K.mat(0xffae57, { emissive: 0xff9a2e, emissiveIntensity: 1.1, roughness: 0.4 }), T = K.mat(0x46d7cf, { emissive: 0x2fd0c6, emissiveIntensity: 1.0, roughness: 0.4 });
          const li = [], e = 3.2 * k;
          for (let x = -L / 2; x <= L / 2 + 1; x += 60) li.push([x, ym, -32.5, 0, e, e * 0.6, e], [x, ym, 32.5, 0, e, e * 0.6, e]);      // edge lights
          K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), A, li);
          K.plate(L, 2 * k, A, 0, -37 - k, 0, 0, y + s * 0.6); K.plate(L, 2 * k, A, 0, 37 + k, 0, 0, y + s * 0.6);                       // accent edge bands
          if (o.glow) { const gm = K.mat(0xffae57, { transparent: true, opacity: 0.5, emissive: 0xff9a2e, emissiveIntensity: 0.7, depthWrite: false }); const gp = K.plate(L + o.glow, 75 + o.glow, gm, 0, 0, 0, 0, y * 0.45); gp.castShadow = false; gp.receiveShadow = false; }
          const ap = [];
          [[-1, o.ta], [1, o.tb]].forEach(q => {
            if (!q[1]) return; const sg = q[0], x0 = sg * L / 2;
            for (let i = 0; i < 13; i++) ap.push([x0 + sg * 2, ym, -27 + i * 4.5, 0, e * 0.7, e * 0.6, e * 0.7]);                      // threshold bar
            for (let d = 30; d <= (o.al || 900); d += 30) ap.push([x0 + sg * d, y, 0, 0, e * 0.8, e, e * 2.2]);                                  // approach centreline barrettes
            for (let i = -4; i <= 4; i++) if (i) ap.push([x0 + sg * 300, y, i * 5.5, 0, e * 0.8, e, e]);                               // 300 m crossbar
          });
          if (ap.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), T, ap);
        }
      }, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, 0, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, th);
    };

    H.ribbon = (lines, w, y, m) => {
      const pos = [], hw = w / 2;
      const tri = (a, b, c) => { const n = (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - a[0]) - (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - a[1]); const q = n >= 0 ? [a, b, c] : [a, c, b]; q.forEach(p => pos.push(p[0], y, p[1])); };
      lines.forEach(l => {
        for (let i = 0; i < l.length - 1; i++) {
          const a = l[i], b = l[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (L < 0.01) continue;
          const nx = -dz / L * hw, nz = dx / L * hw;
          const p1 = [a[0] + nx, a[1] + nz], p2 = [a[0] - nx, a[1] - nz], p3 = [b[0] - nx, b[1] - nz], p4 = [b[0] + nx, b[1] + nz];
          tri(p1, p2, p3); tri(p1, p3, p4);
        }
        if (w > 4) for (let i = 1; i < l.length - 1; i++) { const c = l[i]; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const a0 = k * Math.PI / 4, a1 = (k + 1) * Math.PI / 4; tri(c, [c[0] + Math.cos(a0) * hw, c[1] + Math.sin(a0) * hw], [c[0] + Math.cos(a1) * hw, c[1] + Math.sin(a1) * hw]); } }
      });
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
      const nrm = new Float32Array(pos.length); for (let i = 1; i < nrm.length; i += 3) nrm[i] = 1; g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
      const me = K.mesh(g, m); me.castShadow = false; return me;
    };
    H.merge = geos => {
      const pos = [], nor = []; geos.forEach(g0 => { const g = g0.index ? g0.toNonIndexed() : g0; g.computeVertexNormals(); pos.push(...g.attributes.position.array); nor.push(...g.attributes.normal.array); });
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); return g;
    };
    // many extruded footprints in one mesh: list of [pts, height, y0]
    H.masses = (list, m) => K.mesh(H.merge(list.map(q => { const sh = new THREE.Shape(); q[0].forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: q[1], bevelEnabled: false }).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2).translate(0, q[2] || 0, 0); })), m);
    // many boxes in one mesh: list of [cx, cz, w(x), d(z), h, y0]
    H.boxes = (list, m) => K.mesh(H.merge(list.map(q => new THREE.BoxGeometry(q[2], q[4], q[3]).translate(q[0], (q[5] || 0) + q[4] / 2, q[1]))), m);
    // airliners: list of [x, z, heading(ry, nose along local +x), scale]  (scale 1 ≈ 38 m narrow-body)
    H.planes = (list, y) => {
      y = y || 0;
      const fus = new THREE.LatheGeometry([[0.05, -19], [0.9, -17.2], [1.6, -13], [1.95, -8], [1.95, 13], [1.65, 16.2], [0.95, 18.2], [0.05, 19]].map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])), 12).rotateZ(-Math.PI / 2).translate(0, 3.7, 0);
      const sh = a => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); a.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], p[1]))); return s; };
      const wing = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry([sh([[4.5, 0], [-5, 17], [-7.4, 17], [-3.2, 0], [-7.4, -17], [-5, -17]]), sh([[-14.6, 0], [-17.8, 6.2], [-19.2, 6.2], [-18, 0], [-19.2, -6.2], [-17.8, -6.2]])], { depth: 0.45, bevelEnabled: false }).rotateX(Math.PI / 2).translate(0, 3.3, 0);
      const eng = z => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.05, 0.95, 4.2, 10).rotateZ(Math.PI / 2).translate(0.2, 1.9, z);
      const fin = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh([[-13.8, 0], [-18.4, 7.2], [-19.9, 7.2], [-18.4, 0]]), { depth: 0.4, bevelEnabled: false }).translate(0, 5.2, -0.2);
      const L = list.map(p => [p[0], y, p[1], p[2], p[3] || 1]);
      K.inst(fus, K.mat(0xf4f4f0, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.15 }), L);
      K.inst(H.merge([wing, eng(5.9), eng(-5.9)]), "metal", L);
      K.inst(fin, K.mat(0x17407a, { roughness: 0.5 }), L);
    };
    // air-traffic control tower of total height h (shaft + flared cab)
    H.tower = (x, z, h, r) => K.group(() => {
      r = r || 3; const hs = h - 9;
      K.cyl(r, r * 1.15, hs, "concrete", 0, 0, 0, 16);
      K.lathe([[r, 0], [r * 1.5, 1.6], [r * 2.2, 3.2], [r * 2.2, 3.8]], "white", 0, hs, 0, 16);
      K.cyl(r * 2.3, r * 2.0, 3.4, K.mat(0x245a6b, { roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.5 }), 0, hs + 3.8, 0, 8);
      K.cyl(r * 2.5, r * 2.5, 0.7, "white", 0, hs + 7.2, 0, 8); K.cyl(0.25, 0.25, 4, "steel", 0, hs + 7.9, 0, 6);
    }, x, 0, z);
    // runway in the runway-aligned group (x = distance along the runway, z = -offset): from x0 to x1 on line z, paved width W.
    // o = {y: asphalt top, k: marking exaggeration, col: asphalt colour, sh: shoulder width each side, ta/tb: threshold markings at x0/x1}
    H.runway = (x0, x1, z, W, o) => {
      const L = x1 - x0, cx = (x0 + x1) / 2, y = o.y, k = o.k || 1, sh = o.sh === undefined ? 7.5 : o.sh;
      if (sh) K.box(L + 60, y - 0.4, W + sh * 2, K.mat(0x767f83), cx, 0, z).castShadow = false;
      K.box(L, y, W, K.mat(o.col || 0x353d43), cx, 0, z).castShadow = false;
      const mk = [];                                                                    // [x, z, len, wid]
      for (let x = -L / 2 + 330; x < L / 2 - 330; x += 60) mk.push([x, 0, 30, 0.9 * k]);  // centre line
      mk.push([0, -(W / 2 - 1.5 * k), L - 4, 0.9 * k], [0, W / 2 - 1.5 * k, L - 4, 0.9 * k]);   // side stripes
      [[-1, o.ta], [1, o.tb]].forEach(e => {
        if (!e[1]) return; const sg = e[0], xe = sg * L / 2, n = 12, pw = (W - 9) / (n * 2 - 1);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) mk.push([xe - sg * 24, -(W - 9) / 2 + pw / 2 + i * pw * 2 + (i >= n / 2 ? 0 : 0), 30, pw]);   // threshold bars
        mk.push([xe - sg * 420, -W * 0.19, 50, W * 0.13], [xe - sg * 420, W * 0.19, 50, W * 0.13]);                               // aiming point
        [[170, 3], [300, 2], [570, 2], [720, 1]].forEach(q => { const wd = q[1] * 1.9 * Math.min(k, 1.6); mk.push([xe - sg * q[0], -W * 0.2, 22, wd], [xe - sg * q[0], W * 0.2, 22, wd]); });
      });
      const im = K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 0.35, 1), K.mat(0xf3f1ea, { roughness: 0.6 }), mk.map(q => [cx + q[0], y, z + q[1], 0, q[2], 1, q[3]])); im.castShadow = false;
    };

      function bridge(S, hf, wf, skipL, skipR, main) {

    const merl = [];
    const rot = (x, z, a) => [x * Math.cos(a) - z * Math.sin(a), x * Math.sin(a) + z * Math.cos(a)];
    const sarea = p => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { const q = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; a += p[i][0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[i][1]; } return a / 2; };
    const orient = (p, pos) => ((sarea(p) > 0) === !!pos ? p : p.slice().reverse());
    const inPoly = (pt, poly) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) { if ((poly[i][1] > pt[1]) !== (poly[j][1] > pt[1]) && pt[0] < (poly[j][0] - poly[i][0]) * (pt[1] - poly[i][1]) / (poly[j][1] - poly[i][1]) + poly[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
    const cen = p => p.reduce((a, q) => [a[0] + q[0] / p.length, a[1] + q[1] / p.length], [0, 0]);
    const merge = g => {
      g.updateMatrixWorld(true); const inv = new THREE.Matrix4().copy(g.matrixWorld).invert(), by = new Map(), rm = [];
      g.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh || o.isInstancedMesh) return; const geo = o.geometry.index ? o.geometry.toNonIndexed() : o.geometry.clone();
        geo.applyMatrix4(new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(inv, o.matrixWorld)); if (!by.has(o.material)) by.set(o.material, { p: [], n: [] });
        const e = by.get(o.material); e.p.push(geo.attributes.position.array); e.n.push(geo.attributes.normal.array); rm.push(o); });
      rm.forEach(o => o.parent.remove(o));
      by.forEach((e, m) => { const len = e.p.reduce((a, b) => a + b.length, 0), Pp = new Float32Array(len), N = new Float32Array(len); let off = 0;
        e.p.forEach((a, i) => { Pp.set(a, off); N.set(e.n[i], off); off += a.length; });
        const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(Pp, 3)); geo.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(N, 3));
        const me = new THREE.Mesh(geo, m); me.castShadow = true; me.receiveShadow = true; g.add(me); });
    };
    const wallLine = (pts, h, t, y0, m) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), ry = Math.atan2(-(b[1] - a[1]), b[0] - a[0]);
      K.box(len + t, h, t, m, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y0, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, ry); const n = Math.max(1, Math.round(len / 2.6));

      /* ---------- site plate (cut away on the map) ---------- */
      K.pad(D.H, sandM, -1.6, 1.6);

      /* ---------- OSM footprints: courtyards (same-height inner rings) become holes ---------- */
      const B = D.bld.map(b => ({ h0: b[0], p: b[1], a: Math.abs(sarea(b[1])), c: cen(b[1]) })).sort((a, b) => b.a - a.a);

      K.box(2.4, 12, 2.4, stoneM, 305, 0, -229); K.cyl(1.0, 1.25, 20, stoneM, 305, 12, -229, 12); K.cyl(1.9, 1.5, 0.8, stoneM, 305, 24, -229, 12); K.cyl(0.8, 0.95, 6, stoneM, 305, 26, -229, 12); K.cone(1.1, 7, leadD, 305, 32, -229, 12);

      /* ---------- walls (traced on imagery) ---------- */
      wallLine([[-291, -243], [-291, -107], [-278, -100], [-278, -60], [-281, 0], [-265, 61], [-265, 173]], 13, 2.4, 0, wallM);       // west wall above the city

    const g = _unit.clone().applyMatrix4(_bm); this.addGeo(g); g.dispose();
  };
  Batch.prototype.mesh = function (mat, y) {
    if (!this.pos.length) return null; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(this.pos), 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(this.nor), 3));
    const m = K.mesh(g, mat, 0, y || 0, 0); this.pos = []; this.nor = []; return m;
  };
  /* polygon extrusion geometry (x east, z south) with holes; winding normalised */
  function exGeo(outer, holes, h) {
    const sp = pts => pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], -p[1]));
    let o = sp(outer); if (THREE.ShapeUtils.isClockWise(o)) o.reverse();
    const s = new THREE.Shape(o);
    (holes || []).forEach(hp => { let q = sp(hp); if (!THREE.ShapeUtils.isClockWise(q)) q.reverse(); s.holes.push(new THREE.Path(q)); });
    const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 12 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); return g;
  }
  Batch.prototype.poly = function (outer, holes, h, y) { const g = exGeo(outer, holes, h); if (y) g.translate(0, y, 0); this.addGeo(g); g.dispose(); };
  /* flat ribbon (road / path) along a polyline at height y, width w */
  Batch.prototype.ribbon = function (pts, w, y) {
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
      const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (L < 0.01) continue;
      const nx = -dz / L * w / 2, nz = dx / L * w / 2;
      const q = [[a[0] + nx, a[1] + nz], [a[0] - nx, a[1] - nz], [b[0] - nx, b[1] - nz], [b[0] + nx, b[1] + nz]];
      [[0, 1, 2], [0, 2, 3]].forEach(t => {
        const A_ = q[t[0]], B_ = q[t[1]], C_ = q[t[2]], cr = (B_[0] - A_[0]) * (C_[1] - A_[1]) - (B_[1] - A_[1]) * (C_[0] - A_[0]);   // y-normal of (B-A)x(C-A) = -cr ... flip so it faces up
        (cr < 0 ? [A_, B_, C_] : [A_, C_, B_]).forEach(P_ => { this.pos.push(P_[0], y, P_[1]); this.nor.push(0, 1, 0); });
      });
    }
  };
  const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
  const bboxOf = pts => { const xs = pts.map(p => p[0]), zs = pts.map(p => p[1]); return [Math.min(...xs), Math.min(...zs), Math.max(...xs), Math.max(...zs)]; };
  let _seed = 12345; const rnd = () => ((_seed = (_seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647);
  /* façade rhythm along every ring edge: plinth, string courses, window bays, cornice.
     o = { fl: storeys, fh: storey height, ww, wh: window size, pitch, win: Batch, corn: Batch, minL } */
  function facade(ring, y0, h, o) {
    const n = ring.length, fl = o.fl, fh = o.fh || (h - 1.2) / fl;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const A = ring[i], B = ring[(i + 1) % n], dx = B[0] - A[0], dz = B[1] - A[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (L < (o.minL || 4) || (o.skip && o.skip(A, B))) continue;
      const ang = -Math.atan2(dz, dx), mx = (A[0] + B[0]) / 2, mz = (A[1] + B[1]) / 2;
      o.corn.box(mx, y0, mz, L, 1.1, 0.5, ang);                                  // plinth
      o.corn.box(mx, y0 + h - 0.9, mz, L, 0.9, 1.0, ang);                       // cornice
      for (let f = 1; f < fl; f++) o.corn.box(mx, y0 + f * fh + 0.3, mz, L, 0.28, 0.42, ang);   // string courses
      const nw = Math.max(1, Math.floor((L - 2) / o.pitch)), step = (L - 2) / nw;
      for (let k = 0; k < nw; k++) {
        const t = 1 + step * (k + 0.5) - L / 2, px = mx + Math.cos(-ang) * t, pz = mz + Math.sin(-ang) * t;
        for (let f = 0; f < fl; f++) o.win.box(px, y0 + f * fh + 1.0 + (f ? 0.35 : 0.2), pz, o.ww, o.wh, 0.6, ang);
      }
    }
  }
  /* clip polygon to the half-plane  nx*x + nz*z >= d  (Sutherland-Hodgman) */
  function clipHalf(pts, nx, nz, d) {
    const out = [], n = pts.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % n], da = nx * a[0] + nz * a[1] - d, db = nx * b[0] + nz * b[1] - d;
      if (da >= 0) out.push(a);
      if ((da >= 0) !== (db >= 0)) { const t = da / (da - db); out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]); }
    }
    return out;
  }

  const _bm = new THREE.Matrix4(), _bq = new THREE.Quaternion(), _bv = new THREE.Vector3(), _bs = new THREE.Vector3(), _be = new THREE.Euler();
  const _unit = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0);
  function Batch() { this.pos = []; this.nor = []; }
  Batch.prototype.addGeo = function (g) {

  /* oriented box: base centre (cx,y,cz), size sx(along edge) × sy(up) × sz(thickness), rotation ry about Y */

  function facade(ring, y0, h, o) {

    }
    return out;
  }

   Local frame: U = 12° south of east (the Great Temple faces +U, bearing ≈102°), V = 90° further round (towards south-west). The group is rotated by -12° so the
   frame is built directly in (U,V). Footprints: Great Temple facade terrace / Small Temple facade strip = OSM polygons; the interiors (hypostyle, sanctuary, 63 m deep)

  build(K) {
    const A = 12 * Math.PI / 180, ca = Math.cos(A), sa = Math.sin(A);
    const W2L = (x, z) => [x * ca + z * sa, -x * sa + z * ca];                    // OSM metres (x east, z south) -> local U,V
    const M = {
      sand: K.mat(0xd2bf94), hill: K.mat(0xc2ab7f, { flatShading: true }), cliff: K.mat(0xa88c60, { flatShading: true }),
      stone: K.mat(0xe6d09c, { flatShading: true }), rockF: K.mat(0xc7aa74, { flatShading: true }), stoneL: K.mat(0xeedcae, { flatShading: true }), stoneD: K.mat(0xbfa06a, { flatShading: true }),
      dark: K.mat(0x4a3a28), path: K.mat(0xe9dcc0), water: K.mat(0x1d5a73), shade: K.mat(0xf0ebe0)
    };
    const lists = new Map();
    const push = (m, g) => { if (!lists.has(m)) lists.set(m, []); lists.get(m).push(g); };
    // frame helper: fr = {x,z,th}; local x = outward (facing), z = lateral
    const mk = (cx, cz, th) => {
      const place = (g, x, y, z, ry) => { if (ry) g.rotateY(ry); g.translate(x, y, z); g.rotateY(th); g.translate(cx, 0, cz); };

        trap: (m, wB, wT, h, x0, x1, y) => { const sh = new THREE.Shape(); sh.moveTo(-wB / 2, 0); sh.lineTo(wB / 2, 0); sh.lineTo(wT / 2, h); sh.lineTo(-wT / 2, h);
          const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: x1 - x0, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateY(Math.PI / 2); place(g, x0, y || 0, 0, 0); push(m, g); }
      };
    };
    const px = (m, pts, h, y) => { const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y || 0, 0); push(m, g); };
    const merge = (geos) => { const gs = geos.map(g => (g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g)); let n = 0; gs.forEach(g => (n += g.attributes.position.count));
      const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), nor = new Float32Array(n * 3); let o = 0;
      gs.forEach(g => { pos.set(g.attributes.position.array, o * 3); nor.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o * 3); o += g.attributes.position.count; });
      const r = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); r.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); r.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); return r; };
    const flat = (arr) => { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(arr), 3)); g.computeVertexNormals(); return g; };
    const ribbon = (m, pts, w, y, bb) => { for (let i = 0; i + 1 < pts.length; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1]; if (bb && [a, b].some(p => p[0] < bb[0] || p[0] > bb[1] || p[1] < bb[2] || p[1] > bb[3])) continue; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);

      /* ---------- ground: land plate with the Lake Nasser cut-out, water plate lower ---------- */
      const shore = [[160, 28], [157, 31], [145, 44], [135, 48.6], [109, 44], [99, 39], [84, 38], [76.7, 40], [60, 57], [57, 68], [54, 76], [46, 84], [39, 98], [39, 114], [41, 135]];

      px(M.water, [...shore, [160, 135]], 0.2, -2.1);

      /* ---------- visitor paths (OSM transportation lines) + ring road ---------- */
      const wl = (a) => a.map(p => W2L(p[0], p[1]));
      const ring = [[-70.1, 144.4], [-83.3, 129.9], [-138.3, 105], [-147.3, 97.4], [-184.1, 43.6], [-186.9, 35.7], [-186.4, 27.3], [-119.4, -98.5], [-109.6, -108.5], [-97.7, -115.5], [-84.4, -119.5], [10.8, -120.7], [34.9, -126.9], [62.6, -145.7], [77.7, -151.7], [90.1, -151.5], [100.6, -147], [134.7, -122.3], [141.9, -107.1], [140.6, -91.6], [68.2, 19.1], [29.3, 85.7], [-13.5, 72.9]];

      ribbon(M.path, [[127.9, -29.4], [103.3, 19.5], [99.6, 23.1], [91.9, 24.7], [43.9, 13.7], [-8.5, 9.1], [-11.3, 14.2], [-15.3, 13.9]], 3.2, 0.1);

      ribbon(M.path, wl([[0.3, 42.2], [-14, 76.2]]), 2.4, 0.1);

      ribbon(M.path, [[-33, 70], [-33, 20], [-37, 8], [-42, -8], [-46, -22], [-44, -42], [-38, -56], [-30, -66], [-20, -73], [-8, -76], [6, -74], [18, -66], [28, -55], [42, -44]], 3.0, 0.1);

      /* ---------- the hill and cliff (heights estimated: ≈ 40 m over the Great Temple) ---------- */
      const cl = [[-47, 86, 40], [-44, 70, 40], [-39, 66, 40], [-36, 64, 42], [-36, 22, 42], [-39, 18, 40], [-45, 5, 40], [-50, -20, 40], [-48, -40, 38], [-43, -55, 38], [-35, -68, 36], [-25, -76, 36], [-15, -80, 35], [0, -80, 35],

      // top surface (earcut over the boundary; heights interpolate across)

        [a, b, c].forEach(i => top.push(P[i][0], P[i][2], P[i][1])); });

      const face = (q, idx, ox, oz) => { // q = 3D points; idx = triangle list; flip so that horizontal normal . (ox,oz) > 0 (or ny>0 when oz,ox undefined)
        for (let t = 0; t < idx.length; t += 3) { let [i, j, k] = [idx[t], idx[t + 1], idx[t + 2]]; const a = q[i], b = q[j], c = q[k];
          const e1 = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]], e2 = [c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2]];
          const nx = e1[1] * e2[2] - e1[2] * e2[1], ny = e1[2] * e2[0] - e1[0] * e2[2], nz = e1[0] * e2[1] - e1[1] * e2[0];
          const d = nx * ox + nz * oz + ny * 0.0001; if (Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz) < 1e-6) continue; if (d < 0) { const tmp = j; j = k; k = tmp; }
          [i, j, k].forEach(m => wall.push(q[m][0], q[m][1], q[m][2])); } };

        face([[a[0], 0, a[1]], [b[0], 0, b[1]], [b[0], b[2], b[1]], [a[0], a[2], a[1]]], [0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3], ox, oz); }

        face([[fa[0], fa[1], fa[2]], [fb[0], fb[1], fb[2]], [b[0], b[2], b[1]], [a[0], a[2], a[1]]], [0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3], ox, oz); }

        const tn = [-(f[2] - p[1]), (f[0] - p[0])]; const sd = tn[0] * (p[0] - C0[0]) + tn[1] * (p[1] - C0[1]) > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        face([[p[0], 0, p[1]], [p[0], p[2], p[1]], [f[0], 0.3, f[2]]], [0, 1, 2], sd * tn[0], sd * tn[1]); });
      push(M.cliff, flat(wall));

      /* ---------- GREAT TEMPLE: facade cut into the cliff at U ≈ -34, centre V = 43 ---------- */
      const F = mk(-34, 43, 0), S = M.stone;
      px(M.stoneL, [[-34, 25.6], [-15.7, 25.7], [-16.3, 41], [-30.4, 41.2], [-30.8, 44.7], [-16.2, 44.3], [-16.8, 60.2], [-34, 60.2]], 0.6, 0);        // OSM terrace outline

      F.trap(M.rockF, 38, 33.4, 31.2, -4, 0, 0.6);                                                                  // battered rock facade
      F.bx(M.stoneL, 3.4, 2.4, 35.2, -0.6, 31.8, 0);                                                           // cavetto cornice
      F.bx(M.stoneL, 0.9, 0.5, 34.0, 0.4, 31.2, 0);

      F.bx(M.dark, 0.5, 3.6, 2.6, 0.1, 25.5, 0); F.bx(M.stoneL, 0.9, 2.3, 1.2, 0.35, 26.0, 0);                  // niche + Ra-Horakhty figure
      [-18.3, 18.3].forEach(z => F.bx(M.stoneD, 0.5, 29, 0.7, 0.05, 1, z));                                      // vertical cartouche bands
      const colossus = (zc, dmg) => { const X = 0.5, m = S, y0 = 0.6;
        F.bx(m, 6.8, 1.0, 7.0, X + 3.4, y0, zc);                                   // plinth
        F.bx(m, 1.5, 13.4, 6.6, X + 0.75, y0 + 1, zc);                              // throne back
        F.bx(m, 5.0, 4.0, 6.4, X + 2.6, y0 + 1, zc);                                // seat block
        [-1.75, 1.75].forEach(dz => { F.bx(m, 1.9, 7.3, 2.2, X + 5.1, y0 + 1, zc + dz); F.bx(m, 5.6, 2.2, 2.3, X + 3.3, y0 + 5.9, zc + dz);
          if (!dmg) F.bx(m, 3.1, 1.2, 1.4, X + 4.2, y0 + 8.1, zc + dz * 1.35); });

        /* ---- merge helper: collect many boxes/prisms per material into one mesh ---- */
    const MG = {}; const _m4 = new THREE.Matrix4(), _q = new THREE.Quaternion(), _e = new THREE.Euler(), _v = new THREE.Vector3(), _s = new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1);
    function mg(key, geo, x, y, z, ry, sx, sy, sz) {
      _e.set(0, ry || 0, 0); _q.setFromEuler(_e); _v.set(x || 0, y || 0, z || 0); _s.set(sx || 1, sy || 1, sz || 1); _m4.compose(_v, _q, _s);

    function mbox(key, w, h, d, x, y, z, ry) { mg(key, new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d).translate(0, h / 2, 0), x, y, z, ry); }

    }

      const gg = g.toNonIndexed(); gg.applyMatrix4(m); (MG[key] = MG[key] || []).push(gg);
    }
    function mroad(key, pts, w, y) { // polyline ribbon of width w, flat at y
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (L < 0.3) continue;

    }
    function flush(K, mats) {
      Object.keys(MG).forEach(k => { const list = MG[k]; let n = 0; list.forEach(g => n += g.attributes.position.count);
        const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), nor = new Float32Array(n * 3); let o = 0;
        list.forEach(g => { pos.set(g.attributes.position.array, o * 3); nor.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o * 3); o += g.attributes.position.count; });
        const G = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); G.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); G.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
        K.mesh(G, mats[k] || k, 0, 0, 0); });
    }
    function mgable(key, w, h, len, x, y, z, ry) { // gable roof, ridge along local z, base width w, rise h
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); s.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(0, h); s.closePath();
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: len, bevelEnabled: false }); g.translate(0, 0, -len / 2); mg(key, g, x, y, z, ry);
    }

    }

        /* ---- merge helper: collect many boxes/prisms per material into one mesh ---- */
    const MG = {}; const _m4 = new THREE.Matrix4(), _q = new THREE.Quaternion(), _e = new THREE.Euler(), _v = new THREE.Vector3(), _s = new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1);
    function mg(key, geo, x, y, z, ry, sx, sy, sz) {
      _e.set(0, ry || 0, 0); _q.setFromEuler(_e); _v.set(x || 0, y || 0, z || 0); _s.set(sx || 1, sy || 1, sz || 1); _m4.compose(_v, _q, _s);

    }
    function mroad(key, pts, w, y) { // polyline ribbon of width w, flat at y
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (L < 0.3) continue;

    }
    function flush(K, mats) {

    }
    function mgable(key, w, h, len, x, y, z, ry) { // gable roof, ridge along local z, base width w, rise h

    }

    }

    /* ---------- shared helpers (inline, no external deps) ---------- */
    const M = K.mat;
    const polyArea = p => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % p.length; a += p[i][0] * p[j][1] - p[j][0] * p[i][1]; } return a / 2; };
    const inPoly = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
    /* extruded footprint -> BufferGeometry (not added to the scene) */
    const extG = (pts, h, y, holes) => {
      if (polyArea(pts) > 0) pts = pts.slice().reverse();   /* outline CCW in shape space (x,-z) so holes are wound opposite */
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      (holes || []).forEach(hp => { const hh = new THREE.Path(); hp.forEach((p, i) => (i ? hh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : hh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); s.holes.push(hh); });

    };

    const mergeC = list => {

    };

      const wells = [[-31, -13, 7, 20, 0.35], [-24, -17, 6, 17, 0.35], [-9, -4, 10, 15, 0.3], [26, 10, 12, 9, 0.2], [47, 17, 17, 9, 0.2]];

    const wallStrips = (pts, y0, y1, step, bh, minEdge, off, out, bay, gap) => {
      const n = pts.length; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % n]; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (L < (minEdge || 8)) continue;
        let nx = dz / L, nz = -dx / L; if (inPoly(pts, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2 + nx * 0.6, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + nz * 0.6)) { nx = -nx; nz = -nz; }
        const ux = dx / L, uz = dz / L, e = Math.min(1.4, L * 0.08); const bw = bay || (L - 2 * e), pitch = bw + (gap || 0); const nb = bay ? Math.max(1, Math.floor((L - 2 * e + (gap || 0)) / pitch)) : 1;
        const used = nb * pitch - (gap || 0), s0 = e + (L - 2 * e - used) / 2;

          const ax = a[0] + ux * t0 + nx * off, az = a[1] + uz * t0 + nz * off, bx = a[0] + ux * t1 + nx * off, bz = a[1] + uz * t1 + nz * off;
          for (let y = y0; y + bh <= y1 + 0.01; y += step) {
            const P = [[ax, y, az], [bx, y, bz], [bx, y + bh, bz], [ax, y + bh, az]]; [0, 2, 1, 0, 3, 2].forEach(q => out.pos.push(P[q][0], P[q][1], P[q][2]));
            for (let q = 0; q < 6; q++) out.nor.push(nx, 0, nz); } } }
    };
    const stripGeo = out => { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(out.pos, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(out.nor, 3)); return g; };
    const hash = (a, b) => { let h = Math.floor(a * 73856093) ^ Math.floor(b * 19349663); h = (h ^ (h >>> 13)) * 1274126177; return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967295; };
    const centroid = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

    K.group(() => {
      /* ---------- Nile, land plate, streets ---------- */
      const bk = D.bank, X0 = -215, X1 = 125, Z0 = -276, Z1 = 150;
      K.plate(X1 - X0, Z1 - Z0, M(0x2c7b99, { roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.15 }), (X0 + X1) / 2, (Z0 + Z1) / 2, -1.5, 0, 1.2);
      const land = D.land; K.mesh(extG(land, 1.8, -1.8), M(0xb9ae97));

      D.lawns.forEach(r => lawnG.push({ g: extG(r.o, 0.28, 0, r.h), c: 0xffffff }));
      K.mesh(mergeC(roadG), M(0x4f585e, { roughness: 0.95 })); K.mesh(mergeC(lawnG), M(0x7d9a63, { roughness: 1 }));
      const trT = [], trC = [];
      D.trees.forEach(t => { const s = Math.max(2.4, t[2] * 1.15), hh = 5.5 + s * 0.8; trT.push([t[0], 0, t[1], 0, 1, hh * 0.45, 1]); trC.push([t[0], hh * 0.42, t[1], 0, s, s * 0.85, s]); });
      K.inst(K.cylGeo(0.3, 0.4, 1, 6), "trunk", trT); K.inst(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 8, 6).translate(0, 1, 0), M(0x5f8a52), trC);

      /* ---------- context blocks (OSM footprints; heights from OSM tags where present, else estimated) ---------- */
      const pal = [0xd2c6ae, 0xc9bda5, 0xd9cdb6, 0xc2b79f, 0xcdbfa3], cl = [], st = { pos: [], nor: [] };
      D.ctx.forEach(b => {
        let hh = b.h > 5 ? b.h : (b.a > 4000 ? 36 : b.a > 900 ? 24 : 18); if (b.a === 4257) hh = 36;
        const c = pal[Math.floor(hash(b.p[0][1], b.p[0][0]) * 5)];
        cl.push({ g: extG(b.p, hh - 0.6, 0.0), c }); cl.push({ g: extG(b.p, 0.6, hh - 0.6), c: 0xa89d89 });
        if (hh > 12) wallStrips(b.p, 4.4, hh - 2.2, 3.3, 1.6, 9, 0.12, st, 2.2, 1.3);
      });
      K.mesh(mergeC(cl), VC()); K.mesh(stripGeo(st), M(0x6c7a82, { roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.2 }));

      /* ---------- Maspero building ---------- */
      const [dcx, dcz, dr] = D.drum, DH = 40, CH = 36, WH = 55, TH = 100;
      const body = 0xcfc6b2, grey = 0xbdb4a2, roofC = 0x9d9484, dark = M(0x4b5a62, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.25 });
      const parts = [];
      // wing (slab) and connector
      parts.push({ g: extG(D.wing, WH - 0.8, 0), c: grey }); parts.push({ g: extG(D.wing, 0.8, WH - 0.8), c: roofC });
      parts.push({ g: extG(D.conn, CH - 0.8, 0), c: body }); parts.push({ g: extG(D.conn, 0.8, CH - 0.8), c: roofC });
      // drum: 56-sided cylinder
      const drumPts = []; for (let i = 0; i < 56; i++) { const a = i / 56 * Math.PI * 2; drumPts.push([dcx + Math.cos(a) * dr, dcz + Math.sin(a) * dr]); }
      parts.push({ g: extG(drumPts, DH - 0.8, 0), c: 0xd6cdb9 }); parts.push({ g: extG(drumPts, 0.9, DH - 0.8), c: roofC });
      // stepped roof terraces of the drum
      [[dr - 7, 2.2], [dr - 20, 3.4], [dr - 32, 2.6]].forEach(([rr, hh]) => { const ring = []; for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) { const a = i / 48 * Math.PI * 2; ring.push([dcx + Math.cos(a) * rr, dcz + Math.sin(a) * rr]); } parts.push({ g: extG(ring, hh, DH), c: 0xc9c0ad }); });
      // tower
      parts.push({ g: extG(D.tower, TH - 1.2, 0), c: 0xc4bba8 }); parts.push({ g: extG(D.tower, 1.2, TH - 1.2), c: roofC });
      K.mesh(mergeC(parts), VC({ roughness: 0.8 }));

      wallStrips(D.wing, 5, WH - 1.8, 3.05, 1.7, 5, 0.14, ws, 2.1, 1.2);
      wallStrips(D.tower, 38, TH - 2.4, 3.3, 1.8, 5, 0.14, wt, 2.4, 1.1);
      wallStrips(drumPts, 4, DH - 2.4, 3.55, 1.8, 2.5, 0.16, wd, 0, 0);
      wallStrips(D.conn, 4, CH - 2.4, 3.4, 1.7, 6, 0.14, ws, 2.4, 1.2);
      K.mesh(stripGeo(ws), dark); K.mesh(stripGeo(wt), dark); K.mesh(stripGeo(wd), M(0x3f4d55, { roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.3 }));
      // roof plant, antenna mast on the tower, lift/stair heads
      const tc = centroid(D.tower);
      K.box(9, 4.5, 8, M(0xb4ab99), tc[0] + 2, TH, tc[1] - 3, 0.7); K.box(5, 3, 5, M(0xb4ab99), tc[0] - 5, TH, tc[1] + 5, 0.7);

      K.cyl(3.2, 3.2, 3, M(0xb4ab99), dcx - 8, DH + 3.4, dcz + 8, 18); K.box(10, 3.5, 7, M(0xb4ab99), dcx + 12, DH + 2.2, dcz - 4, 0.6);
      const wc = centroid(D.wing); K.box(12, 4, 8, M(0xb4ab99), wc[0] + 6, WH, wc[1] - 8, 0.76); K.box(8, 3, 6, M(0xb4ab99), wc[0] - 12, WH, wc[1] + 14, 0.76);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;
  }
});
