const hash = (a, b) => { let h = (Math.imul(Math.round(a * 10), 73856093) ^ Math.imul(Math.round(b * 10), 19349663)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177) >>> 0; return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const BT = {};                                                          // batches: one mesh per material
const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };
const flush = () => { Object.keys(BT).forEach(k => { const b = BT[k]; if (!b.p.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3)); if (b.vc) g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); K.mesh(g, b.mat); b.p = []; b.n = []; b.c = []; }); };
const lin = hex => { const c = new THREE.Color(hex); c.convertSRGBToLinear(); return [c.r, c.g, c.b]; };
const mulc = (c, f) => [c[0] * f, c[1] * f, c[2] * f];
const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);
    const c = N[i + 1] > 0.5 ? roof : mulc(wall, 0.78 + 0.22 * Math.min(1, P[i + 1] / Math.max(h, 1))); b.c.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  if (bands && h > 8) { const sg = area2(pts) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = pts.length, bb = BT.bands;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }
};
const WALLS = [0xe6d3ac, 0xd9c29a, 0xd4b583, 0xcdbfa6, 0xdcb99b, 0xd2cabb, 0xeadfc6, 0xc4a478, 0xe0c9a0, 0xd6b487].map(lin);
const ROOFS = [0xa39a88, 0xb0a590, 0x948d80, 0xb5a78f].map(lin);
const inwin = (pts, H) => pts.some(p => Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H);

const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
const flatPoly = (b, pts, y, col) => { const v = pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v, []); tri.forEach(t => pushTri(b, [pts[t[0]][0], y, pts[t[0]][1]], [pts[t[1]][0], y, pts[t[1]][1]], [pts[t[2]][0], y, pts[t[2]][1]], [0, 1, 0], col)); };
const ROADS = { motorway: [0x3f4144, 10, 10, 0.17], primary: [0x424447, 10, 16, 0.14], secondary: [0x484a4d, 7.5, 12, 0.11], tertiary: [0x4e5053, 6, 9, 0.08], minor: [0x585a5c, 4.6, 5.8, 0.05], service: [0x626466, 3.8, 4.6, 0.04] };
function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}
const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };
    for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length]; if (inside(b)) { if (!inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); out.push(b); } else if (inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); } });
  return out; };

/* ---- Ramses (Misr) station building, station frame (origin 30.0626 N, 31.2467 E) ---- */
const STN = {
  hall: [[-50.2, -4], [-74.5, -49.1], [95.6, -136.4], [117.8, -92.3]],
  wings: [[-128.7, -34.3], [-105.5, -46.1], [-103.4, -42.5], [9.3, -101.5], [11.9, -97.4], [15.5, -99.4], [19.1, -92.3], [15.5, -90.2], [16, -89.2], [-71.4, -43.5], [-50.2, -4], [176.2, -122.5], [182.9, -109.7], [-59.5, 17.6], [-86.9, -33.8], [-87.9, -33.2], [-90.5, -38.4], [-116.8, -25], [-115.3, -21.9], [-120.5, -18.9]],
  glassTower: [[180.3, -131.3], [227.9, -154.4], [259.4, -91.7], [212.4, -68.7]],
  offices: [[-23.8, -155.9], [-16.1, -141], [-115.8, -89.2], [-123.6, -104.1]]
};
const inStation = c => pip(STN.hall, c[0], c[1]) || pip(STN.wings, c[0], c[1]) || pip(STN.glassTower, c[0], c[1]) || pip(STN.offices, c[0], c[1]);
function buildStation(ox, oz, full) {
  const stone = K.mat(0xe2d5b6), stoneD = K.mat(0xcdbb96), teal = K.mat(0x2f8f99, { roughness: 0.5 }), darkM = K.mat(0x45382f), glassM = K.mat(0x49707c, { roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.5 }), roofM = K.mat(0x8d7e6b, { roughness: 0.75 }), white = K.mat(0xf3f0e6), solar = K.mat(0x1d3550, { roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.5 });
  const archGeo = (w, h, d) => { const s = new THREE.Shape(), sp = h * 0.6; s.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, sp); s.quadraticCurveTo(w / 2, h * 0.92, 0, h); s.quadraticCurveTo(-w / 2, h * 0.92, -w / 2, sp); s.lineTo(-w / 2, 0);
    const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: d, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.translate(0, 0, -d / 2); return g; };
  return K.group(() => {
    const H = 19;
    // wings (OSM footprint) and hall walls
    const ring = (pts, h, m, y) => K.extrude(pts, h, m, y || 0);
    ring(STN.wings, H, stone);
    ring(STN.wings, 0.5, stoneD, H);                                                    // roof slab
    // great hall: stone walls + 5 low barrel roofs along the long axis
    const hc = cenOf(STN.hall), ang = 0.4746;
    ring(STN.hall, 15.5, stone);
    K.group(() => { for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) K.vault(10.1, 3.4, 188, roofM, 0, 15.4, i * 10.2, Math.PI / 2); K.box(190, 0.6, 51.2, stoneD, 0, 15, 0); }, hc[0], 0, hc[1], ang);
    K.group(() => { for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) K.box(188, 0.8, 0.5, stoneD, 0, 15.4, i * 10.2 + 5.1); for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) K.box(2.6, 1.0, 2.6, stoneD, k * 55, 19, 0); }, hc[0], 0, hc[1], ang);
    // facades (instanced details)
    const arcs = [], arcs2 = [], bandT = [], winA = [], winB = [], frames = [];
    const faceN = (A, B) => { const L = Math.hypot(B[0] - A[0], B[1] - A[1]), d = [(B[0] - A[0]) / L, (B[1] - A[1]) / L]; return { L, d, n: [-d[1], d[0]] }; };
    const place = (list, A, F, u, y, o, ry, sx, sy, sz) => list.push([A[0] + F.d[0] * u + F.n[0] * o, y, A[1] + F.d[1] * u + F.n[1] * o, ry, sx || 1, sy || 1, sz || 1]);
    // SE facade
    { const A = [-59.5, 17.6], B = [182.9, -109.7], F = faceN(A, B); const ry = Math.atan2(F.n[0], F.n[1]); const nb = Math.round(F.L / 5.3);
      for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) { const u = (i + 0.5) * F.L / nb; place(arcs, A, F, u, 0.2, 0.05, ry, 1, 1, 1); place(bandT, A, F, u, 5.3, 0.06, ry); place(winA, A, F, u, 6.5, 0.05, ry); place(winB, A, F, u, 12.2, 0.05, ry); place(winB, A, F, u, 15.4, 0.05, ry); }
      const mid = [A[0] + F.d[0] * F.L / 2 + F.n[0] * 0.5, A[1] + F.d[1] * F.L / 2 + F.n[1] * 0.5];
      K.box(F.L + 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, stoneD, mid[0], H - 0.7, mid[1], ry); K.box(F.L, 0.9, 0.6, stoneD, mid[0], 4.9, mid[1], ry); }
    // SW end facade with the portal and the clock tower
    { const A = [-86.9, -33.8], B = [-59.5, 17.6], F = faceN(A, B); const ry = Math.atan2(F.n[0], F.n[1]);
      [2.5, 7.5, 30.5, 36, 41.5, 47].forEach(u => { place(arcs, A, F, u, 0.2, 0.05, ry); place(bandT, A, F, u, 5.3, 0.06, ry); place(winA, A, F, u, 6.5, 0.05, ry); place(winB, A, F, u, 12.2, 0.05, ry); place(winB, A, F, u, 15.4, 0.05, ry); });
      const pc = [A[0] + F.d[0] * 19 + F.n[0] * 1.2, A[1] + F.d[1] * 19 + F.n[1] * 1.2];
      K.box(15, 22.5, 2.4, stone, pc[0], 0, pc[1], ry); K.box(15.8, 1.0, 3, stoneD, pc[0], 22.5, pc[1], ry); K.box(15.8, 1.0, 3, stoneD, pc[0], 14.2, pc[1], ry);
      K.group(() => { K.mesh(archGeo(7.6, 11.4, 1.4), darkM, 0, 0.1, 1.25); K.mesh(archGeo(4.2, 6.3, 1.4), K.mat(0x2b2018), 0, 0.1, 1.5); [-4.4, 4.4].forEach(dx => K.mesh(archGeo(1.8, 4.2, 0.8), darkM, dx, 7.2, 1.4)); [-3.2, 0, 3.2].forEach(dx => K.mesh(archGeo(1.5, 3.4, 0.8), darkM, dx, 16.2, 1.4)); K.box(10.5, 1.0, 0.3, teal, 0, 13.0, 1.3); }, pc[0], 0, pc[1], ry);
      // clock tower at the south corner
      const tw = [A[0] + F.d[0] * 54 - F.n[0] * 3.2, A[1] + F.d[1] * 54 - F.n[1] * 3.2];
      K.group(() => { K.box(8.4, 31, 8.4, stone, 0, 0, 0); K.box(9.6, 1.6, 9.6, stoneD, 0, 30.4, 0); K.box(9.0, 1.0, 9.0, stone, 0, 32, 0);
        [0, 1].forEach(f => { K.group(() => { K.box(5.4, 13.5, 0.25, teal, 0, 13, 4.25); K.mesh(archGeo(2.0, 5.2, 0.5), darkM, -1.35, 17.2, 4.4); K.mesh(archGeo(2.0, 5.2, 0.5), darkM, 1.35, 17.2, 4.4);
          K.mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.7, 1.7, 0.3, 24).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), white, 0, 24.5, 4.4); K.box(4.6, 5.4, 0.3, darkM, 0, 2.2, 4.3); }, 0, 0, 0, f ? Math.PI / 2 : 0); }); }, tw[0], 0, tw[1], ry); }
    if (arcs.length) { K.inst(archGeo(3.5, 4.5, 0.6), darkM, arcs); K.inst(K.boxGeo(3.5, 0.7, 0.3), teal, bandT); K.inst(archGeo(1.5, 3.0, 0.5), K.mat(0x3a4a50, { roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.4 }), winA); K.inst(K.boxGeo(1.3, 1.9, 0.4), K.mat(0x3a4a50, { roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.4 }), winB); }
    if (full) {
      // glass tower at the north-east end (OSM footprint, height estimated)
      K.extrude(STN.glassTower, 52, K.mat(0x6b8794, { roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.35 })); K.extrude(STN.glassTower, 1.2, K.mat(0x8f9594), 52);
      // offices block along the north-west side
      K.extrude(STN.offices, 15, stone); K.extrude(STN.offices, 0.6, stoneD, 15);
    }
  }, ox || 0, 0, oz || 0);
}

    const H = 230;
    K.group(() => {
      K.pad([[-H, -H], [H, -H], [H, H], [-H, H]], K.mat(0xb3a78d), -1.6, 1.6);
      batch("bld", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.02 }), true);
      batch("bands", K.mat(0x4b5a66, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.2 }), false);
      batch("grass", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true); batch("paved", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
      { const A = [-59.5, 17.6], n = [0.465, 0.885], B = [182.9, -109.7]; flatPoly(BT.paved, [A, B, [B[0] + 45 * n[0], B[1] + 45 * n[1]], [A[0] + 45 * n[0], A[1] + 45 * n[1]]], 0.03, lin(0xcfc4aa)); }
      drawRoads(D, { half: H }); drawBridges(D, H, 7.5);
      const gb = BT.grass; D.grass.forEach(g => { if (g.pts.length >= 3 && inwin(g.pts, H)) { const q = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.09, lin(0x6f9a5a)); } });
      // surrounding buildings (real footprints; heights estimated)
      const SKIP = [[-232, -10], [-158, 46]];
      D.bld.forEach((b, i) => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H) || inStation(c)) return; if (c[0] > SKIP[0][0] && c[0] < SKIP[1][0] && c[1] > SKIP[0][1] && c[1] < SKIP[1][1]) return;

const hash = (a, b) => { let h = (Math.imul(Math.round(a * 10), 73856093) ^ Math.imul(Math.round(b * 10), 19349663)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177) >>> 0; return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const BT = {};                                                          // batches: one mesh per material
const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };
const flush = () => { Object.keys(BT).forEach(k => { const b = BT[k]; if (!b.p.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3)); if (b.vc) g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); K.mesh(g, b.mat); b.p = []; b.n = []; b.c = []; }); };
const lin = hex => { const c = new THREE.Color(hex); c.convertSRGBToLinear(); return [c.r, c.g, c.b]; };
const mulc = (c, f) => [c[0] * f, c[1] * f, c[2] * f];
const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);
    const c = N[i + 1] > 0.5 ? roof : mulc(wall, 0.78 + 0.22 * Math.min(1, P[i + 1] / Math.max(h, 1))); b.c.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  if (bands && h > 8) { const sg = area2(pts) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = pts.length, bb = BT.bands;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }
};
const WALLS = [0xe6d3ac, 0xd9c29a, 0xd4b583, 0xcdbfa6, 0xdcb99b, 0xd2cabb, 0xeadfc6, 0xc4a478, 0xe0c9a0, 0xd6b487].map(lin);
const ROOFS = [0xa39a88, 0xb0a590, 0x948d80, 0xb5a78f].map(lin);
const inwin = (pts, H) => pts.some(p => Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H);

const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
const flatPoly = (b, pts, y, col) => { const v = pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v, []); tri.forEach(t => pushTri(b, [pts[t[0]][0], y, pts[t[0]][1]], [pts[t[1]][0], y, pts[t[1]][1]], [pts[t[2]][0], y, pts[t[2]][1]], [0, 1, 0], col)); };
const ROADS = { motorway: [0x3f4144, 10, 10, 0.17], primary: [0x424447, 10, 16, 0.14], secondary: [0x484a4d, 7.5, 12, 0.11], tertiary: [0x4e5053, 6, 9, 0.08], minor: [0x585a5c, 4.6, 5.8, 0.05], service: [0x626466, 3.8, 4.6, 0.04] };
function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}
const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };
    for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length]; if (inside(b)) { if (!inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); out.push(b); } else if (inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); } });
  return out; };

const STN = {
  hall: [[-50.2, -4], [-74.5, -49.1], [95.6, -136.4], [117.8, -92.3]],
  wings: [[-128.7, -34.3], [-105.5, -46.1], [-103.4, -42.5], [9.3, -101.5], [11.9, -97.4], [15.5, -99.4], [19.1, -92.3], [15.5, -90.2], [16, -89.2], [-71.4, -43.5], [-50.2, -4], [176.2, -122.5], [182.9, -109.7], [-59.5, 17.6], [-86.9, -33.8], [-87.9, -33.2], [-90.5, -38.4], [-116.8, -25], [-115.3, -21.9], [-120.5, -18.9]],
  glassTower: [[180.3, -131.3], [227.9, -154.4], [259.4, -91.7], [212.4, -68.7]],
  offices: [[-23.8, -155.9], [-16.1, -141], [-115.8, -89.2], [-123.6, -104.1]]
};
const inStation = c => pip(STN.hall, c[0], c[1]) || pip(STN.wings, c[0], c[1]) || pip(STN.glassTower, c[0], c[1]) || pip(STN.offices, c[0], c[1]);
function buildStation(ox, oz, full) {
  const stone = K.mat(0xe2d5b6), stoneD = K.mat(0xcdbb96), teal = K.mat(0x2f8f99, { roughness: 0.5 }), darkM = K.mat(0x45382f), glassM = K.mat(0x49707c, { roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.5 }), roofM = K.mat(0x8d7e6b, { roughness: 0.75 }), white = K.mat(0xf3f0e6), solar = K.mat(0x1d3550, { roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.5 });
  const archGeo = (w, h, d) => { const s = new THREE.Shape(), sp = h * 0.6; s.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, sp); s.quadraticCurveTo(w / 2, h * 0.92, 0, h); s.quadraticCurveTo(-w / 2, h * 0.92, -w / 2, sp); s.lineTo(-w / 2, 0);
    const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: d, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.translate(0, 0, -d / 2); return g; };
  return K.group(() => {
    const H = 19;
    // wings (OSM footprint) and hall walls
    const ring = (pts, h, m, y) => K.extrude(pts, h, m, y || 0);
    ring(STN.wings, H, stone);
    ring(STN.wings, 0.5, stoneD, H);                                                    // roof slab
    // great hall: stone walls + 5 low barrel roofs along the long axis
    const hc = cenOf(STN.hall), ang = 0.4746;
    ring(STN.hall, 15.5, stone);
    K.group(() => { for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) K.vault(10.1, 3.4, 188, roofM, 0, 15.4, i * 10.2, Math.PI / 2); K.box(190, 0.6, 51.2, stoneD, 0, 15, 0); }, hc[0], 0, hc[1], ang);
    K.group(() => { for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) K.box(188, 0.8, 0.5, stoneD, 0, 15.4, i * 10.2 + 5.1); for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) K.box(2.6, 1.0, 2.6, stoneD, k * 55, 19, 0); }, hc[0], 0, hc[1], ang);
    // facades (instanced details)
    const arcs = [], arcs2 = [], bandT = [], winA = [], winB = [], frames = [];
    const faceN = (A, B) => { const L = Math.hypot(B[0] - A[0], B[1] - A[1]), d = [(B[0] - A[0]) / L, (B[1] - A[1]) / L]; return { L, d, n: [-d[1], d[0]] }; };
    const place = (list, A, F, u, y, o, ry, sx, sy, sz) => list.push([A[0] + F.d[0] * u + F.n[0] * o, y, A[1] + F.d[1] * u + F.n[1] * o, ry, sx || 1, sy || 1, sz || 1]);
    // SE facade
    { const A = [-59.5, 17.6], B = [182.9, -109.7], F = faceN(A, B); const ry = Math.atan2(F.n[0], F.n[1]); const nb = Math.round(F.L / 5.3);
      for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) { const u = (i + 0.5) * F.L / nb; place(arcs, A, F, u, 0.2, 0.05, ry, 1, 1, 1); place(bandT, A, F, u, 5.3, 0.06, ry); place(winA, A, F, u, 6.5, 0.05, ry); place(winB, A, F, u, 12.2, 0.05, ry); place(winB, A, F, u, 15.4, 0.05, ry); }
      const mid = [A[0] + F.d[0] * F.L / 2 + F.n[0] * 0.5, A[1] + F.d[1] * F.L / 2 + F.n[1] * 0.5];
      K.box(F.L + 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, stoneD, mid[0], H - 0.7, mid[1], ry); K.box(F.L, 0.9, 0.6, stoneD, mid[0], 4.9, mid[1], ry); }
    // SW end facade with the portal and the clock tower
    { const A = [-86.9, -33.8], B = [-59.5, 17.6], F = faceN(A, B); const ry = Math.atan2(F.n[0], F.n[1]);
      [2.5, 7.5, 30.5, 36, 41.5, 47].forEach(u => { place(arcs, A, F, u, 0.2, 0.05, ry); place(bandT, A, F, u, 5.3, 0.06, ry); place(winA, A, F, u, 6.5, 0.05, ry); place(winB, A, F, u, 12.2, 0.05, ry); place(winB, A, F, u, 15.4, 0.05, ry); });
      const pc = [A[0] + F.d[0] * 19 + F.n[0] * 1.2, A[1] + F.d[1] * 19 + F.n[1] * 1.2];
      K.box(15, 22.5, 2.4, stone, pc[0], 0, pc[1], ry); K.box(15.8, 1.0, 3, stoneD, pc[0], 22.5, pc[1], ry); K.box(15.8, 1.0, 3, stoneD, pc[0], 14.2, pc[1], ry);
      K.group(() => { K.mesh(archGeo(7.6, 11.4, 1.4), darkM, 0, 0.1, 1.25); K.mesh(archGeo(4.2, 6.3, 1.4), K.mat(0x2b2018), 0, 0.1, 1.5); [-4.4, 4.4].forEach(dx => K.mesh(archGeo(1.8, 4.2, 0.8), darkM, dx, 7.2, 1.4)); [-3.2, 0, 3.2].forEach(dx => K.mesh(archGeo(1.5, 3.4, 0.8), darkM, dx, 16.2, 1.4)); K.box(10.5, 1.0, 0.3, teal, 0, 13.0, 1.3); }, pc[0], 0, pc[1], ry);
      // clock tower at the south corner
      const tw = [A[0] + F.d[0] * 54 - F.n[0] * 3.2, A[1] + F.d[1] * 54 - F.n[1] * 3.2];
      K.group(() => { K.box(8.4, 31, 8.4, stone, 0, 0, 0); K.box(9.6, 1.6, 9.6, stoneD, 0, 30.4, 0); K.box(9.0, 1.0, 9.0, stone, 0, 32, 0);
        [0, 1].forEach(f => { K.group(() => { K.box(5.4, 13.5, 0.25, teal, 0, 13, 4.25); K.mesh(archGeo(2.0, 5.2, 0.5), darkM, -1.35, 17.2, 4.4); K.mesh(archGeo(2.0, 5.2, 0.5), darkM, 1.35, 17.2, 4.4);
          K.mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.7, 1.7, 0.3, 24).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), white, 0, 24.5, 4.4); K.box(4.6, 5.4, 0.3, darkM, 0, 2.2, 4.3); }, 0, 0, 0, f ? Math.PI / 2 : 0); }); }, tw[0], 0, tw[1], ry); }
    if (arcs.length) { K.inst(archGeo(3.5, 4.5, 0.6), darkM, arcs); K.inst(K.boxGeo(3.5, 0.7, 0.3), teal, bandT); K.inst(archGeo(1.5, 3.0, 0.5), K.mat(0x3a4a50, { roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.4 }), winA); K.inst(K.boxGeo(1.3, 1.9, 0.4), K.mat(0x3a4a50, { roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.4 }), winB); }
    if (full) {
      // glass tower at the north-east end (OSM footprint, height estimated)
      K.extrude(STN.glassTower, 52, K.mat(0x6b8794, { roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.35 })); K.extrude(STN.glassTower, 1.2, K.mat(0x8f9594), 52);
      // offices block along the north-west side
      K.extrude(STN.offices, 15, stone); K.extrude(STN.offices, 0.6, stoneD, 15);
    }
  }, ox || 0, 0, oz || 0);
}

/* ---- Al-Fath Mosque (Ramses Square), built on the imagery footprint; 130 m minaret (Arab Contractors / Wikipedia) ---- */
function buildFath(x, z) {
  const stone = K.mat(0xdcc9a2), stoneD = K.mat(0xc9b48a), domeM = K.mat(0xd8cdb4, { roughness: 0.6 }), gold = K.mat(0xd9b45c, { roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.7 });
  return K.group(() => {
    // local frame: +X = north-east (bearing 45 deg), +Z = south-east
    K.group(() => {
      K.box(51, 14, 33, stone, 0, 0, 0); K.box(52.2, 1.0, 34.2, stoneD, 0, 14, 0); K.box(51, 0.7, 33, stoneD, 0, 8, 0);
      K.box(23, 11, 17, stone, 28, 0, -23); K.box(24.2, 0.9, 18.2, stoneD, 28, 11, -23);
      // domes: one large, four small (Wikipedia / Arab Contractors)
      K.cyl(9.6, 9.8, 2.2, stoneD, -8, 14.9, -3, 32); K.dome(9.5, domeM, -8, 17.1, -3, 1.08, 32); K.cyl(0.35, 0.35, 3.0, gold, -8, 27.2, -3, 8); K.sphere(0.7, gold, -8, 30.4, -3);
      [[-22, 8], [-8, 11.5], [-17, -12.5], [8, -2]].forEach(p => { K.cyl(4.4, 4.5, 1.4, stoneD, p[0], 14.9, p[1], 20); K.dome(4.3, domeM, p[0], 16.3, p[1], 1.1, 20); K.cyl(0.18, 0.18, 1.6, gold, p[0], 21, p[1], 6); });
    }, 0, 0, 0, Math.PI / 4 + 0);
    // minaret: square base, tapering shaft, two balconies, lantern
    K.group(() => {
      K.box(6, 28, 6, stone, 0, 0, 0); K.box(7, 0.8, 7, stoneD, 0, 28, 0);
      K.cyl(2.6, 3.3, 52, stone, 0, 28.8, 0, 8); K.cyl(3.6, 3.0, 1.2, stoneD, 0, 80, 0, 16); K.cyl(2.1, 2.4, 22, stone, 0, 81.2, 0, 8);
      K.cyl(3.0, 2.2, 1.2, stoneD, 0, 103, 0, 16); K.cyl(1.5, 1.8, 14, stone, 0, 104.2, 0, 8); K.cyl(2.2, 1.6, 1.0, stoneD, 0, 118, 0, 16);
      K.cyl(1.0, 1.3, 5, stone, 0, 119, 0, 8); K.dome(1.2, stoneD, 0, 124, 0, 1.6, 12); K.cyl(0.1, 0.1, 5.5, gold, 0, 125.5, 0, 6);
    }, 4.2, 0, -5.5);
  }, x, 0, z, 0);
}

    const H = 300, SZ = -121.6;                                           // window half-size; station origin lies 121.6 m north of this origin
    K.group(() => {
      K.pad([[-H, -H], [H, -H], [H, H], [-H, H]], K.mat(0xb3a78d), -1.6, 1.6);
      batch("bld", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.02 }), true);
      batch("bands", K.mat(0x4b5a66, { roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.2 }), false);
      batch("grass", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true); batch("paved", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, doubleSide: true }), true);
      { const A = [-59.5, 17.6 + SZ * 0 ], n = [0.465, 0.885], B = [182.9, -109.7]; const fc = [[A[0], A[1]], [B[0], B[1]], [B[0] + 45 * n[0], B[1] + 45 * n[1]], [A[0] + 45 * n[0], A[1] + 45 * n[1]]].map(p => [p[0], p[1] + SZ * -1 * -1]); flatPoly(BT.paved, fc, 0.03, lin(0xcfc4aa)); }
      drawRoads(D, { half: H }); drawBridges(D, H, 7.5);
      const gb = BT.grass; D.grass.forEach(g => { if (g.pts.length >= 3 && inwin(g.pts, H)) { const q = clipRect(g.pts, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.09, lin(0x6f9a5a)); } });
      const MQ = [-64.6, 186], inSt = c => inStation([c[0], c[1] - SZ]);
      const skip = c => inSt(c) || Math.hypot(c[0] - MQ[0], c[1] - MQ[1]) < 30 || (c[0] > -234 && c[0] < -156 && c[1] > -134 && c[1] < -74);
      D.bld.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H) || skip(c)) return; const r = hash(c[0], c[1]);
        const h = b.h && b.h !== 5 ? b.h : (b.a > 9000 ? 19 : 14 + Math.floor(r * 5) * 3.3 + (b.a > 1200 ? 3.3 : 0)); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), h, 0, WALLS[Math.floor(r * 97) % WALLS.length], ROOFS[Math.floor(r * 53) % ROOFS.length], null, true); });
      D.inf.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H) || skip(c)) return; const r = hash(c[0] + 3, c[1]); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), 15 + Math.floor(r * 5) * 3.3, 0, WALLS[Math.floor(r * 91) % WALLS.length], ROOFS[Math.floor(r * 37) % ROOFS.length], null, true); });
      addBuilding(STN.glassTower.map(p => [p[0], p[1] + SZ]), 52, 0, lin(0x7d98a4), lin(0x8f9594), null, true); addBuilding(STN.offices.map(p => [p[0], p[1] + SZ]), 15, 0, lin(0xe2d5b6), lin(0xcdbb96), null, true);
      flush();
      buildStation(0, SZ, false);
      buildFath(MQ[0], MQ[1]);
      // domes on the Ramses service complex (imagery positions)
      { const C = [-209.5, -79.5, -301.8, -108, -343.3, 24.6, -251.1, 53.1], cx = (C[0] + C[2] + C[4] + C[6]) / 4, cz = (C[1] + C[3] + C[5] + C[7]) / 4; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const x = C[i * 2] + (cx - C[i * 2]) * 0.1, z = C[i * 2 + 1] + (cz - C[i * 2 + 1]) * 0.1; if (Math.abs(x) < H - 8 && Math.abs(z) < H - 8) K.dome(5.2, K.mat(0xe0d6bd), x, 19, z, 1.0, 20); } }
      K.trees([[38, -8, 1], [44, -2, 1.1], [50, 4, 1], [42, 8, 0.9], [36, 2, 1], [48, -10, 1], [52, 12, 0.9], [40, 14, 1], [-22, 14, 1], [-14, 18, 0.9], [-8, 10, 1], [-18, 24, 0.9]].map(t => [t[0], t[1] + SZ, t[2]]), 8);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;

  }
});

const hash = (a, b) => { let h = (Math.imul(Math.round(a * 10), 73856093) ^ Math.imul(Math.round(b * 10), 19349663)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177) >>> 0; return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const BT = {};                                                          // batches: one mesh per material
const batch = (key, mat, vc) => BT[key] || (BT[key] = { mat, vc, p: [], n: [], c: [] });
const pushTri = (b, a, bb, c, nrm, col) => { { const ux = bb[0] - a[0], uy = bb[1] - a[1], uz = bb[2] - a[2], vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2]; const gx = uy * vz - uz * vy, gy = uz * vx - ux * vz, gz = ux * vy - uy * vx; if (gx * nrm[0] + gy * nrm[1] + gz * nrm[2] < 0) { const t = bb; bb = c; c = t; } } b.p.push(a[0], a[1], a[2], bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.n.push(nrm[0], nrm[1], nrm[2]); if (b.vc) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.c.push(col[0], col[1], col[2]); };
const quad = (b, a, bb, c, d, col) => { const u = [bb[0] - a[0], bb[1] - a[1], bb[2] - a[2]], v = [d[0] - a[0], d[1] - a[1], d[2] - a[2]]; let n = [u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]]; const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1; n = [n[0] / l, n[1] / l, n[2] / l]; if (Math.abs(n[1]) > 0.7 && n[1] < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; pushTri(b, a, bb, c, n, col); pushTri(b, a, c, d, n, col); };
const flush = () => { Object.keys(BT).forEach(k => { const b = BT[k]; if (!b.p.length) return; const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.p, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.n, 3)); if (b.vc) g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.c, 3)); K.mesh(g, b.mat); b.p = []; b.n = []; b.c = []; }); };

/* ribbon along a polyline at constant or per-vertex height; w = full width */
const offs = (pts, w) => pts.map((p, i) => { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1]; const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= l; dz /= l;
  let nx = -dz, nz = dx; if (i > 0 && i < pts.length - 1) { const a2 = pts[i - 1], b2 = pts[i]; let e1x = b2[0] - a2[0], e1z = b2[1] - a2[1]; const l1 = Math.hypot(e1x, e1z) || 1; e1x /= l1; e1z /= l1; const c = nx * (-e1z) + nz * e1x; const m = Math.max(0.55, c); nx = nx / m; nz = nz / m; const ln = Math.hypot(nx, nz); if (ln > 1.8) { nx *= 1.8 / ln; nz *= 1.8 / ln; } }
  return [[p[0] + nx * w / 2, p[1] + nz * w / 2], [p[0] - nx * w / 2, p[1] - nz * w / 2]]; });
const ribbon = (b, pts, w, y, col) => { const o = offs(pts, w); for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const y0 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i] : y, y1 = Array.isArray(y) ? y[i + 1] : y;
  quad(b, [o[i][0][0], y0, o[i][0][1]], [o[i + 1][0][0], y1, o[i + 1][0][1]], [o[i + 1][1][0], y1, o[i + 1][1][1]], [o[i][1][0], y0, o[i][1][1]], col); } };
/* walls along a polyline (strip from yb to yt) */
const strip = (b, pts, yb, yt, col) => { for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const yb0 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i] : yb, yb1 = Array.isArray(yb) ? yb[i + 1] : yb, yt0 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i] : yt, yt1 = Array.isArray(yt) ? yt[i + 1] : yt;
  quad(b, [pts[i][0], yb0, pts[i][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yb1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i + 1][0], yt1, pts[i + 1][1]], [pts[i][0], yt0, pts[i][1]], col); } };
const res = (pts, step) => { const out = [pts[0]]; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]), n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L / step)); for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n]); } return out; };
/* extruded building into a vertex-coloured batch; adds window bands */
const addBuilding = (pts, h, y0, wall, roof, bandCol, bands) => {
  const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const P = g.attributes.position.array, N = g.attributes.normal.array, b = BT.bld;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i += 3) { b.p.push(P[i], P[i + 1] + y0, P[i + 2]); b.n.push(N[i], N[i + 1], N[i + 2]);
    const c = N[i + 1] > 0.5 ? roof : mulc(wall, 0.78 + 0.22 * Math.min(1, P[i + 1] / Math.max(h, 1))); b.c.push(c[0], c[1], c[2]); }
  if (bands && h > 8) { const sg = area2(pts) > 0 ? 1 : -1, n = pts.length, bb = BT.bands;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], c = pts[(i + 1) % n], L = Math.hypot(c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]); if (L < 5) continue; const dx = (c[0] - a[0]) / L, dz = (c[1] - a[1]) / L; const nx = -dz * -sg, nz = dx * -sg; // outward normal (x east, z south)
      const e = 0.9, o = 0.06; const A = [a[0] + dx * e + nx * o, a[1] + dz * e + nz * o], C = [c[0] - dx * e + nx * o, c[1] - dz * e + nz * o];
      for (let y = 4.2; y < h - 1.2; y += 3.3) quad(bb, [A[0], y0 + y, A[1]], [C[0], y0 + y, C[1]], [C[0], y0 + y + 1.15, C[1]], [A[0], y0 + y + 1.15, A[1]], bandCol); } }
};
const WALLS = [0xe6d3ac, 0xd9c29a, 0xd4b583, 0xcdbfa6, 0xdcb99b, 0xd2cabb, 0xeadfc6, 0xc4a478, 0xe0c9a0, 0xd6b487].map(lin);
const ROOFS = [0xa39a88, 0xb0a590, 0x948d80, 0xb5a78f].map(lin);
const inwin = (pts, H) => pts.some(p => Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H);

const pip = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
const flatPoly = (b, pts, y, col) => { const v = pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])); const tri = THREE.ShapeUtils.triangulateShape(v, []); tri.forEach(t => pushTri(b, [pts[t[0]][0], y, pts[t[0]][1]], [pts[t[1]][0], y, pts[t[1]][1]], [pts[t[2]][0], y, pts[t[2]][1]], [0, 1, 0], col)); };
const ROADS = { motorway: [0x3f4144, 10, 10, 0.17], primary: [0x424447, 10, 16, 0.14], secondary: [0x484a4d, 7.5, 12, 0.11], tertiary: [0x4e5053, 6, 9, 0.08], minor: [0x585a5c, 4.6, 5.8, 0.05], service: [0x626466, 3.8, 4.6, 0.04] };
function drawRoads(D, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const HW = opt.half || 1e9; const br = batch("road", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96, doubleSide: true }), true);
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b === "tunnel") return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c !== "path") return;
    if (r.c === "rail") { if (opt.rail !== false) clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 12).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, 3.3, 0.06, lin(0x8c857a))); return; }
    if (r.c === "path") { if (r.b === "bridge" || r.s === "steps" || r.s === "corridor") return; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => ribbon(br, q, r.s === "pedestrian" ? 5 : 1.8, 0.05, lin(0xb3a88f))); return; }
    const k = ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]; clipRuns(r.pts, HW, 10).forEach(q => { if (r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary") ribbon(br, q, w + 3.2, 0.03, lin(0xb9ae98)); ribbon(br, q, w, k[3], lin(k[0]));
      if ((r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "motorway") && w >= 9.5) { const d = res(q, 3); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < d.length; i += 2) ribbon(br, [d[i], d[i + 1]], 0.18, k[3] + 0.035, lin(0xe9e5d9)); } }); });
}
const bridgeJoint = (D, p, same, half) => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) > half || Math.abs(p[1]) > half) return true; return D.roads.some(q => q !== same && q.b === "bridge" && q.c !== "path" && (Math.hypot(q.pts[0][0] - p[0], q.pts[0][1] - p[1]) < 5 || Math.hypot(q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][0] - p[0], q.pts[q.pts.length - 1][1] - p[1]) < 5)); };
function drawBridges(D, half, H, extra) {
  const bd = batch("deck", K.mat(0xffffff, { vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, doubleSide: true }), true), piers = [];
  D.roads.forEach(r => { if (r.b !== "bridge") return; const foot = r.c === "path"; const k = foot ? [0xb7b1a4, 2.4, 2.4, 0] : ROADS[r.c]; if (!k) return; const w = foot ? 3 : (r.ow ? k[1] : k[2]); const Hm = foot ? 5.6 : H;
    const runs = clipRuns(r.pts, half, 6); if (!runs.length) return; const pts = runs[0].length >= 2 ? runs.reduce((a, b) => (b.length > a.length ? b : a)) : runs[0], n = pts.length; const ja = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[0], r, half), jb = bridgeJoint(D, r.pts[r.pts.length - 1], r, half); const ramp = Hm / 0.055; const cum = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0], pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1])); const L = cum[n - 1];
    const ys = pts.map((p, i) => { let h = Hm; if (!ja) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + cum[i] / ramp * Hm); if (!jb) h = Math.min(h, 0.3 + (L - cum[i]) / ramp * Hm); return h; });
    const top = lin(foot ? 0x9d978b : k[0]), conc = lin(0xb9b4a8), dark = lin(0x6f6a62); const o = offs(pts, w); const Lp = o.map(q => q[0]), Rp = o.map(q => q[1]);
    ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), top); ribbon(bd, pts, w, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), dark); strip(bd, Lp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc); strip(bd, Rp, ys.map(y => y - 1.15), ys.map(y => y + 0.05), conc);
    const par = (E) => { strip(bd, E, ys.map(y => y + 0.05), ys.map(y => y + (foot ? 1.1 : 0.95)), conc); };
    par(Lp); par(Rp);
    if (!foot) ribbon(bd, pts, 0.5, ys.map(y => y + 1.0), conc);
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += Math.max(1, Math.round((foot ? 18 : 24) / 6))) if (ys[i] > 2.4) piers.push([pts[i][0], 0, pts[i][1], 0, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7, ys[i] - 1.15, foot ? 0.9 : 1.7]); });
  if (piers.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(1, 1, 1), K.mat(0xb3aea2), piers);
}

const clipRuns = (pts, H, step) => { const r = res(pts, step || 8), runs = []; let cur = []; r.forEach(p => { if (Math.abs(p[0]) <= H && Math.abs(p[1]) <= H) cur.push(p); else { if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); cur = []; } }); if (cur.length > 1) runs.push(cur); return runs; };

const cenOf = p => { let x = 0, z = 0; p.forEach(q => { x += q[0]; z += q[1]; }); return [x / p.length, z / p.length]; };

const clipRect = (pts, H) => { let out = pts.slice(); const edges = [[0, 1, H], [0, -1, H], [1, 1, H], [1, -1, H]];
  edges.forEach(e => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; const inside = p => e[1] * p[e[0]] <= e[2]; const isect = (a, b) => { const t = (e[1] * e[2] - a[e[0]]) / (b[e[0]] - a[e[0]]); const r = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t]; r[e[0]] = e[1] * e[2]; return r; };
    for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length]; if (inside(b)) { if (!inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); out.push(b); } else if (inside(a)) out.push(isect(a, b)); } });
  return out; };

    const H = 260;
    K.group(() => {
      K.pad([[-H, -H], [H, -H], [H, H], [-H, H]], K.mat(0xb3a78d), -1.6, 1.6);

        if (g.a > 250) { const bx = g.pts.map(p => p[0]), bz = g.pts.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...bx), x1 = Math.max(...bx), z0 = Math.min(...bz), z1 = Math.max(...bz); let n = Math.min(24, Math.round(g.a / 170)), k = 0;

      D.water.forEach(w => { const q = clipRect(w.pts, H); if (q.length >= 3) flatPoly(gb, q, 0.12, lin(0x3f8fb0)); });
      // surrounding buildings (real footprints; heights estimated, OSM-tagged ones used when present)
      const hs = (c, b) => { if (b.h && b.h !== 5) return b.h; if (Math.hypot(c[0] + 214, c[1] + 26) < 20 && b.a > 5000) return 20; return 14 + Math.floor(hash(c[0], c[1]) * 5) * 3.3 + (b.a > 1200 ? 3.3 : 0); };

      D.inf.forEach(b => { const c = cenOf(b.p); if (!inwin([c], H)) return; const r = hash(c[0] + 3, c[1]); addBuilding(clipRect(b.p, H), 15 + Math.floor(r * 5) * 3.3, 0, WALLS[Math.floor(r * 91) % WALLS.length], ROOFS[Math.floor(r * 37) % ROOFS.length], null, true); });
      flush();
      K.trees(trees, 9);
      // central plaza ring (imagery) and domes seen on the Central Post Office block and the corner tower

      const dm = K.mat(0xd7ccb0, { roughness: 0.6 });

    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    return K.root;

    /* ribbon along a 2D polyline [[x,z]...]; w = width (number|fn(i)), y = top height (number|fn(i)), t = thickness (number|fn(i)|0 = top face only) */
    H.ribbon = (acc, pts, w, y, t) => {
      const n = pts.length, F = (v, i) => (typeof v === "function" ? v(i) : v), L = [], R = [], LB = [], RB = [], N = [];
      const segN = i => { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; return [-dz / l, dx / l]; };
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { let a = i > 0 ? segN(i - 1) : segN(0), b = i < n - 1 ? segN(i) : segN(n - 2); let mx = a[0] + b[0], mz = a[1] + b[1]; const ml = Math.hypot(mx, mz) || 1; mx /= ml; mz /= ml;
        const dot = Math.max(0.55, mx * b[0] + mz * b[1]), hw = F(w, i) / 2 / dot, yy = F(y, i), tt = t ? F(t, i) : 0, p = pts[i];
        L.push([p[0] + mx * hw, yy, p[1] + mz * hw]); R.push([p[0] - mx * hw, yy, p[1] - mz * hw]); LB.push([p[0] + mx * hw, yy - tt, p[1] + mz * hw]); RB.push([p[0] - mx * hw, yy - tt, p[1] - mz * hw]); }
      for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { const s = segN(i); H.quad(acc, L[i], R[i], R[i + 1], L[i + 1], [0, 1, 0]);
        if (t) { H.quad(acc, L[i], L[i + 1], LB[i + 1], LB[i], [s[0], 0, s[1]]); H.quad(acc, R[i], R[i + 1], RB[i + 1], RB[i], [-s[0], 0, -s[1]]); H.quad(acc, LB[i], RB[i], RB[i + 1], LB[i + 1], [0, -1, 0]); } }
      if (t) { const s0 = segN(0), s1 = segN(n - 2); H.quad(acc, L[0], R[0], RB[0], LB[0], [-s0[1], 0, s0[0]]); H.quad(acc, L[n - 1], R[n - 1], RB[n - 1], LB[n - 1], [s1[1], 0, -s1[0]]); } };
    /* land = window minus water rings, scanline trapezoids (z strips) */
    H.land = (rings, xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax, yTop, yBot, dz) => {
      const iv = z => { const all = []; rings.forEach(r => { const xs = []; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { const a = r[i], b = r[(i + 1) % r.length]; if ((a[1] <= z && b[1] > z) || (b[1] <= z && a[1] > z)) xs.push(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])); }
          xs.sort((p, q) => p - q); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < xs.length; i += 2) all.push([xs[i], xs[i + 1]]); });
        all.sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]); const o = []; all.forEach(w => { if (o.length && w[0] <= o[o.length - 1][1]) o[o.length - 1][1] = Math.max(o[o.length - 1][1], w[1]); else o.push([w[0], w[1]]); }); return o; };
      const comp = W => { const out = []; let cur = xmin; W.forEach(w => { const a = Math.max(w[0], xmin), b = Math.min(w[1], xmax); if (b <= xmin || a >= xmax) return; if (a > cur) out.push([cur, a]); cur = Math.max(cur, b); }); if (cur < xmax) out.push([cur, xmax]); return out; };
      const gs = [];
      for (let z = zmin; z < zmax - 1e-6; z += dz) { const z1 = Math.min(z + dz, zmax); let A = comp(iv(z + 0.02)), B = comp(iv(z1 - 0.02)); if (A.length !== B.length) { const M = comp(iv((z + z1) / 2)); A = M; B = M; }
        for (let k = 0; k < A.length; k++) { const a = A[k], b = B[k]; if (a[1] - a[0] < 0.05 && b[1] - b[0] < 0.05) continue; gs.push(H.ext([[a[0], z], [a[1], z], [b[1], z1 + 0.1], [b[0], z1 + 0.1]], yTop - yBot, yBot)); } }
      return gs; };
    H.clip = (poly, x0, x1, z0, z1) => { let out = poly;
      const edge = (inside, inter) => { const inp = out; out = []; if (!inp.length) return; for (let i = 0; i < inp.length; i++) { const a = inp[i], b = inp[(i + 1) % inp.length], ia = inside(a), ib = inside(b);
        if (ia) out.push(a); if (ia !== ib) out.push(inter(a, b)); } };
      edge(p => p[0] >= x0, (a, b) => [x0, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (x0 - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])]);
      edge(p => p[0] <= x1, (a, b) => [x1, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (x1 - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])]);
      edge(p => p[1] >= z0, (a, b) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z0 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]), z0]);
      edge(p => p[1] <= z1, (a, b) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z1 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]), z1]);
      return out; };
    H.ground = (D, W, Y) => { /* buildings, grass, roads from embedded OSM data D; Y = ground top height */
      const cols = ["limestone", "sand", "stone", "concrete"], bg = [[], [], [], []];
      D.b.forEach((b, i) => { bg[Math.abs(Math.floor(i * 7 + b.p[0][0])) % 4].push(H.ext(b.p, b.h, Y)); });
      bg.forEach((g, i) => H.put(g, cols[i]));
      const gr = []; D.g.forEach(p => gr.push(H.ext(p, 0.12, Y))); H.put(gr, K.mat(0x6f9a63));
      const acc = H.acc(); D.r.forEach(r => H.ribbon(acc, r.p, r.w, Y + 0.06)); H.flush(acc, K.mat(0x4d5c66, {}));
      const pv = H.acc(); (D.pv || []).forEach(r => H.ribbon(pv, r.p, r.w, Y + 0.1)); H.flush(pv, "paving"); };

    const H = {};
    H.ext = (pts, h, y) => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); if (y) g.translate(0, y, 0); return g; };
    H.vprof = (pts, len, x, y, z) => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], p[1])));
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: len, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 4 }); g.translate(x, y, z - len / 2); return g; };

      gs.forEach(g => { pa.set(g.attributes.position.array, o); na.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o); o += g.attributes.position.array.length; });
      const r = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); r.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pa, 3)); r.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(na, 3)); return r; };
    H.put = (gs, m) => gs.length ? K.mesh(H.merge(gs), m, 0, 0, 0) : null;
    H.acc = () => ({ p: [], n: [] });
    H.quad = (acc, a, b, c, d, want) => {
      const tri = (p, q, r) => { const ux = q[0] - p[0], uy = q[1] - p[1], uz = q[2] - p[2], vx = r[0] - p[0], vy = r[1] - p[1], vz = r[2] - p[2];
        let nx = uy * vz - uz * vy, ny = uz * vx - ux * vz, nz = ux * vy - uy * vx; const L = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz); if (L < 1e-9) return; nx /= L; ny /= L; nz /= L;
        if (nx * want[0] + ny * want[1] + nz * want[2] < 0) { const t = q; q = r; r = t; nx = -nx; ny = -ny; nz = -nz; }
        acc.p.push(p[0], p[1], p[2], q[0], q[1], q[2], r[0], r[1], r[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) acc.n.push(nx, ny, nz); };

    H.ribbon = (acc, pts, w, y, t) => {
      const n = pts.length, F = (v, i) => (typeof v === "function" ? v(i) : v), L = [], R = [], LB = [], RB = [], N = [];
      const segN = i => { const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1], dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; return [-dz / l, dx / l]; };
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { let a = i > 0 ? segN(i - 1) : segN(0), b = i < n - 1 ? segN(i) : segN(n - 2); let mx = a[0] + b[0], mz = a[1] + b[1]; const ml = Math.hypot(mx, mz) || 1; mx /= ml; mz /= ml;
        const dot = Math.max(0.55, mx * b[0] + mz * b[1]), hw = F(w, i) / 2 / dot, yy = F(y, i), tt = t ? F(t, i) : 0, p = pts[i];

      return out; };

      const ys = i => YD + (YG + 0.2 - YD) * Math.min(1, cum[i] / (L * 0.9)); const keep = []; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { if (r[i][0] > x1 || r[i][0] < x0) break; keep.push(i); }

    H.flush(R1, conc); H.flush(R2, "road");
    if (sup.length) K.inst(K.boxGeo(2.0, 1, 2.0), concD, sup);

    return K.root;
  }

        });
        K.inst(shieldG, stoneD, sh.map(s => [s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3]]));
        K.box(6.2, 1.0, 0.3, stoneL, 0, 15.6, -1.9);                                      // inscription panel over the arch
        K.box(10.4, 1.0, 5, stoneD, 0, 0, -3.2);                                          // threshold paving
      }, 77.6, 0, 60.5, -40 * RAD);

      /* ---- wall running south-west from Bab al-Nasr (the eastern wall of the city) ---- */
      wall([73, 76], [46, 124], wt, wh);
    }, 0, 1.2, 0);
    merge(G);
    return K.root;

    const M = (c, o) => K.mat(c, o);
    const cc = Math.SQRT1_2;
    const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
    const inside = (pt, poly) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) { if ((poly[i][1] > pt[1]) !== (poly[j][1] > pt[1]) && pt[0] < (poly[j][0] - poly[i][0]) * (pt[1] - poly[i][1]) / (poly[j][1] - poly[i][1]) + poly[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
    const clipHP = (poly, a, b, d) => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < poly.length; i++) { const p = poly[i], q = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length]; const fp = a * p[0] + b * p[1] - d, fq = a * q[0] + b * q[1] - d;
      if (fp >= 0) out.push(p); if ((fp >= 0) !== (fq >= 0)) { const t = fp / (fp - fq); out.push([p[0] + (q[0] - p[0]) * t, p[1] + (q[1] - p[1]) * t]); } } return out; };
    const eg = (pts, h, y) => { const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 8 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y, 0); return g; };
    const mergeG = gs => { let n = 0; gs.forEach(g => (n += g.attributes.position.count)); const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), nor = new Float32Array(n * 3); let o = 0; gs.forEach(g => { pos.set(g.attributes.position.array, o * 3); nor.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o * 3); o += g.attributes.position.count; });
      const r = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); r.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); r.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); return r; };
    /* per-section batcher: instanced boxes (B), merged footprint extrusions (PAD), instanced arch openings (AR); flush() emits the draw calls */
    const mk = K => {
      const lists = new Map(), pads = new Map(), arches = new Map();
      const B = (m, w, h, d, x, y, z, ry) => { if (!lists.has(m)) lists.set(m, []); lists.get(m).push([x, y, z, ry || 0, w, h, d]); };
      const seg = (m, a, b, w, y, h) => { const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dz); B(m, len + 0.05, h, w, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, -Math.atan2(dz, dx)); };
      const PAD = (pts, m, y, t) => { if (pts.length < 3 || Math.abs(area2(pts)) < 2) return; if (!pads.has(m)) pads.set(m, []); pads.get(m).push(eg(pts, t, y)); };
      const AR = (m, w, h, d, x, y, z, ry) => { const k = m.uuid + "|" + w + "|" + h + "|" + d; if (!arches.has(k)) arches.set(k, { m, w, h, d, l: [] }); arches.get(k).l.push([x, y, z, ry || 0]); };
      const flush = () => {
        pads.forEach((gs, m) => K.mesh(mergeG(gs), m, 0, 0, 0));
        const unit = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0); lists.forEach((l, m) => K.inst(unit, m, l));
        arches.forEach(a => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); const r = a.w / 2; s.moveTo(-r, 0); s.lineTo(r, 0); s.lineTo(r, a.h - r); s.absarc(0, a.h - r, r, 0, Math.PI, false); s.lineTo(-r, 0);
          const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: a.d, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 8 }); g.translate(0, 0, -a.d / 2); K.inst(g, a.m, a.l); });
      };
      return { B, seg, PAD, AR, flush };
    };

    /* ------------- surrounding street-wall massing, lawns, trees, lane dashes (data in the model frame) ------------- */
    const buildContext = (K, M, D, o) => {
      const H = mk(K); const [x0, x1, z0, z1] = o.box; const F = o.focus;
      const cen = r => { let x = 0, z = 0; r.forEach(p => { x += p[0]; z += p[1]; }); return [x / r.length, z / r.length]; };
      const pal = [0xdacba6, 0xcfc5b2, 0xc8b898, 0xd6cdbc, 0xc2b399].map(c => M(c, { roughness: 0.92 }));
      const roofM = M(0x8e8b85, { roughness: 0.95 }), winM = M(0x3a4348, { roughness: 0.5 }), lawnM = M(0x68844a), dashM = M(0xeeeeea), roadEdge = M(0xb9b4a6);
      const bl = D.bld.filter(b => { const c = cen(b.p); return c[0] >= x0 && c[0] <= x1 && c[1] >= z0 && c[1] <= z1 && !(o.skipB && o.skipB(b, c)); });
      bl.forEach(b => { H.PAD(b.p, pal[b.c], 0, b.h); if (b.a > 140) H.PAD(b.p, roofM, b.h, 0.3); });
      // dark window ribbons on the street-facing walls of the buildings nearest the focus point
      bl.forEach(b => { const c = cen(b.p); if (Math.hypot(c[0] - F[0], c[1] - F[1]) > F[2] || b.h < 9) return; const P = b.p, n = P.length;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = P[i], q = P[(i + 1) % n]; const dx = q[0] - a[0], dz = q[1] - a[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (len < 6) continue;
          const mx = (a[0] + q[0]) / 2, mz = (a[1] + q[1]) / 2; let nx = dz / len, nz = -dx / len; if (inside([mx + nx * 0.5, mz + nz * 0.5], P)) { nx = -nx; nz = -nz; }

      D.grass.forEach(g => { const c = cen(g); if (c[0] < x0 || c[0] > x1 || c[1] < z0 || c[1] > z1 || (o.skipG && o.skipG(c))) return; H.PAD(g, lawnM, 0, 0.12); });
      // lane dashes along mapped streets (centre lines of two-way roads)
      (D.roads || []).forEach(r => { if (!(r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary" || (r.c === "minor" && !r.ow))) return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c === "minor") return;
        for (let i = 0; i < r.pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = r.pts[i], q = r.pts[i + 1]; const L = Math.hypot(q[0] - a[0], q[1] - a[1]); const ry = -Math.atan2(q[1] - a[1], q[0] - a[0]);

      H.flush();
      // trees (crowns traced from imagery)
      const tr = D.trees.filter(t => t[0] >= x0 && t[0] <= x1 && t[1] >= z0 && t[1] <= z1 && !(o.skipT && o.skipT(t)) && !bl.some(b => Math.abs(b.p[0][0] - t[0]) < 60 && Math.abs(b.p[0][1] - t[1]) < 60 && inside([t[0], t[1]], b.p)));

      return bl.length;
    };

    /* ------------- Misr Station (local frame: origin O_st; station axis a = 20.8 deg N of E toward the platforms, b = toward the SE) ------------- */

.6]],[[27.6,14.2],[27.8,16],[30.8,17.5],[31.1,18.3],[33.1,19.5],[34.5,19.5],[34.8,20.6],[36.5,20.8],[38.4,19.6],[38.8,17.6],[33.4,16.9],[32.4,14.8],[30.9,14.5],[30.4,13.5]],[[27.2,7.8],[23.2,7.3],[23.9,8.6],[23.4,12.3],[21.9,12.3],[19.2,14.2],[17.8,13],[18.4,11],[16.8,10.3],[17.2,11.8],[15.2,11.9],[16.2,14.9],[17.5,16.2],[21.5,15.5],[24.9,15.8],[24.2,14],[25.2,13],[24.8,10.9],[25.6,9.8],[27.1,9.5]],[[-3.6,-46.5],[-4.8,-46.7],[-5.4,-47.7],[-6.9,-47.1],[-6.6,-46.4],[-4.6,-45.8],[-3.4,-42.7],[-3.5,-40.7],[-5.2,-38.8],[-7.8,-39],[-11.6,-40.7],[-12.1,-41.8],[-11.5,-43.5],[-12.8,-43.7],[-18.1,-41.5],[-22.1,-38.8],[-24.4,-34.8],[-23.2,-32.2],[-21.9,-32.2],[-21.2,-35.7],[-18.9,-38],[-14.5,-39.8],[-11.5,-39.4],[-8.2,-36.1],[-3.6,-37.2],[-1.4,-40.4],[-2.2,-44.1]],[[-29.8,-66],[-32.8,-64.2],[-35.2,-61.2],[-36.5,-60.8],[-40.4,-55],[-43.5,-46.5],[-43.2,-43.5],[-44.2,-41.8],[-43.4,-40.1],[-43.1,-36.5],[-41.5,-34.1],[-40.4,-34.5],[-41.1,-43],[-39.4,-51.1],[-35.4,-58.4],[-28.9,-64.2],[-28.8,-65]],[[-20.1,-70],[-19.2,-68.1],[-9.8,-68.2],[-2.1,-65.5],[4.1,-61.4],[8.8,-55.1],[10.2,-55.8],[9.9,-57.7],[6.5,-62.2],[0.1,-67.4],[-10.1,-71.1],[-17.8,-71.1]]],"mon":[18.5,41.9]}};
    const M = (c, o) => K.mat(c, o);
    const cc = Math.SQRT1_2;
    const area2 = p => p.reduce((s, a, i) => { const b = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; return s + a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }, 0);
    const inside = (pt, poly) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) { if ((poly[i][1] > pt[1]) !== (poly[j][1] > pt[1]) && pt[0] < (poly[j][0] - poly[i][0]) * (pt[1] - poly[i][1]) / (poly[j][1] - poly[i][1]) + poly[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
    const clipHP = (poly, a, b, d) => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < poly.length; i++) { const p = poly[i], q = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length]; const fp = a * p[0] + b * p[1] - d, fq = a * q[0] + b * q[1] - d;
      if (fp >= 0) out.push(p); if ((fp >= 0) !== (fq >= 0)) { const t = fp / (fp - fq); out.push([p[0] + (q[0] - p[0]) * t, p[1] + (q[1] - p[1]) * t]); } } return out; };
    const eg = (pts, h, y) => { const sh = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? sh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : sh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(sh, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 8 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); g.translate(0, y, 0); return g; };
    const mergeG = gs => { let n = 0; gs.forEach(g => (n += g.attributes.position.count)); const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), nor = new Float32Array(n * 3); let o = 0; gs.forEach(g => { pos.set(g.attributes.position.array, o * 3); nor.set(g.attributes.normal.array, o * 3); o += g.attributes.position.count; });
      const r = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); r.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); r.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); return r; };
    /* per-section batcher: instanced boxes (B), merged footprint extrusions (PAD), instanced arch openings (AR); flush() emits the draw calls */
    const mk = K => {
      const lists = new Map(), pads = new Map(), arches = new Map();
      const B = (m, w, h, d, x, y, z, ry) => { if (!lists.has(m)) lists.set(m, []); lists.get(m).push([x, y, z, ry || 0, w, h, d]); };
      const seg = (m, a, b, w, y, h) => { const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dz); B(m, len + 0.05, h, w, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, y, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, -Math.atan2(dz, dx)); };
      const PAD = (pts, m, y, t) => { if (pts.length < 3 || Math.abs(area2(pts)) < 2) return; if (!pads.has(m)) pads.set(m, []); pads.get(m).push(eg(pts, t, y)); };
      const AR = (m, w, h, d, x, y, z, ry) => { const k = m.uuid + "|" + w + "|" + h + "|" + d; if (!arches.has(k)) arches.set(k, { m, w, h, d, l: [] }); arches.get(k).l.push([x, y, z, ry || 0]); };
      const flush = () => {
        pads.forEach((gs, m) => K.mesh(mergeG(gs), m, 0, 0, 0));
        const unit = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0); lists.forEach((l, m) => K.inst(unit, m, l));
        arches.forEach(a => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); const r = a.w / 2; s.moveTo(-r, 0); s.lineTo(r, 0); s.lineTo(r, a.h - r); s.absarc(0, a.h - r, r, 0, Math.PI, false); s.lineTo(-r, 0);
          const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: a.d, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 8 }); g.translate(0, 0, -a.d / 2); K.inst(g, a.m, a.l); });
      };
      return { B, seg, PAD, AR, flush };
    };

    /* ------------- surrounding street-wall massing, lawns, trees, lane dashes (data in the model frame) ------------- */
    const buildContext = (K, M, D, o) => {
      const H = mk(K); const [x0, x1, z0, z1] = o.box; const F = o.focus;
      const cen = r => { let x = 0, z = 0; r.forEach(p => { x += p[0]; z += p[1]; }); return [x / r.length, z / r.length]; };
      const pal = [0xdacba6, 0xcfc5b2, 0xc8b898, 0xd6cdbc, 0xc2b399].map(c => M(c, { roughness: 0.92 }));
      const roofM = M(0x8e8b85, { roughness: 0.95 }), winM = M(0x3a4348, { roughness: 0.5 }), lawnM = M(0x68844a), dashM = M(0xeeeeea), roadEdge = M(0xb9b4a6);
      const bl = D.bld.filter(b => { const c = cen(b.p); return c[0] >= x0 && c[0] <= x1 && c[1] >= z0 && c[1] <= z1 && !(o.skipB && o.skipB(b, c)); });
      bl.forEach(b => { H.PAD(b.p, pal[b.c], 0, b.h); if (b.a > 140) H.PAD(b.p, roofM, b.h, 0.3); });
      // dark window ribbons on the street-facing walls of the buildings nearest the focus point
      bl.forEach(b => { const c = cen(b.p); if (Math.hypot(c[0] - F[0], c[1] - F[1]) > F[2] || b.h < 9) return; const P = b.p, n = P.length;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = P[i], q = P[(i + 1) % n]; const dx = q[0] - a[0], dz = q[1] - a[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (len < 6) continue;
          const mx = (a[0] + q[0]) / 2, mz = (a[1] + q[1]) / 2; let nx = dz / len, nz = -dx / len; if (inside([mx + nx * 0.5, mz + nz * 0.5], P)) { nx = -nx; nz = -nz; }
          const ry = -Math.atan2(dz, dx); for (let y = 3.0; y + 1.5 < b.h - 0.4; y += 3.3) H.B(winM, len - 1.4, 1.35, 0.3, mx + nx * 0.1, y, mz + nz * 0.1, ry); } });
      D.grass.forEach(g => { const c = cen(g); if (c[0] < x0 || c[0] > x1 || c[1] < z0 || c[1] > z1 || (o.skipG && o.skipG(c))) return; H.PAD(g, lawnM, 0, 0.12); });
      // lane dashes along mapped streets (centre lines of two-way roads)
      (D.roads || []).forEach(r => { if (!(r.c === "primary" || r.c === "secondary" || r.c === "tertiary" || (r.c === "minor" && !r.ow))) return; if (r.b === "bridge" && r.c === "minor") return;
        for (let i = 0; i < r.pts.length - 1; i++) { const a = r.pts[i], q = r.pts[i + 1]; const L = Math.hypot(q[0] - a[0], q[1] - a[1]); const ry = -Math.atan2(q[1] - a[1], q[0] - a[0]);
          for (let t = 2; t + 3 < L; t += 9) { const m = [a[0] + (q[0] - a[0]) * (t + 1.5) / L, a[1] + (q[1] - a[1]) * (t + 1.5) / L]; if (m[0] < x0 || m[0] > x1 || m[1] < z0 || m[1] > z1 || (o.skipRoad && o.skipRoad(m))) continue; H.B(dashM, 3, 0.05, 0.18, m[0], 0, m[1], ry); } } });
      H.flush();
      // trees (crowns traced from imagery)
      const tr = D.trees.filter(t => t[0] >= x0 && t[0] <= x1 && t[1] >= z0 && t[1] <= z1 && !(o.skipT && o.skipT(t)) && !bl.some(b => Math.abs(b.p[0][0] - t[0]) < 60 && Math.abs(b.p[0][1] - t[1]) < 60 && inside([t[0], t[1]], b.p)));
      if (tr.length) K.trees(tr.map(t => [t[0], t[1], Math.min(2.2, Math.max(0.6, t[2] / 2.8))]), 7);
      return bl.length;
    };

    /* ------------- Misr Station (local frame: origin O_st; station axis a = 20.8 deg N of E toward the platforms, b = toward the SE) ------------- */
    const buildStation = (K, M, o) => {
      const H = mk(K); const TH = 0.3629, CA = Math.cos(TH), SA = Math.sin(TH);
      const XZ = (a, b) => [a * CA + b * SA, -a * SA + b * CA]; const AB = p => [p[0] * CA - p[1] * SA, p[0] * SA + p[1] * CA];
      const abP = o.poly.map(AB);
      const clipR = (a0, a1, b0, b1) => { let p = abP; p = clipHP(p, 1, 0, a0); if (p.length) p = clipHP(p, -1, 0, -a1); if (p.length) p = clipHP(p, 0, 1, b0); if (p.length) p = clipHP(p, 0, -1, -b1); return p.map(q => XZ(q[0], q[1])); };
      const rect = (a0, a1, b0, b1) => [[a0, b0], [a1, b0], [a1, b1], [a0, b1]].map(q => XZ(q[0], q[1]));
      const ext = (poly, h, m, y) => { if (poly.length < 3 || Math.abs(area2(poly)) < 1) return; K.extrude(poly, h, m, y); };
      const Ab = (m, la, h, lb, a, y, b) => { const p = XZ(a, b); H.B(m, la, h, lb, p[0], y, p[1], TH); };

        /* ---------- shared helpers (inline, no external deps) ---------- */
    const M = K.mat;
    const polyArea = p => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % p.length; a += p[i][0] * p[j][1] - p[j][0] * p[i][1]; } return a / 2; };
    const inPoly = (pts, x, z) => { let c = false; for (let i = 0, j = pts.length - 1; i < pts.length; j = i++) { if ((pts[i][1] > z) !== (pts[j][1] > z) && x < (pts[j][0] - pts[i][0]) * (z - pts[i][1]) / (pts[j][1] - pts[i][1]) + pts[i][0]) c = !c; } return c; };
    /* extruded footprint -> BufferGeometry (not added to the scene) */
    const extG = (pts, h, y, holes) => {
      if (polyArea(pts) > 0) pts = pts.slice().reverse();   /* outline CCW in shape space (x,-z) so holes are wound opposite */
      const s = new THREE.Shape(); pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? s.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : s.moveTo(p[0], -p[1])));
      (holes || []).forEach(hp => { const hh = new THREE.Path(); hp.forEach((p, i) => (i ? hh.lineTo(p[0], -p[1]) : hh.moveTo(p[0], -p[1]))); s.holes.push(hh); });
      const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: h, bevelEnabled: false, curveSegments: 8 }); g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); if (y) g.translate(0, y, 0); return g;
    };
    /* merge geometries (each may carry a colour) into one non-indexed geometry with vertex colours */
    const mergeC = list => {
      const pos = [], nor = [], col = []; const c = new THREE.Color();
      list.forEach(it => { const g = it.g.index ? it.g.toNonIndexed() : it.g; const p = g.attributes.position.array, n = g.attributes.normal.array; c.setHex(it.c === undefined ? 0xffffff : it.c); c.convertSRGBToLinear();
        for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { pos.push(p[i]); nor.push(n[i]); } for (let i = 0; i < p.length / 3; i++) col.push(c.r, c.g, c.b); });
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3)); g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3)); return g;
    };
    const VC = (o) => M(0xffffff, Object.assign({ vertexColors: true }, o || {}));
    /* vertical strips (window bands) on the outward faces of a footprint */
    const wallStrips = (pts, y0, y1, step, bh, minEdge, off, out, bay, gap) => {
      const n = pts.length; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % n]; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (L < (minEdge || 8)) continue;
        let nx = dz / L, nz = -dx / L; if (inPoly(pts, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2 + nx * 0.6, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + nz * 0.6)) { nx = -nx; nz = -nz; }
        const ux = dx / L, uz = dz / L, e = Math.min(1.4, L * 0.08); const bw = bay || (L - 2 * e), pitch = bw + (gap || 0); const nb = bay ? Math.max(1, Math.floor((L - 2 * e + (gap || 0)) / pitch)) : 1;
        const used = nb * pitch - (gap || 0), s0 = e + (L - 2 * e - used) / 2;
        for (let k = 0; k < nb; k++) { const t0 = s0 + k * pitch, t1 = t0 + bw;
          const ax = a[0] + ux * t0 + nx * off, az = a[1] + uz * t0 + nz * off, bx = a[0] + ux * t1 + nx * off, bz = a[1] + uz * t1 + nz * off;
          for (let y = y0; y + bh <= y1 + 0.01; y += step) {
            const P = [[ax, y, az], [bx, y, bz], [bx, y + bh, bz], [ax, y + bh, az]]; [0, 2, 1, 0, 3, 2].forEach(q => out.pos.push(P[q][0], P[q][1], P[q][2]));
            for (let q = 0; q < 6; q++) out.nor.push(nx, 0, nz); } } }
    };
    const stripGeo = out => { const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(out.pos, 3)); g.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(out.nor, 3)); return g; };
